descriptions.it: Job Description The opportunity We are looking for a passionate and proficient industrial specialist with expertise in power system analysis\/ management and high-level programming. In an inter-disciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation for different complex systems in power grid applications. Join our dynamic and motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all. How you'll make an impact You create impact:  Together with your team design innovative approaches for grid operation and deliver them as robust software modules You investigate:  Translate real power‑system problems into rigorous models and final solutions for the customers You take initiative:  Collaborate with a global and inter-disciplinary team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy to drive the development from concept to production You connect:  Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities, start-ups, and vendors to integrate diverse perspectives and stakeholder inputs You communicate:  Be able to clearly communicate concepts to software developers, implementation engineering teams and customers. Produce clear design docs and developer-facing examples\/ notebooks that enable reuse. Your background Master Electrical\/Power Systems Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Master's degree with equivalent industry experience Proven expertise in modelling and steady-state analyses of power grids demonstrated hands-on expertise applying these methods in software development. Knowledge in mathematical optimization applied to power systems, and modern numerical solvers is strongly desired (e.g., MIP\/NLP, stochastic; tools such as Gurobi, CPLEX, Ipopt). Experience with machine learning and\/or artificial intelligence technologies is a plus Proficiency in C#, C++, Rust or a similar high-level programming language is required; Python and\/or Matlab for analytics and fast prototyping are a plus. Experience building state-of-the-art software engineering techniques (version control, code reviews, testing, CI\/CD) and integrating solution algorithms into applications are beneficial (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). High performance computing skills such as parallel\/distributed computing, GPU, OpenMP or MPI would be beneficial Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity   More about us    We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.  We can provide more information during the recruitment process.    Are you ready for a new exciting challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don't delay – apply today!  Dbamy o przejrzystość i zgodność z wymogami prawnymi tak, aby każda osoba uczestnicząca w procesie rekrutacyjnym wiedziała, czego może się spodziewać na poszczególnych etapach. Po pomyślnym zakończeniu procesu przedstawimy wybranej osobie szczegóły dotyczące warunków finansowych oraz benefitów. Pozostałe elementy oferty zostaną przekazane przed podpisaniem umowy o pracę, tak by stworzyć możliwość spokojnego zapoznania się z nimi. * Klauzula obowiązuje wyłącznie na terenie Polski ,  zgodnie z lokalnymi przepisami prawa. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully. *Applicable  only for Poland lo

descriptions.it: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How you'll make an impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units\/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A\/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy's AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules. Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit. Compliance with AI governance and security standards. More about us At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives. Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:​ Competitive salary and incentives​ Well-being and care ​ Paid and unpaid leave​ Flexible work options ​ Benefits that support your financial security​ You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are emerging as critical infrastructure for modern data centers, particularly AI facilities, by providing high efficiency (up to 98.5%), compact, and intelligent power management. Unlike conventional transformers, SSTs utilize power electronics to convert medium-voltage grid power directly to 800V DC, significantly reducing footprint, increasing efficiency, and easing grid interconnection. Join us as a Global Product Specialist – Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of data center supply infrastructure, guiding both Hitachi Energy and clients toward smarter, greener, and more resilient operations. If you combine a solid understanding of relevant technologies with insight into customer value drivers—and can translate customer needs into actionable requirements that keep our solutions both innovative and aligned with client expectations—then this role is an excellent fit for you. How you´ll make an impact Conduct market evaluations, competitor analyses, and identify gaps in product, solutions, and services, while assessing Hitachi Energy's positioning Gather and analyze global standards, market requirements, customer needs, and values to contribute to the product roadmap Support the Global Product Manager in creating business cases for product, solutions, and service development projects Support global and local marketing teams in creating market communication materials, including assistance with new product launches Provide sales support, participate in customer meetings, and attend trade shows as required, ensuring the availability of appropriate training materials for internal and external use Drive technical solutions across Hitachi Energy's global footprint, following an annual cycle of activities to govern Global Product Management Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering, along with 10+ years of related experience preferred Prior experience in Product Management or Product Ownership within data centre domain, and knowledge of Solid-State Transformer (SST) technology Possess a technical mindset to serve as a technical expert, instilling customer confidence in the product and contributing to product design Ability to simplify and present the value proposition of a complex offering Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative business analysis Proficient in analyzing market potential through product segmentation, go-to-market channels, and developing business cases. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (20%) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity In your role as an On-site IT Service Specialist, you will   be responsible for   delivering Desk Side Support to IT users, specifically handling IT issues that require physical intervention. Your duties will extend to aiding incident resolution through collaboration with various support teams and groups within the IT department. You will play a critical role, serving as a representative of the IT organization, acting as the interface between the customer and other IT functions.   How you'll make an impact Diagnoses and resolves IT-related issues effectively and efficiently Ensures that computers are delivered in a 'ready-to-use' condition for IT users Provides ad-hoc training to users on common IT issues and guides them through self-service tools Handles warranty cases in collaboration with the appropriate Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) vendors Identifies and report potential risks that could impact the quality of OSS services Offers support to end users and ensure the functionality of IT equipment and software in meeting rooms and other user collaboration areas as part of desk-side support Adheres to prescribed OSS governance, which involves participating in meetings and following the escalation process, among other responsibilities Follows OSS procedures as outlined in the Runbook, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and knowledge articles   Your background Formal qualification in IT completed from an accredited university or college OR completed an apprenticeship in the field of   IT ​ Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, including the ability to communicate effectively with both business   and technical audiences in German and English. ​ Proactive and solution-oriented mindset   ​ Demonstrates an ability to work independently and is self-driven ​ Legal authorization to work in applied location is   required . We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in   the future for this role ​ More about us Hitachi Energy is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative work environment where people from different backgrounds come together to build innovative solutions for a more sustainable energy future.

You will play a critical role, serving as a representative of the IT organization, acting as the interface between the customer and other IT functions.   How you'll make an impact Diagnoses and resolves IT-related issues effectively and efficiently Ensures that computers are delivered in a 'ready-to-use' condition for IT users Provides ad-hoc training to users on common IT issues and guides them through self-service tools Handles warranty cases in collaboration with the appropriate Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) vendors Identifies and report potential risks that could impact the quality of OSS services Offers support to end users and ensure the functionality of IT equipment and software in meeting rooms and other user collaboration areas as part of desk-side support Adheres to prescribed OSS governance, which involves participating in meetings and following the escalation process, among other responsibilities Follows OSS procedures as outlined in the Runbook, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and knowledge articles   Your background Formal qualification in IT completed from an accredited university or college OR completed an apprenticeship in the field of   IT ​ Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, including the ability to communicate effectively with both business   and technical audiences in German and English. ​ Proactive and solution-oriented mindset   ​ Demonstrates an ability to work independently and is self-driven ​ Legal authorization to work in applied location is   required . We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in   the future for this role ​ More about us Hitachi Energy is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative work environment where people from different backgrounds come together to build innovative solutions for a more sustainable energy future.

descriptions.it: Unisciti al nostro team di ingegneria Dry Transformer, ti aiuterà a modellare i progetti di nuova generazione che migliorano la sicurezza, l'efficienza e la sostenibilità nelle applicazioni di potenza critica. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con R&D, produzione, qualità e supply chain per tradurre i requisiti dei clienti in soluzioni manifatturiere e vederli attraverso prototipi, test di tipo e rilascio seriale. Lavorando in progetti e standard globali, approfondirete le vostre competenze nei sistemi di isolamento, nella progettazione elettromagnetica e nelle prestazioni termiche, contribuendo alla digitalizzazione dei nostri processi di progettazione. Questo è un ruolo di alto impatto in cui il vostro lavoro consente direttamente elettricità affidabile per industrie e comunità in tutto il mondo. Produrre lo sviluppo di specifiche e modelli di progettazione, assicurando loro di soddisfare tutti gli standard e le normative pertinenti Condurre approfondite recensioni di progettazione e verifiche, implementando modifiche per elevare la qualità del progetto Monitor e gestire i tempi di progetto, assicurando che le pietre miliari di progettazione sono raggiunti e i progetti sono forniti su pianificazione Condurre valutazioni di rischio, sviluppare strategie di mitigazione, e cercare opportunità per le innovazioni di progettazione Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Joining our Dry Transformer engineering team, you'll help shape next generation designs that improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in critical power applications. You'll collaborate closely with R&D, production, quality, and supply chain to translate customer requirements into manufacturable solutions and see them through prototype, type testing, and serial release. Working across global projects and standards, you'll deepen your expertise in insulation systems, electromagnetic design, and thermal performance while contributing to the digitalization of our design processes. This is a high impact role where your work directly enables reliable electricity for industries and communities worldwide. How you'll make an impact Lead the development of design specifications and models, ensuring they meet all relevant standards and regulations Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality Monitor and manage project timelines, ensuring design milestones are achieved and projects are delivered on schedule Conduct risk assessments, develop mitigation strategies, and seek opportunities for design innovations Engage with customers to capture and incorporate their feedback into design solutions, enhancing customer satisfaction Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components Prepare and maintain detailed documentation that supports design processes and facilitates knowledge sharing Identify and implement continuous design improvements based on test results and industry best practices, enhancing quality and efficiency Your background Degree in electrical engineering or a related field 2-5 years of experience in electrical design engineering of dry type transformers Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team English is a must, Italian is beneficial Pro-active attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Mit unserem Dry Transformer Engineering Team können Sie Designs der nächsten Generation gestalten, die Sicherheit, Effizienz und Nachhaltigkeit in kritischen Leistungsanwendungen verbessern. Sie arbeiten eng mit F&D, Produktion, Qualität und Lieferkette zusammen, um die Kundenanforderungen in manufakturierbare Lösungen zu übersetzen und durch Prototypen, Mustertests und Serienfreigabe zu sehen. In der Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Projekten und Standards vertiefen Sie Ihr Know-how in Isolationssystemen, elektromagnetischem Design und thermischer Leistung und tragen zur Digitalisierung unserer Designprozesse bei. Dies ist eine wichtige Rolle, in der Ihre Arbeit direkt zuverlässigen Strom für Industrien und Gemeinden weltweit ermöglicht. Wie Sie eine Wirkung machen Führen Sie die Entwicklung von Design-Spezifikationen und -Modelle, um sicherzustellen, dass sie alle relevanten Standards und Vorschriften erfüllen Durchführung gründliche Design-Bewertungen und -Verifikationen, Umsetzung von Änderungen zur Erhöhung der Projektqualität Überwachung und Verwaltung von Projekt-Zeitplänen, sicherzustellen, dass Design-Meilen erreicht werden und Projekte auf Zeitplan durchgeführt werden. Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: L'occasion De vous joindre à notre équipe d'ingénierie de Transformateur Dry, vous aiderez à façonner des conceptions de prochaine génération qui améliorent la sécurité, l'efficacité et la durabilité dans les applications énergétiques critiques. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec la R-D, la production, la qualité et la chaîne d'approvisionnement afin de traduire les exigences des clients en solutions de fabrication et de les voir par prototype, essai de type et libération en série. En travaillant sur des projets et des normes mondiaux, vous approfondirez votre expertise en systèmes d'isolation, conception électromagnétique et performance thermique tout en contribuant à la numérisation de nos processus de conception. Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact où votre travail permet directement une électricité fiable pour les industries et les collectivités du monde entier. Comment vous ferez un impact Dirigez l'élaboration de spécifications et de modèles de conception, en s'assurant qu'ils répondent à toutes les normes et réglementations pertinentes Effectuez des examens et des vérifications de conception approfondis, implantez des modifications pour améliorer la qualité des projets Surveillez et gérez les échéanciers des projets, en veillant à ce que les étapes de la conception soient franchies et que les projets soient exécutés dans les délais prescrits Mener des évaluations des risques, élaborer des stratégies d'atténuation et rechercher des occasions d'innovations en matière de conception Engagez les clients à saisir et à intégrer leurs commentaires dans les solutions de conception, à améliorer la satisfaction des clients Collaborez avec l'équipe de la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour s'assurer que les conceptions sont manufacturables et rentables, en choisissant des matériaux et des composants optimaux Préparer et maintenir une documentation détaillée qui appuie les processus de conception et facilite le partage des connaissances Identifier et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations de conception continues fondées sur les résultats des essais et les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie, améliorer la qualité et l'efficacité Vos antécédents en génie électrique ou dans un domaine connexe 2-5 ans d'expérience en génie électrique des transformateurs à sec Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our dynamic Business R&D team in Turgi, where we develop cutting-edge medium-voltage frequency converters and HVDC subsystems. You'll work in a collaborative environment with six power electronics engineers and three mechanical engineers, contributing to innovative solutions that have a global impact. This position combines 60% R&D and 40% production engineering, offering flexibility for research activities and hands-on involvement in manufacturing processes. How you'll make an impact • Research & Development (60%) Drive innovation in medium-voltage converter design and technology Develop and build from prototype until the final product Collaborate with global teams in Poland, Sweden, India and China Work arrangement: Flexible (remote or on-site as needed) • Production Engineering (40%) Ensure seamless integration of designs into manufacturing processes Optimize production workflows for efficiency and quality Provide technical support to production teams and troubleshoot issues Work arrangement: On-site presence required at our factories in Turgi and Seon Lead & implement lean management and CIP methodology Your background Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field Experience in power electronics and converter technology Experience in mechanical design and development, with tools like SolidEdge, NX, SAP Knowledge of production processes and industrialization Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and teamwork abilities Fluent in English and German What We Offer Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. We also offer you: Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers Numerous exciting career and training opportunities within Hitachi Energy Discounted conditions in our daycare centres in Baden and Oerlikon Extra days off between Christmas and New Year Subsidized meals at locations with canteens Discounts on memberships at various fitness centers Additional perks such as credit cards, petrol benefits, and more Additional perks such as credit cards, petrol benefits, and more

descriptions.it: Descrizione La capacità di lavorare come Senior Key Account Manager significa che si assume la responsabilità di un cliente strategicamente importante nel campo dell'infrastruttura energetica svizzera. Essi operano in un ambiente stimolante e tecnicamente sagomato e lavorano a stretto contatto con aree specialistiche interne per sviluppare soluzioni sostenibili e partnership a lungo termine. Il focus di questo ruolo è sul supporto operativo e strategico del cliente, compresa la gestione attiva delle offerte e dei processi teneri. Mansioni - Responsabilità per un cliente strategicamente importante nel settore delle infrastrutture energetiche svizzere - Cooperazione con i dipartimenti interni per lo sviluppo di soluzioni sostenibili e partnership a lungo termine - Supporto operativo e strategico del cliente - Leadership delle offerte e dei processi teneri - Interfaccia centrale tra cliente e Hitachi Energy - Garantire una performance professionale di Hitachi Energy contro un giocatore centrale dell'approvvigionamento energetico svizzero - Stabilimento e manutenzione di relazioni resilienti a lungo termine con gli stakeholder pertinenti a tutti i livelli gerarchici, compresi i livelli C - Sviluppo e realizzazione di una strategia di conto e crescita specifica per il cliente (posizione di mercato, pipeline, previsione, ambiente competitivo) - Chiudere la cooperazione con le unità e le funzioni aziendali interne (vendita, ingegneria, project management, servizio ecc.) per una soluzione ottimale e offrire design - Applicazione e sviluppo di processi e strumenti standardizzati di vendita e CRM (ad esempio Salesforce, Account Plans, KPI) - Leader professionale delle gare locali – dalla strategia di gara alla fase di negoziazione alla conclusione del contratto • Requisiti - Studi universitari completi in ingegneria o qualifiche comparabili - Ulteriori competenze di gestione auspicabili - Esperienza a lungo termine nella gestione dei conti chiave o nella distribuzione di soluzioni tecniche complesse, idealmente nei settori della generazione di energia, delle reti di trasmissione e distribuzione, delle società di approvvigionamento energetico o dei data center - La conoscenza del portafoglio prodotti di Hitachi Energy è auspicabile - comprovata esperienza nella gestione di complesse relazioni con i clienti e nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie di vendita - In una manovra di successo nelle strutture di un grande gruppo e leader di mercato - Trovata esperienza nel trattamento e nella gestione di avvisi complessi - Capacità di lavorare in modo operativo dettagliato e di eseguire in modo sicuro al livello di gestione superiore - Ottima conoscenza delle vendite popolari, CRM e strumenti di ufficio - competenze linguistiche tedesche in parola e scrittura; conoscenza inglese fluente; conoscenza francese del vantaggio Cosa? - ruolo chiave in un player centrale nell'infrastruttura energetica svizzera - Spazio di design elevato con influenza diretta sul rapporto di lavoro e sul successo del mercato - Una stretta collaborazione con esperti e decisori esperti all'interno di Hitachi Energy - Opportunità di sviluppo e di carriera interessanti in una società tecnologica leader a livello globale - Contributo a un approvvigionamento energetico sicuro, sostenibile e sostenibile Contatto - [Inserisci quiere informazioni di contatto]
descriptions.en: Descrizione The ability to work as a Senior Key Account Manager means that you take responsibility for a strategically important customer in the field of Swiss energy infrastructure. They operate in a challenging, technically shaped environment and work closely with internal specialist areas to develop sustainable solutions and long-term partnerships. The focus of this role is on the customer's operational and strategic support, including the active management of tenders and tender processes. Mansioni - Responsibility for a strategically important customer in the field of Swiss energy infrastructure - Cooperation with internal departments for the development of sustainable solutions and long-term partnerships - Operating and strategic support of the customer - Leadership of tenders and tender processes - Central interface between customer and Hitachi Energy - Ensuring a professional performance by Hitachi Energy against a central player of the Swiss energy supply - Establishment and maintenance of long-term, resilient relationships with relevant stakeholders at all hierarchical levels, including C levels - Development and implementation of a customer-specific account and growth strategy (market positioning, pipeline, forecast, competitive environment) - Close cooperation with internal business units and functions (sales, engineering, project management, service etc.) for optimal solution and offer design - Application and development of standardized sales and CRM processes and tools (e.g. Salesforce, Account Plans, KPIs) - Professional leadership of local tenders – from the tender strategy to the negotiation phase to the conclusion of the contract • Requisiti - Complete university studies in engineering or comparable qualifications - Additional management skills desirable - Long-term experience in key account management or the distribution of complex technical solutions, ideally in the fields of energy generation, transmission and distribution networks, energy supply companies or data centers - Knowledge of Hitachi Energy's product portfolio is desirable - proven experience in the management of complex customer relationships and in the development and implementation of sales strategies - In successful manoeuvring in the structures of a large group and market leader - Found experience in the processing and management of complex alerts - Ability to work operationally detailed and to perform safely at top management level - Very good knowledge of popular sales, CRM and office tools - German language skills in word and writing; flowing English knowledge; French knowledge of advantage • Cosa offriamo - Key role in a central player in the Swiss energy infrastructure - High design space with direct influence on business relationship and market success - Close cooperation with experienced experts and decision-makers within Hitachi Energy - Attractive development and career opportunities in a globally leading technology company - Contribution to a secure, sustainable and sustainable energy supply Contatto - [Inserisci quiere informazioni di contatto]
descriptions.de: ## Descrizione Die Möglichkeit, als Senior Key Account Manager zu arbeiten, bedeutet, dass Sie die Verantwortung für einen strategisch bedeutenden Kunden im Bereich der Schweizer Energieinfrastruktur übernehmen. Sie agieren dabei in einem anspruchsvollen, technisch geprägten Umfeld und arbeiten eng mit internen Fachbereichen zusammen, um nachhaltige Lösungen und langfristige Partnerschaften zu entwickeln. Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt in der operativen und strategischen Betreuung des Kunden inklusive der aktiven Führung von Ausschreibungen und Angebotsprozessen. ## Mansioni - Verantwortung für einen strategisch bedeutenden Kunden im Bereich der Schweizer Energieinfrastruktur - Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen zur Entwicklung nachhaltiger Lösungen und langfristiger Partnerschaften - Operative und strategische Betreuung des Kunden - Führung von Ausschreibungen und Angebotsprozessen - Zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Hitachi Energy - Sicherstellung eines professionellen Auftritts von Hitachi Energy gegenüber einem zentralen Akteur der Schweizer Energieversorgung - Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger, belastbarer Beziehungen zu relevanten Stakeholdern des Kunden auf allen Hierarchieebenen, einschließlich C-Level - Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer kundenspezifischen Account- und Wachstumsstrategie (Marktpositionierung, Pipeline, Forecast, Wettbewerbsumfeld) - Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Business Units und Funktionen (Sales, Engineering, Projektmanagement, Service etc.) zur optimalen Lösungs- und Angebotsgestaltung - Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung standardisierter Sales- und CRM-Prozesse und -Tools (z. B. Salesforce, Account Pläne, KPIs) - Fachliche Führung lokaler Ausschreibungen (Tenders) – von der Angebotsstrategie über die Verhandlungsphase bis zum Vertragsabschluss ## • Requisiti - Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation - Ergänzende Managementqualifikation wünschenswert - Langjährige Erfahrung im Key Account Management oder im Vertrieb komplexer technischer Lösungen, idealerweise in den Bereichen Energieerzeugung, Übertragungs- und Verteilnetze, Energieversorgungsunternehmen oder Rechenzentren - Kenntnisse des Produktportfolios von Hitachi Energy sind wünschenswert - Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Management komplexer Kundenbeziehungen sowie in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Vertriebsstrategien - Versiert im erfolgreichen Manövrieren in den Strukturen eines Grosskonzerns und Marktführers - Fundierte Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung und Führung von komplexen Ausschreibungen - Fähigkeit, operativ detailnah zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig auf Top-Management-Ebene sicher aufzutreten - Sehr gute Kenntnisse gängiger Sales-, CRM- und Office-Tools - Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil ## • Cosa offriamo - Schlüsselrolle bei einem zentralen Akteur der Schweizer Energieinfrastruktur - Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum mit direktem Einfluss auf Geschäftsbeziehung und Markterfolg - Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Expertinnen und Experten sowie Entscheidungsträgern innerhalb von Hitachi Energy - Attraktive Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten in einem global führenden Technologieunternehmen - Beitrag zu einer sicheren, nachhaltigen und zukunftsfähigen Energieversorgung ## Contatto - [Inserisci quiere informazioni di contatto]

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a Global Product Specialist for mainstream business of Dry-type transformers to join our innovative team in any of these locations: Raleigh\/USA, Bland\/USA, Savli\/India, Vadodara\/India, Cheonan\/South Korea, Zaragoza\/Spain, Shanghai\/China. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting the global product manager in managing the dry-type transformer product portfolio, conducting comprehensive market\/segment technical analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct comprehensive market\/segment technical analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the transformer portfolio. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on dry type transformers. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap and technical requirement specifications. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. descriptions.it: The Opportunity Business Unit Service is at the forefront of delivering advanced digital and outcome ‑ based service solutions worldwide. Our Service R&D organization develops next ‑ generation digital, data ‑ driven, and OT ‑ integrated service solutions that enable long ‑ term asset performance, reliability, and operational excellence across the energy and industrial domain. As Lead Data Platform Architect, you will play a key role in defining and evolving the data platform foundation that underpins BU Service digital service solutions. You will ensure that data platforms spanning cloud services, IoT and OT data sources, analytics, and AI enablement are architected, governed, and operated to support scalable, secure, and high ‑ quality digital solutions. This role directly impacts the success of data ‑ driven services, advanced analytics, and AI ‑ powered use cases, where data quality, availability, and reliability are critical for business value and customer trust. How You'll Make an Impact Defining and owning the data platform strategy and architecture for digital service solutions, covering cloud ‑ native data platforms, data lakes\/ lakehouses , streaming and batch pipelines, and analytics services. Establishing architectural principles and standards aligned with modern cloud delivery models, industrial scalability, and long ‑ lifecycle service solutions. Governing data ingestion and integration patterns from cloud services, enterprise systems, IoT, OT devices, and edge software. Designing and maintaining data models, schemas, and integration patterns that ensure consistent, reusable, and high ‑ quality data across solutions. Establishing and operating data governance frameworks, including data quality, lineage, traceability, ownership, and lifecycle management. Ensuring compliance with cybersecurity, regulatory, and industrial data handling requirements. Enabling advanced analytics, AI\/ML, and digital twin use cases through appropriate data platform capabilities, pipelines, and analytics services. Guiding implementation of robust, scalable data pipelines and storage solutions in collaboration with development, platform, DevOps, AI, cybersecurity, and IT teams. Integrating data platform components into CI\/CD pipelines, supporting automated testing, deployment, and governance controls. Defining and monitoring key metrics related to data quality, platform reliability, usage, and business impact. Your Background University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. Proven experience in designing, implementing, or governing cloud ‑ based data platforms in complex digital or industrial environments. Strong understanding of data modeling, data pipelines, and data lifecycle management. Experience with data ingestion from IoT, OT, and enterprise systems. Solid knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and traceability concepts. Experience working in agile, hybrid, or scaled development environments. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across global, cross ‑ functional teams What's in It for You A strategic leadership role where your work directly shapes the quality and reliability of next ‑ generation digital service solutions The opportunity to operate at enterprise scale, influencing standards, capabilities, and ways of working beyond individual projects A collaborative, technology ‑ driven environment with strong links to innovation, R&D, and service transformation Exposure to complex, real ‑ world digital challenges across cloud, edge, and industrial domains A role designed for experienced professionals who want to combine technical depth with organizational leadership and strategic impact More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbei

Le do concurrente in meccanica, automazion e tecnologia di controllo ti permettono di analizzare efficacemente le interruzioni e di implementare soluzioni sostenibili. Lavora strettamente con divers interfacce e contribuisci alla continuua evoluzione della nostra infrastruttura tecnologica. La nostra locale divisione Isolation & Components è leader di mercato nel setore della progettazione e produzione di isolamenti e componenti per trasformatori. I nostri clienti includono aziende internazioni di settore elettrico che si occupationo di generazione, trasmissione e distribuzione dell'elettricità. Le nostre isolazioni ad alta tensione occupationano una posizione di leadership a livello mondiale. questo puoi ottenere attraverso la manutenzione meccanica delle macchine e degli impianti, la manutenzione e revisione delle macchine e degli impianti, la ricerca e risoluzione delle interruzioni, la manutenzione e l'ottimizzazione questo richardiede una formazione di base come macchinista nel campo della mecatronica, costruzione di macchine e impianti o costruzione di strumenti, espérienza lavorativa nella manutenzione e riparazione delle macchine e degli impianti, concurrentze nel campo dell'automazione.

descriptions.it: Descrizione L'opportunità Come tecnico di servizio di campo, si giocherà un ruolo chiave nel mantenere il funzionamento affidabile dei trasformatori di trazione attraverso i siti dei clienti e nella nostra fabbrica. Potrai eseguire riparazioni hands-on, diagnosticare problemi tecnici e supportare i clienti direttamente. Con la tua esperienza pratica, collaborerai a stretto contatto con i team interni e contribuirai al miglioramento continuo del prodotto e del processo. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Seguire sempre gli standard di sicurezza e le procedure aziendali durante entrambe le attività del settore (60%) e della fabbrica (40%). - Eseguire riparazioni in loco e la manutenzione di trasformatori di trazione, fornendo soluzioni rapide e professionali. - Condurre riparazioni sul campo, test diagnostici elettrici e trattamento dell'olio nelle sedi dei clienti. - Sostenere le indagini in caso di insuccesso attraverso lo smontaggio, l'analisi delle cause della radice e la preparazione dei rapporti tecnici. - Fornire ai clienti supporto tecnico e formazione sul funzionamento delle attrezzature e manutenzione di base. - Contribuire a piccoli progetti di miglioramento volti a migliorare qualità, efficienza e processi di servizio. - Preparare la documentazione di servizio, compresi i rapporti di lavoro, l'uso del materiale, le carte di ispezione di qualità e i registri di riparazione. - Collaborare con team di ingegneria, qualità, project management e vendita per risolvere problemi tecnici escalati. - In fabbrica, garantire un coordinamento efficace e l'esecuzione del lavoro di riparazione insieme al team di assistenza. Il tuo sfondo - Completato l'apprendistato tecnico o la laurea in campo elettrico/elettrotecnico/manutenzione. - Minimo di 1-2 anni di servizio sul campo o esperienza di riparazione tecnica, idealmente in un ambiente industriale. - Capacità di leggere e interpretare disegni tecnici, schemi di cablaggio elettrici e schemi. - Forte capacità di analisi e risoluzione dei problemi per risolvere problemi tecnici complessi. - comunicatore orientato al cliente, fluente in inglese; francese è un vantaggio. - Indipendente, self-driven e flessibile con ore di lavoro. - patente di guida valida. Ulteriori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: ## Descrizione The Opportunity As a Field Service Technician, you will play a key role in maintaining the reliable operation of traction transformers across customer sites and in our factory. You will perform hands-on repairs, diagnose technical issues, and support customers directly. With your practical expertise, you will collaborate closely with internal teams and contribute to continuous product and process improvements. ## How you'll make an impact - Always follow safety standards and company procedures during both field (60%) and factory (40%) activities. - Perform on-site repairs and servicing of traction transformers, delivering prompt and professional solutions. - Conduct field repairs, electrical diagnostic testing, and oil treatment at customer locations. - Support failure investigations through disassembly, root-cause analysis, and the preparation of technical reports. - Provide customers with technical support and training on equipment operation and basic maintenance. - Contribute to small improvement projects aimed at boosting quality, efficiency, and service processes. - Prepare service documentation, including work reports, material usage, quality inspection cards, and repair records. - Collaborate with engineering, quality, project management, and sales teams to resolve escalated technical issues. - In the factory, ensure effective coordination and execution of repair work alongside the Service team. ## Your background - Completed technical apprenticeship or degree in Electrical/Electrotechnical/Maintenance fields. - Minimum of 1–2 years of field service or technical repair experience, ideally in an industrial environment. - Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical cabling diagrams, and schematics. - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for solving complex technical problems. - Customer-oriented communicator, fluent in English; French is an advantage. - Independent, self-driven, and flexible with working hours. - Valid driving licence. ## More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Beschreibung Die Chance Als Field Service Technician spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Aufrechterhaltung des zuverlässigen Betriebs von Traktionstransformatoren über Kundenstandorte und in unserer Fabrik. Sie werden manuelle Reparaturen durchführen, technische Probleme diagnostizieren und Kunden direkt unterstützen. Mit Ihrer praktischen Kompetenz arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Teams zusammen und tragen zu kontinuierlichen Produkt- und Prozessverbesserungen bei. Wie Sie einen Einfluss haben - Befolgen Sie immer die Sicherheitsstandards und die Verfahren des Unternehmens während der beiden Bereiche (60%) und der Fabrik (40%). - Führen Sie vor Ort Reparaturen und Wartung von Traktionstransformatoren, liefern schnelle und professionelle Lösungen. - Führen Sie Feldreparaturen, elektrische Diagnostik und Ölbehandlung an Kundenstandorten durch. - Unterstützung von Misserfolgsuntersuchungen durch Demontage, Wurzelanalyse und Erstellung von technischen Berichten. - Bereitstellung von Kunden mit technischer Unterstützung und Schulung im Anlagenbetrieb und der grundlegenden Wartung. - Beitrag zu kleinen Verbesserungsprojekten zur Steigerung von Qualität, Effizienz und Service-Prozessen. - Bereiten Sie Servicedokumentation, einschließlich Arbeitsberichte, Materialnutzung, Qualitätskontrollkarten und Reparaturaufzeichnungen vor. - Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Qualität, Projektmanagement und Vertriebsteams, um eskalierte technische Probleme zu lösen. - In der Fabrik gewährleisten Sie eine effektive Koordination und Durchführung von Reparaturarbeiten neben dem Service-Team. Ihr Hintergrund - Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder Abschluss in Elektro-/Elektrotechnik/Maintenance-Bereichen. - Mindestens 1–2 Jahre Felddienst oder technische Reparatur-Erfahrung, ideal in einem industriellen Umfeld. - Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen, elektrische Verkabelungsdiagramme und Schaltpläne zu lesen und zu interpretieren. - Starke analytische und störungsfreie Fähigkeiten zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme. - Kundenorientierter Kommunikationspartner, fließend auf Englisch; Französisch ist ein Vorteil. - Unabhängig, selbstfahrend und flexibel mit Arbeitszeiten. - gültiger Führerschein. Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen dabei, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungsfähigkeit zu optimieren und eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité En tant que technicien du service mobile, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le maintien de l'exploitation fiable des transformateurs de traction sur les sites clients et dans notre usine. Vous effectuerez des réparations manuelles, diagnostiquerez des problèmes techniques et supporterez directement les clients. Grâce à votre expertise pratique, vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes internes et contribuerez à l'amélioration continue des produits et des procédés. Comment vous ferez un impact - Respectez toujours les normes de sécurité et les procédures de l'entreprise pendant les activités sur le terrain (60 %) et en usine (40 %). - Effectuer des réparations sur place et l'entretien des transformateurs de traction, offrant des solutions rapides et professionnelles. - Effectuer des réparations sur le terrain, des tests de diagnostic électrique et le traitement de l'huile sur place. - Appuyer les enquêtes sur les défaillances par le démontage, l'analyse des causes profondes et la préparation de rapports techniques. - Fournir aux clients un soutien technique et une formation sur le fonctionnement de l'équipement et l'entretien de base. - Contribuer à de petits projets d'amélioration visant à améliorer la qualité, l'efficacité et les processus de service. - Préparer la documentation de service, y compris les rapports de travail, l'utilisation du matériel, les cartes d'inspection de la qualité et les dossiers de réparation. - Collaborer avec des équipes d'ingénierie, de qualité, de gestion de projet et de vente pour résoudre des problèmes techniques exacerbés. - Dans l'usine, assurer une coordination et une exécution efficaces des travaux de réparation aux côtés de l'équipe de Service. Vos antécédents - Apprentissage technique ou diplôme dans les domaines de l'électricité, de l'électrotechnique et de l'entretien. - minimum de 1 à 2 ans d'expérience de service sur le terrain ou de réparation technique, idéalement dans un environnement industriel. - Capacité de lire et d'interpréter des dessins techniques, des diagrammes de câblage électrique et des schémas. - Fortes compétences analytiques et de dépannage pour résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes. - Communicateur orienté client, parlant couramment l'anglais; le français est un avantage. - Indépendant, autonome et flexible avec des horaires de travail. - Permis de conduire valide. Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

descriptions.it: Job Description The opportunity We are looking for a passionate and proficient industrial specialist with expertise in power system analysis\/ management and high-level programming. In an inter-disciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation for different complex systems in power grid applications. Join our dynamic and motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all. How you'll make an impact You create impact: Together with your team design innovative approaches for grid operation and deliver them as robust software modules You investigate: Translate real power‑system problems into rigorous models and final solutions for the customers You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and inter-disciplinary team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy to drive the development from concept to production You connect: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities, start-ups, and vendors to integrate diverse perspectives and stakeholder inputs You communicate: Be able to clearly communicate concepts to software developers, implementation engineering teams and customers. Produce clear design docs and developer-facing examples\/ notebooks that enable reuse. Your background Master Electrical\/Power Systems Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Master's degree with equivalent industry experience Proven expertise in modelling and steady-state analyses of power grids demonstrated hands-on expertise applying these methods in software development. Knowledge in mathematical optimization applied to power systems, and modern numerical solvers is strongly desired (e.g., MIP\/NLP, stochastic; tools such as Gurobi, CPLEX, Ipopt). Experience with machine learning and\/or artificial intelligence technologies is a plus Proficiency in C#, C++, Rust or a similar high-level programming language is required; Python and\/or Matlab for analytics and fast prototyping are a plus. Experience building state-of-the-art software engineering techniques (version control, code reviews, testing, CI\/CD) and integrating solution algorithms into applications are beneficial (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). High performance computing skills such as parallel\/distributed computing, GPU, OpenMP or MPI would be beneficial Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out. We can provide more information during the recruitment process. Are you ready for a new exciting challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don't delay – apply today! Dbamy o przejrzystość i zgodność z wymogami prawnymi tak, aby każda osoba uczestnicząca w procesie rekrutacyjnym wiedziała, czego może się spodziewać na poszczególnych etapach. Po pomyślnym zakończeniu procesu przedstawimy wybranej osobie szczegóły dotyczące warunków finansowych oraz benefitów. Pozostałe elementy oferty zostaną przekazane przed podpisaniem umowy o pracę, tak by stworzyć możliwość spokojnego zapoznania się z nimi. * Klauzula obowiązuje wyłącznie na terenie Polski , zgodnie z lokalnymi przepisami prawa. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully. *Applicable only for Poland lo

descriptions.it: Descrizione Hitachi Energy cerca un/a Junior Project Manager Site Service GCB 80 – 100% (f/m/d) con sede a Zurich, Switzerland. Settore: Project | Program Management. Tipo: Full time. Candidati tramite il sito ufficiale Hitachi Energy.
descriptions.en: The opportunity The High Voltage Products division of Hitachi Energy is globally recognized as a specialist in systems for power transmission and distribution. At the Zurich Oerlikon location, Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) systems and Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) are developed and manufactured for the reliable transmission and distribution of electrical energy. By using state-of-the-art development tools and methods, high reliability of switching systems and switchgear is ensured. The Service organization is responsible for worldwide aftersales support of GCB and GIS systems, including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, additional services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits, and replacements. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to efficient and well-coordinated project execution in a global service environment. With a strong service mindset, attention to detail, and structured coordination skills, this position plays a key role in delivering high customer satisfaction and optimal project results. How you'll make an impact Responsibility for the execution, organizational leadership, and coordination of onsite commissioning and maintenance activities for Generator Circuit Breaker service projects Acting as the main point of contact for internal and external customers during site activities Support of assigned field service personnel, including the creation of installation and assembly schedules while considering required resources such as tools and personnel Monitoring, documenting, and reporting project progress and costs Ensuring compliance with safety regulations and quality assurance measures, while minimizing project costs and risks Process compliant handling of deviations during onsite activities, including the initiation of appropriate corrective actions Compilation, filing, and archiving of project documentation, including technical documents, test records, and reports Responsibility for the billing of performed services to customers Contribution to continuous improvement of processes and activities (CIP) to achieve consistently high customer satisfaction Your background Higher technical education (HF) or a comparable qualification Further education in project management (IPMA or PMI) is considered an advantage Practical experience in the installation and\/or commissioning of switchgear is beneficial Solid technical knowledge and the ability to understand technical documentation, system interfaces, and operational constraints Confident demeanor with strong communication skills, particularly in multicultural environments Business fluent English and good knowledge of German Strong team spirit combined with structured organizational skills Assertiveness and leadership capability, with willingness to travel worldwide to construction sites Good knowledge of SAP and MS Office More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Warenbezeichnung Hitachi Energy sucht einen Junior Project Manager Site Service GCB 80 – 100% (f/m/d) mit Sitz in Zürich, Schweiz. Sektor: Projekt | Programmmanagement. Typ: Vollzeit. Bewerben Sie sich über die offizielle Website Hitachi Energy.
descriptions.fr: Désignation des marchandises Hitachi Energy est à la recherche d'un Junior Project Manager Site Service GCB 80 – 100% (f/m/d) basé à Zurich, Suisse. Secteur : Gestion de programme. Type: Temps plein. Postuler sur le site officiel Hitachi Energy.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are emerging as critical infrastructure for modern data centers, particularly AI facilities, by providing high efficiency (up to 98.5%), compact, and intelligent power management. Unlike conventional transformers, SSTs utilize power electronics to convert medium-voltage grid power directly to 800V DC, significantly reducing footprint, increasing efficiency, and easing grid interconnection. Join us as a Global Product Specialist – Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of data center supply infrastructure, guiding both Hitachi Energy and clients toward smarter, greener, and more resilient operations. If you combine a solid understanding of relevant technologies with insight into customer value drivers—and can translate customer needs into actionable requirements that keep our solutions both innovative and aligned with client expectations—then this role is an excellent fit for you. How you´ll make an impact Conduct market evaluations, competitor analyses, and identify gaps in product, solutions, and services, while assessing Hitachi Energy's positioning Gather and analyze global standards, market requirements, customer needs, and values to contribute to the product roadmap Support the Global Product Manager in creating business cases for product, solutions, and service development projects Support global and local marketing teams in creating market communication materials, including assistance with new product launches Provide sales support, participate in customer meetings, and attend trade shows as required, ensuring the availability of appropriate training materials for internal and external use Drive technical solutions across Hitachi Energy's global footprint, following an annual cycle of activities to govern Global Product Management Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering, along with 10+ years of related experience preferred Prior experience in Product Management or Product Ownership within data centre domain, and knowledge of Solid-State Transformer (SST) technology Possess a technical mindset to serve as a technical expert, instilling customer confidence in the product and contributing to product design Ability to simplify and present the value proposition of a complex offering Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative business analysis Proficient in analyzing market potential through product segmentation, go-to-market channels, and developing business cases. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (20%) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are emerging as critical infrastructure for modern data centers, particularly AI facilities, by providing high efficiency (up to 98.5%), compact, and intelligent power management. Unlike conventional transformers, SSTs utilize power electronics to convert medium-voltage grid power directly to 800V DC, significantly reducing footprint, increasing efficiency, and easing grid interconnection. Join us as a Global Product Specialist – Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of data center supply infrastructure, guiding both Hitachi Energy and clients toward smarter, greener, and more resilient operations. If you combine a solid understanding of relevant technologies with insight into customer value drivers—and can translate customer needs into actionable requirements that keep our solutions both innovative and aligned with client expectations—then this role is an excellent fit for you. How you´ll make an impact Conduct market evaluations, competitor analyses, and identify gaps in product, solutions, and services, while assessing Hitachi Energy's positioning Gather and analyze global standards, market requirements, customer needs, and values to contribute to the product roadmap Support the Global Product Manager in creating business cases for product, solutions, and service development projects Support global and local marketing teams in creating market communication materials, including assistance with new product launches Provide sales support, participate in customer meetings, and attend trade shows as required, ensuring the availability of appropriate training materials for internal and external use Drive technical solutions across Hitachi Energy's global footprint, following an annual cycle of activities to govern Global Product Management Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering, along with 10+ years of related experience preferred Prior experience in Product Management or Product Ownership within data centre domain, and knowledge of Solid-State Transformer (SST) technology Possess a technical mindset to serve as a technical expert, instilling customer confidence in the product and contributing to product design Ability to simplify and present the value proposition of a complex offering Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative business analysis Proficient in analyzing market potential through product segmentation, go-to-market channels, and developing business cases. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (20%) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
