Nous y parvenons grâce à l'expansion continue de notre leadership dans les technologies de base ainsi qu'à l'amélioration continue de nos processus opérationnels. En tant que gestionnaire de maintenance, ils ont une équipe de 6 personnes Vous avez la responsabilité globale de la maintenance de toutes les installations de production et de tous les systèmes techniques dans un environnement de fabrication hautement automatisé. L'objectif de la fonction est d'assurer une disponibilité élevée des installations, une sécurité maximale et une organisation de maintenance efficace et rentable. Ils agissent comme un partenaire stratégique de la gestion et maintiennent à la fois stratégique et opérationnel. Tu peux faire ça. - Gestion stratégique et opérationnelle de l'organisme de maintenance - Planification, contrôle et mise en œuvre des mesures d'entretien et d'entretien (concepts d'entretien préventif, correctif et holistique) - Élaboration et mise en œuvre de stratégies d'entretien visant à accroître la disponibilité, la productivité et la vie des plantes - Direction professionnelle et disciplinaire et perfectionnement de l ' équipe de maintenance - Responsabilité de la planification budgétaire, du contrôle des coûts, des pièces de rechange et de la stratégie de stockage - Appui à la reconstruction, aux nouveaux projets de construction et d ' investissement - Assurer le respect des exigences en matière de sécurité, d ' environnement et de droit - Amélioration continue des processus de maintenance et introduction d'outils numériques et de systèmes de paiement clés Cela vous apportera - Études techniques complètes en ingénierie, mécatronique, génie électrique, technologie d'automatisation ou qualification comparable - Expérience multiannuelle de gestion et de maintenance dans un processus ou une série de production à haute automatisation - Connaissance des systèmes d'automatisation, robot et de contrôle industriel - Expérience des méthodes d'entretien structuré, amélioration continue et entretien - Expérience en coopération avec les interfaces interdisciplinaires et en gestion de projets d'investissement technique - Analyse, structure et haute conversion travaillant avec un leadership fort - Très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais Plus sur nous Nos méthodes de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles, et à créer un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer et développer leurs compétences.

descriptions.it: Descrizione L'occasione The Grid Automation Business Unit di Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un Global IT Leader dinamico per il ruolo di Global BST Manager, Grid Automation, per guidare un team esistente di oltre quaranta professionisti IT nel sostenere e promuovere le attività globali di Grid Automation e le iniziative di trasformazione IT digitale. Business Solution Teams (BSTs) in ogni Business Unit (BU) hanno la completa responsabilità per la gestione delle applicazioni specifiche BU e dei servizi di infrastruttura, compresa la consegna dei servizi. Essi supervisionano e controllano queste applicazioni e servizi, rispettando gli standard di governance e sicurezza globali. BST progetta e implementa la Roadmap IT e Application Landscape per i rispettivi BU per allineare con i requisiti aziendali. Contabile per la gestione delle applicazioni per applicazioni specifiche BU, Infrastructure/ Onsite Service Delivery Operational Management dei Siti assegnati BST. - Supporto IT/OT Cybersecurity Insite Service Delivery Gestione Operativa dei Siti assegnati BST. - Digital Transformation IT Build Deployments per sostenere la crescita del business. - Contabile per l'offerta IT totale al business e fornire l'interfaccia ai partner IT rilevanti, articolando le esigenze del business ai partner IT rilevanti per garantire un supporto efficace al business. - Assicurare l'allineamento della roadmap IT alle esigenze aziendali attraverso la comunicazione e i loop di feedback attivi tra gli stakeholder e l'organizzazione IT. - Definire e implementare le priorità IT strategiche nell'organizzazione in linea con le iniziative di strategia BU e Strategic Business, coprendo il panorama delle applicazioni delle funzioni aziendali, utilizzando il portafoglio soluzioni IT esistente o garantendo nuove soluzioni, se del caso. - Comprendere le esigenze aziendali, la strategia aziendale attuale e a lungo termine e tradurli in opportunità per l'IT per aggiungere valore al business. - Implementare e garantire il rispetto di standard globali e locali, strumenti, processi relativi all'esecuzione di operazioni/progetti. - Analizzare i risultati degli audit interni ed esterni e identificare le aree comuni di miglioramento all'interno dell'organizzazione. - Fornire il punto di escalation BU per tutti i problemi relativi all'IT. - Responsabile del bilancio BST e degli investimenti e della trasparenza dei costi dell'unità aziendale IT. - Impostare la documentazione standard per gli audit e i loro record, risultati e report. - Sviluppare e condividere le migliori pratiche nella comunità BST. - Promuovere la comunicazione tra BU e l'organizzazione IT. - Assicurare (con il supporto HR) che l'area di responsabilità sia adeguatamente organizzata, personale, qualificata e diretta. - Guide, motiva e sviluppa subalterni diretti e indiretti all'interno delle politiche HR, a beneficio sia dell'azienda che del dipendente. Requisiti - Minimo 15+ anni di esperienza professionale in IT. - 10+ anni di esperienza lavorando in organizzazioni globali e diverse con la comprensione di Infrastrutture, Applicazioni e piattaforme. - È richiesto un diploma di laurea; un master è preferito. - Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale. - Altamente organizzato con attenzione ai dettagli. - E' stato un successo a lavorare in organizzazioni matrici. - Capacità di condurre con successo squadre remote in più fusi orari Chi siamo Hitachi Energy è un leader tecnologico globale che sta promuovendo un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Serviamo i clienti nei settori dell'utilità, dell'industria e delle infrastrutture con soluzioni e servizi innovativi in tutta la catena del valore. Insieme a clienti e partner, pionieri delle tecnologie e consentiamo la trasformazione digitale necessaria per accelerare la transizione energetica verso
descriptions.en: ## Descrizione The opportunity The Grid Automation Business Unit of Hitachi Energy is seeking a dynamic Global IT Leader for the role of Global BST Manager, Grid Automation, to lead an existing team of over forty IT Professionals in supporting and advancing Grid Automation's global businesses and digital IT transformation initiatives. Business Solution Teams (BSTs) in each Business Unit (BU) have complete responsibility for managing BU-specific applications and Infrastructure services, including service delivery. They oversee and control these applications and services while adhering to global governance and security standards. BSTs design and implement the IT Roadmap and Application Landscape for their respective BUs to align with business requirements. They closely collaborate with global departments to help deliver function-wide applications and enterprise platforms. ## Mansioni - Lead Business relationship management with BUs including BST Leadership and guidance across BU/HUB/GPG/Functions. - Lead IT Demand Mgt to meet Business requirements. - Management and governance of the BST IT organization to support and deliver on Demand priorities. - Accountable for Application Management for BU specific applications, Infrastructure/ Onsite Service Delivery Operational Management of BST assigned Sites. - Support IT/OT Cybersecurity Onsite Service Delivery Operational Management of BST assigned Sites. - Digital Transformation IT Build Deployments to support growth of business. - Accountable for the total IT offering to the business and provide interface to relevant IT partners, articulating the needs of the business to the relevant IT partners to ensure impactful support to the business. - Ensure alignment of IT roadmap to business needs through communication and active feedback loops between stakeholders and IT organization. - Define and implement strategic IT priorities in the organization in line with BU strategy and Strategic Business initiatives, covering business functions application landscape, utilizing the existing IT solutions portfolio or ensuring to provide new solutions, where appropriate. - Understand the business demands, the current and long-term business strategy and translate them into opportunities for IT to add value to the business. - Implement and ensure compliance with global and local standards, tools, processes related to operations/projects execution. - Analyze results of internal and external audits and identify common areas of improvement within the organization. - Provide the BU escalation point for all IT related issues. - Responsible for BST budget and investments and creating transparency on business unit IT costs. - Setting standard documentation for audits and their records, findings and reports. - Develop and share best practices across BST community. - Foster communication between BU and IT organization. - Ensure (with HR support) that the area of responsibility is properly organized, staffed, skilled and directed. - Guides, motivates and develops direct and indirect subordinates within HR policies, for the benefit of both company and the employee. ## Requisiti - Minimum 15+ years of professional working experience in IT. - 10+ years' experience working in global and diverse organizations with understanding of Infrastructure, Applications and platforms. - A bachelor's degree is required; a master's degree is preferred. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. - Highly organized with attention to detail. - Proven success working in matrixed organizations. - Capable of successfully leading remote teams across multiple time zones ## Chi siamo Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader that is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We serve customers in the utility, industry and infrastructure sectors with innovative solutions and services across the value chain. Together with customers and partners, we pioneer technologies and enable the digital transformation required to accelerate the energy transition toward
descriptions.de: Beschreibung Die Gelegenheit Die Grid Automation Business Unit von Hitachi Energy sucht einen dynamischen Global IT Leader für die Rolle von Global BST Manager, Grid Automation, um ein bestehendes Team von über vierzig IT-Experten bei der Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung von Grid Automations globalen Unternehmen und digitalen IT-Transformationsinitiativen zu leiten. descriptions.it: Descrizione Inizia la tua carriera con un ingresso pratico nell'industria e forma attivamente la nostra produzione mediante l'ottimizzazione dei processi data-driven. Stai implementando le tue conoscenze teoriche dai tuoi studi, ad esempio dal metodo e dalla gestione dei progetti, direttamente nella pratica e ottieni un'esperienza preziosa. Vi offriamo un ambiente che vi dà sicurezza e fiducia in se stessi per la vostra carriera. Condizioni di lavoro flessibili e un team di supporto dedicato vi accompagnerà sulla vostra strada per la laurea di successo. Nota: Lo stage è esclusivamente possibile in combinazione con un corso di laurea integrato pratica presso l'Università di Scienze Applicate Svizzera nordoccidentale FHNW / Zurigo Università di Scienze Applicate ZHAW. Per ulteriori informazioni: Link to FHNW: https://www.fhnw.ch/de/studie/technik/pibs Link to ZHAW: https://www.zhaw.ch/de/engineering/studie/bachelorstudie/praxisintegrated-bachelorstudie/ • Automatizzare i processi aziendali con Power BI, Power Automate o Power Platform • Supportare e supportare sia i progetti esistenti che i nuovi • Lavorare con i sistemi di attrezzature manifatturiere (MES) e le basi di dati • Creare sequenze di processo secondo BPMN 2.0 e digitalizzazione avanzata (elaborazione mineraria, sviluppo civico e analisi aziendale) • Collegare il know-how tecnico con il pensiero aziendale e implementare la teoria in pratica (ingegneria dei requisiti) • • Vi offriamo un ambiente in cui potete sviluppare e coltivare le vostre competenze – supportate da mentoring e da una cultura inclusiva. Abbiamo risvegliato il vostro interesse? Quindi non vediamo l'ora della vostra domanda, compreso CV, lettera di motivazione e certificati.
descriptions.en: Descrizione Start your career with a practical entry into the industry and actively shape our production by data-driven process optimization. You are implementing your theoretical knowledge from your studies – for example from method and project management – directly into practice and gain valuable experience. • We offer you an environment that gives you security and self-confidence for your career. Flexible working conditions and a dedicated, supportive team will accompany you on your way to the successful Bachelor's degree. Note: The internship is exclusively possible in combination with a practice-integrated bachelor's degree programme at the University of Applied Sciences Northwestern Switzerland FHNW / Zurich University of Applied Sciences ZHAW. Further information can be found here: Link to FHNW: https://www.fhnw.ch/de/studie/technik/pibs Link to ZHAW: https://www.zhaw.ch/de/engineering/studie/bachelorstudie/praxisintegrated-bachelorstudie/ You can do that • Automate business processes with Power BI, Power Automate or Power Platform • Support and support both existing and new projects • Work with Manufacturing Equipment Systems (MES) and Databases • Create processes according to BPMN 2.0 and advance digitization (process mining, Citizen Development and Business Analysis) • Connect technical know-how with economic thinking and implement the theory in practice (requirement engineering) • Learn how to pick up different stakeholders to achieve success (Change Management) That's what you bring • Completed Gymnasiale Matura (provisions for admission to the Fachhochschule FHNW/ZHAW) • Openness, proactivity and self-motivation • Impressed communication skills and social competence • Ability to work independently and structured • Related German (at least C1), knowledge in English (B1) More about us • Our flexible work practices help you combine personal and professional goals. • We offer you an environment where you can develop and grow your skills – supported by mentoring and an inclusive culture. Did we awaken your interest? Then we look forward to your application including CV, letter of motivation and certificates.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Stiamo cercando un leader di qualità esperto per guidare l'agenda di Qualità e miglioramento continuo (CI) in tutto il nostro Hub Europe. In questo ruolo chiave di leadership, si possiede la strategia di qualità, rafforzare i nostri sistemi di gestione della qualità, garantire la soddisfazione del cliente, e lead certificazione, audit e iniziative di miglioramento continuo in tutte le entità del Hub. Dove CI è in ambito, si distribuirà anche una cultura CI sostenibile e una struttura di miglioramento. La posizione di questo ruolo è flessibile in Europa e sarà determinata nelle fasi successive. Come farete un impatto Qualità & Leadership CI Definire e implementare la strategia Hub Quality e CI. Assicurare l'allineamento con le direttive globali, i requisiti normativi e le esigenze aziendali. Guidare la costruzione e la governance attraverso i team Hub Quality e CI. Customer Focus Incorpora la Voce del Cliente in tutte le iniziative di Qualità. Rappresentare l'azienda nelle discussioni dei clienti su questioni di qualità. Valutare i rischi e implementare soluzioni per garantire un'elevata soddisfazione del cliente. Sistema di Gestione della Qualità & Certificazione Condurre lo sviluppo e la manutenzione del Sistema di Gestione della Qualità. Controllare gli audit interni/esterni e garantire la chiusura tempestiva delle azioni. Certificazioni richieste sicure in tutte le unità Hub. Performance & Miglioramento Monitor processo e offrire prestazioni; analizzare le tendenze e guidare azioni correttive. Identificare opportunità di miglioramento e collaborare con gli stakeholder per implementare i cambiamenti. Escalare i problemi di qualità dei fornitori e garantire la risoluzione. Gestione non conformità Gestisci NCR di alto profilo e interventi dei clienti. Assicurare un contenimento efficace, misure correttive e preventive per proteggere la fiducia dei clienti. Rilevamento continuo del quadro di miglioramento continuo (Lighthouse, L6S, Lessons Learned, ecc.). Supporto e priorità progetti di miglioramento che elevano qualità e prestazioni operative. Il tuo corso di laurea in un campo correlato; un master o MBA è un vantaggio. 10-15 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile in un ambiente multinazionale. Una forte esperienza di leadership nella gestione della qualità; la leadership CI è un vantaggio. Capacità di analizzare le prestazioni, risolvere i problemi sistematicamente e gestire i rischi. Solida influenza, comunicazione, gestione dei cambiamenti e capacità di risoluzione dei conflitti. mentalità orientata al cliente e comprovata capacità di collaborare attraverso le funzioni.
descriptions.en: The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced Quality leader to drive the Quality and Continuous Improvement (CI) agenda across our Hub Europe. In this key leadership role, you will own the Quality strategy, strengthen our Quality Management Systems, ensure customer satisfaction, and lead certification, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives across all entities in the Hub. Where CI is in scope, you will also deploy a sustainable CI culture and improvement structure. The location of this role is flexible within Europe, and will be determined in later stages. How you will make an impact Quality & CI Leadership Define and implement the Hub Quality and CI strategy. Ensure alignment with global directives, regulatory requirements, and business needs. Drive capability building and governance across Hub Quality and CI teams. Customer Focus Embed the Voice of the Customer in all Quality initiatives. Represent the company in customer discussions on quality matters. Evaluate risks and implement solutions to secure high customer satisfaction. Quality Management System & Certification Lead the development and maintenance of the Quality Management System. Oversee internal\/external audits and ensure timely closure of actions. Secure required certifications across all Hub units. Performance & Improvement Monitor process and offer performance; analyze trends and drive corrective actions. Identify improvement opportunities and collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes. Escalate supplier quality issues and ensure resolution. Non‑Conformance Management Manage high‑profile NCRs and customer interventions. Ensure effective containment, corrective, and preventive measures to protect customer trust. Continuous Improvement Deploy the Continuous Improvement Framework (Lighthouse, L6S, Lessons Learned, etc.). Support and prioritize improvement projects that elevate quality and operational performance. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field; a Master's degree or MBA is an advantage. 10–15 years of experience in a similar role within a multinational environment. Strong leadership experience in Quality Management; CI leadership is a plus. Ability to analyse performance, solve problems systematically, and manage risks. Solid influencing, communication, change management, and conflict‑resolution skills. Customer‑centric mindset and proven ability to collaborate across functions.
descriptions.de: Die Chance Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem erfahrenen Qualitätsführer, der die Agenda Qualität und kontinuierliche Verbesserung (CI) in ganz Europa treibt. In dieser zentralen Führungsrolle besitzen Sie die Qualitätsstrategie, stärken unsere Qualitätsmanagementsysteme, sorgen für Kundenzufriedenheit und führen Zertifizierung, Audits und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen in allen Unternehmen des Hubs. Wenn CI in Reichweite ist, werden Sie auch eine nachhaltige CI-Kultur und Verbesserung Struktur einsetzen. Der Standort dieser Rolle ist in Europa flexibel und wird später bestimmt. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf Qualität & CI Leadership Definieren und implementieren die Hub Quality and CI Strategie. Gewährleistung der Angleichung an globale Richtlinien, regulatorische Anforderungen und Geschäftsanforderungen. Antriebsfähigkeitsaufbau und Governance in Hub Quality und CI-Teams. Customer Focus Embed the Voice of the Customer in allen Qualitätsinitiativen. Vertreten Sie das Unternehmen in Kundengesprächen zu Qualitätsfragen. Risiken auswerten und Lösungen implementieren, um eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten. Qualitätsmanagement System & Zertifizierung Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Wartung des Qualitätsmanagementsystems. Sehen Sie interne / externe Audits und sorgen Sie für eine rechtzeitige Schließung von Aktionen. Sichere Zertifizierungen über alle Hub-Einheiten. Performance & Verbesserung Monitor Prozess und bieten Leistung; analysieren Trends und treiben Korrekturmaßnahmen. Identifizieren Sie Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten und arbeiten Sie mit den Interessengruppen zusammen, um Änderungen vorzunehmen. Eskalieren Sie die Fragen der Lieferantenqualität und stellen Sie die Lösung sicher. Non‐Conformance Management Verwalten Sie hochkarätige NCRs und Kundeninterventionen. Gewährleistung wirksamer Eindämmung, Korrektur und vorbeugende Maßnahmen zum Schutz des Kundenvertrauens. Kontinuierliche Verbesserung des kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsrahmens (Lighthouse, L6S, Lessons Learned, etc.). Unterstützung und Priorisierung von Verbesserungsprojekten, die Qualität und operative Leistung erhöhen. Ihr Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich; ein Master-Abschluss oder MBA ist ein Vorteil. 10–15 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einem multinationalen Umfeld. Starke Führungserfahrung im Qualitätsmanagement; CI-Führung ist ein Plus. Fähigkeit, Leistung zu analysieren, Probleme systematisch zu lösen und Risiken zu bewältigen. Solide Einflussnahme, Kommunikation, Change Management und Konfliktlösungsfähigkeiten. Customer‐centric mindset und bewährte Fähigkeit, über Funktionen zusammenzuarbeiten.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader expérimenté de la qualité pour piloter le programme Qualité et amélioration continue (IC) dans notre Hub Europe. Dans ce rôle clé de leadership, vous posséderez la stratégie Qualité, renforcerez nos systèmes de gestion de la qualité, assurerez la satisfaction des clients et dirigerez des initiatives de certification, d'audit et d'amélioration continue dans toutes les entités du Hub. Lorsque l'IC a une portée, vous allez également déployer une culture et une structure d'amélioration durables de l'IC. L'emplacement de ce rôle est souple en Europe et sera déterminé ultérieurement. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Qualité et leadership de l'IC Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie Hub Qualité et IC. Assurer l'alignement sur les directives mondiales, les exigences réglementaires et les besoins des entreprises. Favoriser le renforcement des capacités et la gouvernance au sein des équipes de la qualité du Hub et de l'IC. Focus client Intégrez la voix du client dans toutes les initiatives Qualité. Représenter l'entreprise dans les discussions des clients sur les questions de qualité. Évaluer les risques et mettre en œuvre des solutions pour garantir une satisfaction élevée de la clientèle. Système de gestion de la qualité et certification Diriger le développement et la maintenance du système de gestion de la qualité. Superviser les vérifications internes/externes et assurer la clôture en temps opportun des actions. Sécuriser les certifications requises dans toutes les unités du Hub. Rendement et amélioration Surveiller le processus et offrir le rendement; analyser les tendances et prendre des mesures correctives. Identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et collaborer avec les intervenants pour mettre en oeuvre les changements. Évaluer les problèmes de qualité des fournisseurs et assurer la résolution. Gestion de la non-conformité Gérer les RCN et les interventions des clients. Assurer un confinement efficace, des mesures correctives et préventives pour protéger la confiance des clients. Amélioration continue Déployer le cadre d'amélioration continue (Lighthouse, L6S, leçons apprises, etc.). Appuyer et prioriser les projets d'amélioration qui améliorent la qualité et le rendement opérationnel. Votre licence d'études dans un domaine connexe; une maîtrise ou un MBA est un avantage. 10 à 15 ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire au sein d'un environnement multinational. Une solide expérience de leadership en gestion de la qualité; le leadership de l'IC est un atout. Capacité d'analyser les performances, de résoudre les problèmes systématiquement et de gérer les risques. Des compétences solides en matière d'influence, de communication, de gestion du changement et de résolution des conflits. L'état d'esprit du client et la capacité éprouvée de collaborer entre les fonctions.

descriptions.it: The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is to advance a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to homes, schools, hospitals, and industries — and we do so with people who are passionate, collaborative, and committed to making a real difference. As a SCADA\/RTU Commissioning Engineer, you will join our Grid Automation Systems team in Baden, Switzerland. In this role, you will oversee the commissioning of substation automation systems for medium‑complexity assignments, ensuring all activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in line with contract requirements, quality standards, and safety expectations. How you'll make an impact   • Carry out testing and commissioning of substation automation systems at customer sites in Switzerland and abroad, while actively supporting the Service Management team • Execute commissioning activities safely, following all Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards; report hazards and near misses to support continuous improvement • Perform commissioning tasks according to defined process descriptions and checklists; coordinate closely with engineering and project management teams • Identify, track, and resolve open points, ensuring customer sign‑off before site demobilization • Report site progress and planning updates; ensure efficient use of commissioning tools and test equipment • Provide marked‑up drawings to engineering for preparing as‑built documentation and final submissions • Support planning and implementation of commissioning activities • Implement design changes and provide mark‑ups for as‑built project documentation • Coordinate site activities required to finalize customer acceptance certification   Your background   • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent • 4+ years of experience as a commissioning engineer for automation systems and related products • Strong knowledge of substation SCADA\/RTU systems, HMI principles, and Hitachi Energy products; understanding of protection philosophies • Basic knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 61850, LON, IEC 101–104, DNP; ability to read schematic drawings and identify discrepancies; strong problem‑solving and conflict‑resolution skills • Familiarity with engineering toolchains typical for SAS\/SCADA (IET600, PCM600, MicroSCADA); willingness to learn across SCADA, RTU, networking, and cybersecurity topics • Strong communication and presentation skills • Proficiency in spoken and written English, German is preferred More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe that diversity and collaboration are the foundation of great innovation. You will join a global team where different perspectives are valued, and where we work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

How you'll make an impact   • Carry out testing and commissioning of substation automation systems at customer sites in Switzerland and abroad, while actively supporting the Service Management team • Execute commissioning activities safely, following all Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards; report hazards and near misses to support continuous improvement • Perform commissioning tasks according to defined process descriptions and checklists; coordinate closely with engineering and project management teams • Identify, track, and resolve open points, ensuring customer sign‑off before site demobilization • Report site progress and planning updates; ensure efficient use of commissioning tools and test equipment • Provide marked‑up drawings to engineering for preparing as‑built documentation and final submissions • Support planning and implementation of commissioning activities • Implement design changes and provide mark‑ups for as‑built project documentation • Coordinate site activities required to finalize customer acceptance certification   Your background   • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent • 4+ years of experience as a commissioning engineer for automation systems and related products • Strong knowledge of substation SCADA\/RTU systems, HMI principles, and Hitachi Energy products; understanding of protection philosophies • Basic knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 61850, LON, IEC 101–104, DNP; ability to read schematic drawings and identify discrepancies; strong problem‑solving and conflict‑resolution skills • Familiarity with engineering toolchains typical for SAS\/SCADA (IET600, PCM600, MicroSCADA); willingness to learn across SCADA, RTU, networking, and cybersecurity topics • Strong communication and presentation skills • Proficiency in spoken and written English, German is preferred More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe that diversity and collaboration are the foundation of great innovation. You will join a global team where different perspectives are valued, and where we work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Nel tuo ruolo di Specialista di Servizio IT in loco, sarai responsabile della consegna del Supporto Side Desk agli utenti IT, in particolare della gestione dei problemi IT che richiedono un intervento fisico. I vostri doveri si estenderanno per aiutare la risoluzione degli incidenti attraverso la collaborazione con vari team di supporto e gruppi all'interno del reparto IT. Si svolgerà un ruolo critico, servendo come rappresentante dell'organizzazione IT, agendo come l'interfaccia tra il cliente e altre funzioni IT. Come farete un impatto Diagnosi e risolve i problemi legati all'IT in modo efficace ed efficiente Assicura che i computer sono forniti in una condizione 'ready-to-use' per gli utenti IT Fornisce una formazione ad-hoc per gli utenti su questioni IT comuni e li guida attraverso strumenti di auto-servizio Maniglie casi di garanzia in collaborazione con i fornitori di attrezzature originali appropriate (OEM) Identificare e segnalare potenziali rischi che potrebbero influenzare la qualità dei servizi di fine OSS Demonstra una capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente ed è auto-driven L'autorizzazione legale per lavorare in posizione applicata è necessaria. Hitachi Energy si impegna a creare un ambiente di lavoro diversificato, inclusivo e collaborativo in cui le persone provenienti da diversi contesti si uniscono per costruire soluzioni innovative per un futuro energetico più sostenibile.
descriptions.en: The opportunity In your role as an On-site IT Service Specialist, you will be responsible for delivering Desk Side Support to IT users, specifically handling IT issues that require physical intervention. Your duties will extend to aiding incident resolution through collaboration with various support teams and groups within the IT department. You will play a critical role, serving as a representative of the IT organization, acting as the interface between the customer and other IT functions. How you'll make an impact Diagnoses and resolves IT-related issues effectively and efficiently Ensures that computers are delivered in a 'ready-to-use' condition for IT users Provides ad-hoc training to users on common IT issues and guides them through self-service tools Handles warranty cases in collaboration with the appropriate Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) vendors Identifies and report potential risks that could impact the quality of OSS services Offers support to end users and ensure the functionality of IT equipment and software in meeting rooms and other user collaboration areas as part of desk-side support Adheres to prescribed OSS governance, which involves participating in meetings and following the escalation process, among other responsibilities Follows OSS procedures as outlined in the Runbook, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and knowledge articles Your background Formal qualification in IT completed from an accredited university or college OR completed an apprenticeship in the field of IT ​ Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, including the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences in German and English. ​ Proactive and solution-oriented mindset ​ Demonstrates an ability to work independently and is self-driven ​ Legal authorization to work in applied location is required . We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this role ​ More about us Hitachi Energy is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative work environment where people from different backgrounds come together to build innovative solutions for a more sustainable energy future.
descriptions.de: Die Gelegenheit In Ihrer Rolle als IT-Spezialist vor Ort sind Sie für die Bereitstellung von Desk Side Support für IT-Nutzer verantwortlich, insbesondere für IT-Probleme, die eine physische Intervention erfordern. • Ihre Aufgaben werden sich auf die Unterstützung der Vorfallauflösung durch Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Support-Teams und Gruppen innerhalb der IT-Abteilung erstrecken. Sie werden eine kritische Rolle spielen, die als Vertreter der IT-Organisation dient und als Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden und anderen IT-Funktionen fungiert. Wie Sie eine Wirkung machen Diagnosen und löst IT-bezogene Probleme effektiv und effizient sichert, dass Computer in einem "ready-to-use" Zustand für IT-Nutzer liefert Ad-hoc-Training für Benutzer zu gemeinsamen IT-Problemen und führt sie durch Self-Service-Tools Handles Garantiefälle in Zusammenarbeit mit den entsprechenden Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) Anbietern Identifiziert und melden potenzielle Risiken, die die die die Qualität der OSS-Services beeinflussen könnten Proaktive und lösungsorientierte Denkweise Demonstratet eine Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten und ist selbstgesteuert Legale Berechtigung zur Arbeit an angewandter Stelle ist erforderlich. Für diese Rolle werden wir jetzt oder in Zukunft keine Personen für Beschäftigungsvisums fördern. Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy ist verpflichtet, ein vielfältiges, inklusives und kollaboratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Hintergründen zusammenkommen, um innovative Lösungen für eine nachhaltigere Energie-Zukunft zu entwickeln.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Dans votre rôle de spécialiste des services informatiques sur place, vous serez chargé de fournir un soutien côté bureau aux utilisateurs de TI, en particulier pour traiter les problèmes informatiques qui nécessitent une intervention physique. Vos fonctions s'étendront à la résolution d'incidents grâce à la collaboration avec diverses équipes et groupes de soutien au sein du service informatique. Vous jouerez un rôle crucial en tant que représentant de l'organisation informatique, agissant comme interface entre le client et les autres fonctions informatiques. Comment vous ferez un impact Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes liés à la TI de façon efficace et efficiente Veiller à ce que les ordinateurs soient livrés dans un état « prêt à l'emploi » pour les utilisateurs de la TI Offrir une formation ad hoc aux utilisateurs sur les problèmes communs de TI et les guider à l'aide d'outils en libre-service Gérer les cas de garantie en collaboration avec les fournisseurs d'équipement d'origine appropriés Identifier et signaler les risques potentiels qui pourraient avoir une incidence sur la qualité des services SSO Offrir un soutien aux utilisateurs finals et assurer la fonctionnalité de l'équipement et des logiciels de TI dans les salles de réunion et d'autres domaines de collaboration des utilisateurs dans le cadre du soutien côté bureau Adhérer à la gouvernance de SSO prescrite, qui consiste à participer aux réunions et à suivre le processus d'escalade, entre autres responsabilités Suivre les procédures SSO décrites dans le Runbook, les procédures d'exploitation normalisées (SOP) et les articles sur les connaissances Votre expérience Qualification officielle en TI obtenue d'une université ou d'un collège accrédité OU complété un apprentissage dans le domaine de la TI Excellentes compétences en communication, tant écrites que verbales, y compris la capacité de communiquer efficacement Un état d'esprit proactif et axé sur la solution démontre une capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et est autonome. Nous ne parrainerons pas de personnes pour des visas d'emploi maintenant ou à l'avenir pour ce rôle Plus sur nous Hitachi Energy s'engage à créer un environnement de travail diversifié, inclusif et collaboratif où des personnes de différents horizons se réunissent pour construire des solutions innovantes pour un avenir énergétique plus durable.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Our High Voltage Products division is a worldwide specialist in power transmission and distribution. Our Service Unit supports customers around the globe with Generator Circuit Breaker systems (GCB) and gas‑insulated switchgear (GIS). From training and commissioning to maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and replacements — we ensure critical power infrastructure works reliably, safely, and efficiently. Service is at the heart of everything we do. As part of our international service team, you'll take on varied, hands‑on work and become a recognized product expert. After comprehensive, practical training in Switzerland, you'll travel the world to commission and maintain GCB systems — all while working in a dynamic, multicultural environment. This is a role with real impact, technical depth, and plenty of room to grow. How you´ll make an impact Lead multicultural service projects for GCB on power plants from 20 MW to 1600 MW worldwide Ensure smooth and timely execution of installation and maintenance work on site Perform the final quality check and guarantee that all work meets our high standards Deliver product training directly to customers at their facilities Identify risks proactively and implement effective mitigation measures Coordinate on‑site teams and give practical, clear instructions Manage resource and provide regular reporting to project management Drive process improvements and implement efficiency‑boosting initiatives on site Your background Completed apprenticeship in metalwork, electrical engineering, or automotive technology Solid electrical knowledge (essential); further education such as a technician diploma is a plus Minimum 2 years of professional experience; experience in site leadership is an advantage Good English skills (B2 or above); German is a plus High willingness to travel — up to 80% worldwide Flexible, resilient, and communicative team player who enjoys solving problems pragmatically and values high safety and quality standards More about us Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom Attractive training and development opportunities Interesting and very varied activities\/projects, including off-shore assignments Well-established and dynamic team Open corporate culture An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

descriptions.it: Unisciti al nostro team di Next Generation Grids Transformers a Ginevra e plasma il futuro dell'energia. In qualità di Senior R&D Electrical Engineer, lavorerai su tecnologie di trasformatore all'avanguardia in un ambiente dinamico e internazionale. Farai parte di un team collaborativo, contribuendo al ciclo di vita R&D completo, dal concept al test e al lancio dei prodotti, garantendo che le nostre soluzioni soddisfino sia le specifiche tecniche che le esigenze del mercato. Questo ruolo offre esperienza pratica, crescita tecnica e la possibilità di avere un impatto reale nella transizione energetica. Applicare la tua conoscenza dell'elettromagnetismo per supportare la validazione di concetti innovativi attraverso simulazioni Tackle una varietà di sfide ingegneristiche sui trasformatori di frequenza media Contribuire allo sviluppo di nuove funzionalità nei nostri strumenti di progettazione interna Organizzare attività di prototipazione e test per convalidare nuove tecnologie\/prodotti in collaborazione con i team globali Il pensiero analitico e la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo all'interno di team interdisciplinari e internazionali • Offriamo pratiche di lavoro flessibili e un ambiente di supporto in cui è possibile crescere le vostre abilità e carriera. Che cosa ci si può aspettare da noi Eccitanti opportunità di carriera e di formazione all'interno di Hitachi Energy Inclusive e diversificata cultura del lavoro Sconti sui membri del fitness e vari servizi
descriptions.en: The opportunity Join our Next Generation Grids Transformers team in Geneva and shape the future of energy. As a Senior R&D Electrical Engineer, you will work on cutting-edge transformer technologies in a dynamic, international environment. You'll be part of a collaborative team, contributing to the full R&D lifecycle—from concept to testing and product launch, ensuring that our solutions meet both technical specifications and market demands. This role offers hands-on experience, technical growth, and the chance to make a real impact in the energy transition. How you will make an impact Apply your knowledge of electromagnetism to support innovative concepts' validation through simulations Tackle a variety of engineering challenges on Medium Frequency Transformers Contribute to the development of new features in our internal design tools Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new technologies\/products in collaboration with global teams Align your work with our strategic technology roadmap Take ownership of work packages and deliver results using a structured approach Deepen your understanding of transformer technologies and support internal consulting to optimize your R&D activities Contribute to intellectual property and risk management activities in R&D Your background MSc or PhD in Electrical or Electromechanical Engineering, ideally with experience in R&D within a business environment Knowledge of electromagnetism and circuit theory with ability to perform electromagnetic simulations Proficiency in MATLAB and\/or Python Strong communication skills in English (French is a plus) Analytical thinking and ability to work independently and collaboratively within interdisciplinary and international teams Awareness of business processes related to product development More about us • We offer flexible working practices and a supportive environment where you can grow your skills and career. What you can expect from us Exciting career and training opportunities within Hitachi Energy Inclusive and diverse work culture Discounts on fitness memberships and various services Attractive pension benefits through our company pension fund
descriptions.de: Treten Sie unserem Next Generation Grids Transformers Team in Genf bei und gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Energie. Als Senior R&D Electrical Engineer arbeiten Sie an hochmodernen Transformatortechnologien in einem dynamischen, internationalen Umfeld. Sie werden Teil eines kollaborativen Teams sein, das zum gesamten F&E-Lebenszyklus beiträgt – vom Konzept über das Testen bis hin zur Produkteinführung, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Lösungen sowohl technische Spezifikationen als auch Marktanforderungen erfüllen. Diese Rolle bietet praktische Erfahrung, technisches Wachstum und die Chance, einen echten Einfluss auf die Energiewende zu nehmen. Wie Sie einen Einfluss ausüben Anwendung Ihres Wissens über Elektromagnetismus zur Unterstützung der Validierung innovativer Konzepte durch Simulationen Bewältigen Sie eine Vielzahl von technischen Herausforderungen bei mittelfrequenten Transformatoren Tragen Sie zur Entwicklung neuer Funktionen in unseren internen Design-Tools bei Organisieren Sie Prototyping- und Testaktivitäten zur Validierung neuer Technologien / Produkte in Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Teams Richten Sie Ihre Arbeit an unserer strategischen Technologie-Roadmap aus Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete und liefern Sie Ergebnisse mit einem strukturierten Ansatz Vertiefen Sie Ihr Verständnis von Transformatortechnologien und unterstützen Sie interne Beratung zur Optimierung Ihrer F & E-Aktivitäten Beitragen Sie zu geistigem Eigentum und Risikomanagementaktivitäten in F & E Ihr Hintergrund MSc oder PhD in Elektrotechnik oder Elektromechanische Technik, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in F & E in einem Geschäftsumfeld Wissen über Elektromagnetismus und Schaltungstheorie mit der Fähigkeit, elektromagnetische Simulationen durchzuführen Proficiency in MATLAB und / oder Python Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (Französisch ist ein Plus) Analytisches Denken und Fähigkeit, unabhängig und kollaborativ in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams zu arbeiten Bewusstsein für Geschäftsprozesse im Zusammenhang mit der Produktentwicklung Mehr über uns • Wir bieten flexible Arbeitspraktiken und ein unterstützendes Umfeld, in dem Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten und Ihre Karriere ausbauen können. Was Sie von uns erwarten können Spannende Karriere- und Ausbildungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb von Hitachi Energy Inclusive und diverse Arbeitskultur Rabatte auf Fitness-Mitgliedschaften und verschiedene Dienstleistungen Attraktive Pensionsleistungen durch unsere betriebliche Pensionskasse
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Joignez-vous à notre équipe de Transformateurs de Grilles de Nouvelle Génération à Genève et façonnez l'avenir de l'énergie. En tant qu'ingénieur principal en R-D en électricité, vous travaillerez sur des technologies de transformation de pointe dans un environnement international dynamique. Vous ferez partie d'une équipe collaborative, contribuant à l'ensemble du cycle de vie de la R-D, du concept au test et au lancement de produits, en veillant à ce que nos solutions répondent aux spécifications techniques et aux exigences du marché. Ce rôle offre une expérience pratique, une croissance technique et la chance d'avoir un impact réel sur la transition énergétique. Comment vous ferez un impact Appliquer votre connaissance de l'électromagnétisme pour soutenir la validation des concepts innovants par des simulations S'attaquer à divers défis d'ingénierie sur les transformateurs à moyenne fréquence Contribuer au développement de nouvelles caractéristiques dans nos outils de conception interne Organiser des activités de prototypage et de test pour valider les nouvelles technologies / produits en collaboration avec des équipes mondiales Alignez votre travail sur notre feuille de route technologique stratégique S'approprier les paquets de travail et produire des résultats en utilisant une approche structurée Développer votre compréhension des technologies des transformateurs et soutenir le conseil interne pour optimiser vos activités de R-D Contribuer aux activités de propriété intellectuelle et de gestion des risques en R-D Votre maîtrise en génie électrique ou électromécanique, idéalement avec l'expérience en R-D dans un environnement commercial Connaissance de l'électromagnétisme et de la théorie des circuits avec capacité d'effectuer des simulations électromagnétiques Compétence en MATLAB et / ou Python Fortes compétences en communication en anglais (le français est un plus) Pensée analytique et capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et en collaboration au sein d'équipes interdisciplinaires et internationales Sensibilisation aux processus d'affaires liés au développement de produits Plus sur nous • Nous offrons des pratiques de travail flexibles et un environnement de soutien où vous pouvez développer vos compétences et votre carrière. Ce que vous pouvez attendre de nous Des opportunités de carrière et de formation passionnantes au sein de Hitachi Energy Une culture de travail inclusive et diversifiée Réductions sur les adhésions à la condition physique et divers services Des prestations de retraite attrayantes grâce à notre fonds de pension d'entreprise

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Iscriviti al nostro Centro di Servizi Locali in Svizzera per una posizione dinamica che unisce la gestione dei progetti a responsabilità pratiche sul campo. In questo ruolo, supervisionerai i progetti di assistenza dei trasformatori di potenza dall'inizio alla fine, assicurandoti che tutti gli strumenti, le attrezzature e le procedure di calibrazione siano preparati con cura per operazioni sicure ed efficienti in loco. Entrando a far parte del nostro team, contribuirai direttamente alla stabilità della rete elettrica svizzera e avrai l'opportunità di collaborare con i principali attori del mercato energetico svizzero. Se ti piace gestire gli stakeholder tanto quanto rimboccarti le maniche per assicurarti che i team sul campo siano pronti all'azione, questo è il ruolo che fa per te. Si prega di inviare i vostri documenti in inglese. Come creare un impatto Lead e coordinare progetti di servizio trasformatori cross-funzionali dall'inizio all'altro, esecuzione in loco e chiusura, con piena responsabilità su tempistiche, costi, qualità, risorse e rischi Garantire disponibilità, conformità e affidabilità di strumenti, strumenti e apparecchiature di collaudo, inclusa manutenzione, calibrazione, certificazione e prontezza per le operazioni di servizio dei trasformatori Gestire e ottimizzare la logistica degli utensili e delle attrezzature, coprendo il controllo dell'inventario, Stoccaggio, rifornimento, spedizione, preparazione del materiale specifico per progetto e condivisione delle risorse tra i progetti Supportare i team sul campo con pacchetti completi, inclusi documentazione tecnica, procedure, requisiti di sicurezza e coordinamento onsite quando necessario Agire come interfaccia primaria tra clienti, team di assistenza sul campo, workshop, fornitori e stakeholder interni, garantendo una comunicazione chiara, proattiva e orientata alla soddisfazione durante tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto Pianifico, programma, e supervisionare le attività di servizio, garantendo la piena prontezza lavorativa prima della mobilitazione del sito, inclusi ambito tecnico, documentazione, permessi, accesso, logistica e prerequisiti HSE. Preparare e coordinare le attività in loco, garantire un'esecuzione sicura, fluida ed efficiente, e fornire supporto operativo operativo operativo durante situazioni critiche o complesse. Identificare, escalare e risolvere i rischi di progetto e operativi, garantendo la rigorosa conformità alle regole HSE, Standard ISO e requisiti normativi Favoriscono il miglioramento e la standardizzazione continui, migliorando la gestione degli strumenti, i processi di preparazione del sito e l'efficienza complessiva dell'esecuzione dei servizi Il tuo background Laurea in ingegneria, gestione tecnica o in un campo correlato 3+ anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti o nel coordinamento dei servizi sul campo Handson mentalità e forte interesse per strumenti, calibrazione, sicurezza e preparazione tecnica Solide competenze organizzative e comunicative Esperienza in standard di qualità (ad esempio, ISO): Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e assumersi la responsabilità dei compiti dall'inizio all'estremo, Affare fluente in francese e inglese; Il tedesco è un vantaggio Più su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le performance personali e aziendali, creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Join our Local Service Center Switzerland for a dynamic position that blends project management with hands-on field responsibilities. In this role, you will oversee power transformer service projects from start to finish, ensuring all tools, equipment, and calibration procedures are meticulously prepared for safe and efficient onsite operations. By joining our team, you will contribute directly to the stability of Switzerland's electrical grid and have the opportunity to collaborate with key players in the Swiss energy market. If you enjoy managing stakeholders as much as rolling up your sleeves to make sure field teams are ready for action, this is the role for you. Please submit your documents in English. How You'll Make an Impact Lead and coordinate cross‑functional transformer service projects end‑to‑end, onsite execution, and close‑out, with full ownership of schedule, cost, quality, resources, and risks Ensure availability, compliance, and reliability of tools, instruments, and testing equipment, including maintenance, calibration, certification, and readiness for transformer service operations Manage and optimize tooling and equipment logistics, covering inventory control, storage, replenishment, shipment, project‑specific material preparation, and resource sharing across projects Support En rejoignant notre équipe, vous contribuerez directement à la stabilité du réseau électrique suisse et aurez la possibilité de collaborer avec des acteurs clés du marché suisse de l'énergie. descriptions.it: The opportunity The design of high voltage (HV) devices, such as gas circuit breakers (CB) and gas insulated switchgear (GIS), requires – among others –simulations and experiments for verification of insulation and switching performance. Additionally, the research activities in the area of gas circuit breakers are enhanced by various computer-aided-engineering tools. We are looking for an intern student with expertise in computational chemistry to contribute to the development of novel insulating materials for high-voltage power grid applications. The superior goal is the achievement of high-end quality of the product. The duration of the internship is 6 to 12 months. How you'll make an impact Contribute to technology development and research activities focusing on material analysis and characterization Support simulations of gas insulation systems using state of the art computational chemistry packages Study the relationship between microstructure and material characteristics and document findings and present test results to the team Your background B.Sc. degree in Material Science, Chemistry, Physics or similar discipline with focus on computer-aided methods Programming skills and experience in computational chemistry is an advantage Fluency in written and spoken English Team player and well organized Creative and able to work autonomously Laboratory and experimental experience is a plus More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptions.it: The Opportunity As an GPG Insulation & Components APQP Leader you will be responsible for the implementation and maintenance of Foundation APQP essentials, according to the defined strategy and plan for GPG I&C Quality. You will collaborate with crossfunctional teams ensuring that Foundation APQP essentials are updated according to novelties and new risks. How you´ll make an impact Coordinate the development of Foundation APQP plan. Lead foundation APQP Plan related meetings, collecting and preparing documentation, being main connection point between QMT, Factories, Global experts and R&D. Participate in Foundation FMEA workshops and s upport HUBs and Factories to use foundation APQP essentials (to be cascaded to local products). Support R&D organization to use foundation APQP essentials for new product developments. Support ToT projects to ensure proper transfer of APQP essentials. Act as GPG I&C Plato Admin, train crossfunctional teams, support the organization on the usage and ensure that foundation content is updated . Proactive identification of technology novelties to drive updates in foundation APQP essentials and c ollaborate with GPG Operations to identify global process changes that might affect to foundation APQP essentials ( e.g. from best practices to requirement). Strong knowledge of APQP processes, FMEA, PPAP, SPC, and MSA methodologies. Experience with Plato is an advatage . Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and implement process improvements. descriptions.it: The opportunity Sustainability starts at the design table—and this role puts you right at the center of that impact. As the Engineering Design Sustainability Lead , you will shape how sustainability is embedded into global engineering decisions across our transformer business. This is a highly visible, strategic role where engineering excellence meets environmental responsibility. You will lead the shift from downstream sustainability activities to design‑led outcomes, ensuring product‑level carbon reduction, material optimization, and environmental performance are built into every design choice from the outset. You will work across global engineering teams to translate sustainability ambitions into measurable, auditable product outcomes—balancing cost, safety, quality, and performance. With increasing expectations from customers, regulators, and stakeholders for credible product‑level data, your work will directly support compliance, ESG reporting, and long‑term business resilience. If you thrive at the intersection of engineering, data, and sustainability—and enjoy influencing without direct authority—this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of sustainable product design at scale. How you'll make an impact Define and drive a global, design‑led sustainability strategy within Engineering. Embed sustainability into engineering standards, processes, and decision frameworks. Reduce product‑level carbon footprint through smart design, material, and architecture choices. Establish sustainability targets, KPIs, and traceable product‑level data at BOM level. Partner across engineering, R&D, supply chain, digital and operations teams globally. Strengthen governance, reporting, and audit‑ready sustainability metrics. Build capability and foster ownership of sustainable design within engineering teams. Translate regulatory and customer sustainability expectations into engineering requirements. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Your background Master's degree or PhD in Engineering or a closely related sustainability discipline. 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years in sustainability‑focused roles. Proven success delivering design‑led sustainability or product carbon reduction initiatives. Strong knowledge of lifecycle assessment, sustainable materials, and carbon accounting. Experience leading global, cross‑functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders. Strong analytical mindset with a data‑driven approach to decision‑making. More about us At Hitachi Energy , sustainability, innovation, and safety are core to how we design the future of energy. You'll work in a global, diverse environment where ideas are valued and impact is visible. • We offer meaningful opportunities to grow, lead, and shape industry‑leading solutions with purpose.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence Manager for the Business Unit Transformers to join our team shaping the future of energy through digital innovation, data‑driven insights, and AI‑enabled solutions. In this role, you will drive data‑ and AI‑enabled value creation by converting business strategy into prioritized AI initiatives, ensuring measurable impact across operations, decision‑making, and innovation. This position offers the opportunity to grow your career within the newly established Digital Transformation Organization, collaborate with global stakeholders, and shape the future of Transformer solutions. How you will make an impact Shape the future of data, analytics, and AI by setting a clear strategic direction that drives meaningful business outcomes at scale. Turn real business challenges into AI opportunities that improve decisions, performance, and competitive advantage. Build and lead a high‑impact AI portfolio, taking ideas from early concepts to scaled solutions that create measurable value. Champion responsible and trusted AI by embedding strong governance, ethics, and data standards into everything delivered. Elevate data as a strategic asset by improving quality, consistency, and access to enable powerful insights and AI solutions. Lead diverse, cross‑functional teams to deliver AI initiatives that are practical, scalable, and business‑ready. Learn from results to continuously refine approaches, scale successes, and amplify business impact. Build strong partnerships with business and digital leaders to align priorities and accelerate AI adoption. Strengthen organizational capabilities through targeted learning, clear messaging, and a strong data‑driven mindset. Drive change with confidence by guiding stakeholders through transformation and ensuring responsible adoption of new solutions. Inspire, develop, and grow high‑performing Data, Analytics, and AI teams aligned behind a shared vision. Your background Master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., CAIP, advanced AI\/ML certifications) highly valued. Minimum 15+ years of experience in roles related to business process management or program implementation in the manufacturing industry. Effective communication skills with a proven ability to engage diverse stakeholders at all levels, fostering a collaborative environment to drive initiatives. Demonstrated competence in influencing and motivating teams to adopt new processes, reduce resistance, and achieve successful transitions to globally harmonized practices. descriptions.it: Über die Position Als Vorarbeiter in der GI Valves Fabrik in Turgi bzw. Seon übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in der täglichen Produktionssteuerung. Du koordinierst operative Tätigkeiten innerhalb des Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Montage-, Prüf- und Logistikprozesse effizient, sicher und qualitätsgerecht ablaufen. Dabei bist Du die direkte Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeiter und arbeitest eng mit der Produktionsleitung und anderen Schnittstellen zusammen. Dein Einsatz trägt wesentlich dazu bei, dass wir unsere Produktionsziele erreichen und uns kontinuierlich verbessern. Neben koordinativen Tätigkeiten arbeitest Du aktiv im Montageprozess mit. Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung der Produktionsabläufe (Montage, Prüfung, Logistik) Unterstützung des Teams sowohl fachlich als auch operativ Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Durchführung von Sicherheitsunterweisungen Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Planung, Qualität und Logistik sowie Dokumentation der Produktionsleistung Das bringst du mit Technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Elektrotechnik, Elektroinstallation, Mechatronik) Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage elektrotechnischer Komponenten Erfahrung als Vorarbeiter und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil SAP-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit digitalen Produktionssystemen sind ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Iscriviti al nostro Centro di Servizi Locali in Svizzera per una posizione dinamica che unisce la gestione dei progetti a responsabilità pratiche sul campo. In questo ruolo, supervisionerai i progetti di assistenza dei trasformatori di potenza dall'inizio alla fine, assicurandoti che tutti gli strumenti, le attrezzature e le procedure di calibrazione siano preparati con cura per operazioni sicure ed efficienti in loco. Entrando a far parte del nostro team, contribuirai direttamente alla stabilità della rete elettrica svizzera e avrai l'opportunità di collaborare con i principali attori del mercato energetico svizzero. Se ti piace gestire gli stakeholder tanto quanto rimboccarti le maniche per assicurarti che i team sul campo siano pronti all'azione, questo è il ruolo che fa per te. Si prega di inviare i vostri documenti in inglese. Come creare un impatto Lead e coordinare progetti di servizio trasformatori cross-funzionali dall'inizio all'altro, esecuzione in loco e chiusura, con piena responsabilità su tempistiche, costi, qualità, risorse e rischi Garantire disponibilità, conformità e affidabilità di strumenti, strumenti e apparecchiature di collaudo, inclusa manutenzione, calibrazione, certificazione e prontezza per le operazioni di servizio dei trasformatori Gestire e ottimizzare la logistica degli utensili e delle attrezzature, coprendo il controllo dell'inventario, Stoccaggio, rifornimento, spedizione, preparazione del materiale specifico per progetto e condivisione delle risorse tra i progetti Supportare i team sul campo con pacchetti completi, inclusi documentazione tecnica, procedure, requisiti di sicurezza e coordinamento onsite quando necessario Agire come interfaccia primaria tra clienti, team di assistenza sul campo, workshop, fornitori e stakeholder interni, garantendo una comunicazione chiara, proattiva e orientata alla soddisfazione durante tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto Pianifico, programma, e supervisionare le attività di servizio, garantendo la piena prontezza lavorativa prima della mobilitazione del sito, inclusi ambito tecnico, documentazione, permessi, accesso, logistica e prerequisiti HSE. Preparare e coordinare le attività in loco, garantire un'esecuzione sicura, fluida ed efficiente, e fornire supporto operativo operativo operativo durante situazioni critiche o complesse. Identificare, escalare e risolvere i rischi di progetto e operativi, garantendo la rigorosa conformità alle regole HSE, Standard ISO e requisiti normativi Favoriscono il miglioramento e la standardizzazione continui, migliorando la gestione degli strumenti, i processi di preparazione del sito e l'efficienza complessiva dell'esecuzione dei servizi Il tuo background Laurea in ingegneria, gestione tecnica o in un campo correlato 3+ anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti o nel coordinamento dei servizi sul campo Handson mentalità e forte interesse per strumenti, calibrazione, sicurezza e preparazione tecnica Solide competenze organizzative e comunicative Esperienza in standard di qualità (ad esempio, ISO): Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e assumersi la responsabilità dei compiti dall'inizio all'estremo, Affare fluente in francese e inglese; Il tedesco è un vantaggio Più su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le performance personali e aziendali, creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Join our Local Service Center Switzerland for a dynamic position that blends project management with hands-on field responsibilities. In this role, you will oversee power transformer service projects from start to finish, ensuring all tools, equipment, and calibration procedures are meticulously prepared for safe and efficient onsite operations. By joining our team, you will contribute directly to the stability of Switzerland's electrical grid and have the opportunity to collaborate with key players in the Swiss energy market. If you enjoy managing stakeholders as much as rolling up your sleeves to make sure field teams are ready for action, this is the role for you. Please submit your documents in English. How You'll Make an Impact Lead and coordinate cross‑functional transformer service projects end‑to‑end, onsite execution, and close‑out, with full ownership of schedule, cost, quality, resources, and risks Ensure availability, compliance, and reliability of tools, instruments, and testing equipment, including maintenance, calibration, certification, and readiness for transformer service operations Manage and optimize tooling and equipment logistics, covering inventory control, storage, replenishment, shipment, project‑specific material preparation, and resource sharing across projects Support field teams with complete job packs, including technical documentation, procedures, safety requirements, and onsite coordination when required Act as the primary interface between customers, field service teams, workshops, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring clear, proactive, and satisfaction‑oriented communication throughout the project lifecycle Plan, schedule, and supervise service activities, ensuring full job readiness prior to site mobilization, including technical scope, documentation, permits, access, logistics, and HSE prerequisites Prepare and coordinate onsite activities, guarantee safe, smooth, and efficient execution, and providing hands‑on operational support during critical or complex situations Identify, escalate, and resolve project and operational risks, ensuring strict compliance with HSE rules, ISO standards, and regulatory requirements Drive continuous improvement and standardization, enhancing tooling management, site preparation processes, and overall service execution efficiency Your background Degree in engineering, technical management, or a related field 3+ years of project management or field service coordination experience Handson mindset and strong interest in tools, calibration, safety, and technical preparation Solid organizational and communication skills Experience with quality standards (e.g., ISO) Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks end-to-end Business fluent in French and fluent English; German is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Die Gelegenheit Treten Sie unserem lokalen Service-Center Schweiz für eine dynamische Position bei, die Projektmanagement mit praktischen • Aufgaben vor Ort verbindet. In dieser Rolle beaufsichtigen Sie die Serviceprojekte für Leistungstransformatoren von Anfang bis Ende und stellen sicher, dass alle Werkzeuge, Geräte und Kalibrierungsverfahren sorgfältig auf einen sicheren und effizienten Betrieb vor Ort vorbereitet sind. Indem Sie sich unserem Team anschließen, tragen Sie direkt zur Stabilität des Schweizer Stromnetzes bei und haben die Möglichkeit, mit wichtigen Akteuren auf dem Schweizer Energiemarkt zusammenzuarbeiten. Wenn Sie Stakeholder genauso gerne verwalten wie die Ärmel hochkrempeln, um sicherzustellen, dass die Außendienstteams einsatzbereit sind, ist dies die richtige Rolle für Sie. Bitte reichen Sie Ihre Unterlagen in englischer Sprache ein. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Führen und koordinieren funktionsübergreifende Transformator-Serviceprojekte Ende-zu-Ende, Ausführung vor Ort und Abschluss, mit vollständiger Verantwortung für Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, Ressourcen und Risiken Stellen Sie die Verfügbarkeit, Konformität und Zuverlässigkeit von Werkzeugen, Instrumenten und Prüfgeräten sicher, einschließlich Wartung, Kalibrierung, Zertifizierung und Bereitschaft für den Transformator-Servicebetrieb Verwalten und optimieren Sie die Werkzeug- und Ausrüstungslogistik, einschließlich Bestandskontrolle, Lagerung, Nachschub, Versand, projektspezifische Materialvorbereitung und projektübergreifende Ressourcenteilung Unterstützen Sie Außendienstteams mit vollständigen Arbeitspaketen, einschließlich technischer Dokumentation, Verfahren, Sicherheitsanforderungen und Vor-Ort-Koordination bei Bedarf Handeln Sie als
descriptions.fr: L'occasion Joignez-vous à notre Centre de services locaux Suisse pour une position dynamique qui combine la gestion de projet avec des responsabilités pratiques sur le terrain. Dans ce rôle, vous superviserez les projets de service de transformateurs de puissance du début à la fin, assurant que tous les outils, équipements et procédures d'étalonnage sont méticuleusement préparés pour des opérations sur place sûres et efficaces. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous contribuerez directement à la stabilité du réseau électrique suisse et aurez la possibilité de collaborer avec des acteurs clés du marché suisse de l'énergie. Si vous aimez gérer les parties prenantes autant que monter vos manches pour vous assurer que les équipes de terrain sont prêtes à agir, c'est le rôle pour vous. Veuillez soumettre vos documents en anglais. Comment vous ferez un impact Dirigez et coordonnez des projets de services de transformation transfonctionnels en anglais, de bout en bout, d'exécution sur place et de fermeture, avec pleine propriété du calendrier, du coût, de la qualité, des ressources et des risques Assurer la disponibilité, la conformité et la fiabilité des outils, des instruments et du matériel d'essai, y compris la maintenance, l'étalonnage, la certification et la préparation aux opérations de transformation Gérer et optimiser l'outillage et la logistique du matériel, y compris le contrôle des stocks, le stockage, la reconstitution, l'expédition, la préparation du matériel spécifique au projet et le partage des ressources entre les projets Soutenir les équipes de terrain avec des équipes de travail complètes, y compris la documentation technique, les procédures, les exigences en matière de sécurité et la coordination sur place au besoin Agir comme interface principale entre les clients, les équipes de services sur le terrain, les ateliers, les fournisseurs et les intervenants internes, assurer une communication claire, proactive et axée sur la satisfaction tout au long du cycle de vie du projet Plan, du calendrier et de la supervision des activités de service, assurer une pleine préparation au travail avant la mobilisation du site, y compris la documentation et les permis, l'accès.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously
