descriptions.it: ## Descrizione L'opportunità Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è il leader tecnologico nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta tensione. Tutte le rinomate aziende internazionali dell'industria elettrica, attive nella produzione di energia, trasmissione e distribuzione sono tra i nostri clienti. Abbiamo una posizione superiore nelle aree di boccole ad alta tensione in tutto il mondo. Unisciti al nostro team come nostro responsabile della produzione. In questo ruolo, lavorerai come Business Partner per la gestione e il responsabile del reparto di controllo in fabbrica (Local Product Group), mentre allo stesso tempo monitorerai attentamente i principali indicatori finanziari, le tendenze di mercato e le attività dei clienti. Attingendo alle tue capacità analitiche ben affinate utilizzando SAP S4 HANA, lavorerai a stretto contatto con i vari stakeholder per garantire un efficace processo decisionale per il successo della fabbrica. ## Mansioni - Responsabilità per la chiusura mensile, la segnalazione, il bilancio e la previsione in linea con le linee guida per la segnalazione di Hitachi Energy - Monitoraggio delle variazioni tra bilancio e risultati effettivi per sostenere le azioni di gestione - Supporto definizione di pianificazione aziendale, implementazione e follow up secondo le strategie di business unit - Crea analisi approfondite delle immersioni in SAP HANA di Gross Profit (ad esempio: riconoscimento delle entrate, COGS, mix di prodotti, overhead di produzione, Capex, assorbimento) - Mantenere Full Cost Model e rivedere i prezzi e la capacità di produzione - Support Project Management durante l'esecuzione del progetto e i responsabili delle vendite dell'unità durante la fase di gara; identificare e comunicare i rischi finanziari e le opportunità durante le offerte; partecipazione alle recensioni dei rischi - Monitoraggio dei KPI di produzione, analisi mensile dei costi SG&A, Cash Flows & Overdues, OBL, ORs and Revenues - Le capacità di miglioramento delle imprese e la gestione dei progetti possono- # • Requisiti # - Master o laurea in amministrazione aziendale / finanza / economia (o simile) - 5 10 anni di esperienza e un record di successo in un ruolo simile all'interno di un ambiente internazionale - Eccellente conoscenza pratica in SAP S/4 HANA - Esperienza nel controllo della fabbrica e nel business del prodotto - L'atteggiamento attivo e pratico con un forte può fare mindset, in grado di lavorare efficacemente sotto pressione e prendere la proprietà delle responsabilità - Ottima comprensione del bilancio, del reddito e del flusso di cassa - Specialista di finanza e controllo con solida competenza in MS Office, SAP, Power BI e ABACUS Analyzer, e una buona comprensione di IFRS - Fluente in inglese, il tedesco sarebbe un forte vantaggio # Cosa # - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: ## Descrizione The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is the technology leader in design and manufacture of high voltage transformer bushings. All renowned international companies of the electrical industry, active in power generation, transmission and distribution are among our customers. We have a top position in the high voltage bushing areas worldwide. Join our team as our Production Controller. In this role, you will operate as a Business Partner to the company's management and head of controlling department in the factory (Local Product Group), while at the same time closely monitoring key financial indicators, market trends and customer activities. Drawing on your finely honed analytical abilities using SAP S4 HANA, you will work closely with the various stakeholders to ensure effective decision-making for the success of the factory. ## Mansioni - Responsibility for monthly closing, reporting, budgeting and forecasting in line with Hitachi Energy reporting guidelines - Monitoring of variances between budget and actual results to support management actions - Support business planning definition, implementation and follow up according to business unit strategies - Create deep dive analysis in SAP HANA of Gross Profit (e.g.: revenue recognition, COGS, product mix, production overhead, Capex, absorption) - Maintain Full Cost Model and review pricing and capacity for production - Support Project Management during project execution and sales managers of the unit during the tender phase; identify and communicate financial risks and opportunities during tenders; participation in risk reviews - Monitoring of production KPIs, monthly SG&A cost analysis, Cash Flows & Overdues, OBL, ORs and Revenues follow up - Business improvement capabilities and project management can- do attitude ## • Requisiti - Master or bachelor's degree in business administration / finance / economics (or similar) - 5- 10 years of experience and successful track record in a similar role within an international environment - Excellent practical knowledge in SAP S/4 HANA - Experience in factory controlling and product business - Proactive, hands-on attitude with a strong can do mindset, able to work effectively under pressure and take ownership of responsibilities - Very good understanding of balance sheet, income statement and Cash flow - Finance and controlling specialist with solid proficiency in MS Office, SAP, Power BI, and ABACUS Analyzer, and a good understanding of IFRS - Fluent in English, German would be a strong advantage ## • Cosa offriamo - Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: ## Descrizion Die Chance Unsere lokale Produktgruppe Insulation & Components ist Technologieführer in der Entwicklung und Herstellung von Hochspannungstransformatordurchführungen. Alle namhaften internationalen Unternehmen der Elektroindustrie, die in der Stromerzeugung, -übertragung und -verteilung tätig sind, gehören zu unseren Kunden. Wir haben eine Spitzenposition in den Hochspannungsdurchführungsbereichen weltweit. Treten Sie unserem Team als Produktionscontroller bei. In dieser Funktion sind Sie als Geschäftspartner der Unternehmensleitung und Leiter des Controllings in der Fabrik (Local Product Group) tätig und beobachten gleichzeitig wichtige Finanzkennzahlen, Markttrends und Kundenaktivitäten. Mit Ihren feinen analytischen Fähigkeiten mit SAP S4 HANA arbeiten Sie eng mit den verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine effektive Entscheidungsfindung für den Erfolg der Fabrik zu gewährleisten. ## Mansioni - Verantwortung für den monatlichen Abschluss, die Berichterstattung, die Budgetierung und die Prognose gemäß den Hitachi Energy Reporting Guidelines - Überwachung von Abweichungen zwischen Budget und tatsächlichen Ergebnissen zur Unterstützung von Managementmaßnahmen - Unterstützung bei der Definition, Umsetzung und Nachverfolgung der Geschäftsplanung gemäß Geschäftsbereichsstrategien - Erstellung einer tiefen Tauchanalyse des Bruttogewinns in SAP HANA (z. B. Umsatzerkennung, COGS, Produktmix, Produktionsaufwand, Capex, Absorption) - Behalten Sie das Vollkostenmodell bei und überprüfen Sie die Preise und die Produktionskapazität - Unterstützung des Projektmanagements während der Projektdurchführung und der Vertriebsleiter der Einheit während der Ausschreibungsphase; Identifizierung und Kommunikation finanzieller Risiken und Chancen während der Ausschreibungen; Teilnahme an Risikoprüfungen - Überwachung von Produktions-KPIs, monatliche SG&A-Kostenanalyse, Cash Flows & Overdues, OBL, ORs und Revenue Follow-up - Business Improvement Fähigkeiten und Projektmanagement Can-Do Haltung ## • Requisiti - Master- oder Bachelor-Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft / Finanzen / Wirtschaft (oder ähnlich) - 5- 10 Jahre Erfahrung und erfolgreiche Erfolgsbilanz in einer ähnlichen Rolle in einem internationalen Umfeld - Ausgezeichnete praktische Kenntnisse in SAP S/4 HANA - Erfahrung im Factory Controlling und Produktgeschäft Proaktive, praktische Haltung mit einer starken Denkweise, die in der Lage ist, effektiv unter Druck zu arbeiten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen - Sehr gutes Verständnis von Bilanz, Gewinn- und Verlustrechnung und Cashflow Finanz- und Controlling-Spezialist mit soliden Kenntnissen in MS Office, SAP, Power BI und ABACUS Analyzer und einem guten Verständnis der IFRS - fließend Englisch, Deutsch wäre ein großer Vorteil • Cosa offriamo Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité Notre groupe de produits local Isolation & Components est le leader technologique dans la conception et la fabrication de douilles de transformateurs haute tension. Toutes les entreprises internationales de renom de l'industrie électrique, actives dans la production, la transmission et la distribution d'électricité sont parmi nos clients. Nous avons une position supérieure dans les zones de douille haute tension dans le monde entier. Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que contrôleur de production. Dans ce rôle, vous agirez en tant que partenaire d'affaires de la direction de l'entreprise et chef du service de contrôle de l'usine (Groupe de produits locaux), tout en suivant de près les principaux indicateurs financiers, les tendances du marché et les activités des clients. En s'appuyant sur vos capacités d'analyse raffinées en utilisant SAP S4 HANA, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les différents intervenants pour assurer une prise de décision efficace pour le succès de l'usine. Mansioni - La responsabilité de la clôture mensuelle, de l ' établissement des rapports, de la budgétisation et des prévisions conformément aux directives Hitachi pour l ' établissement des rapports sur l ' énergie - Suivi des écarts entre le budget et les résultats réels pour appuyer les actions de gestion - Appuyer la définition, la mise en œuvre et le suivi de la planification des activités selon les stratégies des unités opérationnelles - Créer une analyse de plongée profonde dans SAP HANA du bénéfice brut (par exemple: comptabilisation des revenus, COGS, mélange de produits, frais généraux de production, Capex, absorption) - Maintenir le modèle de coût complet et revoir les prix et la capacité de production - Appui à la gestion de projet pendant l'exécution du projet et aux directeurs des ventes de l'unité pendant la phase d'appel d'offres; identification et communication des risques financiers et des opportunités au cours des appels d'offres; participation à l'examen des risques - Suivi des ICR de la production, analyse mensuelle des coûts de la S&A, flux de trésorerie et arriérés, BBL, ROR et recettes - Capacités d'amélioration des affaires et la gestion de projet peuvent- faire attitude • Requisiti - Maîtrise ou baccalauréat en administration des affaires / finance / économie (ou similaire) - 5-10 ans d'expérience et de réussite dans un rôle similaire dans un environnement international - Excellente connaissance pratique en SAP S/4 HANA - Expérience dans le contrôle d'usine et le commerce de produits - Une attitude proactive et pratique avec un fort pouvoir d'esprit, capable de travailler efficacement sous pression et d'assumer les responsabilités - Très bonne compréhension du bilan, du bilan et des flux de trésorerie - Spécialiste des finances et du contrôle avec une solide compétence en MS Office, SAP, Power BI et ABACUS Analyzer, et une bonne compréhension des IFRS - Fluent en anglais, l'allemand serait un fort avantage • Cosa offriamo - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

descriptions.it: The opportunity At our BiMOS Backend plant in Lenzburg, Switzerland and Power Semiconductor factory in Prague, Czech Republic, we manufacture efficient, high-quality power semiconductors for use in motor control units, traction applications, industrial applications and inverter systems. In this way, we make a decisive contribution to making industry, public and private transportation more energy-efficient, while our technology also enables the production and transportation of renewable energy from the production site to the consumer. A new production facility is being established in Prague for one of our original equipment manufacturer (OEM) products. This move is motivated by considerations of capacity and business continuity. As part of your Internship in Production Development, you will assist with the transfer of production capabilities from Lenzburg to Prague. You play a vital role in facilitating the introduction and ramp-up of Hitachi Energy Semiconductors products at our second manufacturing site in Prague \/ Czech Republic. • Your responsibilities focus on ensuring operational excellence, process integrity, and effective knowledge transfer across locations. How you'll make an impact Supporting the implementation and qualification of new production tools, ensuring they meet performance and reliability standards Assisting with equipment integration as well as the collection and analysis of production and process data Establishing process quality control procedures and corresponding control loops to maintain product consistency and compliance Organizing and supporting training of new production personnel, ensuring effective knowledge transfer from the Lenzburg site to the new factory Supporting product qualification by coordinating production of samples and testing activities Support the implementation of logistical flows for raw materials and processed parts between Lenzburg and Prague Ensuring comprehensive and accurate documentation of processes, work instructions, supporting materials, production tools, and their configurations, to support operational excellence and future audits Your background Study engineering, physics, chemistry, production technology, or related disciplines; holding a bachelor's degree is preferred. The assignment can be part of a master's thesis Show genuine interest in semiconductor backend manufacturing, including areas like innovative processes, logistics, and governance Show effective communication skills for collaborating with diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams, as well as an interest in international collaboration and knowledge sharing Exhibit attention to detail in documentation and process setup, along with organizational abilities for supporting training, planning, and knowledge transfer Adapt easily to changing environments, embrace new tools, and commit to a six- to nine-month assignment split between Switzerland and the Czech Republic, supporting both operational and developmental activities English at minimum C1 level. Mastering of German is an advantage More about us This internship provides hands-on experience with manufacturing processes and operational excellence in a leading power semiconductor environment. It offers the chance to develop technical and organizational skills while supporting a major industrial expansion across Switzerland and the Czech Republic. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

titles.fr: Gestionnaire d'équipe de R-D semi-conducteur – Dispositifs bipolaires 80 - 100% (f/m/d)

descriptions.it: Mansioni - Guida e mentora un team di ingegneri R&D in un ambiente collaborativo - Gestisce l'intero ciclo di sviluppo dei dispositivi semiconduttori bipolari, dalla concezione alla trasferta di produzione - Definisce e attua strategie R&D allineate con gli obiettivi aziendali e le roadmap tecnologiche - Conduce ricerche sui materiali, sulle architetture dei dispositivi e sui processi di produzione - Collabora diretta con l'ingegneria dei processi, la gestione dei prodotti e la produzione - Monitora le tecnologie emergenti e le tendenze di mercato nei semiconduttori di potenza - Redige documentazione tecnica, presentazioni e domande di brevetto - Gestisce progetti, budget, tempi e standard di qualità • Requisiti - Dottorato o Master in Fisica, Ingegneria Elettrica, Scienze dei Materiali o campo affine con una solida conoscenza della fisica dei dispositivi semiconduttori - Molti anni di esperienza in R&D semiconduttori, inclusa la responsabilità di leadership - Estesa esperienza in dispositivi semiconduttori di potenza (ad esempio IGBT, MOSFET di potenza, diodi, tiristori) o applicazioni semiconduttori di potenza - Dimostrata capacità di guidare i tecnici in un ambiente R&D complesso - Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione interpersonale, risoluzione dei conflitti e gestione degli stakeholder - Passione per la leadership, l'innovazione e l'attivazione degli altri per il successo Cosa? - Pratiche di lavoro flessibili per ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali e creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere - Condizioni scontate nei nostri asili nido di Baden e Oerlikon - Giorni extra tra Natale e Capodanno - Sconto del 50% sui piatti principali nei nostri frigoriferi FELFEL - Quanto costa la società - Benefici pensionistici dotatinti con il nostro fondo pensione aziendale - Promozione della diversità e dell'inclusione e offerte culturali - Numerose opportunità di carriera e formazione all'interno di Hitachi Energy Contatto
descriptions.en: The opportunity At Hitachi Energy, we are committed to advancing a sustainable energy future for all by empowering the brightest minds to push technological boundaries. Join a diverse global community that thrives on collaboration, innovation, and purpose. We are looking for an experienced R&D Team Lead with a strong background in power semiconductor technologies and a proven track record in leading and developing high-performing R&D teams. How you'll make an impact Lead, manage, and develop a team of R&D engineers, fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and accountable team culture Take full responsibility for team delivery, including resource planning, performance management, and team development Own the end-to-end development of bipolar semiconductor devices, from concept to manufacturing transfer Define and execute R&D strategies aligned with business goals and technology roadmaps Drive innovation in materials, device architectures, and fabrication processes Collaborate closely with process engineering, product management, and manufacturing to ensure successful industrialization Actively monitor emerging technologies and market trends in power semiconductors Guide and review technical work, ensuring high quality standards and technical excellence Oversee project execution, including timelines, budget, and risk management Prepare and review technical documentation, presentations, and patent applications Your background PhD or master's degree in physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline with strong grounding in semiconductor device physics Several years of experience in semiconductor R&D, including proven experience in leading and managing R&D teams Solid track record in people management, including performance management, coaching, and team development Extensive hands-on experience in power semiconductor devices (e.g. IGBTs, power MOSFETs, diodes, thyristors) or related applications Demonstrated ability to drive technical delivery through others in a complex R&D environment Strong interpersonal, leadership, and stakeholder management skills Experience in managing cross-functional teams and influencing without authority Strong ownership mindset with the ability to balance technical depth and leadership responsibilities Passion for developing people, driving innovation, and building high-performing teams More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. descriptions.it: Come specialista di assemblaggio in produzione, si gioca un ruolo centrale nella produzione dei nostri prodotti. L'installazione di impianti di produzione, l'esecuzione di lavori di assemblaggio e l'assicurarsi che tutte le fasi di lavoro siano eseguite in conformità con i requisiti in materia di qualità, efficienza e sicurezza. Grazie alla vostra esperienza, riconoscete le deviazioni in anticipo, analizzate le cause e sostenete attivamente il continuo miglioramento dei processi produttivi e l'integrazione di nuovi dipendenti. Questo consente di eseguire lavori di assemblaggio e produzione secondo specifiche, istruzioni di lavoro e standard di qualità Installazione, gestione e monitoraggio di impianti di produzione e attrezzature di lavoro Assicurare un processo di produzione regolare, mantenendo il tempo, i costi e le specifiche di qualità Applicazione dei controlli di qualità, nonché l'identificazione, l'analisi e la correzione di deviazioni Spostamento, smistamento e imballaggio di materiali e prodotti finiti Documentazione dei dati di produzione per supportare l'analisi delle prestazioni Questo ti porta a lavorare con una completa esperienza tecnica e artigianale o professionale comparabile nella produzione Esperienza pluriennale nell'ambiente di produzione industriale, idealmente nell'assemblaggio o nella produzione Buona conoscenza dei processi di produzione, dei flussi di lavoro e degli strumenti Capacità di sviluppare soluzioni strutturate anche in problemi complessi Lavoro autonomo, affidabile e di qualità-consapevole Funzionamento delle competenze del Team, nonché la volontà di assumersi responsabilità e trasmettere conoscenze in funzionamento a 2 turni.
descriptions.en: As an assembly specialist in production, you play a central role in the production of our products. You set up production facilities, perform assembly work and make sure that all work steps are carried out in accordance with requirements regarding quality, efficiency and safety. Thanks to your experience, you recognize deviations early, analyze causes and actively support the continuous improvement of production processes and the incorporation of new employees. This allows you to perform assembly and production work according to specifications, work instructions and quality standards Set up, operate and monitor production facilities and work equipment Ensure a smooth production process while maintaining time, cost and quality specifications Implementation of quality controls as well as identification, analysis and correction of deviations Moving, sorting and packaging of materials and finished products Documentation of production data to support performance analysis This brings you to work with completed technical & craftsmanship or comparable professional experience in production Multiannual experience in industrial production environment, ideally in assembly or manufacturing Good knowledge of production processes, workflows and tools Ability to develop structured solutions even in complex problems Self-employed, reliable and quality-conscious functioning Team skills as well as the willingness to take responsibility and pass on knowledge in 2-shift operation More about us We are looking for a safe workplace in a future-oriented company, exciting development opportunities, a collegial and value-adding working environment and attractive social benefits.
descriptions.de: Über die Position Als Montagefachkraft in der Produktion übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Fertigung unserer Produkte. Du richtest Produktionsanlagen ein, führst Montagearbeiten durch und stellst sicher, dass alle Arbeitsschritte gemäss Vorgaben hinsichtlich Qualität, Effizienz und Sicherheit ausgeführt werden. Dank deiner Erfahrung erkennst du Abweichungen frühzeitig, analysierst Ursachen und unterstützt aktiv die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse sowie die Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Montage- und Produktionsarbeiten gemäss Spezifikationen, Arbeitsanweisungen und Qualitätsstandards Einrichten, Bedienen und Überwachen von Produktionsanlagen und Arbeitsmitteln Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Produktionsablaufs unter Einhaltung von Termin-, Kosten- und Qualitätsvorgaben Durchführung von Qualitätskontrollen sowie Identifikation, Analyse und Behebung von Abweichungen Bewegen, Sortieren und Verpacken von Materialien und Fertigprodukten Dokumentation von Produktionsdaten zur Unterstützung der Leistungsanalyse Unterstützung bei der Optimierung von Prozessen sowie Einbringen von Verbesserungsvorschlägen Fachliche Unterstützung und Einarbeitung von weniger erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene technische\/handwerkliche Berufsausbildung oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung in der Produktion Mehrjährige Erfahrung im industriellen Produktionsumfeld, idealerweise in Montage oder Fertigung Gute Kenntnisse von Produktionsprozessen, Arbeitsabläufen und Werkzeugen Fähigkeit, auch bei komplexeren Problemen strukturiert Lösungen zu erarbeiten Selbstständige, zuverlässige und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise Teamfähigkeit sowie die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wissen weiterzugeben Bereitschaft in 2-Schicht Betrieb zu arbeiten Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.
descriptions.fr: En tant que spécialiste de la production, vous jouez un rôle central dans la production de nos produits. Vous créez des installations de production, effectuez des travaux d'assemblage et assurez-vous que toutes les étapes de travail sont effectuées conformément aux exigences en matière de qualité, d'efficacité et de sécurité. Grâce à votre expérience, vous reconnaissez les écarts tôt, analysez les causes et soutenez activement l'amélioration continue des processus de production et l'intégration de nouveaux employés. Cela vous permet d'effectuer des travaux de montage et de production selon les spécifications, les instructions de travail et les normes de qualité Configurer, exploiter et surveiller les installations de production et les équipements de travail Assurer un processus de production fluide tout en maintenant le temps, les coûts et les spécifications de qualité Mise en œuvre des contrôles de qualité ainsi que l'identification, l'analyse et la correction des écarts Déplacement, tri et emballage des matériaux et des produits finis Documentation des données de production pour soutenir l'analyse des performances Cela vous amène à travailler avec un savoir-faire technique & ou une expérience professionnelle comparable dans la production Expérience pluriannuelle dans l'environnement de production industrielle, idéalement dans l'assemblage ou la fabrication Bonne connaissance des processus de production, des workflows et des outils Capacité de développer des solutions structurées même dans des problèmes complexes Travailleur indépendant, fiable et soucieux de la qualité Compétences de l'équipe ainsi que la volonté d'assumer la responsabilité et de transmettre des connaissances dans l'exploitation de 2 équipes Plus sur nous Nous cherchons un lieu de travail sûr dans une entreprise tournée vers l'avenir, des possibilités de développement passionnantes, un environnement de travail collégial et enrichissant et des avantages sociaux attrayants.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità In questo ruolo, diventerai parte di un team di project management collaborativo all'interno di un ambiente internazionale. Supporti il team nelle attività operative e amministrative quotidiane e ottieni preziose informazioni sul coordinamento e l'esecuzione del progetto. La posizione offre un'esposizione pratica ai processi di lavoro strutturati e una stretta collaborazione con vari stakeholder. Cresce assumendo la responsabilità di compiti definiti, pur essendo supportato da colleghi esperti. Supporto del team di gestione del progetto nelle attività di progetto quotidiane Mantenere i compiti amministrativi in modo indipendente Mantenere la documentazione del progetto e la comunicazione Supporto con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni Assistere nella pianificazione e coordinamento delle attività Contribuire a un'esecuzione e all'organizzazione del progetto L'interesse per la gestione del progetto e argomenti organizzativi Molto buone competenze linguistiche italiane Buone capacità di comunicazione e uno stile di lavoro strutturato Alto livello di affidabilità e attenzione ai dettagli • Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro.
descriptions.en: The opportunity In this role, you will become part of a collaborative project management team within an international environment. You support the team in daily operational and administrative activities and gain valuable insights into project coordination and execution. The position offers hands‑on exposure to structured work processes and close cooperation with various stakeholders. You grow by taking responsibility for defined tasks while being supported by experienced colleagues. How you'll make an impact Support the project management team in daily project activities Handle administrative tasks independently Maintain project documentation and reporting Support communication with internal and external stakeholders Assist in scheduling and task coordination Contribute to smooth project execution and organization Your background Strong interest in project management and organizational topics Very good Italian language skills Good communication skills and a structured working style High level of reliability and attention to detail Confident handling of common office tools More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
descriptions.de: Die Gelegenheit In dieser Rolle werden Sie Teil eines kollaborativen Projektmanagement-Teams in einem internationalen Umfeld werden. Sie unterstützen das Team bei täglichen operativen und administrativen Aktivitäten und gewinnen wertvolle Einblicke in die Projektkoordination und -ausführung. Die Position bietet eine praktische Exposition gegenüber strukturierten Arbeitsprozessen und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Interessenvertretern. Sie wachsen durch die Verantwortung für definierte Aufgaben und werden von erfahrenen Kollegen unterstützt. descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous ferez partie d'une équipe collaborative de gestion de projet dans un environnement international. Vous aidez l'équipe dans les activités opérationnelles et administratives quotidiennes et vous obtenez des informations précieuses sur la coordination et l'exécution des projets. Le poste offre une exposition pratique à des processus de travail structurés et une collaboration étroite avec divers intervenants. Vous grandissez en assumant la responsabilité de tâches définies tout en étant soutenu par des collègues expérimentés. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Soutenir l'équipe de gestion de projet dans les activités quotidiennes de projet Gérer les tâches administratives de façon indépendante Maintenir la documentation et les rapports de projet Soutenir la communication avec les intervenants internes et externes Aider à planifier et à coordonner les tâches Contribuer à l'exécution et à l'organisation de projets en douceur Vos antécédents Intérêt marqué pour la gestion de projet et les sujets organisationnels Très bonne connaissance de la langue italienne Bonnes compétences en communication et style de travail structuré Haute fiabilité et attention aux détails Gestion fiable des outils de bureau communs Plus à propos de nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie et axée sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable. • Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail.

descriptions.en: The Possibility We are looking for a dynamic and experienced executive for purchasing that strengthens our dedicated service team at Hitachi, Ltd., where speed and quality are of the utmost importance. In this key position, you conduct strategic purchasing initiatives, optimize procurement processes and run a talented team of around 12 shopping experts. Your expertise ensures a fast and cost-effective procurement of goods and services while maintaining the highest quality standards and promoting long-term, partnership relationships with suppliers. This allows you to take over the leadership, promotion and further development of our purchasing team and create a performance-oriented and responsible corporate culture. They develop and implement innovative procurement concepts in accordance with our service strategy. In doing so, you place particular emphasis on timely delivery, continuous quality improvement, efficiency improvement in the supply chain and sustainable cost reduction. The application of the Critical-Path method to ensure timely procurement processes and to minimize delivery delays is one of your core tasks. They ensure consistent excellence throughout the entire purchasing process – from demand determination to payment – and ensure clear processes and maximum transparency. They define and control supplier segmentation and develop targeted procurement strategies. In addition, you are responsible for the selection, qualification and contract negotiations with suppliers. By building strategic partnerships at leadership level and establishing robust supplier management systems with KPIs, scorecards, regular reviews and escalation processes, you can ensure the sustainable performance of our supplier network. They work closely with cross-departmental teams such as material planning, engineering, quality and controlling, in order to optimally tune the purchase to the corporate requirements. They control purchase-related risks, including supply chain disruptions, price fluctuations and compliance issues. This brings you with completed studies in the field of supply chain management, business management, engineering or comparable training with relevant professional experience. At least 5 years of relevant experience in purchasing or supply chain management or at least 3 years of leadership experience in a related area. Detectable successes in strategic purchasing, in negotiations and in supplier or customer management are advantageous. Very good understanding of purchasing processes, contract law and principles of the supply chain. Impressed analytical skills as well as problem-solving and decision-making. Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Very good knowledge of purchasing software (e.g. SAP Ariba) and Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international environment and manage multiple priorities. Experience in manufacturing, technology or industry is very desirable. Our flexible work models help you to optimize personal and business performance and create an environment where all employees can develop and grow. descriptions.it: L'opportunità Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è un leader tecnologico globale nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta tensione. Rinomate aziende internazionali nell'industria elettrica, tra cui la generazione di energia, la trasmissione e la distribuzione, si affidano alle nostre soluzioni. Abbiamo una posizione leader a livello mondiale nella tecnologia di boccole ad alta tensione. Per rafforzare le nostre operazioni, stiamo cercando uno specialista Tender e Quotation (commerciale) per unirsi al nostro team nella nostra fabbrica di boccole MICAFIL in Svizzera. In questo ruolo, sarete parte di un team internazionale che si concentra sulla traduzione delle esigenze e delle sfide dei clienti in offerte e citazioni competitive. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con le nostre vendite e altri team interni per garantire che offriamo le migliori soluzioni per soddisfare le esigenze dei nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Se siete appassionati di preparare offerte e offerte e volete contribuire attivamente, unisciti al nostro team! Analizzare la richiesta di preventivi (RFQ) e altri documenti d'appalto per comprendere i requisiti del cliente, l'ambito del lavoro e le specifiche tecniche con allineamento con il team di vendita Collaborare con le attività di vendita, ingegneria, legale e altri dipartimenti interni per raccogliere informazioni necessarie, dettagli tecnici, e stime dei costi per le presentazioni delle offerte. Proattivamente mantenere la comunicazione chiara e strutturata con i clienti e le squadre interne durante il processo di aggiudicazione Il vostro background tecnico (professionale, come l'apprendistato) o background di educazione commerciale Minimo di 3 anni di esperienza amministrativa\/commerciale nelle attività di aggiudicazione, preparazione delle quote e calcolo dei prezzi, o coordinamento delle offerte, supporto delle vendite interne, o gestione del progetto all'interno di un ambiente industriale o eccellente Esperienza di sviluppo nel formulare offerte e citazioni accurate
descriptions.en: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a Tender and Quotation Specialist (commercial) to join our team at our MICAFIL bushing factory in Switzerland. In this role, you will be part of an international team focusing on translating customer needs and challenges into competitive bids and quotations. You'll work closely with our sales and other internal teams to ensure that we offer the best solutions to meet our customers' needs around the globe. If you are passionate about preparing tenders and bids and want to actively contribute, join our team! How you'll make an impact Analyze Request for Quotations (RFQs), and other tender documents to understand client requirements, scope of work, and technical specifications with alignment with the Sales team Collaborate with sales, engineering, legal, and other internal departments to gather necessary information, technical details, and cost estimates for tender submissions Develop comprehensive and well-structured tender and quotation documents, including technical proposals, drawings, commercial offers and supporting documentation Ensure all submissions are accurate, complete, and meet the specified deadlines and submission protocols May participate in pre-bid meetings, client clarifications, and negotiations as required Maintain a systematic record of all tender activities, submissions, and outcomes, for quotations and order checklists preparation and handover Continuously improve tender processes and documentation templates to enhance efficiency and quality Coordinate with internal stakeholders for optimal solutions. Proactively maintain clear and structured communication with customers and the internal teams throughout the tendering process Your background Technical (vocational, such as apprenticeship) or commercial education background Minimum of 3 years of administrative\/business experience in tendering activities, quotation preparation and price calculation, or bid coordination, internal sales support, or project management within an industrial or technical environment Proven experience in formulating accurate bids and quotations Strong understanding of tender processes, contractual terms, and commercial aspects Excellent written and verbal communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and experience with tender management software or CRM systems Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to details and solution-driven approach Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German and other languages is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

In dieser Rolle werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Teams sein, das sich darauf konzentriert, Kundenbedürfnisse und -herausforderungen in wettbewerbsfähige Angebote und Angebote zu übersetzen. Sie arbeiten eng mit unserem Vertrieb und anderen internen Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass wir die besten Lösungen anbieten, um die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden auf der ganzen Welt zu erfüllen. Wenn Sie sich leidenschaftlich für die Vorbereitung von Ausschreibungen und Geboten interessieren und aktiv beitragen möchten, treten Sie unserem Team bei! Lehrlingsausbildung) oder kaufmännische Ausbildung Mindestens 3 Jahre administrative / geschäftliche Erfahrung in Ausschreibungsaktivitäten, Angebotsvorbereitung und Preiskalkulation oder Gebotskoordination, interne Verkaufsunterstützung oder Projektmanagement in einem industriellen oder technischen Umfeld Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Formulierung genauer Gebote und Angebote Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) und Erfahrung mit Ausschreibungsmanagement-Software oder CRM-Systemen Starke analytische und Problemlösungskompetenzen, mit scharfer Aufmerksamkeit für Details und lösungsorientierter Ansatz fließend in Englisch ist erforderlich; Kenntnisse in Deutsch und anderen Sprachen sind ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Notre groupe de produits local Isolation & Components est un leader technologique mondial dans la conception et la fabrication de douilles de transformateurs haute tension. Des entreprises internationales renommées dans l'industrie électrique – y compris la production, le transport et la distribution d'électricité – font confiance à nos solutions. Nous détenons une position de leader mondial dans la technologie de douille haute tension. Pour renforcer nos opérations, nous recherchons un spécialiste de l'appel d'offres et de la cotation (commercial) pour rejoindre notre équipe dans notre usine de douilles MICAFIL en Suisse. Dans ce rôle, vous ferez partie d'une équipe internationale axée sur la traduction des besoins et des défis des clients en offres et en devis concurrentiels. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos ventes et d'autres équipes internes pour vous assurer que nous offrons les meilleures solutions pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients partout dans le monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la préparation des appels d'offres et que vous voulez contribuer activement, rejoignez notre équipe ! Analyser les demandes de soumissions (QF) et d'autres documents d'appel d'offres afin de comprendre les exigences des clients, l'étendue du travail et les spécifications techniques avec l'harmonisation avec l'équipe des ventes Collaborer avec les services des ventes, de l'ingénierie, des services juridiques et d'autres ministères internes afin de recueillir les renseignements, les détails techniques et les estimations des coûts nécessaires pour les soumissions Élaborer des documents d'appel d'offres complets et bien structurés, y compris des propositions techniques, des dessins, des offres commerciales et de la documentation à l'appui S'assurer que toutes les soumissions sont exactes, complètes et respectent les délais et les protocoles de soumission spécifiés. Maintenir une communication claire et structurée avec les clients et les équipes internes tout au long du processus d'appel d'offres Votre expérience Technique (professionnelle, comme l'apprentissage) ou formation commerciale Expérience minimum de 3 ans d'expérience administrative/d'affaires dans les activités d'appel d'offres, la préparation des devis et le calcul des prix, ou la coordination des soumissions, le soutien interne aux ventes ou la gestion de projet dans un environnement industriel ou technique Expérience éprouvée dans la formulation d'offres et de soumissions précises Forte compréhension des processus d'appel d'offres, des termes contractuels et des aspects commerciaux Excellente compétence en communication écrite et verbale Compétence en Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) et expérience en matière de logiciels de gestion d'offres ou de systèmes CRM Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec une attention particulière aux détails et à l'approche axée sur la solution La maîtrise de l'anglais est un atout.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Ti unirai a Hitachi Energy e supporterai le attività di sviluppo e ricerca di prodotti tecnici all'interno di un ambiente di ingegneria dinamica. In questo ruolo, contribuirai allo sviluppo dei componenti Switchgear (GIS) isolati a gas, lavorando a stretto contatto con team interfunzionali per supportare l'innovazione e l'efficienza del progetto. Questa posizione offre un coinvolgimento pratico nei processi di progettazione, l'esposizione a strumenti di ingegneria avanzati e la collaborazione tra le funzioni di sviluppo e produzione del prodotto. Sviluppare e ottimizzare i componenti e i gruppi GIS all'interno del progetto GLK-14 Supporta le attività ingegneristiche relative ai sistemi HVPLM e SAP Preparare, rivedere e aggiornare i disegni tecnici e la documentazione di progettazione Collaborare con i team interfunzionali per garantire la qualità e la manufacturabilità del design Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei processi di progettazione e dei flussi di lavoro di ingegneria L'esperienza iniziale nella progettazione meccanica e nella preparazione del disegno tecnico La familiarità con i sistemi IT di ingegneria (ad esempio PLM, SAP) è un vantaggio strutturato e orientato al dettaglio di lavorare Capacità di collaborare efficacemente all'interno di team tecnici Più su di noi A Hitachi Energy, sarete parte di un ambiente internazionale e collaborativo, lavorando su tecnologie innovative che contribuiscono a un futuro energetico più sostenibile. Questo ruolo offre opportunità di apprendimento continuo, sviluppo e esposizione a progetti di ingegneria globale.
descriptions.en: The opportunity You will join Hitachi Energy and support technical product development and research activities within a dynamic engineering environment. In this role, you will contribute to the development of Gas-Insulated Switchgear (GIS) components, working closely with cross-functional teams to support innovation and efficient project execution. This position offers hands-on involvement in design processes, exposure to advanced engineering tools, and collaboration across product development and manufacturing functions. How you'll make an impact Develop and optimize GIS components and assemblies within the GLK-14 project scope Support engineering activities related to HVPLM and SAP systems Prepare, review, and update technical drawings and design documentation Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure design quality and manufacturability Contribute to continuous improvement of design processes and engineering workflows Your background Completed apprenticeship as a Mechanical Designer or equivalent qualification Initial experience in mechanical design and technical drawing preparation Familiarity with engineering IT systems (e.g. PLM, SAP) is an advantage Structured and detail-oriented way of working Ability to collaborate effectively within technical teams More about us At Hitachi Energy, you will be part of an international and collaborative environment, working on innovative technologies that contribute to a more sustainable energy future. This role offers opportunities for continuous learning, development, and exposure to global engineering projects.
descriptions.de: Die Gelegenheit Sie begleiten Hitachi Energy und unterstützen technische Produktentwicklung und Forschungsaktivitäten in einem dynamischen Engineering-Umfeld. In dieser Rolle tragen Sie zur Entwicklung von Gas-Insulated Switchgear (GIS) Komponenten bei, die eng mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenarbeiten, um Innovation und effiziente Projektdurchführung zu unterstützen. Diese Position bietet eine praktische Beteiligung an Designprozessen, der Exposition gegenüber fortschrittlichen Engineering-Tools und der Zusammenarbeit über Produktentwicklungs- und Fertigungsfunktionen. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Entwicklung und Optimierung von GIS-Komponenten und -Baugruppen im Rahmen des GLK-14-Projekts ausüben Support-Engineering-Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit HVPLM- und SAP-Systemen Vorbereitung, Überprüfung und Aktualisierung von technischen Zeichnungen und Designdokumenten Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um Designqualität und Manufakturabilität zu gewährleisten Ihr Hintergrund Vollständige Ausbildung als Mechanischer Designer oder gleichwertige Qualifikation Erste Erfahrung im mechanischen Design und technischen Zeichnen Vorbereitung Vertrautheit mit Ingenieur IT-Systemen (z.B. PLM, SAP) ist ein Vorteil Strukturierte und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise Fähigkeit, effektiv in technischen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy werden Sie Teil eines internationalen und kollaborativen Umfelds sein, das an innovativen Technologien arbeitet, die zu einer nachhaltigeren Zukunft beitragen. Diese Rolle bietet Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliches Lernen, Entwicklung und Exposition gegenüber globalen Engineering-Projekten.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Vous rejoindrez Hitachi Energy et soutenirz des activités de développement technique de produits et de recherche dans un environnement d'ingénierie dynamique. Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez au développement des composants GIS, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour soutenir l'innovation et l'exécution efficace des projets. Cette position offre une implication pratique dans les processus de conception, l'exposition aux outils d'ingénierie avancés et la collaboration entre les fonctions de développement de produits et de fabrication. Comment faire un impact Développer et optimiser les composants et les assemblages SIG dans le cadre du projet GLK-14 Soutenir les activités d'ingénierie liées aux systèmes HVPLM et SAP Préparer, examiner et mettre à jour les dessins techniques et la documentation de conception Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour assurer la qualité et la manufacturabilité de la conception Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus de conception et des flux de travail d'ingénierie Votre expérience Apprentissage complété en tant que concepteur mécanique ou qualification équivalente Expérience initiale en conception mécanique et préparation technique du dessin Familiarité avec les systèmes informatiques d'ingénierie (p. ex. PLM, SAP) est un avantage Mode de travail structuré et axé sur les détails Capacité de collaborer efficacement au sein des équipes techniques Plus sur nous Chez Hitachi Énergie, vous ferez partie d'un environnement international et collaboratif, travaillant sur des technologies innovantes qui contribuent à un avenir énergétique plus durable. Ce rôle offre des possibilités d'apprentissage continu, de développement et d'exposition à des projets d'ingénierie mondiaux.

descriptions.it: Hitachi Energy High Tensione Products è lo specialista di fama mondiale per la trasmissione di energia e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di servizio è responsabile del supporto post-vendita mondiale dei sistemi di commutazione di protezione del generatore (GCB) e dei sistemi di interruttori isolati a gas (GIS), tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi aggiuntivi, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, conversioni e scambi. Le tue competenze sono importanti, perché garantisci una gestione efficiente del progetto organizzativo. Con il vostro ricercato per i dettagli, parteciperete attivamente al coordinamento e alla pianificazione dei nostri flussi di lavoro. Porti il giusto mix di forza di comunicazione e orientamento di servizio? Allora abbiamo la giusta sfida per voi! Nella posizione impegnativa come project manager di montaggio per sistemi di commutazione 80-100% (w\/m\/d), si assume la responsabilità per l'implementazione tecnica e tempestiva dei lavori di montaggio, installazione e manutenzione. Sono coinvolti nel continuo miglioramento dei processi e delle attività (KVP), con l'obiettivo di creare sempre un'alta soddisfazione del cliente e un risultato ottimale per Hitachi Energy. In questa funzione, è possibile effettuare il trattamento e la gestione organizzativa e il coordinamento dei lavori di “moon, commissioning e manutenzione sul sito Contatti per i clienti interni ed esterni Cura del personale di servizio esterno assegnato, creare orari di installazione tenendo conto delle risorse disponibili e necessarie (utilizzare materiale, strumenti e dipendenti) e il monitoraggio e la documentazione del progresso del progetto e dei costi.
descriptions.en: Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products is the world-renowned specialist for energy transmission and energy distribution. The service unit is responsible for the worldwide after-sales support of generator protection switch systems (GCB) and gas-insulated switchgear systems (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, additional services, troubleshooting, extensions, conversions and exchanges. Your skills are important, because you ensure efficient organizational project management. With your trained look for details, you will actively participate in the coordination and planning of our workflows. Do you bring the right mix of communication strength and service orientation? Then we have the right challenge for you! In the challenging position as assembly project manager for switching systems 80-100% (w\/m\/d), you take responsibility for the technical and timely implementation of assembly, installation and maintenance work. They are involved in the continuous improvement of processes and activities (KVP), with the aim of always creating a high customer satisfaction and an optimal project result for Hitachi Energy. In this function, you can carry out the processing and organizational management and coordination of the “moon, commissioning and maintenance work on site Contact persons for internal and external customers Care of the assigned external service staff, create installation timetables taking into account the available and necessary resources (use material, tools and employees) and monitoring and documentation of project progress and costs.
descriptions.de: Die Möglichkeit Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products ist der weltweit anerkannte Spezialist für Energieübertragung und Energieverteilung. Die Serviceeinheit ist für den weltweiten After Sales Support von Generatorenschutzschaltersystemen (GCB) und gasisolierten Schaltanlagen (GIS) inklusive Schulungen, Installation und Inbetriebnahme, planmässiger Wartung, Zusatzleistungen, Troubleshooting, Erweiterungen, Umbauten und Austausch zuständig. Auf Ihr Können kommt es an, denn Sie sorgen routiniert für eine effiziente organisatorische Projektabwicklung. Mit Ihrem geschulten Blick für Details wirken Sie aktiv bei der Koordination und Planung unserer Arbeitsabläufe mit. Bringen Sie den richtigen Mix aus Kommunikationsstärke und Dienstleistungsorientierung mit? Dann haben wir die richtige Herausforderung für Sie! In der herausfordernden Position als Montage Projektleiter für Schaltanlagen 80-100% (w\/m\/d), übernehmen Sie Verantwortung für die fach- und termingerechte Durchführung von Montage-, Inbetriebsetzungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten. Sie arbei-ten dabei an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen und Tätigkeiten (KVP), mit dem Ziel, stets eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit und ein optimales Projektergebnis für Hitachi Energy zu schaffen. Das können Sie bewirken In dieser Funktion übernehmen Sie die Abwicklung und organisatorische Führung und Koordination der „Mon-tage-, Inbetriebsetzungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten vor Ort Ansprechpartner für interne und externe Kunden Betreuung der zugeteilte Aussendienstmitarbeitende, erstellen Montagezeitpläne unter Berücksichtigung der zur Verfügung stehenden und notwendigen Ressourcen (Verbrauchsmaterial, Werkzeug und Mitarbeiter) und Überwachung und Dokumentation von Projektfortschritt und -kosten (Reporting) Verantwortlichkeit für die Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften und der erforderlichen Quali-tätssicherungsmassnahmen, für die Minimierung der Projektkosten und risiken sowie für die prozessgerechte Verarbeitung von Abweichungsmeldungen während der Arbeiten vor Ort, inkl. der Einleitung entsprechender Korrekturmassnahmen Komplette Zusammenstellung, Ablage und Archivierung der Dokumentation (Red Mark, Prüfprotokolle und Berichte) zur „As Built“- Erstellung sowie die Verrechnung an den Kunden Ihr Hintergrund Technische Grundausbildung und mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung in der Montage und\/oder Inbetriebnahme von GIS Anlagen Solides technisches Fachwissen und Führungserfahrung ist von Vorteil Weiterbildung wie Technikerschule, technischer Kaufmann usw. von Vorteil Gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil Sicheres Auftreten und überzeugende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, insbesondere in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Kulturen Teamfähigkeit und Organisationsstärke Durchsetzungs- und Führungsstärke mit Bereitschaft zu weltweiten Baustellenbesuchen Gute Kenntnisse in SAP und MS Office Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmodelle helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeitenden befähigt sind und sich entfalten können.
descriptions.fr: Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products est le spécialiste de la transmission et de la distribution d'énergie de renommée mondiale. L'unité de service est responsable du support après-vente mondial des systèmes de protection des générateurs (GCB) et des systèmes de commutation à isolation gazeuse (SIG), y compris la formation, l'installation et la mise en service, la maintenance planifiée, les services supplémentaires, le dépannage, les extensions, les conversions et les échanges. • Vos compétences sont importantes, car vous assurez une gestion de projet efficace. Grâce à votre recherche de détails, vous participerez activement à la coordination et à la planification de nos workflows. Apportez-vous la bonne combinaison de force de communication et d'orientation de service? Alors nous avons le bon défi pour vous! Dans le poste difficile de gestionnaire de projet d'assemblage pour les systèmes de commutation 80-100% (w\/m\/d), vous assumez la responsabilité de la mise en œuvre technique et opportune des travaux d'assemblage, d'installation et de maintenance. Ils participent à l'amélioration continue des processus et des activités (KVP), dans le but de toujours créer une satisfaction client élevée et un résultat de projet optimal pour Hitachi Energy. Dans cette fonction, vous pouvez effectuer le traitement et la gestion organisationnelle et la coordination de la lune, la mise en service et l'entretien du site.Contacts pour les clients internes et externes.

descriptions.it: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity   Are you passionate about transforming manufacturing environments through smart, data‑driven digital solutions? As an IT Business Analyst for MES and Manufacturing Systems within the BST Grid Integration Application Delivery Team, you will play a key role in shaping the digital backbone of our global factories. You will bridge operational needs with modern technology, enabling efficient, safe, and reliable production processes that support our Grid Integration business. You will work closely with stakeholders, development, and operations to ensure our application landscape delivers maximum business value, innovation, and user satisfaction.      This position is based in Lenzburg with the option for hybrid work. This role offers the opportunity to influence how our manufacturing sites evolve, standardize, and innovate. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply—your mindset and potential are equally important. A team with great cooperation and with diverse backgrounds is waiting for you to join!   How you'll make an impact   Act as the primary Business Analyst for manufacturing applications , ensuring they meet evolving operational and strategic requirements Collaborate closely with production teams, process engineers, application owners, and global GI stakeholders to collect requirements , define solutions, and secure alignment across all sites Analyze and model processes (e.g., production workflows, quality checkpoints, traceability, data collection), translating them into clear functional and technical requirements for system enhancements or new Manufacturing capabilities Support the full lifecycle of manufacturing applications, ensuring security, compliance, reliability, and integration with critical systems Facilitate workshops, perform gap analyses, lead stakeholder meetings, and create clear documentation to ensure shared understanding and effective decision‑making Identify opportunities to streamline system landscapes , improve data quality, reduce manual work, and strengthen harmonization across factories Drive continuous improvement by monitoring system performance, gathering feedback from users, and proposing enhancements to increase value and efficiency Your Background   Proven experience as an IT Business Analyst, Management Consultant, IT Consultant, or Manufacturing IT Analyst within complex industrial or production environments Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand and model business and manufacturing processes and translate them into actionable requirements Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across diverse teams and cultures Demonstrate experience working with IT\/OT teams, development, operations teams and vendors to deliver high-quality application support and enhancements Experience with MES platforms, industrial data systems, or integration technologies is an advantage, but not mandatory Fluency in English is required More about us We offer a competitive Swiss benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well‑being. Depending on experience and role, this may include: Pension and insurance plans Performance‑based bonus Flexible working arrangements Learning and development opportunities

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a leading global specialist in power transmission and distribution. In our services division, we work to make complex systems efficient, reliable and future-proof. To further develop our digital solutions, we are looking for a committed individual in the field of low-code development with a focus on the Microsoft Power Platform. In this role, you will work alongside an experienced team to design modern applications and develop your own solutions that make our processes smarter and more transparent. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non‑EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate confirming that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Sei appassionato di trasformare gli ambienti produttivi attraverso soluzioni digitali intelligenti e basate sui dati? Come analista IT Business per MES e sistemi di produzione all'interno del BST Grid Integration Application Delivery Team, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella modellazione della spina dorsale digitale delle nostre fabbriche globali. Potrai collegare le esigenze operative con la tecnologia moderna, consentendo processi produttivi efficienti, sicuri e affidabili che supportano il nostro business Grid Integration. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate, lo sviluppo e le operazioni per garantire il nostro paesaggio delle applicazioni offre il massimo valore aziendale, l'innovazione e la soddisfazione degli utenti. Questa posizione è basata a Lenzburg con l'opzione per il lavoro ibrido. Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di influenzare come i nostri siti produttivi si evolvono, standardzzano e innovano. Anche se non si soddisfa ogni esigenza, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare – la vostra mentalità e il vostro potenziale sono altrettanto importanti. Un team con grande collaborazione e con diversi background vi aspetta per unirvi! Migliorare le capacità di produzione, migliorare le prestazioni industriali, migliorare le capacità di sviluppo, migliorare la conformità IT e garantire l'allineamento sicuro in tutti i siti Analizzare e migliorare l'affidabilità dei processi e dei processi (ad esempio, i flussi di lavoro di produzione, i controlli di qualità, la tracciabilità, la raccolta dei dati) • Offriamo un pacchetto di benefici svizzeri competitivo progettato per supportare la crescita e il benessere professionali. A seconda dell'esperienza e del ruolo, questo può includere: Pensione e piani assicurativi Bonus basato sulle prestazioni Disposizioni di lavoro flessibili

descriptions.de: Die Gelegenheit Sind Sie begeistert, Fertigungsumgebungen durch intelligente, datengetriebene digitale Lösungen zu transformieren? Als IT Business Analyst für MES und Fertigungssysteme im BST Grid Integration Application Delivery Team spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung des digitalen Rückgrats unserer globalen Fabriken. Sie werden die operativen Anforderungen mit moderner Technologie überbrücken und effiziente, sichere und zuverlässige Produktionsprozesse ermöglichen, die unser Unternehmen Grid Integration unterstützen. Sie arbeiten eng mit Stakeholdern, Entwicklung und Operationen zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Anwendungslandschaft maximalen Unternehmenswert, Innovation und Nutzerzufriedenheit liefert. Diese Position basiert in Lenzburg mit der Option für hybride Arbeiten. Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit zu beeinflussen, wie sich unsere Fertigungsstätten entwickeln, vereinheitlichen und innovativ entwickeln. Auch wenn Sie nicht jede Anforderung erfüllen, ermutigen wir Sie, sich zu bewerben – Ihre Denkweise und Potenziale sind ebenso wichtig. Ein Team mit großer Zusammenarbeit und mit vielfältigen Hintergründen erwartet Sie beitreten! Wie Sie einen Impact Act als primäre Business Analyst für die Herstellung von Anwendungen machen, sicherstellen, dass sie die operativen und strategischen Anforderungen erfüllen Zusammen mit Produktionsteams, Prozessingenieuren, Anwendungsbesitzern und globalen GI Stakeholdern, um Anforderungen zu sammeln, Lösungen zu definieren und eine sichere Ausrichtung auf alle Standorte zu gewährleisten • Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Schweizer Leistungspaket zur Unterstützung Ihres beruflichen Wachstums und Wohlbefindens. Je nach Erfahrung und Rolle kann dies beinhalten: Pensions- und Versicherungspläne Performancebasierter Bonus Flexible Arbeitsvereinbarungen Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Êtes-vous passionné par la transformation des environnements de fabrication au moyen de solutions numériques intelligentes et axées sur les données? En tant qu'analyste IT pour le MES et les systèmes de fabrication au sein de l'équipe de livraison des applications d'intégration du réseau BST, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la formation de l'épine dorsale numérique de nos usines mondiales. Vous relierez les besoins opérationnels avec la technologie moderne, permettant des processus de production efficaces, sûrs et fiables qui soutiennent notre activité d'intégration du réseau. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants, le développement et les opérations pour vous assurer que notre environnement d'application offre une valeur commerciale maximale, de l'innovation et de la satisfaction des utilisateurs. Cette position est basée à Lenzburg avec l'option pour le travail hybride. Ce rôle offre l'occasion d'influencer l'évolution, la normalisation et l'innovation de nos sites de fabrication. Même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les exigences, nous vous encourageons à postuler – votre état d'esprit et votre potentiel sont tout aussi importants. Une équipe avec une grande coopération et des antécédents variés vous attend pour rejoindre! Comment vous allez faire un impact Act en tant qu'analyste principal pour les applications de fabrication , en s'assurant qu'ils répondent aux exigences opérationnelles et stratégiques en évolution Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de production, les ingénieurs de processus, les propriétaires d'applications et les intervenants mondiaux de l'IG pour recueillir les exigences , définir des solutions et assurer l'alignement sur tous les sites Analyser et modéliser les processus (p. ex., flux de production, contrôles de qualité, traçabilité, collecte de données), les traduire en exigences fonctionnelles et techniques claires pour les améliorations du système ou les nouvelles capacités de fabrication Soutenir le cycle de vie complet des applications de fabrication, assurer la sécurité, la conformité, la fiabilité et l'intégration aux systèmes critiques Faciliter les ateliers, effectuer des analyses d'écarts, diriger les réunions des intervenants et créer une documentation claire pour assurer une compréhension partagée et une prise de décision efficace Identifier les possibilités de rationaliser les paysages du système, améliorer la qualité des données, réduire le travail manuel et renforcer l'harmonisation entre les usines Favoriser l'amélioration continue par la surveillance du rendement du système, recueillir les commentaires des utilisateurs et proposer des améliorations pour ne pas accroître la valeur et l'efficacité Votre expérience acquise en tant en tant • Nous offrons un package d'avantages concurrentiel suisse conçu pour soutenir votre croissance professionnelle et votre bien-être. Selon l'expérience et le rôle, cela peut comprendre : Régimes de retraite et d'assurance Prime au rendement Modalités de travail flexibles Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement
