descriptions.it: The opportunity As a Business Intelligence Analyst within Hitachi Energy's Business Solution Team, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between complex data and strategic action for our Grid Integration business. You will be responsible for designing and delivering customer-driven BI applications that empower our HVDC and Business unit-wide teams to make informed decisions. By ensuring that our front-end solutions are scalable, user-friendly, and governed by global standards, you will contribute directly to our digital transformation journey and the ambitious goal of improving business efficiency through data transparency. How you'll make an impact Develop and maintain a roadmap for new, customer-driven BI applications, ensuring that design and report interfaces meet the specific needs of our HVDC and GI projects Ensure that all BI implementations follow the established structure and guidelines. You will drive Master Data alignment and ensure data validity through rigorous quality assurance and interface management with our data warehouse storage Actively identify and capture new Business Intelligence demands across the organization, translating business requirements into reusable data flow architectures Run BI training sessions to empower the organization, managing the application lifecycle through dedicated support, service request resolution, and the proactive use of our ticketing systems Ensure all initiatives follow PPS (Project Power System) process guidelines, contributing to a transparent and auditable environment that supports both internal goals and regulatory requirements Your background Strong experience in BI design and report development, including a deep understanding of data collection methods and interface management with data warehouse environments Proven ability to create and maintain reusable data flow architectures and ensure alignment with Master Data management principles Experience in maintaining existing BI solutions, managing application roadmaps, and utilizing ticket systems to solve service requests and issues Exceptional skills in identifying business demands and communicating technical structures to non-technical stakeholders, including conducting training sessions for diverse user groups A firm commitment to following process guidelines (such as PPS) and ensuring that local implementations adhere to global organizational structures and BI guidelines Strong focus on data quality assurance and the ability to ensure data validity across complex, large-scale IT initiatives More about us We offer a competitive Swiss benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well‑being. Depending on experience and role, this may include: Pension and insurance plans Performance‑based bonus Flexible working arrangements Learning and development opportunities

descriptions.it: Unisciti al nostro team di ingegneria dinamica nel Centro Regionale di Competence, Europe Hub, come Project Manager Engineering e guida tecnicamente l'esecuzione e l'offerta di progetti di infrastruttura di alimentazione elettrica all'avanguardia eMobility, comprese le soluzioni di ricarica DC per gli autobus elettrici. Fornerai soluzioni tecniche, i principali sforzi di ingegneria nei sistemi di distribuzione MV & LV e nelle apparecchiature di conversione di potenza e collaborerai con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per guidare l'innovazione e l'eccellenza. Se sei appassionato di mobilità sostenibile e prosperi in un ambiente collaborativo veloce, questa è la tua occasione per fare un impatto reale. Fornire un supporto tecnico per l'esecuzione e l'offerta di progetti di eMobility (ad es., depositi di autobus, stazioni di ricarica terminali), supporto e guida per l'esecuzione locale e i team di appalto. A seconda dell'esperienza e del ruolo, questo può includere: Pensione e piani assicurativi Bonus basato sulle prestazioni Disposizioni di lavoro flessibili
descriptions.en: The opportunity Join our dynamic Engineering team in Regional Center of Competence, Europe Hub, as a Project Manager Engineering and lead technically the execution and tendering of cutting-edge eMobility electric power supply infrastructure projects—including DC charging solutions for electric buses. You'll shape technical solutions, lead engineering efforts across MV & LV distribution systems and power conversion equipment and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to drive innovation and excellence. If you're passionate about sustainable mobility and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this is your chance to make a real impact. descriptions.it: L'opportunità Come GPG Insulation & Components APQP Leader sarete responsabili per l'implementazione e la manutenzione degli elementi essenziali della Fondazione APQP, secondo la strategia definita e il piano per la qualità GPG I&C. Collaborerai con team interfunzionali per garantire che gli elementi essenziali della Fondazione APQP siano aggiornati in base alle novità e ai nuovi rischi. Come farete un impatto Coordinate lo sviluppo del piano APQP Foundation. Fondazione di piombo APQP Piano incontri correlati, la raccolta e la preparazione della documentazione, essendo il punto di collegamento principale tra QMT, Factories, esperti globali e R&D. Partecipazione in Fondazione FMEA workshop e s upport HUBs e Fabbriche per utilizzare fondazioni APQP essenziali (per essere cascaded ai prodotti locali). Supporta l'organizzazione R&D per utilizzare le basi APQP essenziali per nuovi sviluppi del prodotto. Sostegno ai progetti ToT per garantire un corretto trasferimento di elementi essenziali APQP. Agire come GPG I&C Plato Admin, formare squadre interfunzionali, sostenere l'organizzazione sull'uso e garantire che il contenuto di fondazione è aggiornato . Identificazione attiva delle novitÃ tecnologiche per guidare gli aggiornamenti negli essenziali APQP di fondazione e collaborare con GPG Operations per identificare i cambiamenti di processo globali che potrebbero influenzare le basi essenziali APQP (ad esempio dalle migliori pratiche ai requisiti). 3-5 anni di esperienza con APQP (preferibilmente in industrie come Automotive o Wind). Forte conoscenza dei processi APQP, delle metodologie FMEA, PPAP, SPC e MSA. L'esperienza con Platone è un avatage . Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze con la capacità di identificare e implementare miglioramenti di processo. Prove capacità di guidare team interfunzionali e facilitare una collaborazione efficace tra i diversi stakeholder. Fluency in English Che cosa w e o ffer Contratto collettivo e ore di lavoro flessibili. Salute e benessere. Opportunità di carriera all'interno di Hitachi Energ y, localmente e globalmente. Supporto da mentore durante l'imbarco. Programmi di formazione e sviluppo. Un luogo di lavoro diverso con 70+ nazionalità in Svezia. Compensazione supplementare del congedo parentale. Accesso a un Portale dei Benefit dei Dipendenti con sconti. Più un bout u s At Hitachi Energy, lavorerai in un ambiente coinvolgente e collaborativo che offre tecnologia di livello mondiale. Apprezziamo lo sviluppo personale e la diversità, e ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro energetico sostenibile. Stiamo crescendo e accogliamo i candidati che non possono soddisfare ogni esigenza, le vostre questioni potenziali. Le applicazioni sono esaminate su base continuativa, quindi non aspettare – applichiamo oggi! descriptions.fr: L'opportunité En tant que responsable de l'isolation et des composants GPG, vous serez responsable de la mise en oeuvre et de la maintenance des éléments essentiels de la Fondation, conformément à la stratégie et au plan définis pour la qualité GPG I&C. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes interfonctionnelles afin que les éléments essentiels de la Fondation APQP soient mis à jour en fonction des nouveautés et des nouveaux risques. Comment vous ferez un impact Coordonner l'élaboration du plan de la Fondation APQP. Fondement principal APQP Planifier les réunions connexes, recueillir et préparer la documentation, étant le principal point de connexion entre le QMT, les usines, les experts mondiaux et la R-D. Participer aux ateliers FMEA de la Fondation et les HUB et les usines pour utiliser les essentiels APQP de la Fondation (à être en cascade vers les produits locaux). Appuyer l'organisme de R-D pour qu'il utilise les éléments essentiels du PAQP pour les nouveaux produits. Soutenir les projets ToT pour assurer le transfert approprié des éléments essentiels du PAQP. Agir comme GPG I & C Plato Admin, former des équipes interfonctionnelles, soutenir l'organisation sur l'utilisation et s'assurer que le contenu de la fondation est mis à jour. Identification proactive des nouveautés technologiques permettant d'effectuer des mises à jour dans les éléments essentiels du PAQA de base et c collaboration avec les Opérations du PPG pour déterminer les changements de processus mondiaux qui pourraient affecter les éléments essentiels du PAQA de base (p. ex., des pratiques exemplaires aux exigences). Votre diplôme technique de l'Université. 3-5 ans d'expérience avec APQP (de préférence dans des industries comme l'automobile ou le vent). Forte connaissance des processus du PAQA, de la FMEA, du PPAP, du CPS et des méthodologies du MSA. Expérience avec Platon est un advatage . Excellente capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité d'identifier et de mettre en oeuvre des améliorations de processus. Capacité éprouvée de diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles et de faciliter une collaboration efficace entre divers intervenants. La fluidité en anglais Quoi de neuf Convention collective et horaires de travail flexibles. Indemnité de soins de santé et de bien-être. Opportunités de carrière au sein de Hitachi Energy y, localement et dans le monde. Soutien aux mentors pendant l'embarquement. Programmes de formation et de perfectionnement. Un lieu de travail diversifié avec plus de 70 nationalités en Suède. Indemnité de congé parental supplémentaire. Accès à un portail d'avantages sociaux des employés avec rabais. Plus un bout u s Chez Hitachi Energy, vous travaillerez dans un environnement passionnant et collaboratif offrant une technologie de calibre mondial. Nous apprécions le développement personnel et la diversité, et nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir énergétique durable. descriptions.it: The opportunity: For our Transformer Global Team we are looking for R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f\/m\/d) In this role you will be responsible for supporting and leading Research and Development projects related to Transformer Service Operations. Your focus will be contribution towards operations around transformer service portfolio, best practices collection, standardization and coordination of improvements within Transformer Service HUBs and local units together with Technology Centers and Research teams. How will you make an impact: Run standardization projects, propose and develop new operational concepts around new services, and simulate their expected performance in real pilots. Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new \/ existing transformer services. Making standard policies, instructions, training material to ensure the effective implementation of the targeted processes from operational, quality and knowledge transfer standpoint. Provide support to other team member as well as local units when needed (operations, engineering, product management, product marketing, ...) Participate in, and assist team members in a variety of more complex operations activities. Global collaboration with scientists of Hitachi Energy Research team and Technology Centers, Technology Managers and Engineers from the various GPGs (Service \/ PT \/ DT). Your background: MSc education within Electrical or Mechanical Engineering field. More than 10 years of proven experience within Power Transformers operations. Experience in transformer service portfolio within multinational environment will be highly valued. Ability to use effective methodologies around knowledge and experience capture. Ability to create technical and operational documentation, training instructions… Spirit of innovation, out of the box thinking. Excellent abilities in teamwork in international teams with excellent interpersonal skills. A high level of self-motivation. A collaborative, structured, problem-solving, self-driven, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills. Fluent spoken and written English. Other languages will be an advantage. More about us: Our employee benefit programs are tailored to each country, depending on location of employment and job grade. More specific information on the employee benefit program offering in your intended country of employment\/ more information will be available during the recruitment process.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a skilled and driven R&D Test and Process Engineer for Bushings with a specialized focus on high voltage (HV) testing and manufacturing process development . This role is critical in ensuring the performance, safety, and compliance of high voltage energy systems through rigorous testing, data analysis, and continuous process optimization. You will play a key role in bridging R&D and manufacturing, supporting the development of innovative energy technologies. How you'll make an impact Lead and execute high voltage testing activities in compliance with IEC, IEEE, and internal standards Design and implement test setups, selecting appropriate HV equipment and methodologies Analyze test data, document results, and support root cause investigations and corrective actions Collaborate with R&D and manufacturing teams to define test strategies and process requirements Drive continuous improvement in testing and prototyping processes to enhance efficiency and quality Ensure proper maintenance, calibration, and safe operation of HV test equipment Support prototyping activities and assess process feasibility in a manufacturing environment Promote a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to ISO 9001, ISO 45001, and company policies Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in high voltage testing. Process engineering experience is a plus. Strong knowledge of HV testing protocols, equipment, and safety practices Familiarity with IEC, IEEE, ISO 9001, and ISO 45001 standards Proficient in analyzing test data and conducting failure analyses Fluent in German and good English knowledge, with excellent communication and problem-solving skills About Us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

titles.fr: Ingénieur d'entretien de l'équipement de poste – Échéance 80 – 100% (f/m/d)

descriptions.it: Mansioni - Mantenere e ottimizzare l'attrezzatura chimica e al plasma bagnati per garantire elevata disponibilità - Risoluzione dei problemi e sistemi complessi di riparazione in collaborazione con i partner OEM - Pianificare e sostenere attività di manutenzione preventiva per migliorare le prestazioni degli utensili - Gestire i pezzi di ricambio e contribuire agli aggiornamenti delle attrezzature e miglioramenti dei processi - Collaborare con team di ingegneria, R&D e operazioni per sostenere gli obiettivi di produzione - Creare e mantenere la documentazione tecnica e supportare il monitoraggio dei dati nei sistemi MES - Identificare e implementare miglioramenti in strumenti, processi ed efficienza operativa - Garantire il rispetto degli standard HSE e promuovere un ambiente di lavoro sicuro Requisiti - Formazione professionale tecnica nell'automazione, nell'elettronica o in un settore relativo (EFZ o equivalente) - 2+ anni di esperienza nella manutenzione delle attrezzature in semiconduttori o industrie simili - Forte conoscenza tecnica negli strumenti al plasma (ad es. sistemi AMAT, LAM) - Solida comprensione dell'elettronica, meccanica, pneumatica e sistemi di vuoto - Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente orientato al team e all'interno delle operazioni a turni - Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese (il tedesco è un plus) Cosa? - Ti unirai a un ambiente di produzione dinamico e veloce in cui il lavoro di squadra, l'affidabilità e l'eccellenza tecnica sono fondamentali. - Lavorando in una configurazione a turni, sarete parte di un team di manutenzione altamente qualificato che supporta operazioni critiche e processi produttivi avanzati. - Questo ruolo offre esperienza pratica con tecnologie complesse e l'opportunità di sviluppare le tue competenze tecniche, contribuendo direttamente alla stabilità e alle prestazioni di produzione. Contatto - Unisciti al nostro team innovativo come Ingegnere di Manutenzione Shift e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel cuore della produzione di semiconduttori! - Con una forte attenzione ai processi di incisione, lavorerai con tecnologia all'avanguardia per ottimizzare le prestazioni del sistema e garantire operazioni senza interruzioni. - Questa è la tua opportunità di collaborare con gli esperti, contribuire a progetti innovativi e crescere in un ambiente dinamico e high-tech. - Se siete appassionati di precisione e innovazione, vogliamo sentirvi!
descriptions.en: ## Mansioni - Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability - Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners - Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance - Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements - Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals - Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems - Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency - Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment ## Requisiti - Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent) - 2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries - Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems) - Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems - Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations - Good communication skills in English (German is a plus) ## Cosa offriamo - You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key. - Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes. - This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance. ## Contatto - Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! - With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. - This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. - If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!
descriptions.de: Mansion - Bewahren und optimieren nasse chemische und Plasma-Ätzgeräte, um hohe Verfügbarkeit zu gewährleisten - Fehlerbehebung und Reparatur komplexer Systeme in Zusammenarbeit mit OEM-Partnern - Planen und unterstützen vorbeugende Wartungsarbeiten zur Verbesserung der Werkzeugleistung - Ersatzteile verwalten und zu Anlagen-Upgrades und Prozessverbesserungen beitragen - Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieur-, FuE- und Betriebsteams zur Unterstützung von Produktionszielen - Erstellung und Pflege von technischen Dokumentationen und Support-Datenverfolgung in MES-Systemen - Verbesserung von Werkzeugen, Prozessen und betrieblicher Effizienz identifizieren und implementieren - Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von HSE-Standards und Förderung eines sicheren Arbeitsumfelds Voraussetzungen - Technische Berufsbildung in Automatisierung, Elektronik oder einem verwandten Bereich (EFZ oder Äquivalent) - 2+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Wartung von Geräten in Halbleitern oder ähnlichen Industrien - Starkes technisches Wissen in Plasmawerkzeugen (z.B. AMAT, LAM-Systeme) - Solides Verständnis von Elektronik, Mechanik, Pneumatik und Vakuumsystemen - Fähigkeit, in einem teamorientierten Umfeld und innerhalb von Schichtbetrieben zu arbeiten - Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch (Deutsch ist ein Plus) Cosa offriamo - Sie werden sich einer dynamischen und schnellen Produktionsumgebung anschließen, in der Teamarbeit, Zuverlässigkeit und technische Exzellenz entscheidend sind. - Sie arbeiten in einem Schichtaufbau, werden Teil eines hochqualifizierten Wartungsteams sein, das kritische Operationen und fortgeschrittene Fertigungsprozesse unterstützt. - Diese Rolle bietet praktische Erfahrungen mit komplexen Technologien und die Möglichkeit, Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln und direkt zur Produktionsstabilität und Leistungsfähigkeit beizutragen. Contattoo - Begleiten Sie unser innovatives Team als Shift Maintenance Engineer und spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle im Herzen der Halbleiterproduktion! - Mit einem starken Fokus auf Ätzprozessen arbeiten Sie mit modernster Technologie, um die Systemleistung zu optimieren und einen reibungslosen Betrieb zu gewährleisten. - Dies ist Ihre Gelegenheit, mit Experten zusammenzuarbeiten, zu bahnbrechenden Projekten beizutragen und in einem dynamischen, High-Tech-Umfeld zu wachsen. - Wenn Sie Leidenschaft für Präzision und Innovation sind, wollen wir von Ihnen hören!

Planifier et soutenir les activités de maintenance préventive pour améliorer la performance des outils - Gérer les pièces de rechange et contribuer à la modernisation du matériel et à l ' amélioration des procédés - Collaborer avec les équipes du génie, de la R-D et des opérations pour appuyer les objectifs de production - Créer et maintenir la documentation technique et le suivi des données dans les systèmes MES - Identifier et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations dans les outils, les processus et l'efficacité opérationnelle - Assurer le respect des normes HSE et promouvoir un environnement de travail sûr Requisiti - Formation professionnelle technique en automatisation, en électronique ou dans un domaine connexe (EFZ ou équivalent) - 2+ ans d'expérience dans l'entretien des équipements dans les industries semi-conducteurs ou similaires - Forte connaissance technique des outils plasma (par exemple AMAT, systèmes LAM) - Compréhension solide des systèmes électroniques, mécaniques, pneumatiques et de vide - Capacité de travailler dans un environnement axé sur l'équipe et dans le cadre d'opérations par équipes - Bonnes compétences en communication en anglais (l'allemand est un plus) Cosa offriamo - Vous rejoindrez un environnement de production dynamique et rapide où le travail d'équipe, la fiabilité et l'excellence technique sont essentiels. - Travaillant dans une configuration basée sur le poste, vous ferez partie d'une équipe de maintenance hautement qualifiée soutenant des opérations critiques et des processus de fabrication avancés. - Ce rôle offre une expérience pratique avec des technologies complexes et la possibilité de développer vos compétences techniques tout en contribuant directement à la stabilité de la production et aux performances. Contatto - Rejoignez notre équipe innovante en tant qu'ingénieur de maintenance de quart et jouez un rôle crucial au cœur de la production de semi-conducteurs ! - Avec une forte focalisation sur les processus de gravure, vous travaillerez avec une technologie de pointe pour optimiser les performances du système et assurer des opérations sans faille. - C'est l'occasion de collaborer avec des experts, de contribuer à des projets novateurs et de grandir dans un environnement dynamique et de haute technologie. - Si vous êtes passionné par la précision et l'innovation, nous voulons vous entendre !

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods. For our business unit High Voltage Products we are looking for a Functional Lead of the Standardization Team in Secondary Engineering. In this challenging position you will take over the functional lead for the standardization team to drive forward the product standardization and improvements. You will work closely with the Secondary Engineering team in Switzerland, Germany and India and develop a Standardization Roadmap that guides the development of our product for the future. Together with the standardization team, you will ensure successful implementation of improvements, such as releases of new templates and engineering guidelines that enables Engineering to deliver their projects effectively and in high quality. How you'll make an impact Lead functionally the Secondary Engineering Standardization Team including the daily management of tasks, planning and balancing of team workload, ensuring progress, transparency, and effective utilization of team capacity and development of required competences the team Define of GIS Secondary Engineering design standards through the development of templates and design guidelines with the support of the standardization team and experts Develop, maintain and regularly update of the Secondary Engineering Standardization Roadmap in collaboration with the Standardization team members, Key stakeholders within Secondary Engineering and other departments Engage in the Quality process and Continuous Improvement Cycles of the GIS organization and actively collaborate with other engineering teams and stakeholders to discuss, evaluate and align improvements, and to prioritize them for the implementation Execute and technically lead improvement tasks from the Standardization roadmap individually Drive the standardization and harmonization of E3 templates to provide an efficient and high-quality basis for project-specific schematics Your background Electrical engineering background Demonstrated ability to lead successfully, either in management position or in challenging and complex projects Solid experience in engineering of Secondary Equipment (LCCs) as Secondary Engineering PM Experience of the corresponding tools used for Secondary Engineering Readiness to take over role as functional leadership within a team. Proven experience in Project Management, Certification e.g. as PMP is a plus Fluency in English. German or any other language is a plus The job owner lives an innovative and performance-oriented thinking as well as following the values of Hitachi Energy and makes a personal contribution to a good working atmosphere More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Il nostro obiettivo è supportare i nostri clienti in tutto il mondo con tecnologie di alta qualità e creare valore aggiunto sostenibile. Ciò si ottiene attraverso il continuo sviluppo delle nostre tecnologie di base e il continuo miglioramento dei nostri processi – supportati da una cooperazione aperta e da un forte spirito di squadra. In qualità di Team Leader Maintenance, assume un ruolo responsabile e guida un team dedicato di sei dipendenti. descriptions.it: The opportunity As a Factory Environmental and Employee Health & Safety Specialist part of the local HSE team, you will play a key role in participating to HSE development, with main focus on Environmental topic, but granting a good support on Health & Safety activities. Key tasks on the Environmental side will be related to safeguarding our site's environmental integrity and driving our sustainability ambitions forward. In this role, you will ensure full compliance with all relevant environmental laws, regulations, and permits, while fostering strong relationships with community stakeholders and environmental authorities. You will develop, implement, and maintain robust environmental policies and procedures that promote accountability across the organization. By conducting environmental risk assessments, delivering training on sustainability practices, and leading initiatives that improve resource efficiency, you will directly contribute to reducing the factory's environmental footprint and supporting long-term operational excellence. On the H&S part, you'll be required to support main Health and Safety development activities organized by the HSE Manager, delivering results according to Management expectations. Please submit your application in English. How you'll make an impact Ensure regulatory compliance with Swiss environmental law and related frameworks (USG\/EPA, LRV\/OAPC, GSchG\/WPA, VVEA, ChemA\/ChemO), including permit management and coordination with cantonal authorities (BAFU) Lead environmental impact assessments for new production lines, plant changes, and modifications, ensuring alignment with internal environmental policies Manage waste and disposals, including segregation, traceability, registers, supplier audits, and all special waste streams, while supporting wastereduction and VVEA improvement initiatives Oversee chemical compliance, including ChemA, ChemO, ORRChem, CLP, Manage and maintain Safety SDS requirements, and notifications of new substances Support safe handling and storage of dangerous goods (DG) by coordinating with relevant departments and ensuring ongoing compliance Plan and conduct environmental audits and inspections, identifying improvement areas and ensuring timely corrective actions, also providing environmental compliance support and training to Engineering, Maintenance, and overall Business Unit, including REACH\/RoHS documentation and sustainability-related data needs On the Health and Safety part, you're required to support HSE manager in H&S-related topics managing production activities and equipment with the highest safety standards, both on the practical part and on documentation preparation. Support HSE reporting activities required by governmental or Hitachi Energy internal stakeholders. Your background Min. 3 years of experience in environmental roles within the industrial sector and strong knowledge of Swiss environmental regulations and compliance obligations Solid understanding of best practices in emissions, waste, water, chemicals, and sustainability Strong analytical skills, including environmental data processing and use of relevant software tools Basic knowledge of H&S principles and concepts Excellent command of Office 365 applications Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess environmental risks and develop effective mitigation strategies Excellent verbal and written communication skills for engaging with diverse internal and external stakeholders Fluent in Italian and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Descrizione Hitachi Energy è leader globale nelle tecnologie energetiche e rinnovabili che permettono ai clienti di utilità e industria di migliorare le loro prestazioni riducendo al contempo l'impatto ambientale. CHSEM fornisce dispositivi semiconduttori ad alta potenza ai clienti interni Hitachi Energy (ad esempio HVDC, GPQSS) e ai clienti esterni. L'Ingegnere di Qualità del Materiale Senior garantisce la qualità, la robustezza e l'affidabilità a lungo termine delle materie prime critiche utilizzate nella produzione di dispositivi semiconduttori BiMOS presso la struttura di fabbricazione di Lenzburg. Essendo un'autorità tecnica, il ruolo gestisce in modo indipendente complessi argomenti di qualità legati ai materiali e ai fornitori, contribuisce alla strategia di qualità dei fornitori e supporta sia lo sviluppo delle capacità dei fornitori che del team per consentire operazioni stabili e scalabili. Mansioni - Guidare l'approccio di qualità del materiale per le materie prime critiche utilizzate nelle operazioni di BiMOS - Definire e migliorare continuamente i concetti e le strategie di controllo CTQ - condurre indagini complesse sulla qualità dei materiali relative a deviazioni, rese e problemi di affidabilità - Monitorare e sviluppare le prestazioni dei fornitori e garantire un'efficace attuazione delle azioni correttive - Qualifica del materiale di piombo, riqualificazione e attività di gestione del cambiamento - Supporta la produzione con competenze tecniche durante la produzione, la risoluzione dei problemi e le fasi di rampa - Guidare iniziative di miglioramento interfunzionale per migliorare qualità, affidabilità e efficienza dei costi - Agire come riferimento tecnico, supporto o mentoring ingegneri e rafforzare le capacità di fornitori e team Requisiti - Corso di laurea o master in Scienze dei materiali, Chimica, Fisica, o un campo correlato - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella qualità dei materiali, nella qualità dei fornitori o nella produzione di semiconduttori - Revisore certificato (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, o equivalente) - Forte conoscenza della qualità dei materiali, del controllo dei processi e della gestione dei rischi in un ambiente di produzione - Prova capacità di gestire in modo indipendente i problemi complessi di qualità dei materiali e dei fornitori - Esperienza con metodi di qualità strutturati come 8D, Six Sigma o equivalente Cosa? - Giorni extra tra Natale e Capodanno - Pasti sottosidrati nelle località con mense - 50% di sconto sui corsi principali presso i nostri frigoriferi FELFEL - Sconto sugli iscritti a vari centri fitness - Sconti su vari prodotti e servizi - Prestazioni pensionistiche interessanti con il nostro fondo pensionistico aziendale - Diversità: Promozione della diversità e inclusione - Offerte culturali, carte di credito, benzina, ecc.)
descriptions.en: ## Descrizione Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. ## Mansioni - Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations - Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies - Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues - Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions - Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities - Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases - Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency - Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities ## Requisiti - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field - Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing - Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) - Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment - Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues - Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent ## Cosa offriamo - Extra days off between Christmas and New Year - Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens - 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges - Discount on memberships at various fitness centres - Discounts on various products and services - Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund - Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion - Cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)
descriptions.de: Beschreibung Hitachi Energy ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Strom- und Erneuerbaren Technologien, mit denen Kunden aus der Energieversorgung und Industrie ihre Leistung verbessern und gleichzeitig die Umweltauswirkungen senken können. CHSEM bietet leistungsstarke Halbleiter-Geräte an Hitachi Energy interne Kunden (z.B. HVDC, GPQSS) sowie externe Kunden. Der Senior Material Quality Engineer gewährleistet die Qualität, Robustheit und langfristige Zuverlässigkeit von kritischen Rohstoffen, die bei der Herstellung von BiMOS-Halbleitergeräten in der Lenzburg-Fabrik eingesetzt werden. Als technische Behörde fungiert die Rolle selbstständig für komplexe material- und lieferantenbezogene Qualitätsthemen, trägt zur Lieferantenqualitätsstrategie bei und unterstützt sowohl die Lieferanten- als auch die Teamfähigkeitsentwicklung, um stabile und skalierbare Operationen zu ermöglichen. Mansion - Fahren Sie den Materialqualitätsansatz für kritische Rohstoffe, die im BiMOS-Betrieb verwendet werden - CTQ Konzepte und Steuerungsstrategien definieren und kontinuierlich verbessern - Führen komplexe Materialqualitätsuntersuchungen im Zusammenhang mit Abweichungen, Ertrag und Zuverlässigkeit - Überwachen und entwickeln Lieferantenleistung und gewährleisten eine effektive Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen - Hauptmaterialqualifikation, Requalifikation und Change Management Aktivitäten - Unterstützung der Produktion mit technischem Know-how während der Produktion, der Fehlerbehebung und der Rampenphase - Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende Verbesserungsinitiativen, um Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz zu verbessern - Akt als technische Referenz, Unterstützung oder Mentoring Ingenieure und Stärkung von Lieferanten und Teamfähigkeiten Voraussetzungen - Bachelor- oder Masterstudium Materialwissenschaften, Chemie, Physik oder ein verwandten Bereich - Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Materialqualität, Lieferantenqualität oder Halbleiterherstellung - Zertifizierter Prüfer (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011 oder gleichwertig) - Starkes Wissen über Materialqualität, Prozesskontrolle und Risikomanagement in einem Fertigungsumfeld - bewährte Fähigkeit, komplexe Material- und Lieferantenqualitätsfragen unabhängig zu verwalten - Erfahrung mit strukturierten Qualitätsmethoden wie 8D, Six Sigma oder gleichwertig Cosa offriamo - Extratage zwischen Weihnachten und Neujahr - Geförderte Mahlzeiten an den Standorten mit Kantinen - 50% Rabatt auf Hauptkurse in unseren FELFEL Kühlschränken - Rabatt auf Mitgliedschaften in verschiedenen Fitnesscentern - Rabatte auf verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen - Attraktive Pensionsleistungen mit unserem Firmenrentenfonds - Vielfalt: Förderung von Vielfalt und Integration - Kulturangebote, Kreditkarten, Benzin usw.)
descriptions.fr: Descrizione Hitachi Energy est un leader mondial dans le domaine de l'énergie et des technologies renouvelables qui permet aux clients des services publics et de l'industrie d'améliorer leurs performances tout en réduisant l'impact environnemental. CHSEM fournit des dispositifs semi-conducteurs de haute puissance aux clients internes d'Hitachi Energy (p. ex. HVDC, GPQSS) ainsi qu'aux clients externes. Le Senior Material Quality Engineer assure la qualité, la robustesse et la fiabilité à long terme des matières premières critiques utilisées dans la production de semi-conducteurs BiMOS à l'usine de fabrication de Lenzburg. Agissant en tant qu'autorité technique, ce rôle gère de manière indépendante des sujets complexes liés à la qualité des matériaux et des fournisseurs, contribue à la stratégie de qualité des fournisseurs et soutient le développement des capacités des fournisseurs et des équipes pour permettre des opérations stables et évolutives. Mansioni - Conduire l'approche de qualité des matières premières critiques utilisées dans les opérations BiMOS - Définir et améliorer continuellement les concepts de CTQ et les stratégies de contrôle - Mener des enquêtes complexes sur la qualité des matériaux liées aux écarts, au rendement et à la fiabilité - Surveiller et développer le rendement des fournisseurs et assurer la mise en oeuvre efficace des mesures correctives - Qualification du matériel principal, requalification et gestion du changement - Soutenir la production avec une expertise technique pendant les phases de production, de dépannage et de montée en charge - Lancer des initiatives d'amélioration interfonctionnelles pour améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité et le rapport coût-efficacité - Agir comme référence technique, soutenir ou encadrer les ingénieurs et renforcer les capacités des fournisseurs et des équipes Requisiti - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences des matériaux, chimie, physique ou domaine connexe - Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la qualité des matériaux, la qualité des fournisseurs ou la fabrication de semi-conducteurs - Auditeur certifié (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011 ou équivalent) - Forte connaissance de la qualité des matériaux, du contrôle des procédés et de la gestion des risques dans un environnement manufacturier - Capacité éprouvée de gérer indépendamment les problèmes complexes de qualité des matériaux et des fournisseurs - Expérience avec des méthodes de qualité structurées telles que 8D, Six Sigma, ou équivalent Cosa offriamo - Jours de congé supplémentaires entre Noël et le Nouvel An - Repas subventionnés sur place avec cantines - Remise de 50% sur les cours principaux de nos réfrigérateurs FELFEL - Réduction sur les abonnements dans divers centres de fitness - Réductions sur différents produits et services - Prestations de retraite attractives avec notre fonds de pension d'entreprise - Diversité : promotion de la diversité et de l'inclusion - Offres culturelles, cartes de crédit, essence, etc.)

descriptions.it: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation, commissioning and maintenance of high-power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency.  In this role, you will take ownership of driving and implementing the service sales strategy, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring strong commercial outcomes across the full contract lifecycle. You will play a key role in developing competitive proposals, structuring contracts, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements, internal policies, and technical standards. Working at the intersection of sales, legal, finance, and engineering, you will contribute to sustainable business growth while optimizing both financial and operational performance. How you'll make an impact Drive and execute the service sales strategy while monitoring performance, identifying market trends to develop new business opportunities, and leading contract and proposal development aligned with customer requirements, budgets, and timelines Negotiate and define contract baselines, ensuring compliance while maximizing financial and operational performance Manage contract execution, including documenting and controlling changes and amendments Monitor contract performance, identifying deviations and driving corrective actions where needed Ensure accurate and timely execution of all commercial aspects in close collaboration with technical, financial, and legal stakeholders Support business development by providing expert advice on commercial and contractual topics, leveraging strong legal knowledge Your background Bachelor's degree or technical qualification (FH\/HF\/TS), preferably in electrical engineering, with knowledge of power electronics and\/or control technology Initial professional experience (2–3 years) in projects, tenders, contract management or a technical role with exposure to project or customer-facing work, with the ability to manage tasks independently Strong commercial mindset and interest in contract negotiation, with first exposure to or willingness to develop skills in contract, change, and claim management Basic understanding of legal terminology and contractual frameworks, or motivation to build up this knowledge in a commercial role Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset Ability to collaborate across functions and influence stakeholders in a complex environment Hands-on, customer-focused mindset with a strong drive to deliver results Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP SD\/CS preferred) and fluent in German and English More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers per unire il nostro team innovativo e avanzato. In questo ruolo, guiderai la gestione end-to-end del pilastro Sostenibilità dei Materiali, allineando le metodologie per la valutazione dell'impatto ambientale, definendo i processi, implementando iniziative e monitorando i progressi nell'unità aziendale. Questa è la tua opportunità di allineare con gli obiettivi aziendali e i requisiti normativi, sostenere gli obiettivi di sostenibilità dell'organizzazione e fare un impatto significativo nel settore dell'energia. Guidare la strategia di sostenibilità della supply chain BU, concentrandosi sulla sostenibilità dei materiali e sull'allineamento degli affari. Monitorare le tendenze, le normative e i requisiti dei clienti, integrandoli in piani e processi. Standardizzare i processi di sostenibilità dei materiali e garantire un'efficace attuazione in tutta la supply chain. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento della sostenibilità, tra cui decarbonizzazione e coinvolgimento dei fornitori. Traccia le prestazioni di sostenibilità e migliora continuamente attraverso le informazioni basate sui dati. Sviluppare e mantenere i dati di sostenibilità dei materiali, consentendo valutazioni LCA, EPD e PCF coerenti. Partner con fornitori e stakeholder per promuovere la riduzione delle emissioni e pratiche sostenibili. Fornire formazione e promuovere le migliori pratiche in tutta la comunità SCM. Allineare e applicare metodologie per la valutazione degli impatti ambientali materiali in linea con gli standard in evoluzione. Requisiti dei fornitori di supporto, selezione dei materiali, reclami ambientali e richieste di sostenibilità dei clienti La vostra laurea in Scienze Ambientali, Ingegneria, Gestione della Supply Chain, o un campo relativo. Minimo di 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione della supply chain con particolare attenzione alla sostenibilità, con una consolidata leadership nella creazione di strategia e roadmap, preferibilmente all'interno di organizzazioni globali o su larga scala. Forte competenza in materia di standard di sostenibilità dei materiali come ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, il Greenhouse Gas Protocol e le relative strutture. Ampia esperienza con Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), e l'implementazione di programmi di sostenibilità globale relativi a materiali e fornitori. Forte capacità di leadership con un track record di sviluppo ed esecuzione di iniziative strategiche in ambienti complessi e internazionali. Ottima comunicazione, presentazione e capacità di influenzare, con la capacità di costruire relazioni e ispirare il cambiamento a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione. Crediamo che il grande lavoro prosperi in un ambiente in cui le persone si sentono sinceramente sostenute e abbastanza ricompensate. I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un luogo di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme. Lo stipendio minimo per questa posizione in località specificata: Italia: a partire da 62.200 EUR lordo salario annuo L'offerta finale si baserà sulla posizione del candidato, le competenze e le qualifiche, l'esperienza, e allineato con strutture di pagamento interne. Questo ruolo può essere aperto in più posizioni. Se le informazioni sullo stipendio elencate non sono applicabili per la vostra posizione attuale, i dettagli dello stipendio relativi alla vostra posizione saranno discussi con voi in una fase successiva. La nostra offerta di benefici è su misura in base al vostro paese di lavoro e generalmente include: stipendio competitivo e incentivi Benessere e cura Lasciare a pagamento e non pagati Opzioni di lavoro flessibili Vantaggi che sostengono la vostra sicurezza finanziaria Riceverai informazioni più specifiche durante il processo di reclutamento.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of the Material Sustainability pillar, aligning methodologies for environmental impact assessments, defining processes, implementing initiatives, and monitoring progress across the business unit. This is your opportunity to align with business objectives and regulatory requirements, supporting the organization's sustainability goals and making a meaningful impact in the energy industry. How you will make an impact Drive the BU supply chain sustainability strategy, focusing on material sustainability and business alignment. Monitor sustainability trends, regulations, and customer requirements, integrating them into plans and processes. Standardize material sustainability processes and ensure effective implementation across the supply chain. Lead sustainability improvement initiatives, including decarbonization and supplier engagement. Track sustainability performance and drive continuous improvement through data-driven insights. Develop and maintain material sustainability data, enabling consistent LCA, EPD, and PCF assessments. Partner with suppliers and stakeholders to advance emission reduction and sustainable practices. Deliver training and promote best practices across the SCM community. Align and apply methodologies for assessing material environmental impacts in line with evolving standards. Support supplier requirements, material selection, environmental claims, and customer sustainability requests Your background Degree in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Minimum of 10 years of experience in supply chain management with focus on sustainability, with proven leadership in strategy and roadmap creation, preferably within global or large-scale organizations. Strong expertise in materials sustainability standards such as ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, the Greenhouse Gas Protocol, and related frameworks. Extensive experience with Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), and implementing global sustainability programs related to materials and suppliers. Strong leadership skills with a track record of developing and executing strategic initiatives in complex, international environments. Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships and inspire change at all organization levels. More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a work place where personal and organizational success grow together. The minimum salary for this position in specified location: ​ ​ Italy: starting from 62,200 EUR gross annual salary ​ The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures. ​ ​This role may be open in multiple locations. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage. ​ ​ Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes: ​ Competitive salary and incentives ​ Well-being and care ​ Paid and unpaid leave ​ Flexible work options ​ Benefits that support your financial security ​ You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process. ​
descriptions.de: Hitachi Energy sucht einen Global SCM Material Sustainability Lead für die Business Unit Transformers, um sich unserem innovativen und zukunftsweisenden Team anzuschließen. In dieser Funktion leiten Sie das End-to-End-Management der Säule Materialnachhaltigkeit, richten Methoden für Umweltverträglichkeitsprüfungen aus, definieren Prozesse, implementieren Initiativen und überwachen den Fortschritt in der gesamten Geschäftseinheit. Dies ist Ihre Chance, sich an Geschäftszielen und regulatorischen Anforderungen auszurichten, die Nachhaltigkeitsziele des Unternehmens zu unterstützen und einen sinnvollen Einfluss auf die Energiewirtschaft zu erzielen. Wie Sie Ihre Wirkung erzielen, treiben Sie die Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie der BU-Lieferkette voran, wobei Sie sich auf materielle Nachhaltigkeit und Geschäftsausrichtung konzentrieren. Überwachen Sie Nachhaltigkeitstrends, Vorschriften und Kundenanforderungen und integrieren Sie diese in Pläne und Prozesse. Standardisieren Sie Materialnachhaltigkeitsprozesse und gewährleisten Sie eine effektive Umsetzung in der gesamten Lieferkette. Leiten Sie Initiativen zur Verbesserung der Nachhaltigkeit, einschließlich Dekarbonisierung und Lieferantenbindung. Verfolgen Sie die Nachhaltigkeitsleistung und fördern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen durch datengesteuerte Erkenntnisse. Entwicklung und Pflege von Material-Nachhaltigkeitsdaten, die konsistente LCA-, EPD- und PCF-Bewertungen ermöglichen. Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferanten und Stakeholdern, um die Emissionsreduzierung und nachhaltige Praktiken voranzutreiben. Bereitstellung von Schulungen und Förderung von Best Practices in der gesamten SCM-Community. Anpassung und Anwendung von Methoden zur Bewertung von wesentlichen Umweltauswirkungen im Einklang mit sich entwickelnden Normen. Unterstützung von Lieferantenanforderungen, Materialauswahl, Umweltaussagen und Nachhaltigkeitsanforderungen für Kunden Ihr Hintergrundstudium in Environmental Science, Engineering, Supply Chain Management oder einem verwandten Bereich. Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Supply Chain Management mit Fokus auf Nachhaltigkeit, mit nachgewiesener Führungsrolle in der Strategie- und Roadmap-Erstellung, vorzugsweise in globalen oder großen Organisationen. Starke Expertise in Nachhaltigkeitsstandards für Materialien wie ISO 14040\/14044, ISO 14067, dem Greenhouse Gas Protocol und verwandten Frameworks. Umfangreiche Erfahrung mit Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) und der Umsetzung globaler Nachhaltigkeitsprogramme in Bezug auf Materialien und Lieferanten. Starke Führungsqualitäten mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung und Durchführung strategischer Initiativen in komplexen, internationalen Umgebungen. Hervorragende Kommunikation, Präsentation und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Beziehungen aufzubauen und Veränderungen auf allen Organisationsebenen anzuregen. Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. Unsere Vorteile sind so konzipiert, dass sie für jeden Einzelnen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – und so Engagement, Leistung und Wachstum fördern. Indem wir Wohlbefinden priorisieren, bauen wir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem persönlicher und organisatorischer Erfolg zusammenwachsen. Das Mindestgehalt für diese Position an einem bestimmten Ort: Italien: ab 62.200 EUR Bruttojahresgehalt Das endgültige Angebot wird auf dem Standort, den Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen der Kandidaten, der Erfahrung und den internen Vergütungsstrukturen basieren. Diese Rolle kann an mehreren Standorten offen sein. Wenn die angegebenen Gehaltsinformationen für Ihren aktuellen Standort nicht gelten, werden die für Ihren Standort relevanten Gehaltsdetails zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt mit Ihnen besprochen. Unser Leistungsangebot ist auf Ihr Beschäftigungsland zugeschnitten und umfasst im Allgemeinen: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Anreize Wohlbefinden und Pflege Bezahlter und unbezahlter Urlaub Flexible Arbeitsoptionen Vorteile, die Ihre finanzielle Sicherheit unterstützen Sie erhalten während des Rekrutierungsprozesses spezifischere Informationen.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy cherche un responsable mondial de la durabilité des matériaux SCM pour les transformateurs de l'unité d'affaires de rejoindre notre équipe innovante et prospective. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez la gestion de bout en bout du pilier Développement durable des matériaux, en alignant les méthodes d'évaluation des impacts environnementaux, en définissant les processus, en mettant en oeuvre des initiatives et en surveillant les progrès dans l'ensemble de l'unité opérationnelle. C'est l'occasion pour vous de vous conformer aux objectifs opérationnels et aux exigences réglementaires, de soutenir les objectifs de durabilité de l'organisation et d'avoir un impact significatif dans l'industrie de l'énergie. Comment vous ferez un impact Conduire la stratégie de durabilité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement BU, en mettant l'accent sur la durabilité matérielle et l'alignement des entreprises. Surveiller les tendances en matière de durabilité, les règlements et les exigences des clients, en les intégrant dans les plans et les processus. Normaliser les processus de durabilité matérielle et assurer une mise en œuvre efficace dans toute la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Diriger les initiatives d'amélioration de la durabilité, y compris la décarbonisation et l'engagement des fournisseurs. Suivre les performances en matière de durabilité et favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce à des données. Élaborer et tenir à jour des données sur la durabilité des matériaux, ce qui permettra d'effectuer des évaluations cohérentes de la LCA, de la DPE et de la PCF. Établir des partenariats avec les fournisseurs et les intervenants pour faire progresser la réduction des émissions et les pratiques durables. Offrir de la formation et promouvoir les pratiques exemplaires dans l'ensemble de la collectivité de MSC. Aligner et appliquer des méthodes d'évaluation des impacts environnementaux matériels conformément aux normes en évolution. Soutenir les exigences des fournisseurs, la sélection des matériaux, les revendications environnementales et les demandes de durabilité des clients Diplôme en sciences de l'environnement, en génie, en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou dans un domaine connexe. Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement en mettant l'accent sur la durabilité, avec un leadership prouvé dans la création de stratégies et de feuilles de route, de préférence au sein des organisations mondiales ou à grande échelle. Forte expertise en matière de normes de durabilité des matériaux, telles que ISO 14067, ISO 14044, le Protocole sur les gaz à effet de serre et les cadres connexes. Expérience approfondie des évaluations du cycle de vie, des déclarations de produits environnementaux et de la mise en oeuvre de programmes mondiaux de durabilité liés aux matériaux et aux fournisseurs. De solides compétences en leadership avec une expérience de développement et d'exécution d'initiatives stratégiques dans des environnements internationaux complexes. Excellente communication, présentation et influence des compétences, avec la capacité d'établir des relations et d'inspirer le changement à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. Plus sur nous Nous croyons que le grand travail prospère dans un environnement où les gens se sentent véritablement soutenus et équitablement récompensés. Nos avantages sont conçus pour créer une valeur réelle pour chaque individu – alimenter l'engagement, la performance et la croissance. En donnant la priorité au bien-être, nous construisons un lieu de travail où la réussite personnelle et organisationnelle se développe ensemble. Le salaire minimum pour ce poste dans un lieu déterminé: Italie: à partir de 62 200 EUR salaire annuel brut L'offre finale sera fondée sur l'emplacement des candidats, les compétences et les qualifications, l'expérience et l'alignement sur les structures de paye internes. Ce rôle peut être ouvert à plusieurs endroits. Si les renseignements sur le salaire énumérés ne s'appliquent pas à votre lieu de résidence actuel, les détails sur le salaire se rapportant à votre lieu de résidence seront discutés avec vous ultérieurement. Notre offre de prestations est adaptée à votre pays d'emploi et comprend généralement : Salaire et incitatifs compétitifs Bien-être et soins Congé payé et non rémunéré Options de travail flexibles Avantages qui soutiennent votre sécurité financière Vous recevrez des informations plus précises pendant le processus de recrutement.

descriptions.it: Über die Position Als Vorarbeiter in der GI Valves Fabrik in Turgi bzw. Seon übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in der täglichen Produktionssteuerung. Du koordinierst operative Tätigkeiten innerhalb des Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Montage-, Prüf- und Logistikprozesse effizient, sicher und qualitätsgerecht ablaufen. Dabei bist Du die direkte Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeiter und arbeitest eng mit der Produktionsleitung und anderen Schnittstellen zusammen. Dein Einsatz trägt wesentlich dazu bei, dass wir unsere Produktionsziele erreichen und uns kontinuierlich verbessern. Neben koordinativen Tätigkeiten arbeitest Du aktiv im Montageprozess mit. Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung der Produktionsabläufe (Montage, Prüfung, Logistik) Unterstützung des Teams sowohl fachlich als auch operativ Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Durchführung von Sicherheitsunterweisungen Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Planung, Qualität und Logistik sowie Dokumentation der Produktionsleistung Das bringst du mit Technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Elektrotechnik, Elektroinstallation, Mechatronik) Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage elektrotechnischer Komponenten Erfahrung als Vorarbeiter und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil SAP-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit digitalen Produktionssystemen sind ein Plus Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptions.it:
Designazione delle merci

L'opportunità presso il nostro centro di competenza.Power Converter Solutions., abbiamo una posizione di primo piano nello sviluppo, produzione, installazione, messa in servizio e manutenzione di convertitori elettronici ad alta potenza principalmente per STATCOM e sistemi di alimentazione ferroviaria. Forniamo anche soluzioni per stazioni di pompaggio idro e interventi di rete. Con l'aiuto dei nostri convertitori altamente efficienti, contribuiamo all'integrazione delle energie rinnovabili nella rete elettrica di domani e al tempo stesso aumentare l'efficienza del sistema complessivo.

In questo ruolo, si assumerà la responsabilità di guidare e attuare la strategia di vendita dei servizi, individuare nuove opportunità di business, e garantire risultati commerciali forti durante l'intero ciclo di vita del contratto. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nello sviluppo di proposte competitive, strutturando i contratti, e garantendo l'allineamento con i requisiti dei clienti, politiche interne e standard tecnici. Lavorando all'intersezione tra vendite, legali, finanza e ingegneria, si contribuirà a una crescita sostenibile del business, ottimizzando sia le prestazioni finanziarie che operative.

Come farete un impatto

- Guidare ed eseguire la strategia di vendita dei servizi monitorando le performance, individuando le tendenze di mercato per sviluppare nuove opportunità commerciali, e lo sviluppo di contratti e proposte leader in linea con i requisiti dei clienti, budget, e timeline - Negoziare e definire le linee di base dei contratti, garantendo la conformità e massimizzando le prestazioni finanziarie e operative - Gestire l'esecuzione dei contratti, tra cui la documentazione e il controllo delle modifiche e modifiche - Monitorare le prestazioni dei contratti, individuare le deviazioni e guidare le azioni correttive ove necessario - Garantire l'esecuzione accurata e tempestiva di tutti

aspetti commerciali in stretta collaborazione con le parti interessate tecniche, finanziari e giuridiche - Sostenere lo sviluppo delle imprese fornendo consulenza di esperti su argomenti commerciali e contrattuali, sfruttando una forte conoscenza giuridica

Il tuo passato

- Laurea o qualifica tecnica (FH/HF/TS), preferibilmente in ingegneria elettrica, con conoscenza dell'elettronica di potenza e/o della tecnologia di controllo - Esperienza professionale iniziale (2,3 anni) in progetti, gare d'appalto, gestione di contratti o un ruolo tecnico con esposizione a lavori di progetto o rivolti al cliente, con la capacità di gestire compiti in modo indipendente - Forte mentalità commerciale e interesse nella negoziazione di contratti, con la prima esposizione o la volontà di sviluppare competenze in contratto, cambiamento, e gestione dei crediti - comprensione di base della terminologia legale e quadri contrattuali,

o motivazione a sviluppare queste conoscenze in un ruolo commerciale - Forte capacità analitiche, di risoluzione dei problemi e di decisione con una mentalità proattiva e orientata alla soluzione - Capacità di collaborare tra le funzioni e influenzare gli stakeholder in un ambiente complesso - Una mentalità attiva e orientata al cliente con una forte spinta a produrre risultati - Proficienza nei sistemi ERP (preferita SAP SD/CS) e fluente in tedesco e inglese

Più su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano ad ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possano sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation, commissioning and maintenance of high-power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency. In this role, you will take ownership of driving and implementing the service sales strategy, identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring strong commercial outcomes across the full contract lifecycle. You will play a key role in developing competitive proposals, structuring contracts, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements, internal policies, and technical standards. Working at the intersection of sales, legal, finance, and engineering, you will contribute to sustainable business growth while optimizing both financial and operational performance. How you'll make an impact Drive and execute the service sales strategy while monitoring performance, identifying market trends to develop new business opportunities, and leading contract and proposal development aligned with customer requirements, budgets, and timelines Negotiate and define contract baselines, ensuring compliance while maximizing financial and operational performance Manage descriptions.it: L'opportunità In Hitachi Energy Research, collaboriamo strettamente con le aree di business per sviluppare le basi per la prossima generazione di prodotti Power Grids. Situato nelle vicinanze di Zurigo, il centro di ricerca impiega più di 60 scienziati provenienti da tutto il mondo con competenze interdisciplinari. Nel team Systems Integration and Physics affrontiamo le sfide e le opportunità per migliorare la flessibilità della rete e facilitare la proliferazione delle energie rinnovabili. Un obiettivo chiave del nostro lavoro è la modellazione multifisica per i sistemi elettronici di potenza, che svolge un ruolo fondamentale in applicazioni in rapida crescita come la ricarica di veicoli elettrici, lo stoccaggio di energia e le energie rinnovabili come l'eolico e il solare. In questo contesto, offriamo una posizione di tirocinio di 6 mesi che offre l'opportunità di lavorare su progetti reali in un team internazionale di ricercatori. Come fare un impatto Estensione di uno strumento basato su MATLAB per la progettazione sistematica e completa e l'ottimizzazione dei componenti magnetici nei convertitori elettronici di potenza Progettazione e confronto di diversi tipi di avvolgimento Progettazione e confronto di diversi materiali di base Implementazione e test di modelli. Documentazione degli studi e dei risultati nelle relazioni tecniche Adeguamento dell'architettura del codice secondo necessità per mantenere la chiarezza e facilitare la manutenzione Collaborazione con un team di ricerca internazionale ed esperti in elettronica di potenza Il tuo background Iscritto a un corso di laurea magistrale in ingegneria elettrica,
descriptions.en: The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.
descriptions.de: Die Chance Bei Hitachi Energy Research arbeiten wir eng mit Geschäftsbereichen zusammen, um Grundlagen für die nächste Generation von Stromnetzen zu entwickeln. Das in der Nähe von Zürich gelegene Forschungszentrum beschäftigt mehr als 60 Wissenschaftler aus aller Welt mit interdisziplinärer Expertise. Im Team für Systemintegration und Physik befassen wir uns mit den Herausforderungen und Chancen bei der Verbesserung der Netzflexibilität und der Förderung der Verbreitung erneuerbarer Energien. Ein Schwerpunkt unserer Arbeit ist die Multiphysik-Modellierung für leistungselektronische Systeme, die in schnell wachsenden Anwendungen wie dem Laden von Elektrofahrzeugen, der Energiespeicherung und erneuerbaren Energien wie Wind und Sonne eine entscheidende Rolle spielt. In diesem Zusammenhang bieten wir eine 6-monatige Praktikumsposition an, die die Möglichkeit bietet, in einem internationalen Team von Wissenschaftlern an realen Projekten zu arbeiten. Erweiterung eines MATLAB-basierten Tools zur systematischen und umfassenden Auslegung und Optimierung magnetischer Komponenten in leistungselektronischen Wandlern Entwurf und Vergleich verschiedener Wicklungstypen Entwurf und Vergleich verschiedener Kernmaterialien Implementierung und Prüfung von Modellen. descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Chez Hitachi Energy Research, nous collaborons étroitement avec les secteurs d'activité pour développer les bases de la prochaine génération de produits Power Grids. Situé à proximité de Zurich, le centre de recherche emploie plus de 60 scientifiques du monde entier dotés d'une expertise interdisciplinaire. Au sein de l'équipe Intégration des systèmes et physique, nous abordons les défis et les opportunités liés à l'amélioration de la flexibilité du réseau et à la facilitation de la prolifération des énergies renouvelables. L'un des principaux objectifs de notre travail est la modélisation multi-physique pour les systèmes électroniques de puissance, qui joue un rôle essentiel dans les applications à croissance rapide telles que la recharge des véhicules électriques, le stockage de l'énergie et les énergies renouvelables comme l'énergie éolienne et solaire. Dans ce contexte, nous proposons un stage de 6 mois qui offre la possibilité de travailler sur des projets concrets au sein d'une équipe internationale de chercheurs scientifiques.
