descriptions.it: L'occasione Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un Senior R&D Mechanical Engineer – High Tensione per unire il nostro team innovativo e di punta. In questo ruolo, si assumerà una responsabilità significativa per lo sviluppo e la consegna di prodotti e tecnologie innovative. Potrai sfruttare la tua esperienza tecnica per portare aspetti chiave dei progetti, assicurando che le soluzioni soddisfino i più elevati standard di qualità e prestazioni, rispettando le rigorose scadenze e budget. Questo è un ruolo di alto impatto con eccellenti opportunità per la crescita e lo sviluppo della carriera. Applicare le tue competenze in tecnologie, strumenti e metodi per risolvere complesse sfide industriali e sviluppare prodotti e soluzioni innovative Contribuire a modellare strategie tecnologiche e portafogli di progetto, aiutando a guidare la direzione dell'organizzazione Lavorare su complessi compiti di ingegneria utilizzando tecniche avanzate e innovative per fornire risultati R&D efficaci Assumere le responsabilità della leadership del progetto o svolgere un ruolo chiave all'interno dei team di progetto, supportando e incoraggiando i giovani colleghi Resta aggiornato con le tendenze e le tecnologie chiave nel tuo campo e spingere proattivamente i miglioramenti nelle operazioni e nella soddisfazione del cliente Act come esperto di materia, supportando i colleghi e condividendo le conoscenze per promuovere la collaborazione e l'innovazione all'interno del team Support business operations e clienti come esperto tecnico e rappresentano il team in forum di ingegneria interni ed esterni Contrinseco La tua laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Meccanica, Fisica, o un campo correlato 5-10 anni di esperienza in R&D o ingegneria, preferibilmente in apparecchiature o componenti ad alta tensione Forte competenza nella progettazione e sviluppo di componenti ad alta tensione (l'esperienza con cespugli è un vantaggio) Ottima capacitÃ di comunicazione in inglese, sia scritta che parlata Solida comprensione dei processi aziendali e degli ambienti R&D Esperienza comprovata nella gestione del progetto e collaborazione interfunzionale La comprensione fondamentale delle considerazioni di proprietÃ intellettuale in R&D Maggiori informazioni su di noi A Hitachi Energy, lavorerai in un ambiente internazionale e collaborativo, contribuendo a tecnologie innovative che modellano il futuro dei sistemi energetici. Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di affrontare le sfide del mondo reale nelle reti elettriche e nella sostenibilità, combinando ingegneria avanzata con applicazioni di impatto. Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Senior R&D Mechanical Engineer – High Voltage to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will take on significant responsibility for the development and delivery of innovative products and technologies. You will leverage your technical expertise to lead key aspects of projects, ensuring that solutions meet the highest standards of quality and performance while adhering to strict deadlines and budgets. This is a high-impact role with excellent opportunities for career growth and development. How you will make an impact Apply your expertise in technologies, tools, and methods to solve complex industrial challenges and develop innovative products and solutions Contribute to shaping technology strategies and project portfolios, helping guide the direction of the organization Work on complex engineering tasks using advanced and innovative techniques to deliver impactful R&D results Take on project leadership responsibilities or play a key role within project teams, while supporting and mentoring junior colleagues Stay up to date with key trends and technologies in your field and proactively drive improvements in operations and customer satisfaction Act as a subject matter expert, supporting colleagues and sharing knowledge to foster collaboration and innovation within the team Support business operations and customers as a technical expert and represent the team in internal and external engineering forums Contribute to intellectual property strategy, identify risks, and support effective risk management in R&D projects Your background Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field 5–10 years of experience in R&D or engineering, preferably in high voltage equipment or components Strong expertise in the design and development of high voltage components (experience with bushings is an advantage) Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken Solid understanding of business processes and R&D environments Proven experience in project management and cross-functional collaboration Basic understanding of intellectual property considerations in R&D More about us At Hitachi Energy, you will work in an international and collaborative environment, contributing to innovative technologies that shape the future of energy systems. This role offers the opportunity to address real-world challenges in power grids and sustainability, combining advanced engineering with impactful applications. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de:
Hitachi Energy sucht einen Senior R&D Mechanical Engineer – High Voltage, um sich unserem innovativen und zukunftsweisenden Team anzuschließen. In dieser Funktion übernehmen Sie erhebliche Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Lieferung innovativer Produkte und Technologien. Sie werden Ihr technisches Fachwissen nutzen, um wichtige Aspekte von Projekten zu leiten und sicherzustellen, dass Lösungen die höchsten Qualitäts- und Leistungsstandards erfüllen und gleichzeitig strenge Fristen und Budgets einhalten. Dies ist eine wichtige Rolle mit hervorragenden Möglichkeiten für berufliches Wachstum und Entwicklung. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Wenden Sie Ihre Expertise in Technologien, Tools und Methoden an, um komplexe industrielle Herausforderungen zu lösen und innovative Produkte und Lösungen zu entwickeln Tragen Sie dazu bei, Technologiestrategien und Projektportfolios zu gestalten und die Richtung der Organisation zu lenken Arbeiten Sie an komplexen technischen
• Aufgaben mit fortschrittlichen und innovativen Techniken, um wirkungsvolle F & E-Ergebnisse zu liefern Übernehmen Sie Projektleitungsverantwortung oder spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle in Projektteams, während Sie Junior-Kollegen unterstützen und betreuen Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit den wichtigsten Trends und Technologien in Ihrem Bereich und fördern Sie proaktiv Verbesserungen im Betrieb und der Kundenzufriedenheit Handeln Sie als Fachexperte, unterstützen Sie Kollegen und teilen Sie Wissen, um die Zusammenarbeit und Innovation im Team zu fördern Unterstützen Sie den Geschäftsbetrieb und Kunden als technischer Experte und vertreten Sie das Team in internen und externen Engineering-Foren Beitragen Sie zur Strategie für geistiges Eigentum, identifizieren Sie Risiken und unterstützen Sie ein effektives Risikomanagement in F & E-Projekten Ihr Hintergrund-Master-Abschluss in Maschinenbau, Physik oder einem verwandten Bereich 5-10 Jahre Erfahrung in R & D oder Engineering, vorzugsweise in Hochspannungsgeräten oder Komponenten Starke Expertise in der Konstruktion und Entwicklung von Hochspannungskomponenten (Erfahrung mit Durchführungen ist ein Vorteil) Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch, sowohl schriftlich als auch gesprochen Solides Verständnis von Geschäftsprozessen und F & E-Umgebungen Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit Grundlegendes Verständnis von Überlegungen zum geistigen Eigentum in F & E Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy arbeiten Sie in einem internationalen und kollaborativen Umfeld und tragen zu innovativen Technologien bei, die die Zukunft von Energiesystemen gestalten. Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, reale Herausforderungen in Bezug auf Stromnetze und Nachhaltigkeit anzugehen und fortschrittliches Engineering mit wirkungsvollen Anwendungen zu kombinieren. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: L'occasion pour Hitachi Energy de se joindre à notre équipe novatrice et avant-gardiste à la recherche et au développement en génie mécanique – haute tension. Dans ce rôle, vous assumerez une responsabilité importante dans le développement et la prestation de produits et de technologies innovants. Vous tirerez parti de votre expertise technique pour diriger des aspects clés des projets, en veillant à ce que les solutions répondent aux normes les plus élevées de qualité et de performance tout en respectant des délais et des budgets stricts. Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact avec d'excellentes possibilités de croissance et de développement de carrière. Comment vous aurez un impact Appliquer votre expertise en technologies, outils et méthodes pour résoudre des défis industriels complexes et développer des produits et des solutions innovateurs Contribuer à façonner des stratégies technologiques et des portefeuilles de projets, aider à orienter l'organisation Travailler sur des tâches d'ingénierie complexes en utilisant des techniques avancées et innovantes pour produire des résultats de R-D pertinents Prendre des responsabilités en matière de leadership de projet ou jouer un rôle clé au sein des équipes de projet, tout en appuyant et en mentorant les jeunes collègues Restez à jour sur les principales tendances et technologies dans votre domaine et propulsez l'amélioration des opérations et de la satisfaction de la clientèle Agir en tant qu'expert en la matière, en appuyant les collègues et en partageant les connaissances pour favoriser la collaboration et l'innovation au sein de l'équipe Soutenir les opérations et les clients en tant qu'expert technique et représenter l'équipe dans les forums internes et externes de génie Contribuer à la stratégie de propriété intellectuelle, identifier les risques et appuyer la gestion efficace des risques dans les projets de R-D Votre formation Maîtrise en génie mécanique, physique ou un domaine connexe 5-10 ans d'expérience en R-D ou en génie, de préférence en équipement ou composants haute tension Une solide expertise dans la conception et le développement de composants haute tension (l'expérience avec les douilles est un avantage) Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais, à la fois écrite et parlée Bonne compréhension des processus d'affaires et des environnements de R-D Expérience éprouvée en gestion de projet et collaboration interfonctionnelle Connaissance de base des considérations de propriété intellectuelle en R-D Plus sur nous Chez Hitachi Energy, vous travaillerez dans un environnement international et collaboratif, contribuant à des technologies novatrices qui façonnent l'avenir des systèmes énergétiques. descriptions.de: In unserem Team zur Bewertung und Qualifizierung unserer Hitachi Energy Semiconductors-Produkte in Lenzburg haben wir uns auf den Weg gemacht, um alle Kosten und den Kauf von Chips und robusten Halbleitermodulen sowie die Vorteile eines strengen Qualifizierungsprozesses zu erfüllen. Unsere Produkte haben wir an eine große Auswahl an Kunden in der ganzen Welt für verschiedene industrielle Anwendungen verkauft, nicht für erneuerbare Energien, Verkehr und E-Mobilität. Um unsere Begeisterung für Tests zu steigern und zu verbessern, bin ich sehr motiviert, einen R&D-Ingenieur für elektrische Validierung zu finden. Kommen Sie zu einem Projekt – tragen Sie zu Entwicklungsprojekten für Chips und Halbleitermodule der Produktionsgeneration bei – arbeiten Sie mit einem Design-, Prozess- und Ingenieurteam für Forschung und Entwicklung zusammen – bewerten Sie die Ergebnisse neuer elektrischer Prüfverfahren – führen Sie verschiedene elektrische Tests durch und überwachen Sie sie Gewährleistung der Produktqualität - Analysieren Sie die Testdaten und führen Sie technische Beratung durch - Erstellen und Überarbeiten von Testberichten für die Kommunikation und Ergebnisse, die von den Projektbeteiligten durchgeführt werden - Tragen Sie zu einer kontinuierlich verbesserten Testaktivität bei, um die Kundenzufriedenheit zu steigern - Verbessern Sie alle Sicherheitsregeln, Umgebungsschutz, Pulizierung und Laborordnung. Hintergrund – Magistrale Auszeichnung, Auszeichnung in der Elektrotechnik oder Feld korrelieren mit einem Schwerpunkt auf eigenen Halbleiter- oder Elektrogeräten – Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Elektrotechnik, bevorzugt in einem F&E-Umfeld – Gutes Verständnis von Ihnen Elektrische Ingenieursprinzipien, Planung und Analyse von Schaltkreisen - Vertrautheit mit CAD-Software für die elektrische Planung (z. B. Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad) - Erfahrungen mit Laboranalysen wie Oszilloskopen, Multimetern und Potenziometern - Beherrschung moderner Software-Tools (Python, LabView, CAD-Software, statistische Datenanalyseinstrumente) – Englisch fließend (Schrift und Text) Unser Angebot – flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierter Mentor und ein unterstützendes und inklusives Umfeld – Sie können sich persönlich und professionell weiterentwickeln – Sie sind sich einig, dass Sie erfolgreich sind, während Sie Ihren Lebenslauf und Ihre Arbeit verrichten lavoro. descriptions.fr: Opportunités Dans notre équipe d'évaluation et de qualification des produits pressés par Hitachi Energy Semiconductors à Lenzburg, nous nous assurons de l'arrivée en arrière-plan de tous les produits et de la puce et des modules semi-conducteurs robustes et privi di difetti traversant un processus de qualification rigoureux. Nos produits viennent d'être consacrés à une vaste gamme de clients dans tout le monde pour diverses applications industrielles, non seulement pour l'énergie renouvelable, le travail et la mobilité électronique. Pour l'extension et le renforcement de nos activités de test, nous recherchons un ingénieur R&D en validation électrique très motivé. Comment faire un impact - Contribuer aux projets de développement de puces et de modules semi-conducteurs de génération de projets - Collaborer avec l'équipe de conception, de processus et d'ingénierie des produits R&D - Valoriser les prestations de nouvelles piles en passant par les tests électriques - Suivre et surveiller les différents tests électriques pour garantir la qualité du produit - Analyser les données des tests et fournir des recommandations techniques - Rédiger et réviser les rapports de tests pour les communications et les résultats des parties prenantes du projet - Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des activités de tests pour la satisfaction du client - Appliquer toutes les règles de sécurité et de protection de l'environnement e pulizia e ordine del laboratorio Contexte - Laurea magistrale, o dottorato in ingenria elettrica ou campo correlato con un focus sui dispositivi semiconduttori o elettronica di potenza - Pochi anni di esperienza in ingenria elettrica, de préférence dans un ambiente R&D - Buona comprensione dei principi di ingegneria elettrica, programmation et analyse de circuits - Familiarité avec les logiciels de CAO pour la programmation électrique (par exemple, Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad) - Expérience avec l'atelier de laboratoire comme les oscilloscopes, les multimètres et les équipements de puissance - Capacité avec les instruments logiciels modernes (Python, LabView, logiciels de CAO, instruments d'analyse des données statistiques) - Fluenza en anglais (écrit et parlé) Cosa ofriamo - Conditions de travail flexibles, mentorat dédié et un environnement de soutien et inclusif permettant de croître personnellement et professionnellement – consentir à prospérer pendant l'équilibre de la vie et du travail. descriptions.it: The opportunity Join a dynamic research team shaping the future of energy systems. You will explore how renewable energy, smart grids, and sector coupling are transforming power systems worldwide. This 6 months internship offers a unique chance to contribute to next-generation solutions while developing your skills in a supportive and flexible environment. You'll work closely with experts across business units and gain valuable insights into innovation and sustainability. How you'll make an impact Perform market analysis on renewables and smart grid topics Derive system and product requirements based on the market analysis Define high-level functional architectures for future solutions Simulate future energy scenarios and technologies Model emerging technologies across power system levels (e.g. DC grids, electro-mobility, energy storage, electrolyzes and fuel cells, demand response, etc.) Develop, maintain and document new techno-economic assessment tools for simulating behavior of energy systems on different time scale Build future energy scenarios on regional and global scales Your background Currently pursuing a M.S. degree in electrical engineering or completed a similar M.S. degree less than 12 months ago Familiar with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi) integrated into simulation workflows developed in MATLAB and Python Experience with renewable energy and smart grid technologies, solutions, and concepts, combined with proficiency in power system analysis tools such as PowerFactory, PSCAD, or similar Excellent communicator in English, both in writing and speaking Background in the following power system topics: steady-state and dynamic stability analysis and modeling, fault analysis and power system protection, energy and ancillary service markets Self-starter with a strong willingness to learn, capable of working independently while also being a reliable and collaborative team player More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

Definiscono e controllano la segmentazione dei fornitori e sviluppano strategie di approvvigionamento mirate. Essi controllano i rischi legati all'acquisto, tra cui interruzioni della supply chain, fluttuazioni dei prezzi e problemi di conformità. Questo ti porta a studi completi nel campo della gestione della supply chain, della gestione aziendale, dell'ingegneria o della formazione comparabile con esperienza professionale rilevante. descriptions.en: The Possibility We are looking for a dynamic and experienced executive for purchasing that strengthens our dedicated service team at Hitachi, Ltd., where speed and quality are of the utmost importance. In this key position, you conduct strategic purchasing initiatives, optimize procurement processes and run a talented team of around 12 shopping experts. Your expertise ensures a fast and cost-effective procurement of goods and services while maintaining the highest quality standards and promoting long-term, partnership relationships with suppliers. This allows you to take over the leadership, promotion and further development of our purchasing team and create a performance-oriented and responsible corporate culture. They develop and implement innovative procurement concepts in accordance with our service strategy. In doing so, you place particular emphasis on timely delivery, continuous quality improvement, efficiency improvement in the supply chain and sustainable cost reduction. The application of the Critical-Path method to ensure timely procurement processes and to minimize delivery delays is one of your core tasks. They ensure consistent excellence throughout the entire purchasing process – from demand determination to payment – and ensure clear processes and maximum transparency. They define and control supplier segmentation and develop targeted procurement strategies. In addition, you are responsible for the selection, qualification and contract negotiations with suppliers. By building strategic partnerships at leadership level and establishing robust supplier management systems with KPIs, scorecards, regular reviews and escalation processes, you can ensure the sustainable performance of our supplier network. They work closely with cross-departmental teams such as material planning, engineering, quality and controlling, in order to optimally tune the purchase to the corporate requirements. They control purchase-related risks, including supply chain disruptions, price fluctuations and compliance issues. This brings you with completed studies in the field of supply chain management, business management, engineering or comparable training with relevant professional experience. At least 5 years of relevant experience in purchasing or supply chain management or at least 3 years of leadership experience in a related area. Detectable successes in strategic purchasing, in negotiations and in supplier or customer management are advantageous. Very good understanding of purchasing processes, contract law and principles of the supply chain. Impressed analytical skills as well as problem-solving and decision-making. Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Very good knowledge of purchasing software (e.g. SAP Ariba) and Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international environment and manage multiple priorities. Experience in manufacturing, technology or industry is very desirable. Our flexible work models help you to optimize personal and business performance and create an environment where all employees can develop and grow. descriptions.de: Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine dynamische und erfahrene Führungskraft für den Einkauf, die unser engagiertes Service-Team bei Hitachi, Ltd. verstärkt, wo Geschwindigkeit und Qualität von größter Bedeutung sind. In dieser Schlüsselposition führen Sie strategische Einkaufsinitiativen, optimieren die Beschaffungsprozesse und leiten ein talentiertes Team von etwa 12 Einkaufsexperten. Ihre Expertise sorgt für eine schnelle und kosteneffiziente Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen, während Sie höchste Qualitätsstandards wahren und langfristige, partnerschaftliche Beziehungen zu Lieferanten fördern. Das können Sie bewirken Sie übernehmen die Führung, Förderung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Einkaufsteams und gestalten eine leistungsorientierte sowie verantwortungsbewusste Unternehmenskultur. Sie entwickeln und implementieren innovative Beschaffungskonzepte im Einklang mit unserer Service-Strategie. Dabei legen Sie besonderen Wert auf termingerechte Lieferung, kontinuierliche Qualitätsverbesserung, Effizienzsteigerung in der Lieferkette und nachhaltige Kostenreduzierung. descriptions.fr: La possibilité Nous recherchons un cadre dynamique et expérimenté pour l'achat qui renforce notre équipe de service dédiée à Hitachi, Ltd., où la vitesse et la qualité sont de la plus haute importance. Dans cette position clé, vous réalisez des initiatives d'achat stratégiques, optimisez les processus d'approvisionnement et dirigez une équipe talentueuse d'environ 12 experts en achats. Votre expertise assure un achat rapide et rentable de biens et de services tout en maintenant les normes de qualité les plus élevées et en favorisant des relations de partenariat à long terme avec les fournisseurs. Cela vous permet de prendre en charge le leadership, la promotion et le développement de notre équipe d'achat et de créer une culture d'entreprise axée sur le rendement et responsable. Ils élaborent et mettent en oeuvre des concepts d'approvisionnement novateurs conformément à notre stratégie de service. Ce faisant, vous insistez particulièrement sur la livraison en temps opportun, l'amélioration continue de la qualité, l'amélioration de l'efficacité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et la réduction durable des coûts. L'application de la méthode Critical-Path pour assurer des processus d'approvisionnement en temps opportun et pour minimiser les retards de livraison est l'une de vos tâches principales. Ils assurent une excellence constante tout au long du processus d'achat – de la détermination de la demande au paiement – et garantissent des processus clairs et une transparence maximale. Ils définissent et contrôlent la segmentation des fournisseurs et élaborent des stratégies d'approvisionnement ciblées. De plus, vous êtes responsable de la sélection, de la qualification et des négociations contractuelles avec les fournisseurs. En établissant des partenariats stratégiques au niveau du leadership et en mettant en place des systèmes robustes de gestion des fournisseurs avec des ICR, des cartes de pointage, des examens réguliers et des processus d'escalade, vous pouvez assurer la performance durable de notre réseau de fournisseurs. Ils travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des équipes interministérielles telles que la planification des matériaux, l'ingénierie, la qualité et le contrôle, afin d'adapter au mieux l'achat aux exigences de l'entreprise. Ils contrôlent les risques liés aux achats, y compris les perturbations de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les fluctuations des prix et les problèmes de conformité. Cela vous amène avec des études terminées dans le domaine de la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, de la gestion d'entreprise, de l'ingénierie ou une formation comparable avec une expérience professionnelle pertinente. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience pertinente en gestion des achats ou de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou au moins 3 ans d'expérience en leadership dans un domaine connexe. Les succès détectés dans les achats stratégiques, les négociations et la gestion des fournisseurs ou des clients sont avantageux. Très bonne compréhension des processus d'achat, du droit des contrats et des principes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Des compétences analytiques réduites ainsi que la résolution de problèmes et la prise de décisions. Excellente communication, présentation et aptitudes interpersonnelles. Très bonne connaissance des logiciels d'achat (par exemple SAP Ariba) et Microsoft Office, en particulier Excel. Capacité de travailler efficacement dans un environnement international accéléré et de gérer de multiples priorités. L'expérience dans la fabrication, la technologie ou l'industrie est très souhaitable. Nos modèles de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser les performances personnelles et professionnelles et à créer un environnement où tous les employés peuvent se développer et croître. L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un chef d'équipe d'approvisionnement dynamique et expérimenté pour rejoindre notre organisation de service rapide à Hitachi, Ltd, où la vitesse et la qualité sont primordiales. descriptions.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere industriale altamente motivato con l'attenzione su Automazione e Robotica per ottimizzare e migliorare l'efficienza delle nostre linee di produzione Interruttore Isolato Gas (GIS). Questo ruolo comporta l'applicazione di principi di ingegneria industriale, tecnologie di automazione e soluzioni robotiche per migliorare i processi produttivi, ridurre i rifiuti e migliorare la produttività. I laureati motivati con una forte attenzione all'automazione e alla robotica sono anche incoraggiati ad applicare. Mansioni - Analizzare i layout delle linee di produzione GIS attuali, i flussi di lavoro e le procedure operative per identificare le aree per il miglioramento dell'efficienza, dei costi e della qualità, con un focus sul potenziale di automazione - Progettazione e realizzazione di processi produttivi ottimizzati, tra cui nuove metodologie, concetti di automazione, applicazioni robotiche, utilizzo di attrezzature e flusso di materiale - Condurre gli studi di tempo e di movimento, la mappatura dei processi e l'analisi del flusso di valore per identificare i colli di bottiglia ed eliminare le attività non a valore aggiunto - Sviluppare e implementare procedure operative standard (SOP) e istruzioni di lavoro per il montaggio e il test GIS, compresi i processi automatizzati e assistiti da robot - Collaborare con altri ingegneri industriali, responsabili della produzione, ingegneri di design, team di implementazione di qualità e nuovi prodotti - Condurre e partecipare a iniziative di miglioramento continuo, tra cui i progetti Lean Manufacturing e Six Sigma, sfruttando le tecnologie di digitalizzazione e automazione - Valutare, specificare e implementare nuove tecnologie, tra cui robotica (ad esempio cobot), sistemi automatizzati e soluzioni di produzione intelligenti per l'ambiente di produzione GIS Requisiti - Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria dell'automazione, Robotica, Ingegneria industriale, Ingegneria manifatturiera, o un campo correlato - L'esperienza professionale iniziale nell'ingegneria industriale all'interno di un ambiente di produzione è preferita - Esperienza iniziale o comprovata con l'automazione industriale e/o l'integrazione robotica (ad esempio, celle robotiche, cobot, sistemi automatizzati di gestione dei materiali) - Forte sfondo nell'ottimizzazione dei processi, principi di produzione magra e metodologie di miglioramento continuo (ad esempio, Kaizen, Six Sigma) - Proficienza negli strumenti di analisi dei processi (ad esempio, mappatura del flusso di valore, studi di tempo, controllo dei processi statistici) - Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente con diversi team e gestire più progetti contemporaneamente - La familiarità con i processi di produzione GIS o la produzione di apparecchiature elettriche complesse simili è altamente auspicabile - Fluente commerciale in inglese e tedesco Cosa? - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere. Contatto Nessuna informazione di contatto fornita.
descriptions.en: ## L'opportunità We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. ## Mansioni - Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential - Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow - Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities - Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes - Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team - Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies - Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment ## Requisiti - Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field - Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred - Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) - Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) - Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously - Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable - Business fluent in English and German ## Cosa offriamo - Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. ## Contatto No contact information provided.
descriptions.de: L'opportunità Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Industrieingenieur mit Fokus auf Automatisierung und Robotik, um die Effizienz unserer Gasisolierten Schaltanlagen (GIS) zu optimieren und zu verbessern. Diese Rolle besteht darin, industrielle Technikprinzipien sowie Automatisierungstechnologien und Robotiklösungen anzuwenden, um Fertigungsprozesse zu verbessern, Abfall zu reduzieren und die Produktivität zu verbessern. Motivierte Absolventen mit einem starken Fokus auf Automatisierung und Robotik werden ebenfalls gefördert. Mansion - Analyse aktueller GIS-Produktionslinienlayouts, Workflows und Betriebsabläufe, um Bereiche zur Verbesserung von Effizienz, Kosten und Qualität zu identifizieren, mit dem Schwerpunkt Automatisierungspotenzial - Entwicklung und Implementierung optimierter Produktionsprozesse, einschließlich neuer Methoden, Automatisierungskonzepte, Roboteranwendungen, Auslastung und Materialfluss - Durchführung von Zeit- und Bewegungsstudien, Prozesskartierungen und Wertstromanalysen, um Engpässe zu identifizieren und nicht-wertgebundene Aktivitäten zu beseitigen - Entwicklung und Implementierung von Standard-Betriebsverfahren (SOPs) und Arbeitsanleitungen für GIS-Montage und -Tests, einschließlich automatisierter und robotergestützter Prozesse - Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Industrieingenieuren, Produktionsleitern, Design-Ingenieuren, Qualität und neue Produkt-Implementierung Team - Führen Sie und nehmen Sie an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen teil, darunter Lean Manufacturing und Six Sigma Projekte, die Digitalisierung und Automatisierungstechnologien nutzen - Neue Technologien wie Robotik (z.B. Cobots), automatisierte Systeme und intelligente Fertigungslösungen für die GIS-Produktionsumgebung evaluieren, definieren und implementieren Voraussetzungen - Masterstudium Automatisierungstechnik, Robotik, Industrietechnik, Fertigungstechnik oder ein verwandten Bereich - Erste Berufserfahrung in der Industrietechnik in einer Fertigungsumgebung wird bevorzugt - Erste oder bewährte Erfahrung mit der industriellen Automatisierung und/oder Robotik-Integration (z.B. Roboterzellen, Cobots, automatisierte Materialhandlingsysteme) - Starker Hintergrund bei Prozessoptimierung, schlanken Fertigungsprinzipien und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmethoden (z.B. Kaizen, Six Sigma) - Effizienz in Prozessanalyse-Tools (z.B. Wertstrom-Mapping, Zeitstudien, statistische Prozesssteuerung) - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit verschiedenen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu verwalten - Vertraulichkeit mit GIS-Produktionsprozessen oder ähnliche komplexe elektrische Geräteherstellung ist sehr wünschenswert - Business fließend auf Englisch und Deutsch Cosa offriamo - Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen dabei, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungsfähigkeit zu optimieren und eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können. Contattoo Keine Kontaktinformationen zur Verfügung gestellt.
descriptions.fr: L'entreprise Nous recherchons un ingénieur industriel hautement motivé, axé sur l'automatisation et la robotique, afin d'optimiser et d'améliorer l'efficacité de nos lignes de production GIS. Ce rôle consiste à appliquer les principes de l'ingénierie industrielle ainsi que les technologies d'automatisation et les solutions robotiques pour améliorer les processus de fabrication, réduire les déchets et améliorer la productivité. Les diplômés motivés qui mettent l'accent sur l'automatisation et la robotique sont également encouragés à postuler. Mansioni - Analyser les schémas actuels de la chaîne de production du SIG, les flux de travail et les procédures opérationnelles pour identifier les domaines à améliorer en termes d'efficacité, de coûts et de qualité, en mettant l'accent sur le potentiel d'automatisation - Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des processus de production optimisés, y compris de nouvelles méthodologies, des concepts d'automatisation, des applications robotiques, l'utilisation des équipements et le flux des matériaux - Effectuer des études sur le temps et les mouvements, la cartographie des processus et l'analyse des flux de valeurs pour identifier les goulets d'étranglement et éliminer les activités non à valeur ajoutée - Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON) et des instructions de travail pour l'assemblage et les essais SIG, y compris des processus automatisés et assistés par robot - Collaborer avec d'autres ingénieurs industriels, gestionnaires de production, ingénieurs de conception, qualité et nouvelle équipe de mise en œuvre de produits - Diriger et participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue, y compris des projets Lean Manufacturing et Six Sigma, en tirant parti des technologies de numérisation et d'automatisation - Évaluer, spécifier et mettre en œuvre de nouvelles technologies, y compris la robotique (par exemple, les robots), les systèmes automatisés et les solutions de fabrication intelligente pour l'environnement de production du SIG Requisiti - Maîtrise en ingénierie d'automatisation, robotique, génie industriel, génie de la fabrication ou un domaine connexe - L'expérience professionnelle initiale en ingénierie industrielle dans un environnement manufacturier est privilégiée - Expérience initiale ou éprouvée en matière d'automatisation industrielle et/ou d'intégration robotique (par exemple, cellules robotiques, cobots, systèmes automatisés de manutention des matériaux) - Forte expérience dans l'optimisation des processus, les principes de fabrication maigre et les méthodes d'amélioration continue (p. ex. Kaizen, Six Sigma) - Compétence en outils d ' analyse des processus (par exemple, cartographie des flux de valeurs, études de temps, contrôle des processus statistiques) - Excellente communication et aptitudes interpersonnelles, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec diverses équipes et de gérer simultanément plusieurs projets - Familiarisation avec les processus de production du SIG ou la fabrication d'équipements électriques complexes similaires est hautement souhaitable - Les affaires parlent couramment l'anglais et l'allemand Cosa offriamo - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir. Contatto Aucune information de contact fournie.

descriptions.it: In Hitachi, stiamo plasmando il futuro con precisione, innovazione e un chiaro focus sulla qualità. Per il nostro stabilimento produttivo a Wettingen, cerchiamo una persona impegnata ed esperta come Responsabile Logistico Merci in Uscita, che gestisca l'intero processo di spedizione con una panoramica e un senso di responsabilità. In questo ruolo chiave, garantirai che i nostri prodotti raggiungano i nostri clienti puntualmente, completi e in perfette condizioni – e quindi contribuiranno in modo decisivo all'affidabilità della consegna e alla soddisfazione del cliente. Stretta collaborazione con i dipartimenti interni (produzione, acquisti, vendite), nonché con partner logistici esterni e spedizionieri. Analisi delle figure chiave rilevanti e preparazione di rapporti sulle prestazioni delle merci in uscita, identificazione e implementazione del potenziale di miglioramento, nonché introduzione di nuove tecnologie, garantire una gestione fluida delle formalità doganali ed esportazione. descriptions.fr: Chez Hitachi, nous façonnons l’avenir avec précision, innovation et un focus clair sur la qualité. Pour notre usine de production à Wettingen, nous recherchons une personne engagée et expérimentée en tant que Responsable Logistique des Marchandises sortantes, qui gérera l’ensemble du processus d’expédition avec une vue d’ensemble et un sens des responsabilités. Dans ce rôle clé, vous veillerez à ce que nos produits atteignent nos clients à temps, complets et en parfait état – et ainsi contribuent de manière décisive à la fiabilité de la livraison et à la satisfaction client. Ce que vous pouvez faire : gestion et coordination de toutes les activités sortantes, y compris la cueillette, l’emballage, le chargement et l’expédition. Optimisation des processus d’entrepôt et logistique sortants pour accroître l’efficacité et réduire les coûts. Leadership, motivation et développement supplémentaire de l’équipe sortante. Garantie du respect des normes de qualité, des réglementations de sécurité et des exigences légales. descriptions.it: La nostra azienda offre l'opportunità di unirsi al team di Ingegneria Industriale, dove i membri del team lavorano all'interno di due aree di focus chiaramente differenziate: sviluppo di produzione e ingegneria industriale. Ogni ruolo ha un focus principale in una di queste aree, mentre entrambi i profili collaborano strettamente all'interno dello stesso team e contribuiscono ai obiettivi di produzione condivisi. Dipendendo dal tuo background, avrai la responsabilità di un'area di focus specifica, mentre rimani connesso alle attività ingegneristiche più ampie. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con la produzione, l'ingegneria e i fornitori in un ambiente altamente collaborativo. Questo setup ti consente di approfondire le tue competenze mentre comprendi i processi adiacenti. Crescerai attraverso l'impatto reale sullo shopfloor, la responsabilità e la collaborazione cross-funzionale. Mansioni - Sviluppare e ottimizzare l'equipaggiamento e i processi di produzione - Progettare componenti meccanici, strumenti e soluzioni tecniche - Supportare l'industrializzazione di nuovi prodotti e concetti di produzione - Migliorare l'efficienza, la qualità e i costi nella produzione - Sviluppare e ottimizzare processi di produzione ad alta tensione - Analizzare e risolvere problemi elettrici e tecnici di produzione - Assicurare concetti di produzione sicuri e conformi - Collaborare con l'ingegneria, la qualità e i fornitori Requisiti - Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o elettrica o campo simile - Buona comprensione dei sistemi meccanici o elettrici - Esperienza con disegni tecnici, schemi o strumenti CAD - Stile di lavoro strutturato, indipendente e orientato alle soluzioni - Buoni abilità analitiche e di risoluzione dei problemi - Buona comunicazione in un ambiente tecnico Cosa offriamo - Condizioni di lavoro flessibili - Mentorato dedicato - Ambiente supportivo e inclusivo dove puoi crescere personalmente e professionalmente – empowerment per prosperare mentre bilanci la vita e il lavoro Contatto

descriptions.de: Unsere Firma bietet die Möglichkeit, Teil des Teams von Industriellen Ingenieuren zu werden, wo die Teammitglieder in zwei klar unterschiedenen Schwerpunkten arbeiten: Produktentwicklung und industrielle Ingenieurarbeit. Jeder Job hat einen Hauptfokus in einer dieser Bereiche, während beide Profile eng zusammenarbeiten und zu den gemeinsamen Produktionszielen beitragen. Abhängig von deinem Hintergrund wirst du für eine bestimmte Schwerpunktverantwortung verantwortlich sein, während du mit den umfassenderen ingenieurlichen Aktivitäten verbunden bleibst. Du wirst eng mit der Produktion, der Ingenieurarbeit und den Lieferanten zusammenarbeiten in einem hochgradig kollaborativen Umfeld. Dieser Aufbau ermöglicht es dir, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen, während du die angrenzenden Prozesse verstehst. Du wirst durch den realen Einfluss auf der Werkbank, die Verantwortung und die cross-funktionalen Zusammenarbeit wachsen. Aufgaben - Entwickeln und optimieren Sie das Equipment und die Produktionsprozesse - Konzipieren Sie mechanische Komponenten, Werkzeuge und technische Lösungen - Unterstützen Sie die Industrialisierung neuer Produkte und Produktionskonzepte - Verbessern Sie die Effizienz, Qualität und Kosten in der Produktion - Entwickeln und optimieren Sie Hochspannungsproduktionsprozesse - Analysieren und lösen Sie elektrische und technische Produktionsprobleme - Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Produktionskonzepte sicher und konform sind - Arbeiten Sie mit der Ingenieurarbeit, der Qualität und den Lieferanten zusammen Anforderungen - Abschluss in Maschinenbau oder Elektrotechnik oder einem ähnlichen Bereich - Gute Kenntnisse von mechanischen oder elektrischen Systemen - Erfahrung mit technischen Zeichnungen, Schemata oder CAD-Tools - Strukturiertes Arbeitsverhalten, unabhängig und lösungsorientiert - Gute analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten - Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in einem technischen Umfeld Was wir bieten - Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen - Dedierte Betreuung - Unterstützendes und inklusives Umfeld, in dem du dich persönlich und beruflich weiterentwickeln kannst – Empowerment, um dich zu prosperieren, während du das Leben und die Arbeit in Einklang bringst Kontakt
descriptions.fr: Notre entreprise offre l'opportunité de rejoindre l'équipe d'ingénieurs industriels, où les membres de l'équipe travaillent dans deux domaines de focus clairement distincts : développement de production et ingénierie industrielle. Chaque poste a un focus principal dans l'un de ces domaines, tandis que les deux profils travaillent étroitement ensemble et contribuent aux objectifs de production partagés. En fonction de votre background, vous aurez la responsabilité d'une zone de focus spécifique, tout en restant connecté aux activités ingénierielles plus larges. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la production, l'ingénierie et les fournisseurs dans un environnement hautement collaboratif. Ce setup vous permet de renforcer vos compétences tout en comprenant les processus adjacents. Vous progresserez grâce à l'impact réel sur la chaîne de production, la responsabilité et la collaboration cross-fonctionnelle. Tâches - Développer et optimiser l'équipement et les processus de production - Concevoir des composants mécaniques, des outils et des solutions techniques - Soutenir l'industrialisation de nouveaux produits et concepts de production - Améliorer l'efficacité, la qualité et les coûts dans la production - Développer et optimiser les processus de production à haute tension - Analyser et résoudre les problèmes électriques et techniques de production - Assurer des concepts de production sûrs et conformes - Collaborer avec l'ingénierie, la qualité et les fournisseurs Exigences - Diplôme en ingénierie mécanique ou électrique ou un domaine similaire - Bonne compréhension des systèmes mécaniques ou électriques - Expérience avec des dessins techniques, des schémas ou des outils CAD - Style de travail structuré, indépendant et orienté vers les solutions - Bonnes capacités analytiques et de résolution de problèmes - Bonne communication dans un environnement technique Ce que nous offrons - Conditions de travail flexibles - Mentorat dédié - Environnement supportif et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – empowerment pour prospérer tout en équilibrant la vie et le travail Contact

descriptions.it: The opportunity   In our R&D BiMOS semiconductor chip groups at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, we are developing advanced power semiconductor devices across multiple voltage classes. Our high-quality products are manufactured at internal and external production sites and delivered to customers worldwide across a wide range of applications, including industrial, renewable energy, traction, and e-mobility. We are currently looking for a motivated R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist to contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor technologies. In this role, you will focus on silicon-based devices (with strong exposure to power diodes) while expanding towards broader device concepts such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. This position is ideal for candidates with a solid technical foundation in semiconductor device physics and simulation, who are eager to further develop their expertise within a collaborative, high-tech R&D environment. Do you combine a strong technical background in semiconductor device physics with hands-on experience in simulation and technology development? Are you motivated to take ownership of development tasks while continuously learning and growing? Then we look forward to your application. How you'll make an impact Contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor chips, with a strong focus on silicon power diodes and related device technologies Support the end-to-end technology and product development cycle, from concept and simulation through to validation and reliability assessment Apply and further develop TCAD simulation models to understand device behavior and optimize performance, yield, and cost Collaborate closely with process engineers, characterization and reliability teams, ensuring alignment between design and manufacturability Take ownership of individual work packages or sub-projects, contributing to overall project goals and timelines Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis, modelling, and optimization approaches Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and build a strong systems-level understanding of semiconductor devices and processes Your background   Master's or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with focus on semiconductor device physics Proven experience in power semiconductor device development, ideally with exposure to silicon power diodes Strong hands-on experience with TCAD simulation tools (e.g. Sentaurus, COMSOL) Good understanding of semiconductor device physics, characteristics, and technology development processes Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with process, characterization, and reliability teams Initial experience in owning technical tasks or supervising junior profiles is a plus Familiarity with process integration aspects or modelling approaches is considered an advantage Self-driven, analytical, and eager to learn and grow in a high-performance R&D environment Proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills

descriptions.it: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a High Voltage Testing Engineer to join our high-voltage testing team at our MICAFIL bushing factory. If you are passionate about high-voltage testing and want to actively contribute to the future of our production processes, this is your opportunity to make a real impact. How you'll make an impact Plan and execute electrical and thermal type tests as well as special tests on high-voltage bushings (in-house and externally), considering available resources and budget Assist and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), including in-house FATs with customers Ensure the full functionality and availability of three high-voltage laboratories in collaboration with the team Lead and manage laboratory-related projects Ensure safety of equipment and personnel through training, instructions, and compliance with safety standards Secure quality, traceability, and compliance of bushing process steps through process instructions Perform routine, type, and special tests as required Continuously challenge and improve procedures and instructions as part of Continuous Improvement Processes (CIP) As part of the Operations department, actively support and contribute to daily business activities Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent Professional experience in high-voltage technology, testing, or electrical machines, ideally in a production or industrial environment Solid understanding of ISO 9001 and ISO 17025 Business-fluent German and good English, both written and spoken Strong team spirit, high social competence, and enjoyment of working in a multicultural environment Flexible mindset with a strong enthusiasm for technology Proactive and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Domestic at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you will be responsible for the efficient and compliant movement of goods within national borders, ensuring timely delivery, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to all domestic transportation and trade regulations. How you'll make an impact Plan, organize, and monitor domestic transportation of goods, including selection of carriers, negotiation of rates and optimization of routes to minimize costs and maximize efficiency. Prepare and process all necessary documentation for domestic shipments, such as packing lists and forwarding orders, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., production, sales, warehousing) and external stakeholders (e.g., carriers or customers) to ensure smooth logistics operations. Track and trace domestic shipments, proactively identifying and resolving any delays, issues, or discrepancies. Manage and maintain relationships with domestic carriers and logistics service providers, evaluating performance and ensuring adherence to service level agreements. Ensure compliance with all relevant domestic transportation laws, regulations, and company policies Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives for domestic logistics processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs and improve service levels. Handle domestic freight claims and resolve shipping discrepancies with carriers. Participate in logistics-related projects and initiatives as required. Your background Swiss Apprenticeship or Higher Education (in the area of transport) Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in domestic transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong understanding of domestic transportation modes and their associated regulations. Proficiency in logistics software and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP). Good negotiation and communication skills, both written and verbal in German and English. Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook). Knowledge of dangerous goods regulations for domestic transport is a plus. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., production, sales, warehousing) and external stakeholders (e.g., carriers or customers) to ensure smooth logistics operations. Track and trace domestic shipments, proactively identifying and resolving any delays, issues, or discrepancies. Manage and maintain relationships with domestic carriers and logistics service providers, evaluating performance and ensuring adherence to service level agreements. Ensure compliance with all relevant domestic transportation laws, regulations, and company policies Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives for domestic logistics processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs and improve service levels. Handle domestic freight claims and resolve shipping discrepancies with carriers. Participate in logistics-related projects and initiatives as required. Your background Swiss Apprenticeship or Higher Education (in the area of transport) Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in domestic transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong understanding of domestic transportation modes and their associated regulations. Proficiency in logistics software and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP). Good negotiation and communication skills, both written and verbal in German and English. Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook). Knowledge of dangerous goods regulations for domestic transport is a plus. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a System Engineer (SCADA\/RTU) to work on control and protection systems in the field of power grid substations. Openness, customer orientation, and innovation are key success factors in our working environment. You should be a team player who collaborates across different organizational levels in an intercultural environment. If you enjoy combining technical expertise with a strong customer focus, this is an opportunity for you! Early-career professionals are also welcome to apply. Welcome to our team! How you'll make an impact In this challenging position, you will design sub-station control systems (SCADA) for high- and medium-voltage switchgear in accordance with the latest technology standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 104, and other protocols You will integrate the systems, including the parameterization of the Ethernet-based communication structure Furthermore, you will implement project-specific functions and software applications, carry out tests, and coordinate interfaces Supporting on-site commissioning at facilities throughout Switzerland is also part of your role You will support the project manager in technical matters and coordinate both customers and in-ternal partners You will create operating manuals tailored to customer requirements Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, or an equivalent qualification Basic knowledge of control and protection systems, RTU systems, or process automation systems is an advantage You have basic knowledge of cybersecurity and network architecture Alongside strong communication skills and team spirit, you must demonstrate the ability to work independently and take responsibility Fluent German (spoken and written) is required. Good English skills are essential; additional languages such as French are an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated semiconductor production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automation and metal joining technologies. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability and quality of bonding and welding processes, by applying data analysis tools and designed experiments Analyze production data to optimize performance, identify long-term trends, and prevent potential failures Work on new automated production systems, improving production capacity and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to maintain and improve production throughput Collaborate to new product development by shaping the production process landscape and enabling volume manufacturing   Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment, ideally within the semiconductor industry Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy High Voltage Service supports customers worldwide with after-sales services for generator circuit breakers and gas-insulated switchgear (GIS). The team works closely with customers globally on installation, commissioning, maintenance, retrofitting and modernization. In this role, you will be closely involved with the product and work on construction sites around the world. You will take on responsibility, contribute your own ideas and gain valuable international experience through extended assignments abroad. Continuous learning, teamwork and professional development are an integral part of your daily work. How you'll make an impact Commission and test GIS systems in close cooperation with customer representatives Verify correct system functionality according to specifications and scope of supply Identify deviations and initiate corrective actions with project stakeholders Ensure compliance with site safety regulations and procedures at all times Apply and monitor environmental protection measures on site Participate in site meetings with relevant stakeholders Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanics, or a related field Initial experience in commissioning and\/or control system engineering Fluent German and English communication skills Ability to work independently under challenging site conditions Willingness to travel globally up to 90% of working time More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our team to drive the implementation of the latest internal and external standards in our Dry Transformers across all the factories in HUB Europe. This role offers you an exciting opportunity to broaden your expertise across various disciplines and functions, engage in dynamic projects and build a strong professional network both within and outside our organization. How you'll make an impact Be an active member of International Standards Committees, staying up to date with emerging changes and requirements and influencing standards development Support Product Management in developing and implementing our Global Technology Platform by engaging in requirements definition and supporting the rollout phases Work with teams from various functions, including Engineering, Operations and Quality. You will establish and maintain both internal and external networks to facilitate information exchange Oversee operations across multiple factories and work towards operational harmonization Ensure the effective implementation of both internal and external standards within our Power Transformers Units in Europe by conducting audits, identifying gaps and facilitating their resolution Responsible for communicating updates, deliver training sessions and provide support and technical guidance to colleagues on Standards Compliance related questions Represent our Company in standards-related discussions with customers and industry stakeholders Your background Master's degree in Engineering (Electrical or Mechanical are preferred) About 10 to 15 years of experience in the Power Transformer field Experience in Project Management and managing functional teams Deep knowledge of transformers design, manufacturing, testing and operations Interest in AI tools and their potential integration into one's work L6S green belt is preferred Excellent intercultural sensitivity and ability to develop and maintain healthy working relationships Strong communication skills, fluent in English, both written and spoken More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Unisciti al nostro team di ingegneria Dry Transformer, ti aiuterà a modellare i progetti di nuova generazione che migliorano la sicurezza, l'efficienza e la sostenibilità nelle applicazioni di potenza critica. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con R&D, produzione, qualità e supply chain per tradurre i requisiti dei clienti in soluzioni manifatturiere e vederli attraverso prototipi, test di tipo e rilascio seriale. Lavorando in progetti e standard globali, approfondirete le vostre competenze nei sistemi di isolamento, nella progettazione elettromagnetica e nelle prestazioni termiche, contribuendo alla digitalizzazione dei nostri processi di progettazione. Questo è un ruolo di alto impatto in cui il vostro lavoro consente direttamente elettricità affidabile per industrie e comunità in tutto il mondo. Produrre lo sviluppo di specifiche e modelli di progettazione, assicurando loro di soddisfare tutti gli standard e le normative pertinenti Condurre approfondite recensioni di progettazione e verifiche, implementando modifiche per elevare la qualità del progetto Monitor e gestire i tempi di progetto, assicurando che le pietre miliari di progettazione sono raggiunti e i progetti sono forniti su pianificazione Condurre valutazioni di rischio, sviluppare strategie di mitigazione, e cercare opportunità per le innovazioni di progettazione Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Joining our Dry Transformer engineering team, you'll help shape next generation designs that improve safety, efficiency, and sustainability in critical power applications. You'll collaborate closely with R&D, production, quality, and supply chain to translate customer requirements into manufacturable solutions and see them through prototype, type testing, and serial release. Working across global projects and standards, you'll deepen your expertise in insulation systems, electromagnetic design, and thermal performance while contributing to the digitalization of our design processes. This is a high impact role where your work directly enables reliable electricity for industries and communities worldwide. How you'll make an impact Lead the development of design specifications and models, ensuring they meet all relevant standards and regulations Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality Monitor and manage project timelines, ensuring design milestones are achieved and projects are delivered on schedule Conduct risk assessments, develop mitigation strategies, and seek opportunities for design innovations Engage with customers to capture and incorporate their feedback into design solutions, enhancing customer satisfaction Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components Prepare and maintain detailed documentation that supports design processes and facilitates knowledge sharing Identify and implement continuous design improvements based on test results and industry best practices, enhancing quality and efficiency Your background Degree in electrical engineering or a related field 2-5 years of experience in electrical design engineering of dry type transformers Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team English is a must, Italian is beneficial Pro-active attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Als Mitglied unseres Dry Transformer Engineering-Teams unterstützen Sie die Gestaltung von Designs der nächsten Generation, die Sicherheit, Effizienz und Nachhaltigkeit in kritischen Energieanwendungen verbessern. Sie arbeiten eng mit Forschung und Entwicklung, Produktion, Qualität und Lieferkette zusammen, um Kundenanforderungen in herstellbare Lösungen zu übersetzen und sie durch Prototypen-, Typprüfungen und Serienfreigabe zu sehen. Durch die Arbeit an globalen Projekten und Standards vertiefen Sie Ihre Expertise in Isolationssystemen, elektromagnetischem Design und thermischer Leistung und tragen gleichzeitig zur Digitalisierung unserer Designprozesse bei. Dies ist eine wichtige Rolle, bei der Ihre Arbeit direkt zuverlässigen Strom für Industrien und Gemeinden weltweit ermöglicht. Wie Sie eine Wirkung machen Führen Sie die Entwicklung von Designspezifikationen und Modellen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie alle relevanten Standards und Vorschriften erfüllen Durchführung gründlicher Designüberprüfungen und -überprüfungen, Implementierung von Modifikationen zur Erhöhung der Projektqualität Monitor und Projektzeitpläne, Gewährleistung, dass Designmeilensteine erreicht werden und Projekte im Zeitplan geliefert werden Führen Sie Risikobewertungen, entwickeln Sie Minderungsstrategien und suchen Sie nach Möglichkeiten für Designinnovationen Engage mit Kunden, um sicherzustellen, dass Designs herstellbar und kostengünstig sind, Auswählen von optimalen Materialien und Komponenten Bereiten Sie detaillierte Dokumentationen vor und implementieren Sie kontinuierliche Designverbesserungen basierend auf Testergebnissen und branchenweiten Best Practices Verbesserung Qualität und Effizienz 2-5 Jahre Erfahrung in der elektrischen Konstruktion von Trockentransformatoren Ausgezeichnete analytische und Problemlösung Fähigkeiten Die Fähigkeit, sowohl unabhängig als auch als Teil eines multidisziplinären Teams zu arbeiten Team Englisch ist ein Muss, Italienisch ist vorteilhaft Pro-aktive Haltung, selbstmotiviert und mit einem starken Gefühl des Eigentums Offen für Veränderung, Feedback und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: L'occasion De vous joindre à notre équipe d'ingénierie de Transformateur Dry, vous aiderez à façonner des conceptions de prochaine génération qui améliorent la sécurité, l'efficacité et la durabilité dans les applications énergétiques critiques. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec la R-D, la production, la qualité et la chaîne d'approvisionnement afin de traduire les exigences des clients en solutions de fabrication et de les voir par prototype, essai de type et libération en série. En travaillant sur des projets et des normes mondiaux, vous approfondirez votre expertise en systèmes d'isolation, conception électromagnétique et performance thermique tout en contribuant à la numérisation de nos processus de conception. descriptions.it: The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is to advance a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to homes, schools, hospitals, and industries — and we do so with people who are passionate, collaborative, and committed to making a real difference. As a SCADA\/RTU Commissioning Engineer, you will join our Grid Automation Systems team in Baden, Switzerland. In this role, you will oversee the commissioning of substation automation systems for medium‑complexity assignments, ensuring all activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in line with contract requirements, quality standards, and safety expectations. How you'll make an impact   • Carry out testing and commissioning of substation automation systems at customer sites in Switzerland and abroad, while actively supporting the Service Management team • Execute commissioning activities safely, following all Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards; report hazards and near misses to support continuous improvement • Perform commissioning tasks according to defined process descriptions and checklists; coordinate closely with engineering and project management teams • Identify, track, and resolve open points, ensuring customer sign‑off before site demobilization • Report site progress and planning updates; ensure efficient use of commissioning tools and test equipment • Provide marked‑up drawings to engineering for preparing as‑built documentation and final submissions • Support planning and implementation of commissioning activities • Implement design changes and provide mark‑ups for as‑built project documentation • Coordinate site activities required to finalize customer acceptance certification   Your background   • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent • 4+ years of experience as a commissioning engineer for automation systems and related products • Strong knowledge of substation SCADA\/RTU systems, HMI principles, and Hitachi Energy products; understanding of protection philosophies • Basic knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 61850, LON, IEC 101–104, DNP; ability to read schematic drawings and identify discrepancies; strong problem‑solving and conflict‑resolution skills • Familiarity with engineering toolchains typical for SAS\/SCADA (IET600, PCM600, MicroSCADA); willingness to learn across SCADA, RTU, networking, and cybersecurity topics • Strong communication and presentation skills • Proficiency in spoken and written English, German is preferred More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe that diversity and collaboration are the foundation of great innovation. You will join a global team where different perspectives are valued, and where we work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

descriptions.it: The opportunity   Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as a Scientist in Physics of Failure & Reliability. We are looking for a passionate and proficient scientist to join us in reliability research for power grid assets and systems.  As part of our dynamic, motivated, and creative team, you'll bridge theory and application, developing, testing, and validating novel methods and technologies to facilitate the energy transition. How you'll make an impact You drive impact : Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects by focusing on the underlying physics of failure, ensuring that reliability enhancements for power grid assets are grounded in a deep understanding of how application stresses translate into real-world failure mechanisms. Prioritize integrating physical failure models into data analysis, so that every solution is both scientifically robust and directly relevant to operational challenges You innovate : Proactively seek out emerging knowledge in failure physics and ensure that data collected and analysed reflects the true physical processes affecting system reliability, keeping the team at the cutting edge of reliability science and its practical applications You take initiative : Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Hitachi Energy business units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You connect : Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise You communicate : Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field Expertise in physics of failure, failure investigation, root-cause analysis, and reliability modeling, all with strong attention to practical application, data analysis and accurate interpretation Industry or post-doc experience (in energy technology or other industries like automotive, rail, aerospace, telecommunication) in developing and implementing product reliability improvements is a plus Fluency in English, both written and spoken More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.
