descriptions.it: The opportunity     Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact   Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities   Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us   We offer you: Extra days off between Christmas and New Year  Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discount on memberships at various fitness centres  Discounts on various products and services Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund   Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

descriptions.it: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a Product Engineer, you will be a core member of the BiMOS Product Engineering Team, playing a key role at the interface of manufacturing, R&D, and quality. Based in Lenzburg, Switzerland, you will take end-to-end ownership of a product platform and drive its optimization using advanced data analysis and continuous improvement methods. Your work will directly impact product quality, yield, and cost competitiveness in high power semiconductor manufacturing. How you'll make an impact Monitor, analyze, and interpret yield and quality data to identify improvement opportunities and drive sustainable enhancements in cost, quality, and yield Lead and execute improvement projects using methodologies such as Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, 8D, and related frameworks Take full product ownership after R&D handover, including coordination and monitoring of new product ramp up in the fabrication line Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting of product defects, weaknesses, and quality issues, deriving clear conclusions on process and design gaps Maintain, enhance, and implement data acquisition, analytics, and reporting methods to support data driven decision making Support process and R&D engineers with strong technical expertise and structured problem-solving approaches Your background Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline Strong expertise in statistical analysis, problem solving methodologies, and advanced data analysis techniques Semiconductor manufacturing experience is an advantage Proven experience leading complex improvement projects, ideally with small, cross functional teams Comfortable working in an international, matrix organization, with excellent communication and collaboration skills Innovative, quality driven team player with a high willingness to learn and take ownership Very good command of German and English (written and spoken, B2\/C1 level) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Export, die unsere internationalen Transportprozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und optimiert. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Organisation und Überwachung weltweiter Transporte über Luft, See, Strasse und Kurierdienste. Du arbeitest eng mit Spediteuren und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine reibungslose Abwicklung sicherzustellen.   Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung von weltweiten Transporten (Luft, See, LKW, Kurier) Beauftragung, Erstellung, Disponierung und Überwachung von Sendungen Abwicklung von Beglaubigungen, Akkreditiven, Carnet ATA und Versicherungszertifikaten Kontrolle der Leistungsverrechnungen Ausstellung von Versanddokumenten via ERP und anderen Tools (GTS\/SAP, Excel etc.) Auswertung von Transportofferten und Prüfung von Frachtrechnungen Kontinuierlicher Austausch mit internen und externen Stakeholdern Anwendung Ihres Fachwissens in Exportkontrolle, Ursprungsregeln und Güterbeförderung mit allen Transportträgern   Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Exportfachmann\/-frau 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im relevanten Bereich Fundiertes Know-how in der Logistikbranche Digitale Kompetenzen (API, EDI, AI): Standard Erfahrung im Stakeholder Management (SCM, Planung, Lieferanten, PMs, Engineering, Qualität, Import\/Export, Finanzen) Kenntnisse in SAP TMS & GTS sowie MS Office (Excel, SharePoint etc.) Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fliessend, Englisch B2 erforderlich, Französisch\/Italienisch von Vorteil Fähigkeiten: Problemlösungskompetenz, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative   Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir, dass Innovation aus Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit entsteht. Wir fördern ein integratives und vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen gemeinsam an nachhaltigen Energielösungen arbeiten.

descriptions.it: The opportunity To strengthen our team, we are seeking a Senior Project Engineer with a strong focus on protection systems for substation automation projects. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Control & Protection scope within complex (sub‑)transmission projects in Switzerland and internationally, acting as a key technical authority from base design through commissioning. You will work closely with project management, customers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define, coordinate, and deliver robust protection solutions in line with system requirements, applicable standards, and Hitachi Energy best practices. You will become part of a world-class engineering community within our European Hub, working alongside highly experienced colleagues with deep expertise in the execution of large and complex projects worldwide. This position offers an excellent environment to learn, develop, and actively contribute to Hitachi Energy's purpose of advancing a sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. It is a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting phase in which electricity is becoming the backbone of a sustainable society. How you'll make an impact Lead and own the Control & Protection engineering scope in substation automation system projects Define protection concepts and philosophies in close collaboration with the technical lead engineering and with customers during the base design phase Coordinate and guide the Protection & Control detailed engineering, ensuring alignment with SCADA, station control, and cyber security disciplines Specify, configure and test protection IEDs in line with customer requirements, grid codes, and standards Support and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our test facilities in Baden (Switzerland) Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with solid experience in protection engineering for substation automation systems Proven expertise in protection schemes for (sub‑)transmission substations Strong knowledge of IEC 61850 and substation automation architectures Experience with Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs is a strong advantage Able to work independently, take technical decisions, and manage interfaces in complex projects Strong communication skills and a structured, quality‑driven mindset Fluent in English; German is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity In our R&D BiMOS semiconductor chip groups at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, we are developing advanced power semiconductor devices across multiple voltage classes. Our high-quality products are manufactured at internal and external production sites and delivered to customers worldwide across a wide range of applications, including industrial, renewable energy, traction, and e-mobility. We are currently looking for a motivated R&D Semiconductor Chip Specialist to contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor technologies. In this role, you will focus on silicon-based devices (with strong exposure to power diodes) while expanding towards broader device concepts such as IGBTs and MOSFETs. This position is ideal for candidates with a solid technical foundation in semiconductor device physics and simulation, who are eager to further develop their expertise within a collaborative, high-tech R&D environment. Do you combine a strong technical background in semiconductor device physics with hands-on experience in simulation and technology development? Are you motivated to take ownership of development tasks while continuously learning and growing? Then we look forward to your application. How you'll make an impact Contribute to the development of next-generation power semiconductor chips, with a strong focus on silicon power diodes and related device technologies Support the end-to-end technology and product development cycle, from concept and simulation through to validation and reliability assessment Apply and further develop TCAD simulation models to understand device behavior and optimize performance, yield, and cost Collaborate closely with process engineers, characterization and reliability teams, ensuring alignment between design and manufacturability Take ownership of individual work packages or sub-projects, contributing to overall project goals and timelines Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis, modelling, and optimization approaches Actively contribute to knowledge sharing within the team and build a strong systems-level understanding of semiconductor devices and processes Your background Master's or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with focus on semiconductor device physics Proven experience in power semiconductor device development, ideally with exposure to silicon power diodes Strong hands-on experience with TCAD simulation tools (e.g. Sentaurus, COMSOL) Good understanding of semiconductor device physics, characteristics, and technology development processes Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with process, characterization, and reliability teams Initial experience in owning technical tasks or supervising junior profiles is a plus Familiarity with process integration aspects or modelling approaches is considered an advantage Self-driven, analytical, and eager to learn and grow in a high-performance R&D environment Proficiency in English with strong communication and presentation skills

This role offers you an exciting opportunity to broaden your expertise across various disciplines and functions, engage in dynamic projects and build a strong professional network both within and outside our organization. descriptions.it: The opportunity Our High Voltage Products division is a worldwide specialist in power transmission and distribution. Our Service Unit supports customers around the globe with Generator Circuit Breaker systems (GCB) and gas‑insulated switchgear (GIS). From training and commissioning to maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and replacements — we ensure critical power infrastructure works reliably, safely, and efficiently. Service is at the heart of everything we do. As part of our international service team, you'll take on varied, hands‑on work and become a recognized product expert. After comprehensive, practical training in Switzerland, you'll travel the world to commission and maintain GCB systems — all while working in a dynamic, multicultural environment. This is a role with real impact, technical depth, and plenty of room to grow. How you´ll make an impact Lead multicultural service projects for GCB on power plants from 20 MW to 1600 MW worldwide Ensure smooth and timely execution of installation and maintenance work on site Perform the final quality check and guarantee that all work meets our high standards Deliver product training directly to customers at their facilities Identify risks proactively and implement effective mitigation measures Coordinate on‑site teams and give practical, clear instructions Manage resource and provide regular reporting to project management Drive process improvements and implement efficiency‑boosting initiatives on site Your background Completed apprenticeship in metalwork, electrical engineering, or automotive technology Solid electrical knowledge (essential); further education such as a technician diploma is a plus Minimum 2 years of professional experience; experience in site leadership is an advantage Good English skills (B2 or above); German is a plus High willingness to travel — up to 80% worldwide Flexible, resilient, and communicative team player who enjoys solving problems pragmatically and values high safety and quality standards More about us Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom Attractive training and development opportunities Interesting and very varied activities\/projects, including off-shore assignments Well-established and dynamic team Open corporate culture An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our Next Generation Grids Transformers team in Geneva and shape the future of energy. As a Senior R&D Electrical Engineer, you will work on cutting-edge transformer technologies in a dynamic, international environment. You'll be part of a collaborative team, contributing to the full R&D lifecycle—from concept to testing and product launch, ensuring that our solutions meet both technical specifications and market demands. This role offers hands-on experience, technical growth, and the chance to make a real impact in the energy transition. How you will make an impact Apply your knowledge of electromagnetism to support innovative concepts' validation through simulations Tackle a variety of engineering challenges on Medium Frequency Transformers Contribute to the development of new features in our internal design tools Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new technologies\/products in collaboration with global teams Align your work with our strategic technology roadmap Take ownership of work packages and deliver results using a structured approach Deepen your understanding of transformer technologies and support internal consulting to optimize your R&D activities Contribute to intellectual property and risk management activities in R&D Your background MSc or PhD in Electrical or Electromechanical Engineering, ideally with experience in R&D within a business environment Knowledge of electromagnetism and circuit theory with ability to perform electromagnetic simulations Proficiency in MATLAB and\/or Python Strong communication skills in English (French is a plus) Analytical thinking and ability to work independently and collaboratively within interdisciplinary and international teams Awareness of business processes related to product development More about us We offer flexible working practices and a supportive environment where you can grow your skills and career. What you can expect from us Exciting career and training opportunities within Hitachi Energy Inclusive and diverse work culture Discounts on fitness memberships and various services Attractive pension benefits through our company pension fund

descriptions.it: The opportunity As   high   voltage lab   engineer , you are a full member of a dynamic team of scientists and technicians working to shape the future technology   to be used in   high voltage products.   In this position, you can test innovative ideas,   implement   new measurement and   diagnostics   methods, while you   maintain   a functional and   safe   testing environment .   Come and join our team if you are interested in the field of high voltage technology   and work towards   a sustainable and exciting future in energy.     How you will   make an impact:   Run and   maintain   state-of-the-art   high voltage labs   Participate actively in planning,   preparation   and execution of high voltage tests   Collaborate closely with a team of scientists and technicians from research   Bring your active contribution to the definition of safe testing practices in the lab during all phases of the experiments with the support   of local HSE partners and research team   Interact with partners in the adjacent Hitachi Energy high voltage labs and business units.     W hat you   will   bring:   Education in electrical engineering with at least a   bachelor   degree (FH)   Proven experience in lab work, including experimental setup with advanced measurement methods   Knowledge of lab integrated programming using LabView,   Matlab   or Python is very much welcome   Skills in data analysis are a plus.   Past experience   in high voltage   lab   is   advantageous .   Conversational level in English is   required,   good knowledge of German language is very appreciated.   More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future. If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, apply!

descriptions.it: We are looking for a passionate Research Team Manager to lead our multidisciplinary Circuit Breaker research team in Baden-Dättwil (Switzerland), part of the Central European Hitachi Energy Research Center. How you'll make an impact   You are a leader Set clear goals and priorities for the team, ensuring alignment with the overall research strategy Encourage a culture of continuous learning and innovation, supporting the team in staying at the forefront of technological advancements Build capabilities and succession within the team: plan capacity, people and resources; coach, mentor and develop engineers; maintain the team as a center of excellence for interrupter technology   You contribute Oversee different research laboratories, ensuring high safety standards and compliance Contribute to research projects and pre-studies with your own scientific expertise Participate in test campaigns, including taking on the electrical emergency first aider role (training will be provided)   You are impactful Foster the creation of new research project proposals and strategic research initiatives Contribute to an innovative, motivating, and inclusive working environment   You foster collaboration Maintain and expand a strong network with relevant business units and leading universities Promote collaboration across all Hitachi Energy Research Centers   Your background   PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Technical expertise in areas such as circuit breakers, high power testing, plasma physics, along with an interest in emerging research and technology fields Several years of experience and a proven track record in industrial R&D, including people leadership experience Fluency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage   If you are eager to drive innovation in a dynamic research environment, we look forward to your application!

descriptions.it: Opportunità: Come parte del team Global Product Group Distribution & Traction Transformers, sarai responsabile dell'analisi aziendale per progetti di digitalizzazione core tra cui Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA e Matterport all'interno di 25 fabbriche nell'ambito del portafoglio. Contribuirai trasversalmente collaborando con funzioni IT e domini aziendali, oltre ad essere responsabile per la progettazione, lo sviluppo e il mantenimento dei rapporti GPG DT Power BI per monitorare i KPI e le metriche di performance Assicurare l'adesione agli standard di governance dei dati e mantenere una documentazione completa per tutti i rapporti e i processi all'interno dell'area GPG DT Operations Digital. Raccogliere e progettare i requisiti aziendali in formato e modelli di documentazione richiesti. Identificare le opportunità per migliorare i processi di reportistica, gli strumenti e le metodologie per una maggiore efficienza e scalabilità. Implementare le migliori pratiche e sfruttare le tecnologie emergenti per migliorare le capacità di analisi dei dati. Fornire formazione e guida ai team aziendali sui report di analisi, strumenti digitali core, strumento TrafoSignature. Collabora con team globali, HUB e fabbriche per raccogliere i requisiti e fornire soluzioni di report su misura. Agire come un collegamento chiave tra team tecnici e stakeholder aziendali per garantire allineamento e trasparenza. Analisi funzionale e aziendale per progetti di base: Digital TrafoSignature, ECS, IBA, Matterport dal punto di vista aziendale. Eseguire i test di accettazione dell'utente e la validazione insieme a utenti chiave e IT. Fornisci aggiornamenti digitali sul contenuto del sito GPG DT con l'utilizzo di CMS. La tua laurea in Ingegneria, Scienza dei dati, IT o un campo tecnico correlato. descriptions.it: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation and commissioning of high power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency. To strengthen our control engineering team, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated Project Control Engineer with interest in power electronics and control technology. You have a quick perception as well as an independent, structured and proactive work style, this is the right challenge for you – join us. How you'll make an impact Project planning of hardware and software for power electronic converters including preparation of concept, specification and documentation Technical coordination between customer, sub-suppliers and our own factory Defining the hardware interfaces including evaluation of electrical components, calculation and design review Responsible for the implementation of the control software including testing on the real-time simulator Perform commissioning and customer training on site Support the sales department during the concept and tender phase Assisting customers on technical issues of the converter during office hours and on-call duty service (24x7) several weeks per year and performing commissioning \/ customer training on site Collaborate with your colleagues from the control, system- and mechanical engineering team as well as the project manager Your background Diploma in Electrical Engineering (university \/ technical college, Bachelor or Master) Working experience in process control and software design (OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI), Ability to code in Python is a plus Knowledge on communication protocols (OPC, IEC61850, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, etc.) Comprehensive knowledge in the field of control engineering and power electronics You are fluent in German and English You have experience in testing and commissioning and enjoy global traveling and commissioning (15% of the working time) Responsible team player with strong communication skills More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Über die Position Starte deine Karriere mit einem praxisnahen Einstieg in die Industrie. Du setzt dein theoretisches Wissen aus dem Studium direkt in die Praxis um und sammelst dabei wertvolle Erfahrungen. • Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, das dir Sicherheit und Selbstvertrauen für deinen Berufseinstieg gibt. Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und ein engagiertes, unterstützendes Team begleiten dich auf deinem Weg zum erfolgreichen Bachelorabschluss. Hitachi Energy bietet Dir interessante • Aufgaben in einem hoch motivierten Engineering Team im Bereich Technical Project Engineering. Hier beschäftigst Du dich mit dem Design und Abwickeln von Umrichter-Systemen in den Bereichen Power Quality (STATCOM), Bahnnetzkupplungen, Netzkupplungen und Pumpspeicheranlagen. Hinweis: Das Praktikum ist ausschliesslich in Kombination mit einem praxisintegrierten Bachelorstudium an der Fachhochschule Nordwestschweiz FHNW \/ Zürcher Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften ZHAW möglich. Weitere Informationen findest du hier: Link zu FHNW: https:\/\/www.fhnw.ch\/de\/studium\/technik\/pibs Link zu ZHAW: https:\/\/www.zhaw.ch\/de\/engineering\/studium\/bachelorstudium\/praxisintegriertes-bachelorstudium\/ Das kannst du bewirken Unterstützung des Engineering Teams bei der Realisierung von Kundenprojekten während der Abwicklungsphase Erstellung von Zeichnungen \/ Schemata \/ 3D-Modellen, die den individuellen • Anforderungen der Kunden entsprechen Mitarbeit bei der Konzeption innovativer, kundenorientierter Lösungen Anlegen und Pflegen von Stücklisten \/ Materialien im ERP-System SAP Pflege von Zeichnungen \/ Schemata \/ und Dokumenten im Dokumenten Management System (DMS) Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Gymnasiale Matura (Voraussetzungen für die Zulassung an der Fachhochschule FHNW\/ZHAW) Interesse an Technik und Energiesystemen und Freude am Arbeiten in interdisziplinären Teams Gute Kenntnisse von Microsoft Office und Affinität zu CAD Tools Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und soziale Kompetenz Fähigkeit zur eigenständigen und strukturierten Arbeitsweise sowie Bereitschaft zur eigenen kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung Fliessendes Deutsch (mindestens C1), Kenntnisse in Englisch (B2) Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen dir, persönliche und berufliche Ziele zu verbinden. • Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, in dem du deine Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen kannst – unterstützt durch Mentoring und eine inklusive Kultur. Haben wir dein Interesse Geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive CV, Motivationsschreiben und Zeugnisse.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated module assembly processes. How you'll make an impact Improve the process capability of module assembly processes, by applying statistical tools, designed experiments and gemba principles Analyse production data to optimize performance, identify long-term trends, and prevent potential failures Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to maintain and improve production throughput Collaborate to new product development by shaping the production process landscape and enabling volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial or mechanical Good understanding of automation and experience in robot handling Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis and production statistics Proficiency in English and German More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Über die Position Als Mitarbeiter Endprüfung bei Hitachi Energy bist du ein entscheidendes Bindeglied zwischen Produktion und Auslieferung. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Produkte vor der Freigabe höchsten Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Dokumentationsanforderungen entsprechen. Mit deinem Qualitätsbewusstsein und deinem strukturierten Vorgehen trägst du maßgeblich zur Zuverlässigkeit unserer Produkte und zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden bei. Das kannst du bewirken Testen von Generatorleistungsschaltern im Prüffeld (80%): Prüfen der Generator Leistungsschalter gemäss vorgegebenem Prüfplan Bewertung der Messergebnisse Durchführung von Kundenabnahmen in Englischer Sprache Erkennen von mechanischen und elektrischen Fehlern Analyse und Korrektur von Verdrahtungsfehlern im Steuerschrank Übernahme der Verantwortung für das Prüfen der zugeteilten Schalter (zeitlicher Ablauf sowie Qualität der Prüfung) Mitarbeit bei der Verbesserung des Messequipments sowie der Prüfprozesse Montage- und Verdrahtungsarbeiten (20%): Selbstständige Verdrahtung von Baugruppen und Schaltersystemen gemäss Arbeitspapieren wie Kundenauftrag, Elektroschema, Checkliste und Arbeits­plan Montage von PGHV-Produkten entsprechend der in den Qualitätssicherungsverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen festgehaltenen Vorgaben und Zielsetzungen Lesen und verstehen von technischen Zeichnungen und Stücklisten Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Grundausbildung (Automatiker EFZ, o.ä.) Erfahrung im lesen und verstehen von elektrischen Schemas, Montagezeichnungen und Arbeitsanweisungen Kenntnisse der Prüfung elektrischer Maschinen und von Steuerschränken sind von Vorteil Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mündlich, schriftlich) Affinität zu Computern (Messequipment, diverse Softwaretools, Dokumentation erstellen und pflegen) Gutes Verständnis für Arbeitssicherheit, hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie kundenorientiertes Denken und professioneller Umgang mit Kunden Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy steht für innovative Technologien und nachhaltige Energielösungen weltweit. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our collaborative team for a 12 months internship in Zürich-Altstetten and gain hands-on experience in a global industrial environment. You will support a highly skilled Planning & Fulfillment team within our Insulation & Components product group, a worldwide leader in high-voltage transformer bushings. In this role, you contribute to essential operational processes while building strong analytical and organizational capabilities. You will learn how international supply chains operate and how data drives decision-making. You grow through close guidance, meaningful tasks, and an encouraging team culture. This role is ideal for someone curious, detail-oriented, and eager to make a real impact. How you'll make an impact Support the Planning & Fulfillment team with administrative tasks Prepare and maintain regular reports and data analyses Help ensure data accuracy across planning systems Collaborate with internal stakeholders across departments Support continuous improvement initiatives within the team Contribute ideas to optimize reporting and workflows Your background Basic commercial education First experience in an administrative or office role Strong communication skills and team spirit Structured and detail-oriented working style Good knowledge of MS Office tools Fluent in German and English More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptions.it: Inizia la tua carriera con un ingresso pratico nel settore e modella attivamente la nostra produzione attraverso l'ottimizzazione dei processi data-driven. Stai implementando le tue conoscenze teoriche dai tuoi studi – ad esempio dal metodo e dalla gestione dei progetti – direttamente nella pratica e ottieni un'esperienza preziosa. • Vi offriamo un ambiente che vi dà sicurezza e fiducia in se stessi per la vostra carriera. Condizioni di lavoro flessibili e un team di supporto dedicato vi accompagnerà sulla vostra strada per la laurea di successo. Nota: Lo stage è possibile esclusivamente in combinazione con un corso di laurea integrato nella pratica presso l'Università di Scienze Applicate della Svizzera nordoccidentale FHNW \/ Zurigo University of Applied Sciences ZHAW. Ulteriori informazioni possono essere trovate qui: Link a FHNW: https:\/\/www.fhnw.ch\/de\/studie\/technik\/pibs Link a ZHAW: https:\/\/www.zhaw.ch\/de\/engineering\/studie\/bachelorstudie\/praxis-integrate-bachelorstudie Questo consente di gestire con successo i processi aziendali automatizzati con Power BI, Power Automate o Power Platform e di accompagnare i progetti esistenti e nuovi con Manufacturing Equipment Systems (MES) e database Crea sequenze di processo secondo BPMN 2.0 e digitalizzazione del disco (process mining, Citizen development and business analysis) per far progredire il know-how tecnico con il business thinking e implementare la teoria in pratica (ingegneria dei requisiti) Questo è ciò che si porta con Gymnasiale Matura completata (provvedimenti per l'ammissione alla Fachhochschule FHNW\/ZHAW) Apertura, proattività e auto-motivazione Capacità di comunicazione goffrata e competenze sociali per metodi di lavoro indipendenti e strutturati Tedesco completo (almeno C1), conoscenza in inglese (B1) Ulteriori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili aiutano a combinare obiettivi personali e professionali. • Vi offriamo un ambiente in cui potete sviluppare e coltivare le vostre competenze – supportate da mentoring e da una cultura inclusiva. Abbiamo risvegliato il vostro interesse? Quindi non vediamo l'ora della vostra domanda, compreso CV, lettera di motivazione e certificati.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our Generator Circuit Breaker (GCB) team and contribute to products that shape the reliability and performance of power generation worldwide. In this role, you will lead and support a motivated team of CAD Designers while collaborating closely with experienced engineers, project leads suppliers, and the in Oerlikon located factory across the entire product lifecycle—from early design concepts to continuous improvement initiatives. You will have the chance to make a real impact by driving high quality design practices, fostering unified working methods, and championing process and documentation excellence. Through a structured introduction program, you will gain the independence and confidence needed to steer your team effectively, while benefiting from targeted training and development opportunities that support your professional growth. How you'll make an impact Coach and lead a team of CAD Designers, ensuring high quality creation, modification, and maintenance of engineering data for generator circuit-breaker systems and components (team size approx. 10 FTE) Develop\/enhance\/maintain master data of all GCB products with 3D-models, drawings and bill of materials in CAD\/PLM systems Implement special designs, cost-saving projects and drive product quality improvements Initiate and establish design-process improvements Ensure efficient collaboration with other engineering functions, project leads and further stakeholders Contribute to apprentice supervision and training together with the apprentice advisors of the team As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Solid technical foundation as senior designer or equivalent engineering background Proven experience and confident handling of CAD tools (preferably Creo) Strong working knowledge of PLM systems (preferably PTC Windchill), roles, object management, and release processes Experience in a team leading function or as a project manager of a project team Distinct self-organization skills, as well as precise, independent working style Ability to structure work, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple design topics simultaneously with high quality and reliability Mindset oriented toward process improvement, document quality, and establishing structured working methods Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as a Scientist in Physics of Failure & Reliability. We are looking for a passionate and proficient scientist to join us in reliability research for power grid assets and systems. As part of our dynamic, motivated, and creative team, you'll bridge theory and application, developing, testing, and validating novel methods and technologies to facilitate the energy transition. How you'll make an impact You drive impact : Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects by focusing on the underlying physics of failure, ensuring that reliability enhancements for power grid assets are grounded in a deep understanding of how application stresses translate into real-world failure mechanisms. Prioritize integrating physical failure models into data analysis, so that every solution is both scientifically robust and directly relevant to operational challenges You innovate : Proactively seek out emerging knowledge in failure physics and ensure that data collected and analysed reflects the true physical processes affecting system reliability, keeping the team at the cutting edge of reliability science and its practical applications You take initiative : Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Hitachi Energy business units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You connect : Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise You communicate : Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field Expertise in physics of failure, failure investigation, root-cause analysis, and reliability modeling, all with strong attention to practical application, data analysis and accurate interpretation Industry or post-doc experience (in energy technology or other industries like automotive, rail, aerospace, telecommunication) in developing and implementing product reliability improvements is a plus Fluency in English, both written and spoken More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

descriptions.it:
L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è leader globale nelle tecnologie energetiche e rinnovabili che permettono ai clienti di utilità e industria di migliorare le loro prestazioni riducendo al contempo l'impatto ambientale. CHSEM fornisce dispositivi semiconduttori ad alta potenza ai clienti interni Hitachi Energy (ad esempio HVDC, GPQSS) e ai clienti esterni. L'Ingegnere di Qualità del Materiale Senior garantisce la qualità, la robustezza e l'affidabilità a lungo termine delle materie prime critiche utilizzate nella produzione di dispositivi semiconduttori BiMOS presso la struttura di fabbricazione di Lenzburg. Essendo un'autorità tecnica, il ruolo gestisce in modo indipendente complessi argomenti di qualità legati ai materiali e ai fornitori, contribuisce alla strategia di qualità dei fornitori e supporta sia lo sviluppo delle capacità dei fornitori che del team per consentire operazioni stabili e scalabili. Guidare l'approccio di qualità del materiale per le materie prime critiche utilizzate nelle operazioni di BiMOS Definire e migliorare continuamente i concetti e le strategie di controllo CTQ Condurre complesse indagini di qualità dei materiali relative a deviazioni, rendimenti e problemi di affidabilità Monitorare e sviluppare le prestazioni dei fornitori e garantire un'efficace implementazione delle azioni correttive Corso di laurea o Master in Scienze dei materiali, Chimica, Fisica, o un campo correlato Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella qualità dei materiali, nella qualità dei fornitori o nella produzione di semiconduttori Forte conoscenza della qualità dei materiali, del controllo dei processi e della gestione dei rischi in un ambiente di produzione Capacità comprovata di gestire in modo indipendente complessi problemi di qualità dei materiali e dei fornitori Esperienza con metodi di qualità strutturati come 8D, Six Sigma, o equivalente
• Vi offriamo: Giorni extra tra Natale e Capodanno Pasti sottosidrati presso le sedi con mense sconto del 50% sui corsi principali presso i nostri frigoriferi FELFEL Sconto sui membri a vari centri fitness Sconti su vari prodotti e servizi Prestazioni interessanti con il nostro fondo pensione aziendale Diversità: Promozione della diversità e inclusione e offerte culturali, carte di credito, benzina, ecc.)
descriptions.en: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us We offer you: Extra days off between Christmas and New Year Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discount on memberships at various fitness centres Discounts on various products and services Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Sei appassionato di guidare l'innovazione e garantire il massimo uptime di strumenti di produzione semiconduttore? Come Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, si gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire la disponibilità, l'affidabilità e il miglioramento continuo del nostro parco utensili di produzione semiconduttore. L'attenzione è rivolta alla corretta, preventiva e predittiva manutenzione delle apparecchiature implantari, lavorando trasversalmente per guidare la sicurezza, la produttività e le ottimizzazioni generali degli utensili e dei flussi di lavoro attraverso la linea di produzione. Miglioramento continuo delle prestazioni dell'attrezzatura, applicazione delle pratiche di sicurezza e di efficienza sul posto di lavoro allineate con la metodologia 6S Collaborare a stretto contatto con altri team di manutenzione, processo e produzione per raggiungere gli obiettivi di performance e ottimizzare l'efficienza della linea Partecipare agli aggiornamenti degli strumenti e ai progetti di modernizzazione per migliorare la capacità e l'affidabilità degli strumenti Esperienza pratica nella manutenzione di strumenti di produzione semiconduttore Solida comprensione dell'elettronica, della meccanica e della pneumatica Minimo 3 anni di esperienza con gli impiantatori ioni (come AMAT o Nissin o Axcelis) Familiarità con strumenti di metrologia per il controllo dei processi (Semilab WT-2000) Formazione aggiuntiva o competenza in sistemi di vuoto o tecnologie correlate Formazione professionale tecnica completa (ad esempio, Tecnologia di automazione, Tecnologia elettronica, o campo simile) La volontà di lavorare in turni è un giocatore di squadra forte deve con la mentalità problem-solving, le abilità organizzative e la competenza in inglese (il tedesco è un plus) Hitachi Energy ti offre compiti interessanti in un team altamente motivato e in uno stile di comunicazione aperto. Attraverso un piano di induzione individuale e orientato alla pratica, vi supporteremo per acquisire rapidamente fiducia professionale per poter lavorare in modo indipendente con un alto livello di responsabilità personale.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.
descriptions.de:
Die Chance Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, Innovationen voranzutreiben und eine maximale Verfügbarkeit von Halbleiterproduktionswerkzeugen zu gewährleisten? Als Implant Maintenance Engineer/Techniker spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der Verfügbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unseres Werkzeugparks für die Halbleiterproduktion. Ihr Fokus liegt auf der korrektiven, präventiven und prädiktiven Wartung von Implantatgeräten, die funktionsübergreifend arbeiten, um Sicherheit, Produktivität und allgemeine Werkzeug- und Workflowoptimierungen in der gesamten Produktionslinie voranzutreiben. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Sicherstellung der maximalen Verfügbarkeit von Halbleiterproduktionswerkzeugen durch proaktive Wartung und Fehlerbehebung von Implantatausrüstung Förderung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Geräteleistung, Anwendung von Arbeitsplatzsicherheits- und Effizienzpraktiken im Einklang mit 6S-Methodik Eng zusammenarbeiten mit anderen Wartungs-, Prozess- und Produktionsteams, um Leistungsziele zu erreichen und die Linieneffizienz zu optimieren Teilnahme an Werkzeug-Upgrades und -Modernisierungsprojekten zur Verbesserung der Werkzeugfähigkeit und -zuverlässigkeit Pflegen Sie eine genaue und detaillierte Dokumentation der Wartungsaktivitäten, des Gerätestatus und der Systemleistung Unterstützung der Ursachenanalyse und Problemlösung für technische Probleme im Team Train und Mentor-Kollegen in den Bereichen Implantat, Sicherheit und beste Wartungspraktiken Fördern Sie eine starke Sicherheitskultur, indem Sie die Einhaltung aller relevanten Vorschriften, Verfahren und Dokumentationen sicherstellen Hands-on Erfahrung in der Wartung von Halbleiterproduktionswerkzeugen Solides Verständnis von Elektronik, Mechanik und Pneumatik Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit Ionenimplantatoren (wie AMAT oder Nissin oder Axcelis) Vertrautheit mit Messtechnikwerkzeugen für die Prozesssteuerung (Semilab WT-2000) Zusätzliche Ausbildung oder Fachkenntnisse in Vakuumsystemen oder verwandten Technologien Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Automatisierungstechniker, Elektroniktechniker oder ähnliches Fachgebiet) Bereitschaft, in Schichten zu arbeiten, ist ein Muss Starker Teamplayer mit Problemlösungsmentalität, organisatorischen Fähigkeiten und Englischkenntnissen (Deutsch ist ein Plus) Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy bietet Ihnen interessante
• Aufgaben in einem hochmotivierten Team und einem offenen Kommunikationsstil. Durch einen individuellen und praxisorientierten Einführungsplan unterstützen wir Sie dabei, schnell professionelles Vertrauen zu gewinnen, um selbstständig und mit hoher Eigenverantwortung arbeiten zu können.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Êtes-vous passionné par la conduite de l'innovation et d'assurer un maximum de disponibilité des outils de production de semi-conducteurs? En tant qu'ingénieur d'entretien d'implants, vous jouez un rôle essentiel dans la disponibilité, la fiabilité et l'amélioration continue de notre parc d'outils de production de semi-conducteurs. Vous vous concentrez sur l'entretien correctif, préventif et prédictif de l'équipement d'implant, le travail interfonctionnel pour stimuler la sécurité, la productivité et les optimisations générales des outils et des workflows dans toute la chaîne de production. Comment vous aurez un impact Assurer un maximum de disponibilité des outils de production de semi-conducteurs grâce à l'entretien proactif et au dépannage de l'équipement d'implant Favoriser l'amélioration continue de la performance de l'équipement, l'application de pratiques de sécurité et d'efficacité en milieu de travail conformes à la méthodologie 6S Collaborer étroitement avec d'autres équipes de maintenance, de processus et de production pour atteindre les objectifs de performance et optimiser l'efficacité de la chaîne Participer à des projets de modernisation et de modernisation des outils pour améliorer la capacité et la fiabilité des outils Maintenir une documentation précise et détaillée sur les activités d'entretien, l'état de l'équipement et la performance du système Soutenir l'analyse des causes profondes et la résolution des problèmes pour les questions techniques au sein de l'équipe Former et encadrer les collègues dans les domaines de l'implant, de la sécurité et des meilleures pratiques d'entretien Promouvoir une solide culture de sécurité en assurant le respect de tous les règlements, procédures et documents pertinents Votre arrière-plan Expérience pratique dans l'entretien des outils de production de semi-conducteurs Connaissance solide de l'électronique, de la mécanique et des pneumatiques Au moins 3 ans d'expérience avec les implants ioniques (comme AMAT ou Nissin ou Axcelis) Familiarisation avec les outils de métrologie pour le contrôle des processus (Semilab WT-2000) Formation ou expertise supplémentaire en systèmes de vide ou technologies connexes Formation professionnelle technique complète (p. ex. technicien en automatisation, technicien en électronique ou domaine similaire) Volonté de travailler en équipes est un must Fort joueur d'équipe avec la mentalité de résolution de problèmes, les compétences organisationnelles, et la compétence en anglais (l'allemand est un plus) En savoir plus sur nous Hitachi Energy vous propose des tâches intéressantes dans une équipe très motivée et un style de communication ouvert. Grâce à un plan d'initiation axé sur l'individu et la pratique, nous vous aiderons à acquérir rapidement la confiance professionnelle pour être en mesure de travailler indépendamment avec un haut niveau de responsabilité personnelle.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a Product Engineer, you will be a core member of the BiMOS Product Engineering Team, playing a key role at the interface of manufacturing, R&D, and quality. Based in Lenzburg, Switzerland, you will take end-to-end ownership of a product platform and drive its optimization using advanced data analysis and continuous improvement methods. Your work will directly impact product quality, yield, and cost competitiveness in high power semiconductor manufacturing. How you'll make an impact Monitor, analyze, and interpret yield and quality data to identify improvement opportunities and drive sustainable enhancements in cost, quality, and yield Lead and execute improvement projects using methodologies such as Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, 8D, and related frameworks Take full product ownership after R&D handover, including coordination and monitoring of new product ramp up in the fabrication line Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting of product defects, weaknesses, and quality issues, deriving clear conclusions on process and design gaps Maintain, enhance, and implement data acquisition, analytics, and reporting methods to support data driven decision making Support process and R&D engineers with strong technical expertise and structured problem-solving approaches Your background Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline Strong expertise in statistical analysis, problem solving methodologies, and advanced data analysis techniques Semiconductor manufacturing experience is an advantage Proven experience leading complex improvement projects, ideally with small, cross functional teams Comfortable working in an international, matrix organization, with excellent communication and collaboration skills Innovative, quality driven team player with a high willingness to learn and take ownership Very good command of German and English (written and spoken, B2\/C1 level) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Export, die unsere internationalen Transportprozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und optimiert. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Organisation und Überwachung weltweiter Transporte über Luft, See, Strasse und Kurierdienste. Du arbeitest eng mit Spediteuren und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine reibungslose Abwicklung sicherzustellen. Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung von weltweiten Transporten (Luft, See, LKW, Kurier) Beauftragung, Erstellung, Disponierung und Überwachung von Sendungen Abwicklung von Beglaubigungen, Akkreditiven, Carnet ATA und Versicherungszertifikaten Kontrolle der Leistungsverrechnungen Ausstellung von Versanddokumenten via ERP und anderen Tools (GTS\/SAP, Excel etc.) Auswertung von Transportofferten und Prüfung von Frachtrechnungen Kontinuierlicher Austausch mit internen und externen Stakeholdern Anwendung Ihres Fachwissens in Exportkontrolle, Ursprungsregeln und Güterbeförderung mit allen Transportträgern Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Exportfachmann\/-frau 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im relevanten Bereich Fundiertes Know-how in der Logistikbranche Digitale Kompetenzen (API, EDI, AI): Standard Erfahrung im Stakeholder Management (SCM, Planung, Lieferanten, PMs, Engineering, Qualität, Import\/Export, Finanzen) Kenntnisse in SAP TMS & GTS sowie MS Office (Excel, SharePoint etc.) Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fliessend, Englisch B2 erforderlich, Französisch\/Italienisch von Vorteil Fähigkeiten: Problemlösungskompetenz, gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir, dass Innovation aus Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit entsteht. Wir fördern ein integratives und vielfältiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen gemeinsam an nachhaltigen Energielösungen arbeiten.
