descriptions.it: L'opportunità The GPG Standardization Lead sarà responsabile della definizione e della guida della strategia di standardizzazione in tutto il Global Product Group (GPG). Il GPG Standardization Lead lavorerà a stretto contatto con diverse unità di business, team di ingegneria e dipartimenti della supply chain per garantire l'implementazione efficiente delle pratiche di standardizzazione, che sono fondamentali per migliorare la disponibilità dei materiali, accelerare i processi di approvvigionamento e sfruttare le economie di scala in un mercato in rapida crescita. Sviluppare e guidare una strategia di standardizzazione completa a livello GPG, in collaborazione con business unit (BU) e HUB regionali. Assicurarsi che la strategia si allinei con obiettivi organizzativi e richieste di mercato. Migliorare la standardizzazione delle parti, quantificare la standardizzazione e i costi associati. Definire i criteri per la standardizzazione e i criteri per la creazione di nuove parti in collaborazione con team di ingegneria e supply chain Sviluppare dashboard visivi per metriche di ingegneria come Value Stream Mapping (VSM), capacità, qualità, metriche Sviluppo di strumenti di ricerca, per migliorare il riutilizzo di parti e componenti esistenti; implementare la piattaforma di progettazione di funzionalità relative alla standardizzazione Creare e mantenere una libreria di specifiche e regole basata sui profili dei clienti per guidare la standardizzazione tra le fabbriche. Accetto su quali elementi da PLM (windchill) per connettersi a strumenti di progettazione. Stabilire metodi per quantificare, misurare e migliorare le pratiche di standardizzazione. Responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne e interne applicabili. Vivere i valori fondamentali di Hitachi Energy di sicurezza e integrità, il che significa assumersi la responsabilità per le proprie azioni, mentre la cura per i vostri colleghi e il business Il vostro background Bachelor \ / Master in Ingegneria è preferito. Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza in ingegneria con un focus sulla standardizzazione. Provato record di traccia nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie di standardizzazione. Forte comprensione dei processi di approvvigionamento e della gestione dei materiali. Esperienza con dashboard di ingegneria e metriche. Ottima capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione per lavorare con team interfunzionali. Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving. Il pensiero strategico e la pianificazione. Familiarità con il software PLM (PTC Windchill è preferito) La competenza nei principi e nelle pratiche di standardizzazione. Conoscenza della mappatura del flusso di valore (VSM) e altre metriche di ingegneria. Familiarità con GMR\/Windchill e altri strumenti di progettazione. Forte capacità organizzative e di gestione del progetto. È richiesta la competenza in lingua inglese parlata e scritta
descriptions.en: The opportunity The GPG Standardization Lead will be responsible for defining and driving the standardization strategy across the Global Product Group (GPG). The GPG Standardization Lead will work closely with various business units, engineering teams, and supply chain departments to ensure the efficient implementation of standardization practices, which are critical to enhancing material availability, speeding up procurement processes, and leveraging economies of scale in a rapidly growing market. How you'll make an impact Develop and drive a comprehensive standardization strategy at the GPG level, in collaboration with business unit (BU) and regional HUBs. Ensure the strategy aligns with organizational goals and market demands. Enhance the standardization of parts by quantifying standardization and associated costs. Define criteria for standardization and criteria for new part creation in collaboration with engineering and supply chain teams Develop visual dashboards for engineering metrics such as Value Stream Mapping (VSM), capacity, quality, metrics Drive development of search tools, to improve reuse of existing parts and components; drive implementation in design platform of features related to standardization Create and maintain a specification and rules library based on customer profiles to drive standardization among factories. Agree on which items from PLM (windchill) to connect to design tools. Establish methods for quantifying, measuring, and improving standardization practices. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's \/ Master's degree in Engineering is preferred. Minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering with a focus on standardization. Proven track record in developing and implementing standardization strategies. Strong understanding of procurement processes and material management. Experience with engineering dashboards and metrics. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strategic thinking and planning. Familiarity with PLM software (PTC Windchill is preferred) Proficiency in standardization principles and practices. Knowledge of Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and other engineering metrics. Familiarity with GMR\/Windchill and other design tools. Strong organizational and project management skills. Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required
descriptions.de: Die Möglichkeit Die GPG-Standardisierung Lead wird für die Definition und Steuerung der Standardisierungsstrategie in der Global Product Group (GPG) verantwortlich sein. Der GPG Standardization Lead wird eng mit verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen, Ingenieurteams und Supply Chain Abteilungen zusammenarbeiten, um die effiziente Umsetzung von Standardisierungspraktiken zu gewährleisten, die für die Verbesserung der Materialverfügbarkeit, die Beschleunigung der Beschaffungsprozesse und die Nutzung von Skaleneffekten in einem schnell wachsenden Markt entscheidend sind. Wie Sie eine Wirkung entfalten und eine umfassende Standardisierungsstrategie auf der GPG-Ebene in Zusammenarbeit mit Business Unit (BU) und regionalen HUBs vorantreiben. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Strategie auf organisatorische Ziele und Marktanforderungen ausgerichtet ist. Verbessern Sie die Standardisierung von Teilen durch Quantifizierung von Standardisierung und damit verbundenen Kosten. Definieren Sie Kriterien für die Standardisierung und Kriterien für die Neugründung in Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieur- und Lieferkettenteams Entwickeln Sie visuelle Dashboards für Engineering Metriken wie Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Kapazität, Qualität, Metriken Die Entwicklung von Suchwerkzeugen, die Wiederverwendung bestehender Teile und Komponenten zu verbessern; die Umsetzung in der Designplattform von Features im Zusammenhang mit Standardisierung Erstellen und Aufrechterhaltung einer Spezifikations- und Regeln-Bibliothek basierend auf Kundenprofilen, um die Standardisierung unter den Fabriken zu steuern Geben Sie an, auf welchen Artikeln von PLM (windchill) zur Verbindung mit Design-Tools stehen. Methoden zur Quantifizierung, Messung und Verbesserung der Standardisierungspraktiken. Verantwortlich für die Einhaltung geltender externer und interner Vorschriften, Verfahren und Richtlinien. Living Hitachi Energy's Kernwerte von Sicherheit und Integrität, was bedeutet, Verantwortung für Ihre eigenen Aktionen zu übernehmen, während Pflege für Ihre Kollegen und das Geschäft Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor \ / Master-Abschluss in Engineering ist bevorzugt. Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Ingenieurwesen mit Schwerpunkt Standardisierung. Erprobter Erfolg bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Standardisierungsstrategien. Starkes Verständnis von Beschaffungsprozessen und Materialmanagement. Erfahrung mit Engineering Dashboards und Metriken. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Kollaborationsfähigkeiten, um mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zu arbeiten. Starke analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten. Strategisches Denken und Planen. Vertraulichkeit mit PLM-Software (PTC Windchill ist bevorzugt) Vorteile bei Normungsprinzipien und -praktiken. Wissen über Value Stream Mapping (VSM) und andere Engineering Metriken. Vertraut mit GMR\/Windchill und anderen Design-Tools. Starke organisatorische und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten. Kenntnisse in gesprochener und geschriebener englischer Sprache sind erforderlich
descriptions.fr: L'occasion Le responsable de la normalisation des GPG sera chargé de définir et de piloter la stratégie de normalisation dans l'ensemble du Groupe mondial des produits (GPG). Le responsable de la normalisation des GPG travaillera en étroite collaboration avec diverses unités opérationnelles, les équipes d'ingénierie et les départements de la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour assurer la mise en oeuvre efficace des pratiques de normalisation, qui sont essentielles pour améliorer la disponibilité des matériaux, accélérer les processus d'approvisionnement et tirer parti des économies d'échelle dans un marché en croissance rapide. Comment vous aurez un impact Élaborer et piloter une stratégie de normalisation globale au niveau des GPG, en collaboration avec les unités d'affaires (BU) et les HUB régionaux. Veiller à ce que la stratégie soit conforme aux objectifs organisationnels et aux exigences du marché. Améliorer la normalisation des pièces en quantifiant la normalisation et les coûts connexes. Définir des critères de normalisation et des critères pour la création de nouvelles pièces en collaboration avec les équipes de l'ingénierie et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement Élaborer des tableaux de bord visuels pour les mesures d'ingénierie telles que la cartographie du flux de valeur (VSM), la capacité, la qualité, les mesures Conduire le développement d'outils de recherche, pour améliorer la réutilisation des pièces et composants existants; Conduire la mise en oeuvre dans la plate-forme de conception de caractéristiques liées à la normalisation Créer et maintenir une bibliothèque de spécifications et de règles basée sur les profils de clients pour conduire la normalisation entre les usines. D'accord sur les éléments de PLM (windchill) à connecter aux outils de conception. Établir des méthodes pour quantifier, mesurer et améliorer les pratiques de normalisation. Responsabilité de veiller au respect des règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables. Vivre les valeurs fondamentales de Hitachi Energy en matière de sécurité et d'intégrité, ce qui signifie prendre la responsabilité de vos propres actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie avec un accent sur la normalisation. Expérience éprouvée dans l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de normalisation. Une bonne compréhension des processus d'approvisionnement et de la gestion du matériel. Expérience des tableaux de bord et des mesures techniques. Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration pour travailler avec des équipes interfonctionnelles. Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Pensée stratégique et planification. Familiarité avec le logiciel PLM (PTC Windchill est préféré) Compétence en principes et pratiques de normalisation. Connaissance de la cartographie du flux de valeur (VSM) et d'autres paramètres techniques. Familiarité avec GMR\/Windchill et d'autres outils de conception. Fortes compétences en gestion organisationnelle et de projet. Une compétence en anglais parlé et écrit est requise

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking an experienced and motivated R&D Team Manager to lead our Next Generation Grids Transformers team in Geneva, Switzerland. In this role, you will manage a team of 5+ engineers and drive the development of advanced and innovative technologies, including medium frequency transformers and power electronics enhanced transformers. You will combine people leadership with strong technical guidance and project ownership, contributing to the execution of R&D strategy in a global environment. How you'll make an impact Lead, develop, and motivate an international R&D team of 5+ engineers with know-how in medium frequency transformers, power converters and lab testing Provide technical leadership and support the team in solving complex engineering challenges Contribute to R&D strategy and technology direction, including development of roadmaps for the New Generation Grids Transformers product line Plan, drive, and deliver R&D projects, ensuring alignment with scope, timelines, and quality targets Collaborate closely with global R&D teams, engineering functions, and external partners Manage project resources and budgets to maximize impact and operational efficiency Site R&D laboratory and infrastructure responsibility, including driving expansion plans Introduce and implement new tools, technologies, and processes to improve performance Your background Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related field Several years of industrial experience in product development, or technology management Strong technical background in transformers and power converters Proven experience in project management within R&D or product development Experience in leading technical teams (line or project leadership) and working in international and cross-functional environments Strong communication skills in English (French is a plus) as well as stakeholder engagement capabilities More about us You will join a collaborative and international R&D environment at the forefront of next-generation grid technologies. Working in Geneva, you will contribute to innovative transformer solutions that support the energy transition and the development of more flexible and sustainable power systems. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow

descriptions.it: Descrizione L'opportunità Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è un leader tecnologico globale nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta tensione. Rinomate aziende internazionali nell'industria elettrica, tra cui la generazione di energia, la trasmissione e la distribuzione, si affidano alle nostre soluzioni. Abbiamo una posizione leader a livello mondiale nella tecnologia di boccole ad alta tensione. Per rafforzare le nostre operazioni, stiamo cercando un ingegnere ad alta tensione per unirsi al nostro team di test ad alta tensione presso la nostra fabbrica di boccole MICAFIL. Se siete appassionati di test ad alta tensione e volete contribuire attivamente al futuro dei nostri processi produttivi, questa è la vostra opportunità di fare un impatto reale. descriptions.it: Descrizione L'opportunità La nostra divisione Prodotti ad alta tensione è uno specialista mondiale nella trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. La nostra unità di servizio supporta i clienti in tutto il mondo con i sistemi di interruttori a circuito di generatore (GCB) e commutatore isolato a gas (GIS). Dalla formazione e dalla messa in servizio alla manutenzione, alla risoluzione dei problemi, agli aggiornamenti e alle sostituzioni — garantiamo che l'infrastruttura energetica critica funzioni in modo affidabile, sicuro ed efficiente. Il servizio è al centro di tutto quello che facciamo. Nell'ambito del nostro team di assistenza internazionale, avrai un lavoro vario e pratico e diventerai un esperto di prodotti riconosciuto. Dopo una formazione completa e pratica in Svizzera, visiterai il mondo per commissionare e mantenere i sistemi GCB, il tutto lavorando in un ambiente dinamico e multiculturale. Questo è un ruolo con impatto reale, profondità tecnica, e un sacco di spazio per crescere. Mansioni - Piombo progetti di servizio multiculturali per GCB su centrali elettriche da 20 MW a 1600 MW in tutto il mondo - Assicurare l'esecuzione regolare e tempestiva dei lavori di installazione e manutenzione in loco - Eseguire il controllo di qualità finale e garantire che tutto il lavoro soddisfi i nostri elevati standard - Fornire la formazione dei prodotti direttamente ai clienti nelle loro strutture - Identificare i rischi proattivamente e attuare misure di mitigazione efficaci - Coordinate i team in loco e date istruzioni pratiche e chiare - Gestire le risorse e fornire report periodici alla gestione del progetto - Miglioramento del processo e realizzazione di iniziative di potenziamento dell'efficienza sul sito Requisiti - Apprendistato completo in metallo, ingegneria elettrica o tecnologia automobilistica - Una solida conoscenza elettrica (essenziale); un'ulteriore formazione come un diploma tecnico è un plus - Minimo 2 anni di esperienza professionale; l'esperienza nella leadership del sito è un vantaggio - Buone competenze in inglese (B2 o superiore); il tedesco è un plus - Alta disponibilità a viaggiare - fino all'80% in tutto il mondo - Giocatore di squadra flessibile, resiliente e comunicativo che gode di risolvere i problemi pragmaticamente e valori elevati standard di sicurezza e qualità Cosa? - Attività emozionanti e varie con grande libertà creativa - Opportunità di formazione e sviluppo interessanti - Attività/progetti interessanti e molto varie, inclusi incarichi off-shore - Team ben consolidato e dinamico - Cultura aziendale aperta - Un pacchetto di benefici interessanti che comprende spese fisse, di viaggio e di pasto, nonché una voce nella scelta di alloggio
descriptions.en: ## Descrizione The opportunity Our High Voltage Products division is a worldwide specialist in power transmission and distribution. Our Service Unit supports customers around the globe with Generator Circuit Breaker systems (GCB) and gas‑insulated switchgear (GIS). From training and commissioning to maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and replacements — we ensure critical power infrastructure works reliably, safely, and efficiently. Service is at the heart of everything we do. As part of our international service team, you'll take on varied, hands‑on work and become a recognized product expert. After comprehensive, practical training in Switzerland, you'll travel the world to commission and maintain GCB systems — all while working in a dynamic, multicultural environment. This is a role with real impact, technical depth, and plenty of room to grow. ## Mansioni - Lead multicultural service projects for GCB on power plants from 20 MW to 1600 MW worldwide - Ensure smooth and timely execution of installation and maintenance work on site - Perform the final quality check and guarantee that all work meets our high standards - Deliver product training directly to customers at their facilities - Identify risks proactively and implement effective mitigation measures - Coordinate on‑site teams and give practical, clear instructions - Manage resource and provide regular reporting to project management - Drive process improvements and implement efficiency‑boosting initiatives on site ## Requisiti - Completed apprenticeship in metalwork, electrical engineering, or automotive technology - Solid electrical knowledge (essential); further education such as a technician diploma is a plus - Minimum 2 years of professional experience; experience in site leadership is an advantage - Good English skills (B2 or above); German is a plus - High willingness to travel — up to 80% worldwide - Flexible, resilient, and communicative team player who enjoys solving problems pragmatically and values high safety and quality standards ## Cosa offriamo - Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom - Attractive training and development opportunities - Interesting and very varied activities/projects, including off-shore assignments - Well-established and dynamic team - Open corporate culture - An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

descriptions.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité Notre division Produits haute tension est un spécialiste mondial de la transmission et de la distribution d'électricité. Notre unité de service prend en charge les clients partout dans le monde avec les systèmes de disjoncteur générateur (GCB) et les commutateurs à gaz (GIS). De la formation et de la mise en service à la maintenance, au dépannage, à la mise à niveau et au remplacement, nous veillons à ce que l'infrastructure électrique essentielle fonctionne de façon fiable, sûre et efficace. IGBT, MOSFET de puissance, diodes, thyristors) ou d'applications connexes Une capacité démontrée de conduire la prestation technique à travers d'autres dans un environnement complexe de R-D Une solide capacité de gestion interpersonnelle, de leadership et d'intervenants Une expérience dans la gestion d'équipes interfonctionnelles et l'influence sans autorité Un état d'esprit de propriété solide avec la capacité d'équilibrer la profondeur technique et les responsabilités de leadership Une passion pour le développement de personnes, l'innovation et la création d'équipes à haut rendement Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance

descriptions.it: L'opportunità per la nostra Business Unit High Tension Products a Zurigo-Oerlikon, stiamo cercando un progettista R&D per rafforzare il nostro team di sviluppo interruttori all'interno dello sviluppo di High Tension Circuit Breaker. In questo ruolo, contribuirai alle attività di progettazione e sviluppo dei prodotti nel nostro paesaggio CAD\/PLM per i progetti R&D in corso. La posizione fa parte del team Interrupter Development e lavora a stretto contatto con i responsabili ingegneri R&D all'interno di progetti di sviluppo dei prodotti. Sarete responsabili per la creazione, la manutenzione e la qualità dei dati del modello 3D\/2D per componenti e assemblaggi assegnati, supportando lo sviluppo del prodotto virtuale dalla fase del prototipo alla produzione seriale. Stai cercando sfide tecniche in un ambiente di sviluppo veloce? Capisci rapidamente gli argomenti tecnici e ti godi di lavorare attraverso diversi punti di vista per raggiungere soluzioni tecniche robuste? Ti piace risolvere complessi compiti di progettazione in stretta collaborazione con ingegneri esperti? Poi questa posizione offre la giusta opportunità per voi. Unisciti al nostro team e contribuisci allo sviluppo di prodotti di alta qualità ad alta tensione in un ambiente di lavoro internazionale a Zurigo. Assumere la responsabilità per l'implementazione 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM dal design del concetto alla produzione di serie all'interno di progetti di sviluppo di prodotti su dispositivi di commutazione ad alta tensione Creare, modificare e analizzare il design di componenti e assemblaggi selezionati di dispositivi di commutazione in stretta collaborazione con gli ingegneri R&D, e collaborare e supportare altri stakeholder di progetto, come la catena di fornitura e la cura del prodotto
descriptions.en: The opportunity For our Business Unit High Voltage Products in Zurich‑Oerlikon, we are looking for an R&D Designer to strengthen our Interrupter Development team within High Voltage Circuit Breaker development. In this role, you will contribute to product design and development activities within our CAD\/PLM landscape for ongoing R&D projects. The position is part of the Interrupter Development team and works closely with the responsible R&D engineers within product development projects. You will be responsible for the creation, maintenance, and quality of 3D\/2D model data for assigned components and assemblies, supporting virtual product development from prototype phase to serial production. Are you looking for technical challenges in a fast‑paced development environment? Do you quickly grasp technical topics and enjoy working through different viewpoints to reach robust technical solutions? Do you like solving complex design tasks in close collaboration with experienced engineers? Then this position offers the right opportunity for you. Join our team and contribute to the development of high‑quality high‑voltage products in an international working environment in Zurich. How you'll make an impact Take responsibility for the 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM implementation from concept design to series production within product development projects on high voltage switching devices Create, modify and analyze the design of selected components and assemblies of switching devices in close collaboration with R&D Engineers, and collaborate and support other project stakeholders, such as supply chain and product care Contribute to the continuous improvement of our CAD\/PLM\/SAP related processes and activities and drive the overall model quality Your background Successfully completed apprenticeship as Konstrukteur\/in EFZ Excellent know-how in CAD\/PLM systems, ideally PTC CREO and PTC Windchill Good Knowledge in SAP\/Office High expectations on quality of work in all regards Independent, proactive and goal-oriented personality Practically oriented and hands-on way of working Team-player, committed, willing to learn Good command of German both written and spoken
descriptions.de: Für unsere Business Unit High Voltage Products in Zürich‐Oerlikon suchen wir einen R&D Designer, um unser Interrupter Development Team innerhalb der High Voltage Circuit Breaker Entwicklung zu stärken. In dieser Rolle werden Sie zur Produktgestaltung und -entwicklung in unserer CAD/PLM-Landschaft für laufende FuE-Projekte beitragen. Die Position ist Teil des Interrupter Development Teams und arbeitet eng mit den verantwortlichen FuE-Ingenieuren in Produktentwicklungsprojekten zusammen. Sie sind für die Erstellung, Wartung und Qualität von 3D\/2D Modelldaten für zugeordnete Komponenten und Baugruppen verantwortlich und unterstützen die virtuelle Produktentwicklung von der Prototypphase bis zur Serienfertigung. Suchen Sie technische Herausforderungen in einem schnelllebigen Entwicklungsumfeld? Greifen Sie schnell technische Themen und genießen Sie die Arbeit durch verschiedene Gesichtspunkte, um robuste technische Lösungen zu erreichen? Mögen Sie komplexe Designaufgaben in enger Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren lösen? Dann bietet diese Position die richtige Gelegenheit für Sie. Begleiten Sie unser Team und tragen Sie zur Entwicklung hochwertiger Hochspannungsprodukte in einem internationalen Arbeitsumfeld in Zürich bei. Wie Sie einen Einfluss ausüben Verantwortung für die 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM-Implementierung von Konzeptdesign zu Serienproduktion innerhalb von Produktentwicklungsprojekten an Hochspannungsschaltgeräten Erstelle, Modifizierung und Analyse der Gestaltung ausgewählter Komponenten und Baugruppen von Schaltgeräten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit R&D Engineers und kooperiere und unterstütze andere Projektverantwortliche, wie z.B. Lieferkette und Produktpflege
descriptions.fr: L'occasion Pour notre Business Unit High Voltage Products à Zurich-Oerlikon, nous cherchons un concepteur de R & D pour renforcer notre équipe de développement Interrupteur dans le développement de disjoncteurs haute tension. Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez aux activités de conception et de développement de produits dans notre paysage CAD\/PLM pour les projets de R-D en cours. Le poste fait partie de l'équipe de développement d'interruption et travaille en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs responsables de la R-D dans le cadre de projets de développement de produits. Vous serez responsable de la création, de la maintenance et de la qualité des données du modèle 3D\/2D pour les composants et assemblages assignés, soutenant le développement de produits virtuels de la phase prototype à la production en série. Vous recherchez des défis techniques dans un environnement de développement rapide? Saisissez-vous rapidement les sujets techniques et profitez de travailler à travers différents points de vue pour atteindre des solutions techniques robustes? Vous aimez résoudre des tâches de conception complexes en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs expérimentés ? Ensuite, ce poste vous offre la bonne occasion. Rejoignez notre équipe et contribuez au développement de produits haute tension de haute qualité dans un environnement de travail international à Zurich. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Prendre la responsabilité de la mise en œuvre 3D\/2D CAD\/PLM de la conception de concepts à la production en série dans le cadre de projets de développement de produits sur des appareils de commutation haute tension Créer, modifier et analyser la conception de composants et d'ensembles sélectionnés de dispositifs de commutation en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs de R&D, et collaborer et appuyer d'autres intervenants du projet, tels que la chaîne d'approvisionnement et le soin des produits Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos processus et activités liés à la CAO\/PLM\/SAP et conduire la qualité globale du modèle Votre expérience Apprentissage réussi en tant que Konstrukteur\/In EFZ Excellent savoir-faire en systèmes CAO\/PLM, idéalement PTC CREO et PTC Windchill Bonne connaissance en SAP\/Office Grandes attentes en matière de qualité de travail en tous points Personnalité indépendante, proactive et orientée vers l'objectif Pratiquement orientée et pratique du travail Joueur d'équipe, engagé, prêt à apprendre Bonne maîtrise de l'allemand à la fois écrite et parlée

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Come leader globale nella tecnologia dei semiconduttori di potenza, offriamo uno dei portafogli di prodotti più diversi nel settore. I nostri prodotti includono tiristori, diodi, tiristori a cancello, tiristori integrati a cancello, transistor bipolari a porte isolate e transistor a effetto campo a semiconduttore metallico. Questi componenti sono affidabili in settori come la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia, la mobilità e l'energia rinnovabile per la loro eccezionale qualità e affidabilità. Nel ruolo di Process Engineer per BiMOS Backend, contribuirai all'avanzamento della nostra produzione di moduli di potenza automatizzata. Avrete l'opportunità di migliorare i processi produttivi esistenti e di condurre progetti di sviluppo innovativi, con particolare attenzione all'assemblaggio e alla saldatura automatizzati di chip. Migliorare la capacità di collegare i processi di chip attraverso l'applicazione di metodi statistici e la progettazione di esperimenti Analizzare i dati di produzione per migliorare le prestazioni del processo, identificare le tendenze a lungo termine e sostenere la prevenzione dei potenziali guasti Condurre l'ottimizzazione dei sistemi di produzione automatizzati per migliorare la capacità di produzione, la stabilità e la qualità Supportare la risoluzione dei problemi e le attività di analisi della causa principale per sostenere e migliorare la produzione attraverso la produzione.
descriptions.en: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated chip assembly and soldering. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability of chip attach processes through the application of statistical methods and design of experiments Analyse production data to enhance process performance, identify long-term trends, and support the prevention of potential failures Lead the optimization of automated production systems to improve manufacturing capacity, stability, and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities to sustain and improve production throughput Contribute to new product development by shaping production processes and supporting the successful transition to volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment Solid machine-vision and automated inspection skills, as well as experience in Pick and Place processes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Die Chance Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Leistungshalbleitertechnologie bieten wir eines der vielfältigsten Produktportfolios der Branche. Unsere Produkte umfassen Thyristoren, Dioden, Gate-Abschaltthyristoren, integrierte Gate-kommutierte Thyristoren, Isolierte-Gate-Bipolartransistoren und Metall-Oxid-Halbleiter-Feldeffekttransistoren. Diese Komponenten sind branchenübergreifend wie Energieübertragung und -verteilung, Mobilität und erneuerbare Energien für ihre außergewöhnliche Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit vertrauenswürdig. Als Process Engineer für BiMOS Backend tragen Sie zur Weiterentwicklung unserer automatisierten Stromerzeugung bei. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, bestehende Fertigungsprozesse zu verbessern und innovative Entwicklungsprojekte zu leiten, mit besonderem Fokus auf automatisierter Chipmontage und Löten. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Verbessern Sie die Fähigkeit von Chip-Anhängeprozessen durch die Anwendung statistischer Methoden und das Design von Experimenten Produktionsdaten analysieren, um die Prozessleistung zu verbessern, langfristige Trends zu identifizieren und die Prävention potenzieller Ausfälle zu unterstützen Führen Sie die Optimierung automatisierter Produktionssysteme zur Verbesserung der Fertigungskapazität, Stabilität und Qualität Unterstützung von Fehlersuche und Ursachenanalyseaktivitäten zur Aufrechterhaltung und Verbesserung des Produktionsdurchsatzes Beitrag zur Entwicklung neuer Produkte durch Gestaltung von Produktionsprozessen und Unterstützung des erfolgreichen Übergangs zur Volumenfertigung Ihr Hintergrund Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer automatisierten Produktionsumgebung Solide Machine-Vision- und automatisierte Inspektionskompetenzen sowie Erfahrung in Pick and Place-Prozessen Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, eine qualitätsorientierte Denkweise und ein proaktiver, praktischer Ansatz Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité En tant que leader mondial de la technologie des semi-conducteurs électriques, nous offrons l'un des portefeuilles de produits les plus diversifiés de l'industrie. Nos produits comprennent des thyristors, des diodes, des thyristors à interrupteur de porte, des thyristors intégrés à interrupteur de porte, des transistors bipolaires à orifice isolé et des transistors à effet de champ à semi-conducteur métallique-oxyde. Ces composants sont fiables dans tous les secteurs comme le transport et la distribution d'électricité, la mobilité et les énergies renouvelables pour leur qualité et leur fiabilité exceptionnelles. Dans le rôle de Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, vous contribuerez à l'avancement de notre production de module d'alimentation automatisée. Vous aurez l'occasion d'améliorer les processus de fabrication existants et de diriger des projets de développement innovateurs, en mettant particulièrement l'accent sur l'assemblage automatisé de puces et la soudure. Comment faire un impact Améliorer la capacité des processus de fixation de puces par l'application de méthodes statistiques et la conception d'expériences Analyser les données de production pour améliorer la performance des procédés, identifier les tendances à long terme et soutenir la prévention des défaillances potentielles Diriger l'optimisation des systèmes de production automatisés pour améliorer la capacité de fabrication, la stabilité et la qualité Soutenir les activités de dépannage et d'analyse des causes profondes pour soutenir et améliorer le débit de production Contribuer au développement de nouveaux produits en façonnant les processus de production et en soutenant la transition réussie vers la fabrication en volume Votre expérience Maîtrise en génie industriel, mécanique, électrique ou chimique, ou dans un domaine connexe Plusieurs années d'expérience dans un environnement de production automatisé Des compétences solides en matière de vision des machines et d'inspection automatisée, ainsi qu'une expérience dans les processus de sélection et de mise en place Des compétences solides en matière d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, un état d'esprit axé sur la qualité et une approche proactive et pratique Familialité avec le DoE, l'analyse des données, les méthodologies Six Sigma et les statistiques de production sont un atout en allemand et en anglais.

descriptions.it: Informazioni sulla posizione Plasma attivamente il futuro: dove sicurezza e innovazione si incontrano. • Cerchiamo uno specialista ambientale impegnato e competente che rafforzerà ulteriormente il nostro impegno per un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, sano e sostenibile. Questo è quello che puoi fare: Garantire il rispetto delle normative ambientali e di sicurezza e delle linee guida interne Effettuare analisi di rischi, pericoli e ambientali, compresa la derivazione di misure Pianificare ed eseguire audit interni, ispezioni e controlli ambientali Indagare su incidenti ed eventi e sviluppare misure preventive Lavorare su progetti ambientali e di sostenibilità, nonché promuovere la cultura ambientale Creare e svolgere formazione su temi legati all'ambiente e alla sicurezza Consigliare e supportare manager e... descriptions.en: About the position Actively shape the future – where security and innovation meet. We are looking for a committed and competent environmental specialist who will further strengthen our commitment to a safe, healthy and sustainable working environment. In this central role, you will be responsible for initiatives to protect our employees, ensure compliance with relevant regulations and promote a proactive safety and environmental culture across the company. This is what you can do: Ensuring compliance with environmental and safety regulations and internal guidelines Carrying out risk, hazard and environmental analyzes including the derivation of measures Planning and carrying out internal audits, inspections and environmental controls Investigating accidents and events and developing preventive measures Working on sustainability and environmental projects as well as promoting environmental culture Creating and carrying out training on environmental and safety-related topics Advising and supporting managers and... Project teams on HSE issues Collaboration with authorities, auditors and external partners This is what you bring with a degree in environmental sciences, environmental technology, occupational safety or a comparable technical/scientific field (university of applied sciences/university) Several years of professional experience in the HSE or environmental sector, ideally in industry, production or technical organizations Sound knowledge of Swiss occupational safety and environmental legislation, including relevant regulations (e.g. major accident regulations, chemicals law, environmental protection law) Experience in carrying out risk analyses, Hazard investigations as well as accident and event clarifications, including the derivation of measures Practice in the planning, implementation and follow-up of audits, inspections and internal inspections, ideally in accordance with ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 Strong communication and consulting skills for supporting managers, project managers and employees in HSE matters Ability to create and carry out training courses on occupational safety, environment and sustainability, as well as analytical skills and experience in dealing with HSE key figures, reporting and continuous improvement Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English, other national languages are an advantage More about us Our flexible working models help you to optimize personal and professional performance and create an environment in which all employees can further develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.fr: À propos du poste Façonner activement l’avenir – là où la sécurité et l’innovation se rencontrent. descriptions.it:
Hitachi Energy, Prodotti ad alta tensione La nostra azienda è nota a livello mondiale come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di Servizio è responsabile del supporto post-vendita a livello mondiale per i sistemi di circuito-breaker per generatori (GCB) e per le sostanze di commutazione isolate con gas (GIS), compresi la formazione, l'installazione e la commissione, la manutenzione programmata, i servizi di valore aggiunto, la risoluzione dei problemi, gli estensioni, i retrofit e le sostituzioni. Descrizione del ruolo Come Acquirente Tecnico, agirai come interfaccia chiave tra Procurement, Ingegneria, Qualità e la nostra rete globale di fornitori. Assicurerai che i materiali, i componenti e i servizi specificiti tecnologicimente chiaramente definiti, chiariti, qualificati e disponibili in linea con le esigenze dei progetti, della qualità e della consegna. Attraverso una stretta collaborazione interfunzionale, traduirai le esigenze di ingegneria in soluzioni di approvvigionamento robuste e supporterai la qualifica dei fornitori e l'allineamento tecnico. Il tuo ruolo diretto alla qualità dei prodotti, alla affidabilità delle forniture e all'eccellenza operativa, volendo a Hitachi Energy di fornire soluzioni innovative e sostenibili per l'energia ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Come realizzare un impatto - Esegui la chiarificazione tecnica dei materiali, dei disegni, delle specifiche e delle modifiche ingegneristiche in stretta collaborazione con l'Ingegneria e i fornitori. - Supporta e coordina le attività del Processo di Approvazione dei Parti di Produzione (PPAP), le prime prove e i processi di classificazione dei fornitori. - Conduci le necessarie tecniche di materiali alternativi, richieste di deviazione e boss di obsolescenza. - Collabora diretta con gli Acquirenti Strategici e Operativi sui temi relativi ai fornitori e ai materiali. - Supporta l'organizzazione e la gestione delle lamentele dei fornitori, dei Rapporti di Non Conformità (NCR) e delle analisi di causa radice. - Supporta e partecipa alle competenze dei fornitori e alle dirette tecniche dei fornitori, comprese le recensioni della capacità, della qualità e della maturità dei processi. - Contribuisce alle prestazioni dei fornitori insieme con la Qualità e la Procurement Strategica. - Assicura l'accuratezza e la completezza dei dati di master dei materiali e dei fornitori nel SAP e agiscono come punto di contatto tecnico durante le escalazioni dei fornitori. - Supporta l'Organizzazione di Servizio e le Squadre di Progetto in materia di approvvigionamento complessivo o urgenti.
• Requisiti - Educazione tecnica completata (ad esempio Polimematico, Tecnico di Automazione, Tecnico Meccanico, Ingegnere di Progetto o simili) - 3-5 anni di esperienza in approvvigionamento tecnico o ruoli correlati allo SCM - Buona comprensione dei disegni tecnici, della Lista di Materiali e dei processi di produzione - Esperienza nel lavoro con i fornitori su temi tecnici e di qualità - Stile di lavoro strutturato, orientaleto alla soluzione e comunicativo - Buone abilità in tedesco e ottimi livelli di inglese - Conoscenza di SAP - Stile di lavoro proattivo, strutturato e orientale alla soluzione - Mindset orientaleto al team con forte collaborazione interfunzionale Cosa? - Pratiche di lavoro flessibili che ti aiuti a ottimizzare il rendimento personale e professionale e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti gli impiegati possano sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. As a Technical Buyer, you act as a key interface between Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and our global supplier network. You ensure that technically specified materials, components, and services are clearly defined, technically clarified, qualified, and available in line with project, quality, and delivery requirements. Through close cross‑functional collaboration, you translate engineering requirements into robust sourcing solutions and support supplier qualification and technical alignment. Your role contributes directly to product quality, supply reliability, and operational excellence, enabling Hitachi Energy to deliver innovative and sustainable energy solutions to our customers worldwide. How you'll make an impact Perform technical clarification of materials, drawings, specifications, and engineering changes in close collaboration with Engineering and suppliers Support and coordinate Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) activities, first samples, and supplier qualification processes Conduct technical evaluations of alternative materials, deviation requests, and obsolescence cases Collaborate closely with Strategic and Operational Buyers on supplier- and material-related topics Support the handling of supplier complaints, Non‑Conformity Reports (NCRs), and root cause analyses Support and participate in supplier assessments and technical supplier evaluations, including capability, quality, and process maturity reviews Contribute to supplier performance evaluations together with Quality and Strategic Procurement Ensure accuracy and completeness of material and supplier master data in SAP and act as the technical contact point during supplier escalations Support Service Organization and Project Teams in complex or urgent procurement topics Your background Completed technical education (e.g. Polymechanic, Automation Technician, Mechanical Technician, Design Engineer or similar) 3-5 years experience in technical procurement or SCM‑related roles Strong understanding of technical drawings, Bill of Material and manufacturing processes Experience working with suppliers on technical and quality‑related topics Structured, solution‑oriented, and communicative working style Good German skills and very good English skills SAP knowledge Proactive, structured, and solution-focused working style. Team oriented mindset with strong cross-functional collaboration More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity   Business Unit Service is at the forefront of delivering advanced, reliability-driven service solutions worldwide. As we evolve from descriptive monitoring toward scalable predictive and prescriptive intelligence, reliability modelling becomes a cornerstone of how we create customer value across the asset lifecycle.  As Senior Reliability Specialist, you will take an enterprise level role in shaping how reliability intelligence is defined, governed, and applied across our global digital service portfolio. You will operate at the intersection of reliability engineering, digital platforms, and service strategy, ensuring that reliability models are scientifically robust, consistently governed, scalable, and reusable—while being directly connected to operational performance and commercial outcomes.   This is a senior, high impact role for an expert who wants to influence how reliability intelligence is used across an entire organization, not just within a single product or project.    How you'll make an impact    Define and implement the enterprise reliability modelling strategy across BU Service Ensure reliability models deliver consistent, explainable, and decision relevant outputs (e.g., PoF, RUL, risk, mitigation) used in customer facing and decision critical contexts   Coordinate companywide projects and activities to harmonize reliability methods and avoid duplication Govern reliability model development, validation, deployment, and retirement Drive integration of reliability models into digital service and predictive platforms Partner with digital, analytics, and IT\/OT teams on data driven reliability solutions Establish standards, guidelines, and training programs for reliability engineering Define and track KPIs and deliver executive insights on reliability performance and maturity     Your background   Master's or PhD degree in Engineering (Reliability, Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, or related) Proven experience in reliability engineering and reliability modelling in mission‑critical environments Strong expertise in failure analysis, reliability modelling, and asset health management methods Experience coordinating or governing technical or modelling activities across multiple teams or units Confidence to work effectively in complex IT\/OT environments with multiple stakeholders Ability to translate reliability insights into operational decisions and service performance outcomes   More about us    We offer a highly collaborative environment across engineering, digital, analytics, and service teams A senior, visible role shaping the future of reliability intelligence in global digital services Continuous learning through exposure to leading reliability, predictive, and digital service practices Flexible working practices that help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow

descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, produits haute tension, est reconnue dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste de la transmission et de la distribution de puissance. How you'll make an impact Define and implement the enterprise reliability modelling strategy across BU Service Ensure reliability models deliver consistent, explainable, and decision relevant outputs (e.g., PoF, RUL, risk, mitigation) used in customer facing and decision critical contexts Coordinate companywide projects and activities to harmonize reliability methods and avoid duplication Govern reliability model development, validation, deployment, and retirement Drive integration of reliability models into digital service and predictive platforms Partner with digital, analytics, and IT\/OT teams on data driven reliability solutions Establish standards, guidelines, and training programs for reliability engineering Define and track KPIs and deliver executive insights on reliability performance and maturity Your background Master's or PhD degree in Engineering (Reliability, Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, or related) Proven experience in reliability engineering and reliability modelling in mission‑critical environments Strong expertise in failure analysis, reliability modelling, and asset health management methods Experience coordinating or governing technical or modelling activities across multiple teams or units Confidence to work effectively in complex IT\/OT environments with multiple stakeholders Ability to translate reliability insights into operational decisions and service performance outcomes More about us • We offer a highly collaborative environment across engineering, digital, analytics, and service teams A senior, visible role shaping the future of reliability intelligence in global digital services Continuous learning through exposure to leading reliability, predictive, and digital service practices Flexible working practices that help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow

descriptions.it: Unisciti al nostro team di OSS collaborativo e supporta le operazioni IT quotidiane vicino al business. Garantisci ai dipendenti di avere dispositivi affidabili e un'esperienza di lavoro digitale fluida. In questo ruolo pratico, impari come risolvere problemi tecnici e preparare attrezzature IT essenziali. Si lavora a stretto contatto con gli utenti finali e ottenere preziose informazioni su come l'IT guida la produttività. Durante i 12 mesi di stage, colleghi esperti sostengono la vostra crescita e sviluppo. Come farete un impatto Assist nella risoluzione dei problemi IT di base, nel ripristino dei computer portatili e di altri dispositivi in modo che siano pronti per l'uso da parte di dipendenti nuovi o esistenti Supporta gli utenti finali nella navigazione di strumenti di self-service e procedure IT standard Assistere con la gestione delle scorte, il recupero degli asset\/ritorno e la preparazione dei dispositivi per i problemi di bordo\/offboarding Processi di garanzia di supporto raccogliendo informazioni e preparando i dispositivi IT Essere impegnato in progetti speciali in cui si effettua l'impatto (locazione, cambiamento dell'assetto dell'ufficio, istituire infrastrutture, impostare le sale riunioni) Essere impegnato in progetti speciali sul sito, come rilocali per uffici, modifiche ai layout per uffici, installazione delle infrastrutture, preparazione o riconfigurazione delle sale riunioni, contribuendo direttamente a come funziona il luogo di lavoro Attualmente studiando presso una scuola universitaria o tecnica (EFZ) in IT, informatica, ingegneria o un campo correlato Lavorare con le persone e con le seguenti procedure consolidate e si è appassionati di rendere le cose migliori La comprensione di base dell'hardware e dei sistemi operativi Eager per imparare e sviluppare competenze tecniche in una mani ‐ su ambiente Forte problema ‐ risolvere mindset e buona attenzione ai dettagli Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese e tedesco Più su di noi Siamo una società di sviluppo continuo con un forte focus • Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda, tra cui una breve lettera di copertura e una trascrizione di record, insieme al vostro CV. Cittadini non UE/AELS, si prega di notare che un certificato universitario ufficiale che mostra che uno stage è una parte obbligatoria dei vostri studi è richiesto.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Join our collaborative OSS team and support daily IT operations close to the business. You ensure employees have reliable devices and a smooth digital workplace experience. In this hands‑on role, you learn how to troubleshoot technical issues and prepare essential IT equipment. You work closely with end users and gain valuable insights into how IT drives productivity. Throughout the 12 months internship, experienced colleagues support your growth and development. How you'll make an impact Assist in troubleshooting basic IT issues, p repare laptops and other devices so they are ready for use by new or existing employees Support end users in navigating self ‑ service tools and standard IT procedures Assist with stock handling, asset pickup\/return, and device preparation for onboarding\/offboarding Support warranty processes by gathering information and preparing devices Help maintain IT equipment in meeting rooms and shared office spaces, ensuring systems operate correctly Update documentation related to device preparation and OSS procedures and report issues to the team. Be engaged in special projects where you make impact ( relocating , changing office set-up, set up infrastructure, set-up of the meeting rooms) Be engaged in special on ‑ site projects, such as office relocations, changes to office layouts, infrastructure setup, and preparation or reconfiguration of meeting rooms, contributing directly to how the workplace functions Your background Currently studying at a university or technical school (EFZ) in IT, computer science, engineering, or a related field Comfortable working with people and with following established procedures and you are passionate about making things better Basic understanding of computer hardware and operating systems Eager to learn and develop technical skills in a hands ‑ on environment Strong problem ‑ solving mindset and good attention to detail Good communication skills in English and German More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.
descriptions.de: Treten Sie unserem kollaborativen OSS-Team bei und unterstützen Sie den täglichen IT-Betrieb in der Nähe des Unternehmens. Sie stellen sicher, dass Mitarbeiter über zuverlässige Geräte und ein reibungsloses digitales Arbeitsplatzerlebnis verfügen. In dieser praktischen Rolle lernen Sie, wie Sie technische Probleme beheben und wichtige IT-Geräte vorbereiten können. Sie arbeiten eng mit Endbenutzern zusammen und gewinnen wertvolle Erkenntnisse darüber, wie IT die Produktivität antreibt. Während des 12-monatigen Praktikums unterstützen erfahrene Kollegen Ihr Wachstum und Ihre Entwicklung. Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen Assist bei der Fehlersuche grundlegende IT-Probleme, p repare Laptops und andere Geräte, so dass sie bereit sind für den Einsatz durch neue oder bestehende Mitarbeiter Unterstützung Endbenutzer bei der Navigation Self-Service-Tools und Standard-IT-Prozeduren Assist bei der Bestandsabwicklung, Asset Pickup / Return und Gerätevorbereitung für Onboarding Support Garantieprozesse durch das Sammeln von Informationen und Vorbereitung von Geräten Hilfe bei der Wartung IT-Ausrüstung in Besprechungsräumen und gemeinsam genutzten Büroräumen, um sicherzustellen, dass Systeme korrekt funktionieren Aktualisieren Sie die Dokumentation in Bezug auf Gerätevorbereitung und OSS-Verfahren und melden Sie Probleme an das Team. Beteiligen Sie sich an speziellen Projekten, bei denen Sie etwas bewirken (Umzug, Änderung der Büroeinrichtung, Einrichtung der Infrastruktur, Einrichtung der Besprechungsräume) Beteiligen Sie sich an speziellen Projekten vor Ort, wie Büroverlagerungen, Änderungen an Bürolayouts, Infrastruktureinrichtung und Vorbereitung oder Neukonfiguration von Besprechungsräumen, die direkt dazu beitragen, wie der Arbeitsplatz funktioniert Ihr Hintergrund Derzeit studieren an einer Universität oder technischen Schule (EFZ) in IT, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich Komfortable Arbeit mit Menschen und mit den folgenden etablierten Verfahren und Sie sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, die Dinge besser Grundlegendes Verständnis von Computer-Hardware und Betriebssystemen Eager zu lernen und zu entwickeln technische Fähigkeiten in einer Hand - auf Umwelt Starke Problemlösung Denkweise und gute Aufmerksamkeit zum Detail Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und Deutsch Mehr über uns Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung. • Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Mentorenschaft und ein unterstützendes, integratives Umfeld, in dem Sie persönlich und beruflich wachsen können - und ermöglichen Ihnen, zu gedeihen und gleichzeitig Leben und Arbeit in Einklang zu bringen. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung, einschließlich eines kurzen Anschreibens und einer Niederschrift der Aufzeichnungen, zusammen mit Ihrem Lebenslauf. Nicht-EU-/EFTA-Bürger, bitte beachten Sie, dass ein offizielles Universitätszertifikat erforderlich ist, aus dem hervorgeht, dass ein Praktikum ein obligatorischer Bestandteil Ihres Studiums ist.
descriptions.fr: L'occasion Joignez-vous à notre équipe collaborative OSS et soutenez des opérations informatiques quotidiennes proches de l'entreprise. Vous vous assurez que les employés ont des appareils fiables et une expérience de travail numérique en douceur. Dans ce rôle pratique, vous apprenez comment résoudre les problèmes techniques et préparer les équipements informatiques essentiels. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs finaux et obtenez des informations précieuses sur la façon dont l'informatique stimule la productivité. Pendant les 12 mois de stage, des collègues expérimentés soutiennent votre croissance et votre développement. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Aider à résoudre les problèmes informatiques de base, à remplacer les ordinateurs portables et autres appareils afin qu'ils soient prêts à être utilisés par des employés nouveaux ou existants Aider les utilisateurs finaux à naviguer des outils d'auto-service et des procédures informatiques standard Aider à la manutention des stocks, à la récupération d'actifs et au retour, et à la préparation des appareils pour les processus de garantie à bord et hors-bord Soutenir les processus de garantie en recueillant de l'information et en préparant des appareils Aider à maintenir l'équipement de TI dans les salles de réunion et les bureaux partagés, en veillant à ce que les systèmes fonctionnent correctement Mettre à jour la documentation relative à la préparation des appareils et aux procédures SSO et signaler les problèmes à l'équipe. S'engager dans des projets spéciaux où vous faites impact (relocalisation, changement d'agencement, mise en place d'infrastructures, mise en place des salles de réunion) S'engager dans des projets spéciaux sur le site, tels que des déménagements de bureaux, des modifications à la disposition des bureaux, la configuration de l'infrastructure et la préparation ou la reconfiguration des salles de réunion, contribuant directement au fonctionnement du lieu de travail Votre expérience Vous étudiez actuellement dans une université ou une école technique (EFZ) en informatique, en informatique, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe Travaillant confortablement avec les gens et en suivant les procédures établies et vous êtes passionné par l'amélioration de la compréhension de base du matériel informatique et des systèmes d'exploitation Evidemment apprendre et développer des compétences techniques dans un environnement ‐ sur l'environnement Problème fort ‐ résoudre l'état d'esprit et une bonne attention aux détails Bonnes compétences en communication en anglais et en allemand Plus sur nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie et fortement axée sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable. • Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature, y compris une brève lettre de présentation et une transcription des dossiers, ainsi que votre CV. Citoyens non-UE\/AELE, veuillez noter qu'un certificat universitaire officiel indiquant qu'un stage est une partie obligatoire de vos études est requis.
