descriptions.it: L'opportunità Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di svolgere un ruolo chiave nella definizione dell'agenda di trasformazione digitale e miglioramento continuo all'interno del GCB. In qualità di responsabile del progetto di miglioramento – Data & Digital Analytics, lavorerai all'incrocio tra business, dati e tecnologia, guidando iniziative basate sui dati che migliorano l'efficienza operativa, la trasparenza e la qualità decisionale. Potrai progettare e fornire soluzioni digitali e analytics scalabili utilizzando le moderne tecnologie cloud, consentendo KPI standardizzati, insight affidabili e automazione sostenibile. Collaborando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder aziendali e IT, contribuirai direttamente a migliorare le prestazioni misurabili e sostenere la maturità digitale a lungo termine dell'organizzazione. Condurre progetti di miglioramento digitale e continuo da concept a rollout e stabilizzazione Definire l'ambito di progetto, le pietre miliari, i KPI, i criteri di governance e di successo allineati alle priorità aziendali Assicurare la disponibilità dei dati, la qualità, la coerenza e l'utilizzo conforme in GCB Design e implementare soluzioni di analisi e elaborazione dati basate su cloud. Corso di laurea o master in informatica, ingegneria, o un campo STEM correlati 2- 3 anni esperienza lavorativa rilevante Forte ingegneria dei dati e competenze di analisi (SQL, database relazionali, analisi cloud, Databricks) Solida comprensione dei dati SAP S\/4HANA Esperienza con Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Un'eccellente gestione del progetto, la proprietà e l'esecuzione focalizzano la collaborazione, la proattiva e l'autodidatta con la passione per l'innovazione digitale e il miglioramento continuo. Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: The opportunity This role offers the opportunity to play a key role in shaping the digital transformation and continuous improvement agenda within GCB. As Improvement Project Manager – Data & Digital Analytics, you will work at the intersection of business, data, and technology, driving data driven initiatives that improve operational efficiency, transparency, and decision-making quality. You will design and deliver scalable digital and analytics solutions using modern cloud technologies, enabling standardized KPIs, reliable insights, and sustainable automation. By collaborating closely with business and IT stakeholders, you will directly contribute to measurable performance improvements and support the organization's long-term digital maturity. How you'll make an impact Lead digital and continuous improvement projects from concept to rollout and stabilization Define project scope, milestones, KPIs, governance, and success criteria aligned with business priorities Ensure data availability, quality, consistency, and compliant usage across GCB Design and implement cloud based analytics and data processing solutions Work extensively with Databricks for data ingestion, transformation, analysis, and modeling Identify process inefficiencies and implement automation to reduce manual effort and cycle times Enable standardized KPIs and transparent reporting for management decision-making Proactively manage risks, dependencies, resources, and stakeholder expectations Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related STEM field 2- 3 years relevant working experience Strong data engineering and analytics skills (SQL, relational databases, cloud analytics, Databricks) Solid understanding of SAP S\/4HANA data Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Proven track record delivering digitalization, process automation, and improvement initiatives Structured, analytical mindset with strong business communication skills Excellent project management, ownership, and execution focus Collaborative, proactive, and self-driven with a passion for digital innovation and continuous improvement Business fluent in English and German More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Die Chance Diese Rolle bietet die Möglichkeit, eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der Agenda für digitale Transformation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung innerhalb des GCB zu spielen. Als Improvement Project Manager – Data & Digital Analytics arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle von Business, Daten und Technologie und fördern datengetriebene Initiativen, die die betriebliche Effizienz, Transparenz und Entscheidungsqualität verbessern. Sie entwerfen und liefern skalierbare Digital- und Analyselösungen mit modernen Cloud-Technologien, die standardisierte KPIs, zuverlässige Erkenntnisse und nachhaltige Automatisierung ermöglichen. Durch die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäfts- und IT-Stakeholdern tragen Sie direkt zu messbaren Leistungsverbesserungen bei und unterstützen die langfristige digitale Reife des Unternehmens. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Führen Sie digitale und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsprojekte vom Konzept bis zur Einführung und Stabilisierung Definieren Sie Projektumfang, Meilensteine, KPIs, Governance und Erfolgskriterien, die mit den Geschäftsprioritäten abgestimmt sind Sicherstellen Sie Datenverfügbarkeit, Qualität, Konsistenz und konforme Nutzung über GCB Design und implementieren Sie Cloud-basierte Analyse- und Datenverarbeitungslösungen Arbeiten Sie umfassend mit Databricks für Datenaufnahme, Transformation, Analyse und Modellierung Prozessineffizienzen identifizieren und implementieren Sie Automatisierung, um den manuellen Aufwand und die Zykluszeiten zu reduzieren Ermöglichen Sie standardisierte KPIs und transparentes Reporting für Managemententscheidungen Proaktiv verwalten Sie Risiken, Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcen und Erwartungen der Stakeholder Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten STEM-Bereich 2- 3 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung Starke Data Engineering- und Analysefähigkeiten (SQL, relationale Datenbanken, Cloud Analytics, Databricks) Solides Verständnis von SAP S\/4HANA-Daten Erfahrung mit Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung von Digitalisierungs-, Prozessautomatisierungs- und Verbesserungsinitiativen Strukturierte, analytische Denkweise mit starken Geschäftskommunikationsfähigkeiten Ausgezeichneter Projektmanagement-, Eigentümer- und Ausführungsfokus Kollaborative, proaktive und selbstgesteuerte mit einer Leidenschaft für digitale Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung Business fließend Englisch und Deutsch Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Ce rôle offre la possibilité de jouer un rôle clé dans l'élaboration du programme de transformation numérique et d'amélioration continue au sein du GCB. En tant que gestionnaire de projet d'amélioration – Data & Digital Analytics, vous travaillerez à l'intersection des activités, des données et de la technologie, en conduisant des initiatives axées sur les données qui améliorent l'efficacité opérationnelle, la transparence et la qualité de la prise de décision. Vous concevrez et fournirez des solutions numériques et analytiques évolutives à l'aide de technologies cloud modernes, permettant des KPI standardisés, des informations fiables et une automatisation durable. En collaborant étroitement avec les intervenants en affaires et en TI, vous contribuerez directement à l'amélioration mesurable du rendement et à la maturité numérique à long terme de l'organisation. Comment vous ferez un impact Diriger les projets d'amélioration numérique et continue du concept au déploiement et à la stabilisation Définir la portée du projet, les jalons, les ICR, la gouvernance et les critères de réussite conformes aux priorités opérationnelles Assurer la disponibilité, la qualité, l'uniformité et l'utilisation conforme des données dans l'ensemble du GCB Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des solutions d'analyse et de traitement des données basées sur le cloud Travailler en profondeur avec Databricks pour l'ingestion, la transformation, l'analyse et la modélisation des données Identifier les inefficacités des processus et mettre en oeuvre l'automatisation pour réduire l'effort manuel et les temps de cycle Permettre des ICR normalisés et des rapports transparents pour la prise de décisions en matière de gestion Gérer de façon proactive les risques, les dépendances, les ressources et les attentes des intervenants Votre formation Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine STEM connexe 2- 3 ans d'expérience de travail pertinente Fortes compétences en ingénierie et en analyse des données (SQL, bases de données relationnelles, analyse du cloud, Databricks) Une bonne compréhension des données SAP S\/4HANA Expérience avec Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Expérience éprouvée en matière de numérisation, d'automatisation des processus et d'amélioration Initiatives structurées, analytiques et solides en matière de communication d'affaires Excellente gestion de projet, propriété et mise au point d'exécution Collaboration, proactivité et autodidacte avec une passion pour l'innovation numérique et l'amélioration continue Business couramment en anglais et en allemand Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser les performances personnelles et commerciales tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Sei appassionato di guidare l'innovazione e migliorare i processi produttivi? In qualità di ingegnere dell'attrezzatura, sarete al centro dell'ottimizzazione dei sistemi di produzione, collaborando con i team interfunzionali e modellando il futuro della tecnologia dei semiconduttori. Questo ruolo offre un ambiente dinamico in cui le vostre idee e competenze influenzeranno direttamente le prestazioni delle attrezzature, gli standard di sicurezza e le iniziative di miglioramento continuo. Se siete pronti a contribuire a progetti significativi e crescere all'interno di un team di supporto e di pensiero, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi. Garantire l'affidabilità dell'attrezzatura impegnandosi nella manutenzione proattiva e contribuendo a iniziative di miglioramento continuo (CIP) Promuovere un ambiente di lavoro sicuro applicando i principi 6S e supportando i protocolli di sicurezza ABRA Collaborare tra i team per sostenere l'ammodernamento, l'espansione e il funzionamento regolare delle linee di produzione Supporta gli sforzi di documentazione contribuendo ai record di attività giornalieri e allo sviluppo delle risorse di risoluzione dei problemi Contribuire al upkeep del sistema aiutando a mantenere l'indirizzo di software di pianificazione della produzione corrente (SiView) e l'aggiornamento degli elementi Apprendistato tecnico con successivi corsi specifici di estensione, o laurea in elettronica, meccanica o fisica, o istruzione equivalente Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nel mantenimento di sistemi di produzione semiconduttore (misure preventive, risoluzione dei problemi, riparazioni, documentazione), soprattutto con attrezzature di produzione utilizzate nella fotolitografia Know-how negli strumenti per resistere al rivestimento \/ in via di sviluppo (Screen 80B\/80EX) e esposizione (Ultratech 1500 \/ Canon i3000W\/3030i5a Steppers) Buon comando di tedesco e inglese obbligatorio, qualsiasi altra lingua vantaggiosa Willingness a lavorare in turni Team player con eccellenti capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione Più Su di noi Hitachi Energy ti offre compiti interessanti in un team altamente motivato e uno stile di comunicazione aperto. Attraverso un piano di induzione individuale e orientato alla pratica, vi supporteremo per guadagnare rapidamente fiducia professionale per poter lavorare in modo indipendente con un alto livello di responsabilità personale.
descriptions.en: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and enhancing manufacturing processes? As an Equipment Engineer, you'll be at the heart of optimizing production systems, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and shaping the future of semiconductor technology. This role offers a dynamic environment where your ideas and expertise will directly impact equipment performance, safety standards, and continuous improvement initiatives. If you're ready to contribute to meaningful projects and grow within a supportive and forward-thinking team, we'd love to hear from you. How you'll make an impact Ensure equipment reliability by engaging in proactive maintenance and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives (CIP) Promote a safe work environment by applying 6S principles and supporting ABRA safety protocols Collaborate across teams to support modernization, expansion, and smooth operation of production lines Support documentation efforts by contributing to daily task records and developing troubleshooting resources Contribute to system upkeep by helping maintain production planning software (SiView) and updating equipment databases and logs Participate in audits and help address safety-related action items and improvements Support technical operations by assisting with system maintenance and ensuring production aligns with current best practices Your background Technical apprenticeship with subsequent specific extension courses, or degree in electronics, mechanics, or physics, or equivalent education At least 5 years of experience in maintaining semiconductor production systems (preventive measures, troubleshooting, repairs, documentation), especially with production equipment used in photolithography Know-how in tools for resist coating \/ developing (Screen 80B\/80EX) and exposing (Ultratech 1500 \/ Canon i3000W\/3030i5a Steppers) Good command of German and English mandatory, any other language advantageous Willingness to work in shifts Team player with excellent interpersonal and communication skills More About Us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.
descriptions.de: Die Chance Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, Innovationen voranzutreiben und Herstellungsprozesse zu verbessern? Als Equipment Engineer stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt der Optimierung von Produktionssystemen, der Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams und der Gestaltung der Zukunft der Halbleitertechnologie. Diese Rolle bietet ein dynamisches Umfeld, in dem Ihre Ideen und Ihr Fachwissen sich direkt auf die Leistung der Ausrüstung, Sicherheitsstandards und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen auswirken. Wenn Sie bereit sind, zu sinnvollen Projekten beizutragen und in einem unterstützenden und zukunftsorientierten Team zu wachsen, würden wir uns freuen, von Ihnen zu hören. Wie Sie die Zuverlässigkeit der Ausrüstung sicherstellen, indem Sie sich an proaktiver Wartung beteiligen und zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen (CIP) beitragen Förderung einer sicheren Arbeitsumgebung durch die Anwendung von 6S-Prinzipien und die Unterstützung von ABRA-Sicherheitsprotokollen Zusammenarbeit in allen Teams zur Unterstützung der Modernisierung, Erweiterung und des reibungslosen Betriebs von Produktionslinien Unterstützung der Dokumentationsbemühungen durch den Beitrag zu täglichen Aufgabenaufzeichnungen und die Entwicklung von Ressourcen zur Fehlerbehebung Beitrag zur Systempflege durch die Unterstützung der Wartung von Produktionsplanungssoftware (SiView) und die Aktualisierung von Gerätedatenbanken und -protokollen Teilnahme an Audits und Hilfe bei der Adressierung sicherheitsrelevanter Maßnahmen und Verbesserungen Unterstützung des technischen Betriebs durch Unterstützung bei der Systemwartung und Sicherstellung der Übereinstimmung der Produktion mit aktuellen Best Practices Ihre technische Hintergrundausbildung mit anschließenden spezifischen Erweiterungskursen oder einem Abschluss in Elektronik, Mechanik oder Physik oder einer gleichwertigen Ausbildung Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Wartung von Halbleiterproduktionssystemen (vorbeugende Maßnahmen, Fehlerbehebung, Reparaturen, Dokumentation), insbesondere mit Produktionsgeräten für die Photolithographie Know-how in Werkzeugen für die Lackbeschichtung / Entwicklung (Screen 80B / 80EX) und Belichtung (Ultratech 1500 \ / Canon i3000W / 3030i5a Steppers) Gute Beherrschung von Deutsch und Englisch Pflicht, jede andere Sprache vorteilhafte Bereitschaft, in Schichten zu arbeiten Teamspieler mit hervorragenden zwischenmenschlichen und kommunikativen Fähigkeiten Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy bietet Ihnen interessante Aufgaben in einem hochmotivierten Team und einen offenen Kommunikationsstil. Durch einen individuellen und praxisorientierten Einführungsplan unterstützen wir Sie dabei, schnell professionelles Vertrauen zu gewinnen, um selbstständig und mit hoher Eigenverantwortung arbeiten zu können.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Êtes-vous passionné par l'innovation et l'amélioration des procédés de fabrication? En tant qu'ingénieur en équipement, vous serez au cœur de l'optimisation des systèmes de production, de la collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et de la formation de l'avenir de la technologie des semi-conducteurs. Ce rôle offre un environnement dynamique où vos idées et votre expertise auront une incidence directe sur la performance de l'équipement, les normes de sécurité et les initiatives d'amélioration continue. Si vous êtes prêt à contribuer à des projets significatifs et à grandir au sein d'une équipe de soutien et d'avant-garde, nous aimerions avoir de vos nouvelles. Favoriser un environnement de travail sécuritaire en appliquant les principes 6S et en appuyant les protocoles de sécurité ABRA Collaborer entre les équipes pour appuyer la modernisation, l'expansion et le bon fonctionnement des chaînes de production Appuyer les efforts de documentation en contribuant aux dossiers quotidiens des tâches et à l'élaboration de ressources de dépannage Contribuer à l'entretien du système en aidant à maintenir le logiciel de planification de la production (SiView) et à mettre à jour les bases de données et les registres de l'équipement Participer aux vérifications et aider à traiter les mesures et améliorations liées à la sécurité Soutenir les opérations techniques en aidant à la maintenance du système et en assurant l'harmonisation de la production avec les pratiques exemplaires actuelles Votre formation Apprentissage technique avec des cours d'extension spécifiques ultérieurs, ou un diplôme en électronique, en mécanique, en physique, ou un enseignement équivalent Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la maintenance des systèmes de production de semi-conducteurs (mesures préventives, dépannage, réparations, documentation), en particulier avec les équipements de production utilisés en photolithographie Savoir-faire dans les outils pour le revêtement résistant \/ en développement (Screen 80B\/80EX) et l'exposition (Ultratech 1500 \/ Canon i3000W\/3030i5a Steppers) Bonne maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais obligatoire, toute autre langue avantageuse Volonté de travailler en équipes Joueur d'équipe avec d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication Plus À propos de nous Hitachi Energy vous offre des tâches intéressantes dans une équipe très motivée et un style de communication ouvert. Par le biais d'un plan d'initiation axé sur l'individu et la pratique, nous vous aiderons à acquérir rapidement la confiance professionnelle pour être en mesure de travailler indépendamment avec un haut niveau de responsabilité personnelle.

descriptions.it: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated module assembly processes. How you'll make an impact Improve the process capability of module assembly processes, by applying statistical tools, designed experiments and gemba principles Analyse production data to optimize performance, identify long-term trends, and prevent potential failures Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to maintain and improve production throughput Collaborate to new product development by shaping the production process landscape and enabling volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial or mechanical Good understanding of automation and experience in robot handling Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis and production statistics Proficiency in English and German More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a proactive and fast-learning HR Operations Specialist to temporarily join our team and support the Employee Lifecycle & Immigration processes.  This is a temporary position for 12 months and requires someone who can quickly adapt, take ownership, and deliver high-quality service in a dynamic, international environment. How you'll make an impact Manage and execute immigration processes for local hires and business travel, handling all types of work and residence permits from start to finish Ensure compliance with Swiss immigration regulations and internal procedures Provide high-level HR Operations support to HR colleagues, business managers, and employees, ensuring timely and accurate processing aligned with our Service Level Agreements Act as a point of contact for HR-related inquiries, offering clear and concise guidance on policies and procedures Handle activities across the Employee Lifecycle, including onboarding, changes, and offboarding Identify and suggest improvements based on feedback and operational experience Participate in process improvement projects and collaborate closely across HR Operations, HR Functions, and HR Business Partners Your background You hold a Swiss federal vocational certificate in HR or equivalent further education, ideally with a focus on immigration or HR Operations Minimum 2 years of experience in an international environment, ideally in immigration or HR Operations Solid understanding of Swiss labor law and immigration procedures Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with Workday and ticketing tools is a plus Strong analytical skills and attention to detail Ability to prioritize tasks effectively and meet deadlines Excellent communication skills, customer service orientation, and a resilient, flexible mindset A team player who works independently and takes initiative Fluent in German and English; Italian or French is a plus More about us Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As a Diffusion and Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of diffusion and implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of diffusion and implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of diffusion and implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Experience with diffusion systems (e.g. ASM, centrotherm ovens) as well as with ion implanters (AMAT, Nissin) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (e.g., Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

descriptions.it: The opportunity   Are you passionate about driving innovation and enhancing manufacturing processes? As an Equipment Engineer, you'll be at the heart of optimizing production systems, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and shaping the future of semiconductor technology. This role offers a dynamic environment where your ideas and expertise will directly impact equipment performance, safety standards, and continuous improvement initiatives. If you're ready to contribute to meaningful projects and grow within a supportive and forward-thinking team, we'd love to hear from you. How you'll make an impact Ensure equipment reliability by engaging in proactive maintenance and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives (CIP) Promote a safe work environment by applying 6S principles and supporting ABRA safety protocols Collaborate across teams to support modernization, expansion, and smooth operation of production lines Support documentation efforts by contributing to daily task records and developing troubleshooting resources Contribute to system upkeep by helping maintain production planning software (SiView) and updating equipment databases and logs Participate in audits and help address safety-related action items and improvements Support technical operations by assisting with system maintenance and ensuring production aligns with current best practices Your background Technical apprenticeship with subsequent specific extension courses, or degree in electronics, mechanics, or physics, or equivalent education At least 5 years of experience in maintaining semiconductor production systems (preventive measures, troubleshooting, repairs, documentation), especially with production equipment used in photolithography Know-how in tools for resist coating \/ developing (Screen 80B\/80EX) and exposing (Ultratech 1500 \/ Canon i3000W\/3030i5a Steppers) Good command of German and English mandatory, any other language advantageous Willingness to work in shifts Team player with excellent interpersonal and communication skills More About Us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As a Diffusion and Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of diffusion and implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of diffusion and implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of diffusion and implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Experience with diffusion systems (e.g. ASM, centrotherm ovens) as well as with ion implanters (AMAT, Nissin) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (e.g., Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

descriptions.it: L'OPPORTUNITÀ Siamo alla ricerca di un Project Manager Engineering o Lead Engineer motivato ed esperto che si unisca al nostro team. In questo ruolo, guiderete e gestirete i progetti del sistema di conversione dalla fase di vendita/gara all'avvio e fino al completamento, assicurando che i risultati dell'ingegneria siano puntuali, nel rispetto del budget e in linea con i requisiti di qualità. Come avrai un impatto Guida la pianificazione, l'esecuzione e la consegna dei progetti in Ingegneria entro tempistiche e budget definiti Guida lo sviluppo di soluzioni tecniche durante le vendite e la fase di gara per l'Ingegneria. Definire l'ambito del progetto, gli obiettivi e i risultati finali in stretta collaborazione con le parti interessate Coordinare i team interni e i partner esterni per garantire un'esecuzione regolare del progetto Comunicare i piani, i progressi e le aspettative del progetto in modo chiaro e proattivo Valutare i requisiti delle risorse e garantire un'allocazione efficace durante tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto Tracciare le tappe del progetto di ingegneria, le tempistiche e i risultati finali utilizzando strumenti appropriati Identificare i rischi tecnici in anticipo, gestire i cambiamenti nell'ambito e attuare misure di mitigazione adeguate Guidare, istruire e motivare i membri del team di progetto, promuovere la responsabilità e le prestazioni elevate Condurre revisioni del progetto e acquisire conoscenze chiave, derivando raccomandazioni attuabili per miglioramenti futuri Il tuo background Master in ingegneria elettrica o meccanica Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nell'esecuzione del progetto in un ambiente di ingegneria Esperienza con il potere
descriptions.en: The opportunity We are looking for a motivated and experienced Project Manager Engineering or Lead Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead and manage converter system projects from sales\/tender phase to initiation and through to completion, ensuring Engineering deliverables are on time, within budget, and in line with quality requirements. How you'll make an impact Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of projects in Engineering within defined timelines and budgets Lead the technical solution development during sales and tender phase for Engineering. Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in close collaboration with stakeholders Coordinate internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth project execution Communicate project plans, progress, and expectations clearly and proactively Assess resource requirements and ensure effective allocation throughout the project lifecycle Track Engineering project milestones, timelines, and deliverables using appropriate tools Identify technical risks early, manage changes in scope, and implement suitable mitigation measures Lead, coach, and motivate project team members, fostering accountability and high performance Conduct project reviews and capture key learnings, deriving actionable recommendations for future improvements Your background Master's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering Minimum 5 years of experience in project execution within an engineering environment Experience with power systems and converter systems is a plus Proven track record in managing complex engineering projects PMP or equivalent certification is an advantage Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills Ability to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills Fluency in English is required; German is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Die Möglichkeit Wir suchen einen motivierten und erfahrenen Projektmanager Engineering oder Lead Engineer, der sich unserem Team anschließt. In dieser Rolle leiten und verwalten Sie Konvertersystemprojekte von der Verkaufs-/Ausschreibungsphase bis zur Initiierung und Fertigstellung und stellen sicher, dass die Engineering-Leistungen pünktlich, innerhalb des Budgets und im Einklang mit den Qualitätsanforderungen sind. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Führen Sie die Planung, Ausführung und Lieferung von Projekten im Engineering innerhalb definierter Zeitpläne und Budgets durch Führen Sie die technische Lösungsentwicklung während der Verkaufs- und Ausschreibungsphase für das Engineering durch. Definieren Sie den Projektumfang, die Ziele und die Ergebnisse in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Stakeholdern Koordinieren Sie interne Teams und externe Partner, um eine reibungslose Projektabwicklung zu gewährleisten Kommunizieren Sie Projektpläne, -fortschritte und -erwartungen klar und proaktiv Bewerten Sie den Ressourcenbedarf und stellen Sie eine effektive Zuweisung während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus sicher Verfolgen Sie Meilensteine, Zeitpläne und Ergebnisse des Engineering-Projekts mithilfe geeigneter Tools Identifizieren Sie technische Risiken frühzeitig, verwalten Sie Änderungen im Umfang und implementieren Sie geeignete Minderungsmaßnahmen Führen, coachen und motivieren Sie Projektteammitglieder, fördern Sie die Rechenschaftspflicht und hohe Leistung Führen Sie Projektüberprüfungen durch und erfassen Sie wichtige Erkenntnisse und leiten Sie umsetzbare Empfehlungen für zukünftige Verbesserungen ab Ihr Hintergrundstudium Master-Abschluss in Elektro- oder Maschinenbau Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Projektabwicklung in einer technischen Umgebung Erfahrung mit Power
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un chef de projet motivé et expérimenté en ingénierie ou d'un ingénieur en chef pour rejoindre notre équipe. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez et gérerez les projets de système de conversion de la phase de vente/d'appel d'offres au lancement et à l'achèvement, en veillant à ce que les livrables d'ingénierie soient à l'heure, dans les limites du budget et conformes aux exigences de qualité. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Diriger la planification, l'exécution et la livraison des projets en ingénierie dans les délais et les budgets définis Diriger le développement de la solution technique pendant la phase de vente et d'appel d'offres pour l'ingénierie. Définir la portée, les objectifs et les livrables du projet en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes Coordonner les équipes internes et les partenaires externes pour assurer la bonne exécution du projet Communiquer les plans, les progrès et les attentes du projet de manière claire et proactive Évaluer les besoins en ressources et assurer une allocation efficace tout au long du cycle de vie du projet Suivre les jalons, les échéanciers et les livrables du projet d'ingénierie à l'aide d'outils appropriés Identifier les risques techniques dès le début, gérer les changements de portée et mettre en œuvre des mesures d'atténuation appropriées Diriger, encadrer et motiver les membres de l'équipe du projet, favoriser la responsabilisation et la haute performance Mener des examens de projet et saisir les enseignements clés, dériver des recommandations exploitables pour des améliorations futures Vos antécédents Maîtrise en génie électrique ou mécanique Minimum 5 ans d'expérience dans l'exécution de projet dans un environnement d'ingénierie Expérience avec Power

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a research scientist with expertise in modelling and simulation of complex physical phenomena to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation and develop new solutions to improve the performance and reliability of power grids devices, such as transformers, circuit breakers, power semiconductors. Seize this unique opportunity and join our motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all! How you'll make an impact You innovate: Drive the translation of innovative ideas into new power grid device features through physical modeling, scientific programming, and advanced data analysis You investigate: Elaborate and implement new models to improve the understanding of physical phenomena, such as electromagnetic, fluid-dynamics, mechanical and nonlinear material behavior You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors You communicate: Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics with strong theoretical background or in applied mathematics Proven expertise in collaborative software development, visualization and working with large code bases Practical experience with usage of simulation software and tools for engineering problems Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

How you'll make an impact You innovate: Drive the translation of innovative ideas into new power grid device features through physical modeling, scientific programming, and advanced data analysis You investigate: Elaborate and implement new models to improve the understanding of physical phenomena, such as electromagnetic, fluid-dynamics, mechanical and nonlinear material behavior You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors You communicate: Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics with strong theoretical background or in applied mathematics Proven expertise in collaborative software development, visualization and working with large code bases Practical experience with usage of simulation software and tools for engineering problems Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future. Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Il team System and Automation del centro di ricerca svizzero è alla ricerca di uno studente stagista con esperienza in elaborazione e visualizzazione dei dati, ingegneria del software o architettura del software per contribuire allo sviluppo di un nuovo quadro visivo per la gestione della variabilità in linguaggi grafici su larga scala. Lo stagista interagirà con team dinamici e multidisciplinari che supervisioneranno e guideranno il progetto. Se hai un forte background tecnico, la motivazione per sviluppare soluzioni innovative e sei orientato agli obiettivi, questa è la tua opportunità per contribuire a un futuro energetico più forte e sostenibile. La durata del tirocinio è di sei mesi. Come fare un impatto Sostenere le attività di sviluppo tecnologico e di ricerca nella gestione della variabilità per i sistemi software Eseguire revisioni all'avanguardia e tecnologiche: confrontare i risultati raggiunti con soluzioni all'avanguardia per l'applicazione data Progettare, prototipare e/o integrare strumenti che supportano l'analisi scalabile e la gestione della variabilità del software tramite interfacce visive intuitive Diffondere e riportare i risultati con i team, scrivere documentazione tecnica, proporre soluzioni creative ed efficienti verso l'implementazione industriale Il tuo background Il candidato dovrebbe essere iscritto a un programma di Master in Informatica, Data Science, Machine Learning, Control and Automation Engineering, o un campo correlato Il candidato dovrebbe avere un forte background nei dati
descriptions.en: The opportunity The System and Automation team at the Swiss research center is looking for an intern student with expertise in software engineering, software architecture, or data processing and visualization to contribute to the development of a novel framework for variability management in large-scale software systems. The intern will interact with dynamic and multidisciplinary teams that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute to a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. How you'll make an impact Support technology development and research activities related to the design and architecture of industrial software systems Perform state-of-the-art and technology reviews: Benchmark the achieved results against state-of-the-art solutions for the given application Design, prototype, and\/or integrate tools that support the scalable analysis and management of software systems via intuitive visual interfaces Disseminate and report your results with the teams, write technical documentation, propose creative and efficient solutions towards industrial implementation Your background Enrolled in an MSc program in Computer Science or a related field (Data Science, Machine Learning, Control and Automation Engineering) Strong background in software engineering, software architecture, and\/or data engineering Experience in Python programming, UI\/UX and\/or simulation tools for power electronics (Simulink, PSCAD, PLECS) is strongly appreciated Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.
descriptions.de: Die Möglichkeit Das System- und Automatisierungsteam des Schweizer Forschungszentrums sucht einen Praktikanten mit Fachkenntnissen in Datenverarbeitung und Visualisierung, Software-Engineering oder Softwarearchitektur, der zur Entwicklung eines neuartigen visuellen Rahmens für das Variabilitätsmanagement in großformatigen grafischen Sprachen beiträgt. Der Praktikant wird mit dynamischen und multidisziplinären Teams interagieren, die das Projekt überwachen und leiten. Wenn Sie über einen starken technischen Hintergrund, Motivation zur Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen und Zielorientierung verfügen, ist dies Ihre Chance, zu einer stärkeren und nachhaltigeren Energiezukunft beizutragen. Die Dauer des Praktikums beträgt sechs Monate. So erzielen Sie eine Wirkung Unterstützen Sie die Technologieentwicklung und Forschungsaktivitäten im Variabilitätsmanagement für Softwaresysteme Führen Sie State-of-the-Art- und Technologieüberprüfungen durch: Vergleichen Sie die erzielten Ergebnisse mit State-of-the-Art-Lösungen für die jeweilige Anwendung Design, Prototyp und/oder integrieren Sie Tools, die die skalierbare Analyse und Verwaltung der Softwarevariabilität über intuitive visuelle Schnittstellen unterstützen Verbreiten und berichten Sie Ihre Ergebnisse mit den Teams, schreiben Sie technische Dokumentationen, schlagen Sie kreative und effiziente Lösungen für die industrielle Umsetzung vor Ihr Hintergrund Der Kandidat sollte in einem MSc-Programm in Informatik, Datenwissenschaft, maschinellem Lernen, Steuerungs- und Automatisierungstechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich eingeschrieben sein Der Kandidat sollte einen starken Hintergrund in Daten haben
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité L'équipe Système et Automatisation du centre de recherche suisse est à la recherche d'un stagiaire ayant une expertise en traitement et visualisation de données, en génie logiciel ou en architecture logicielle pour contribuer au développement d'un nouveau cadre visuel pour la gestion de la variabilité dans les langages graphiques à grande échelle. Le stagiaire interagira avec des équipes dynamiques et multidisciplinaires qui superviseront et guideront le projet. Si vous avez une solide formation technique, la motivation de développer des solutions innovantes et que vous êtes orienté vers des objectifs, c'est l'occasion de contribuer à un avenir énergétique plus fort et plus durable. La durée du stage est de six mois. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Soutenir le développement technologique et les activités de recherche dans la gestion de la variabilité des systèmes logiciels Effectuer des revues de l'état de l'art et de la technologie : comparer les résultats obtenus avec des solutions de l'état de l'art pour l'application donnée Conception, prototype et/ou intégrer des outils qui prennent en charge l'analyse évolutive et la gestion de la variabilité du logiciel via des interfaces visuelles intuitives Diffuser et rendre compte de vos résultats avec les équipes, rédiger de la documentation technique, proposer des solutions créatives et efficaces pour la mise en œuvre industrielle Votre expérience Le candidat doit être inscrit à un programme de maîtrise en informatique, science des données, apprentissage automatique, contrôle et ingénierie de l'automatisation, ou dans un domaine connexe Le candidat doit avoir une solide expérience dans les données
