descriptions.it: L'Opportunity Kick-avvia la tua carriera nel design meccanico con noi! Siamo alla ricerca di un designer meccanico che è desideroso di impegnarsi in progetti entusiasmanti e imparare da professionisti esperti. In questo ruolo, svilupperai le tue competenze nel design dei trasformatori, lavorando a stretto contatto con il nostro team di ingegneri per fornire soluzioni innovative. Se siete appassionati di ingegneria, motivati ad imparare e impegnati nella qualità, questa opportunità è per voi. Come farete un impatto Design Support: Assist nello sviluppo di disegni meccanici applicando gli standard di ingegneria e garantendo precisione nelle specifiche del progetto Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri senior per contribuire a soluzioni su misura per le esigenze del cliente e del mercato Supporto manifatturiero: fornire supporto tecnico ai siti di produzione, contribuire a garantire i progetti soddisfare le specifiche richieste. Coinvolgimento del progetto: Test di supporto, installazione e attività di messa in servizio sotto la guida di ingegneri esperti.
descriptions.en: The Opportunity Kick-start your career in mechanical design with us! We are looking for a Mechanical Designer who is eager to get involved in exciting projects and learn from experienced professionals. In this role, you will develop your skills in transformer design, working closely with our engineering team to deliver innovative solutions. If you are passionate about engineering, motivated to learn, and committed to quality, this opportunity is for you. How you'll make an impact Design Support: Assist in developing mechanical designs by applying engineering standards and ensuring accuracy in project specifications Collaboration: Work closely with senior engineers to contribute to solutions tailored to customer and market needs Manufacturing Support: Provide technical support to manufacturing sites, helping ensure designs meet required specifications Project Involvement: Support testing, installation, and commissioning activities under the guidance of experienced engineers Problem Solving: Assist in identifying and analyzing design or product-related issues, contributing to continuous improvement Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field Around one year of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in transformers or a similar industry CAD Skills: Proficiency in CAD tools; knowledge of Creo, AutoCAD, and Windchill is an advantage Ability to read and interpret technical (including electrical) diagrams Fluency in Italian and English More about us O ur flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Der Opportunity Kick-Start Ihrer Karriere im mechanischen Design mit uns! Wir suchen einen Mechaniker, der sich gerne an spannenden Projekten beteiligen und von erfahrenen Fachleuten lernen möchte. In dieser Funktion entwickeln Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten im Transformatordesign und arbeiten eng mit unserem Engineering-Team zusammen, um innovative Lösungen zu liefern. Wenn Sie sich für das Ingenieurwesen begeistern, motiviert sind zu lernen und sich der Qualität verschrieben haben, ist diese Gelegenheit genau das Richtige für Sie. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf Design-Support haben: Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung mechanischer Entwürfe durch Anwendung von Engineering-Standards und Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit in den Projektspezifikationen Zusammenarbeit: Arbeiten Sie eng mit leitenden Ingenieuren zusammen, um zu Lösungen beizutragen, die auf Kunden- und Marktbedürfnisse zugeschnitten sind Manufacturing Support: Bieten Sie technische Unterstützung für Fertigungsstandorte und tragen Sie dazu bei, die erforderlichen Spezifikationen zu erfüllen Project Involvement: Support Testing, Installation und Inbetriebnahme von Aktivitäten unter der Leitung von erfahrenen Ingenieuren Problemlösung: Unterstützung bei der Identifizierung und Analyse von Design- oder Produktproblemen, Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung Ihres Hintergrunds Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Maschinenbau oder einem verwandten Bereich Rund ein Jahr Erfahrung im Maschinenbau, vorzugsweise in Transformatoren oder einer ähnlichen Industrie CAD-Fähigkeiten: Kenntnisse in CAD-Tools; Kenntnisse in Creo, AutoCAD und Windchill sind ein Vorteil Fähigkeit, technische (einschließlich elektrische) Diagramme zu lesen und zu interpretieren Mehr über uns O Ihre flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und schaffen eine Umgebung, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: L'Opportunity Commencez votre carrière en design mécanique avec nous! Nous sommes à la recherche d'un concepteur mécanique qui est impatient de s'impliquer dans des projets passionnants et d'apprendre de professionnels expérimentés. Dans ce rôle, vous développerez vos compétences en conception de transformateurs, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec notre équipe d'ingénierie pour offrir des solutions innovantes. Si vous êtes passionné par l'ingénierie, motivé à apprendre et engagé dans la qualité, cette opportunité est pour vous. Aide à la conception : Aider à développer des conceptions mécaniques en appliquant des normes d'ingénierie et en assurant l'exactitude des spécifications du projet Collaboration : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs chevronnés pour contribuer à des solutions adaptées aux besoins de la clientèle et du marché.Soutien à la fabrication : Fournir un soutien technique aux sites de fabrication, aider à assurer que les conceptions répondent aux spécifications requises.Participation au projet : Soutien aux essais, à l'installation et à la mise en service d'activités sous la direction d'ingénieurs expérimentés.Résoudre des problèmes : Aider à identifier et analyser la conception ou les problèmes liés aux produits, contribuer à l'amélioration continue Vos antécédents Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie mécanique ou dans un domaine connexe Environ une année d'expérience en génie mécanique, de préférence dans les transformateurs ou dans une industrie semblable.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri R&D per migliorare le capacità di prova e le conoscenze sulle prestazioni e l'affidabilità dei dispositivi SiC fabbricati a Hitachi Energy. He\/She acquisirà l'esposizione a hardware di prova, metodologie di caratterizzazione e sarà coinvolto sia nel lavoro di laboratorio concettuale e pratico. In particolare il lavoro di laboratorio fornirà allo studente uno sfondo completo sulle attività R&D all'interno di una società leader semiconduttore. Come farete un test del dispositivo SiC impatto sia a livello wafer o pacchetto Applicazione di nuove metodologie di test per i dispositivi SiC Design e\/o miglioramenti dell'hardware e del software di prova esistenti (ad esempio PCB, DAQ, script di analisi dati) Analisi dei dati per quantificare le prestazioni e l'affidabilità dei dispositivi, compresi i dati ad alto volume Prepara documentazione e report per i colleghi R&D Attualmente persegue un Master in Ingegneria Elettronica, Elettrica e Meccanica o Fisica Applicata Conoscenze di base di sviluppo e integrazione hardware (ad esempio acquisizione dati, PCB, ecc.) Conoscenza di base o interesse per la fisica dei dispositivi semiconduttori, i dispositivi di potenza, in particolare la conoscenza SiC sarebbe un grande plus Conoscenza di base dei metodi statistici per l'analisi dei dati e software come Minitab o Python Buone capacità di comunicazione e presentazione in inglese Più su di noi Siamo una società tecnologica-driven con un forte focus su innovazione, miglioramento continuo e produzione sostenibile. • Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro.
descriptions.en: The opportunity You will work closely with R&D Engineers to enhance test capabilities and knowledge about performances and reliability of SiC devices fabricated at Hitachi Energy. He\/She will gain exposure to testing hardware, characterization methodologies and will be involved both in conceptual and hands-on lab work. Particularly the lab work will provide to the student a comprehensive background about R&D activities within a leading semiconductor company. How you'll make an impact SiC device testing both at wafer or package level Implementation of new test methodologies for SiC devices Design and\/or improvements of existing testing hardware and software ( e.g. PCBs, DAQs, data analysis scripts) Data analysis to quantify device performance and reliability, including high volume data Prepare documentation and reports for R&D colleagues Your background Currently pursuing a Master Degree in Electronic, Electrical and Mechanical Engineering or Applied Physics Basic knowledge of hardware development and integration ( e.g. data acquisition, PCBs, etc..) Basic knowledge or interest in semiconductor device physics, power devices, particularly SiC knowledge would be a big plus Basic knowledge of statistical methods for data analysis and software such as Minitab or Python Good communication and presentation skills in English More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
descriptions.de: Die Chance Sie werden eng mit F&E-Ingenieuren zusammenarbeiten, um die Testfähigkeiten und das Wissen über die Leistung und Zuverlässigkeit der bei Hitachi Energy hergestellten SiC-Geräte zu verbessern. Er / Sie wird sich dem Testen von Hardware und Charakterisierungsmethoden aussetzen und sowohl an der konzeptionellen als auch an der praktischen Laborarbeit beteiligt sein. Insbesondere die Laborarbeit wird dem Studenten einen umfassenden Hintergrund über F & E-Aktivitäten in einem führenden Halbleiterunternehmen bieten. Wie Sie SiC-Gerätetests sowohl auf Wafer- als auch auf Paketebene durchführen Implementierung neuer Testmethoden für SiC-Gerätedesign und / oder Verbesserungen bestehender Testhardware und -software (z. B. PCBs, DAQs, Datenanalyseskripte) Datenanalyse zur Quantifizierung der Geräteleistung und -zuverlässigkeit, einschließlich Daten mit hohem Volumen Vorbereitung von Dokumentationen und Berichten für R&D-Kollegen Ihr Hintergrund Derzeit verfolgen einen Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Elektrotechnik und Maschinenbau oder Angewandte Physik Grundkenntnisse der Hardware-Entwicklung und -Integration (z. B. Datenerfassung, Leiterplatten usw.) Grundkenntnisse oder Interesse an Halbleiterbauelementphysik, Stromversorgungsgeräten, insbesondere SiC-Wissen, wären ein großes Plus Grundkenntnisse über statistische Methoden für Datenanalyse und Software wie Minitab oder Python Gute Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten in Englisch Mehr über uns Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung. • Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Mentorenschaft und ein unterstützendes, integratives Umfeld, in dem Sie persönlich und beruflich wachsen können - und ermöglichen Ihnen, zu gedeihen und gleichzeitig Leben und Arbeit in Einklang zu bringen.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs de R-D pour améliorer les capacités de test et les connaissances sur les performances et la fiabilité des appareils SiC fabriqués à Hitachi Energy. Il/elle sera exposé à la mise à l'essai du matériel, aux méthodologies de caractérisation et participera à des travaux théoriques et pratiques en laboratoire. En particulier, les travaux de laboratoire fourniront à l'étudiant une formation complète sur les activités de R-D au sein d'une entreprise de semi-conducteurs leader. Comment vous ferez un impact SiC testing appareil à la fois au niveau de wafer ou de paquet Mise en œuvre de nouvelles méthodologies d'essai pour les appareils SiC Conception et/ou améliorations du matériel et des logiciels d'essai existants (p. ex. PCB, DAQ, scripts d'analyse de données) Analyse des données pour quantifier le rendement et la fiabilité des appareils, y compris les données à volume élevé Préparer la documentation et les rapports pour les collègues de R-D Votre formation Actuellement titulaire d'une maîtrise en génie électronique, électrique et mécanique ou en physique appliquée Connaissance de base du développement et de l'intégration du matériel (p. ex. acquisition de données, PCB, etc.) Connaissances de base ou intérêt pour la physique des dispositifs semi-conducteurs, appareils électriques, en particulier la connaissance SiC serait une connaissance de base des méthodes statistiques pour l'analyse des données et des logiciels tels que Minitab ou Python Bonnes compétences en communication et présentation en anglais Plus sur nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie avec un accent fort sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable. • Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist per unire il nostro team innovativo in [location]. In questo ruolo, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella gestione del portafoglio prodotti trasformatori, condurre analisi di mercato, e sostenere lo sviluppo di prodotti all'avanguardia. Questa posizione non solo offre la possibilità di ampliare le tue competenze e conoscenze nel settore energetico, ma offre anche l'opportunità di contribuire a soluzioni trasformative che promuovono la sostenibilità e promuovano la tua carriera in un mercato in rapida evoluzione. Condurre un'analisi approfondita del mercato per identificare le tendenze e valutare il loro impatto sul portafoglio Transformer. Fornire una nuova prospettiva sulla differenziazione di una tecnologia matura e di un prodotto nel mercato analizzando le tendenze del mercato, comprendendo le esigenze dei clienti e monitorando le azioni dei concorrenti con un approccio innovativo e creativo. Valutare i requisiti tecnici e svolgere valutazioni competitive per individuare le lacune dei prodotti e le opportunità di miglioramento. Gestire e aggiornare le specifiche tecniche per i prodotti esistenti per garantire la competitività e il valore del mercato. Superare le iniziative di miglioramento delle prestazioni attraverso benchmarking e feedback di qualità sui prodotti assegnati. Assicurare il rispetto delle normative internazionali e degli standard industriali in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Sostenere lo sviluppo di nuovi prodotti traducendo i requisiti di mercato in input attuabili per la roadmap del prodotto. Preparare e presentare materiali di comunicazione tecnica per sostenere lanci di prodotto e migliorare il posizionamento di mercato. Sviluppare e fornire sessioni di formazione coinvolgenti per abilitare i team interfunzionali con le più recenti conoscenze di prodotto e approfondimenti di mercato. Responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne e interne applicabili. Vivere i valori fondamentali della sicurezza e dell'integrità di Hitachi Energy, il che significa assumersi la responsabilità delle proprie azioni mentre si occupano dei suoi colleghi e degli affari. La tua laurea in Ingegneria, Business Administration, Marketing o un campo relativo. Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti, nell'analisi del mercato o in un ruolo simile all'interno dei trasformatori o dell'industria energetica. Forte comprensione tecnica delle soluzioni energetiche e delle tecnologie industriali per comunicare efficacemente i benefici del prodotto e differenziare le offerte. Capacità comprovata di condurre analisi di mercato e valutazioni competitive per guidare lo sviluppo del prodotto. Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione sia per il pubblico tecnico che non tecnico. Capacità di lavorare in collaborazione tra team interfunzionali e gestire più progetti contemporaneamente
descriptions.en: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously
descriptions.de: Hitachi Energy sucht nach einem [Global\/Regional] Produktspezialisten, der sich unserem innovativen Team an [Standort] anschließt. In dieser Rolle spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Verwaltung des Produktportfolios von Transformatoren, der Durchführung von Marktanalysen und der Unterstützung der Entwicklung innovativer Produkte. Diese Position bietet nicht nur die Möglichkeit, Ihre Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse in der Energiebranche zu erweitern, sondern bietet auch die Möglichkeit, zu transformativen Lösungen beizutragen, die Nachhaltigkeit fördern und Ihre Karriere in einem sich schnell entwickelnden Markt vorantreiben. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Führen Sie eine gründliche Marktanalyse durch, um Trends zu identifizieren und ihre Auswirkungen auf das Transformer-Portfolio zu bewerten. Bieten Sie eine neue Perspektive auf die Differenzierung einer ausgereiften Technologie und eines Produkts auf dem Markt, indem Sie Markttrends analysieren, Kundenbedürfnisse verstehen und die Handlungen der Wettbewerber mit einem innovativen und kreativen Ansatz überwachen. Bewerten Sie die technischen Anforderungen und führen Sie Wettbewerbsbewertungen durch, um Produktlücken und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu ermitteln. Verwalten und aktualisieren Sie die technischen Spezifikationen für bestehende Produkte, um die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und den Wert des Marktes zu gewährleisten. Überwachung von Leistungsverbesserungsinitiativen durch Benchmarking und Qualitätsfeedback zu zugewiesenen Produkten. Gewährleistung der Einhaltung internationaler Vorschriften und Industriestandards während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. Unterstützung der Entwicklung neuer Produkte durch die Umsetzung von Marktanforderungen in umsetzbare Inputs für die Produkt-Roadmap. Bereiten Sie technische Kommunikationsmaterialien vor, um die Einführung von Produkten zu unterstützen und die Marktpositionierung zu verbessern. Entwickeln und liefern Sie ansprechende Schulungen, um funktionsübergreifende Teams mit den neuesten Produktkenntnissen und Marktinformationen zu versorgen. Verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der geltenden externen und internen Vorschriften, Verfahren und Richtlinien. Living Hitachi Energys Kernwerte Sicherheit und Integrität, was bedeutet, Verantwortung für Ihr eigenes Handeln zu übernehmen und sich um Ihre Kollegen und das Unternehmen zu kümmern. Ihr Hintergrundstudium in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing oder einem verwandten Bereich. Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Produktmanagement, Marktanalyse oder einer ähnlichen Rolle in der Transformatoren- oder Energiebranche. Starkes technisches Verständnis von Energielösungen und Industrietechnologien, um Produktvorteile effektiv zu kommunizieren und Angebote zu differenzieren. Bewährte Fähigkeit, Marktanalysen und Wettbewerbsbewertungen durchzuführen, um die Produktentwicklung voranzutreiben. Hervorragende Kommunikation und Präsentation Fähigkeiten für technische und nicht-technische Publikum. Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifend zusammenzuarbeiten und mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu verwalten
descriptions.fr: L'occasion Hitachi Energy est à la recherche d'un spécialiste des produits [mondial\/régional] pour rejoindre notre équipe innovante dans [localisation]. Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la gestion du portefeuille de produits des transformateurs, la conduite d'analyses de marché et le soutien au développement de produits de pointe. Ce poste permet non seulement d'élargir vos compétences et vos connaissances dans le secteur de l'énergie, mais aussi de contribuer à des solutions de transformation qui favorisent la durabilité et font progresser votre carrière dans un marché en évolution rapide. Comment vous ferez un impact Effectuez une analyse de marché approfondie pour identifier les tendances et évaluer leur impact sur le portefeuille Transformer. Fournir une nouvelle perspective sur la différenciation d'une technologie et d'un produit matures sur le marché en analysant les tendances du marché, en comprenant les besoins des clients et en surveillant les actions des concurrents avec une approche novatrice et créative. Évaluer les exigences techniques et effectuer des évaluations concurrentielles pour cerner les lacunes et les possibilités d'amélioration des produits. Gérer et mettre à jour les spécifications techniques pour les produits existants afin d'assurer la compétitivité et la valeur du marché. Superviser les initiatives d'amélioration du rendement au moyen d'analyse comparative et de rétroaction sur la qualité des produits attribués. Assurer la conformité aux règlements internationaux et aux normes de l'industrie tout au long du cycle de vie des produits. Soutenir le développement de nouveaux produits en transformant les exigences du marché en intrants concrets pour la feuille de route des produits. Préparer et présenter du matériel de communication technique pour soutenir les lancements de produits et améliorer le positionnement du marché. Concevoir et offrir des séances de formation stimulantes afin d'habiliter les équipes interfonctionnelles à acquérir les connaissances les plus récentes sur les produits et les perspectives du marché. Responsabilité d'assurer le respect des règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables. Vivre les valeurs fondamentales de Hitachi Energy en matière de sécurité et d'intégrité, ce qui signifie prendre la responsabilité de vos propres actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise. Diplôme d'ingénieur, d'administration des affaires, de marketing ou d'un domaine connexe. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion des produits, l'analyse de marché ou un rôle similaire au sein des transformateurs ou de l'industrie de l'énergie. Une bonne compréhension technique des solutions énergétiques et des technologies industrielles pour communiquer efficacement les avantages des produits et différencier les offres. Capacité éprouvée d'effectuer des analyses de marché et des évaluations concurrentielles pour stimuler le développement de produits. Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation pour les publics techniques et non techniques. Capacité de travailler en collaboration entre les équipes interfonctionnelles et de gérer simultanément plusieurs projets

Come tecnico di laboratorio (m\/f\/d), sarete una parte importante dello sviluppo e della certificazione del prodotto. Sarete direttamente coinvolti nella realizzazione di test e contribuire a modellare soluzioni innovative per il futuro dell'energia. Stiamo plasmando il futuro dell'approvvigionamento energetico sostenibile e vi offriamo un ambiente in cui è possibile sviluppare le vostre competenze e crescere.
descriptions.en: In our accredited development and type testing laboratories in Zurich-Oerlikon, we test high-voltage devices and systems for electrical insulation and nominal current carrying capacity. As a laboratory technician (m\/f\/d), you are an important part of product development and certification. They work directly on the experimental implementation and contribute to designing innovative solutions for the energy future. You can achieve this by assembling, setting up and connecting test objects and test equipment in the high-voltage and high-current laboratory control of delivered test pieces and completion according to documentation and drawings Setting up and calibration of measuring chains in cooperation with test engineers Independent implementation and documentation of small tests according to specifications Maintenance and maintenance of operating equipment, equipment and tools Compliance and enforcement of internal laboratory and safety guidelines Care of assigned trainees and support in the development of new test methods You bring this with completed technical training (e.g. mechanic, electromechanic or automation technician) 2–3 years of professional experience in a comparable environment Very good knowledge of German, knowledge of English beneficial enthusiasm for technical challenges and a flexible way of working More about us Hitachi Energy is a global leader in energy and automation technologies. We shape the future of a sustainable energy supply and provide you with an environment in which you can develop and grow your skills. The opportunity In our accredited development and type-testing laboratories in Zurich-Oerlikon, we test high-voltage equipment and systems for electrical insulation and rated current carrying capacity. As a Laboratory Technician (m\/f\/d), you will be an important part of product development and certification. You will be directly involved in conducting tests and contribute to shaping innovative solutions for the energy future. How you'll make an impact Assembly, setup, and connection of test objects and testing equipment in the high-voltage and high-current laboratory Inspection of delivered test items and completion in accordance with documentation and technical drawings Setup and calibration of measurement chains in collaboration with test engineers Independent execution and documentation of smaller tests according to to specifications Maintenance and care of equipment, instruments, and tools Compliance with and enforcement of internal laboratory and safety regulations Supervision of assigned trainees and support in developing new testing methods Your background Completed technical training (e.g., mechanic, electromechanical technician, or automation technician) 2–3 years of professional experience in a comparable environment Very good German language skills; English is an advantage Enthusiasm for technical challenges and a flexible way of working More About Us Hitachi Energy is a global leader in energy and automation technologies. We are shaping the future of sustainable energy supply and offer you an environment where you can develop your skills and grow.

descriptions.fr: Dans nos laboratoires accrédités de développement et d'essais de type à Zurich-Oerlikon, nous testons des dispositifs et systèmes haute tension pour l'isolation électrique et la capacité nominale de transport du courant. Ils travaillent directement sur la mise en œuvre expérimentale et contribuent à la conception de solutions innovantes pour l'avenir énergétique. descriptions.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di uno scienziato appassionato e competente con esperienza in Modelli di Grande Lingua e AI Generativo per aderire al nostro Centro di Ricerca in Baden\/Svizzera. In un ambiente interdisciplinare, guiderai l'innovazione all'avanguardia per diversi sistemi complessi nelle applicazioni della rete elettrica. Unisciti al nostro team dinamico, motivato e creativo per contribuire a un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Come farete un impatto Siete creativi: condurre una ricerca industriale di alta qualità nelle aree di AI Generativo e Modelli di Grande Lingua per reti elettriche sostenibili, energia verde e campi correlati Sei impattante: Sviluppare soluzioni software innovative, trasformarle in prototipi e aumentare la loro prontezza tecnologica verso la produzione Si prende l'iniziativa: collaborare con un team globale e interdisciplinare di ricercatori e ingegneri in Hitachi Energy Research and Business Units per identificare e risolvere i problemi del mondo reale e realizzare opportunità per ulteriori miglioramenti Collabori: Costruire relazioni all'interno dell'azienda e condividere attivamente le tue conoscenze e competenze. Interagire con partner esterni locali e globali, tra cui università e fornitori Comunica: Dissemina i risultati in relazioni tecniche, domande di brevetto e pubblicazioni scientifiche La vostra laurea in Informatica, Matematica, Fisica, o un campo correlato Competenze dimostrate nelle tecnologie GenAI che spaziano dai modelli di Grande Lingua, dai metodi di ragionamento e dai sistemi agentici, con una forte conoscenza degli algoritmi, dei quadri e degli strumenti pertinenti Competenza nel campo di elaborazione scalabile e ad alte prestazioni Buona conoscenza del NVIDIA Eccellente AI\/ML SW tecnologia stack Forte capacità e forte interesse nell'applicazione AI alle applicazioni industriali del mondo reale e ai casi emergenti relativi alla comunicazione di business
descriptions.en: The opportunity We are looking for a passionate and proficient scientist with expertise in Large Language Models and Generative AI to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation for different complex systems in power grid applications. Join our dynamic, motivated, and creative team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all. How you'll make an impact You are creative : Conduct high-quality industrial research in the areas of Generative AI and Large Language Models for sustainable power grids, green energy and related fields You are impactful: Develop innovative software solutions, turn them into prototypes and increase their technology readiness towards productization You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Business Units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors You communicate: Disseminate your results in technical reports, patent applications, and scientific publications Your background PhD degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field Proven expertise in GenAI technologies spanning Large Language Models, reasoning methods, and agentic systems, with strong knowledge of relevant algorithms, frameworks, and tools Expertise in scalable and high-performance computing Good knowledge of the NVIDIA AI\/ML SW technology stack Strong ability and keen interest in applying AI to real-world industrial applications and business cases related to the energy sector and driving the emerging research in this field toward productization Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, both written and spoken
descriptions.de: Die Chance Wir suchen einen leidenschaftlichen und kompetenten Wissenschaftler mit Expertise in großen Sprachmodellen und Generativer KI, der unserem Forschungszentrum in Baden / Schweiz beitreten wird. In einem interdisziplinären Umfeld treiben Sie Innovationen für verschiedene komplexe Systeme in Stromnetzanwendungen voran. Schließen Sie sich unserem dynamischen, motivierten und kreativen Team an, um zu einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft für alle beizutragen. Sie sind kreativ: Führen Sie qualitativ hochwertige industrielle Forschung in den Bereichen Generative KI und Große Sprachmodelle für nachhaltige Stromnetze, grüne Energie und verwandte Bereiche durch Sie sind wirkungsvoll: Entwickeln Sie innovative Softwarelösungen, verwandeln Sie sie in Prototypen und erhöhen Sie ihre Technologiebereitschaft zur Produktivierung Sie ergreifen die Initiative: Arbeiten Sie mit einem globalen und interdisziplinären Team von Forschern und Ingenieuren in Hitachi Energy Research und Business Units zusammen, um reale Probleme zu identifizieren und zu lösen und Möglichkeiten für weitere Verbesserungen zu erkennen Sie arbeiten zusammen: Bauen Sie Beziehungen innerhalb des Unternehmens auf und teilen Sie aktiv Ihr Wissen und Ihre Expertise. Interagieren Sie mit lokalen und globalen externen Partnern, einschließlich Universitäten und Anbietern Sie kommunizieren: Verbreiten Sie Ihre Ergebnisse in technischen Berichten, Patentanmeldungen und wissenschaftlichen Publikationen Ihr PhD-Hintergrund in Informatik, Mathematik, Physik oder einem verwandten Bereich Nachgewiesene Expertise in GenAI-Technologien, die große Sprachmodelle, Argumentationsmethoden und Agentensysteme umfassen, mit fundiertem Wissen über relevante Algorithmen, Frameworks und Tools Gute Kenntnisse des NVIDIA AI\ / ML SW-Technologiestapels Starke Fähigkeit und großes Interesse an der Anwendung von KI auf reale industrielle Anwendungen und Geschäftsfälle im Zusammenhang mit dem Energiesektor und treiben die aufkommende Forschung in diesem Bereich zur Produktisierung Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Teamplayer-Haltung, Initiative und Kreativität fließend in Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un scientifique passionné et compétent avec une expertise dans les grands modèles linguistiques et l'IA Generative pour rejoindre notre Centre de recherche à Baden\/Suisse. Dans un environnement interdisciplinaire, vous stimulerez l'innovation de pointe pour différents systèmes complexes dans les applications du réseau électrique. Rejoignez notre équipe dynamique, motivée et créative pour contribuer à un avenir énergétique durable pour tous. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Vous êtes créatif : Mener des recherches industrielles de haute qualité dans les domaines de l'IA Generative et des grands modèles linguistiques pour les réseaux électriques durables, l'énergie verte et les domaines connexes Vous avez de l'impact : Développez des solutions logicielles innovantes, transformez-les en prototypes et augmentez leur disponibilité technologique à la production Vous prenez l'initiative : Collaborez avec une équipe mondiale et interdisciplinaire de chercheurs et d'ingénieurs dans Hitachi Energy Research and Business Units pour identifier et résoudre des problèmes réels et réaliser des possibilités d'améliorations supplémentaires Vous collaborez : établissez des relations au sein de l'entreprise et partagez activement vos connaissances et votre expertise. Interagir avec les partenaires extérieurs locaux et mondiaux, y compris les universités et les fournisseurs Vous communiquez: Diffuser vos résultats dans des rapports techniques, des demandes de brevet et des publications scientifiques Votre diplôme de doctorat en informatique, mathématiques, physique ou un domaine connexe Expertise éprouvée en technologies GenAI couvrant les modèles de grande langue, les méthodes de raisonnement et les systèmes d'agents, avec une solide connaissance des algorithmes, des cadres et des outils pertinents Expertise en calcul évolutif et haute performance Bonne connaissance de la pile de technologies NVIDIA AI\/ML SW Forte capacité et vif intérêt à appliquer l'IA aux applications industrielles réelles et aux affaires liées au secteur de l'énergie et à conduire la recherche émergente dans ce domaine vers la production Excellentes compétences en communication, attitude des joueurs d'équipe, initiative et créativité Fluence en anglais, à la fois écrite et parlée

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un Project Manager Process Improvement dinamico ed esperto per guidare iniziative di ottimizzazione strategica tra le unità aziendali. In questo ruolo, aumenterai l'efficienza, ridurrai i costi e rafforzerai le prestazioni operative globali attraverso miglioramenti di processo strutturati e la trasformazione digitale. Come farete un impatto Lead end-to-end progetti di miglioramento del processo utilizzando le metodologie Lean, Six Sigma e A3 Definire la portata del progetto, gli obiettivi, i risultati e le metriche di successo con gli stakeholder Analizzare i processi attuali per identificare le inefficienze e le opportunità di miglioramento Sviluppare e implementare soluzioni di processo scalabili che sfruttano le migliori pratiche e strumenti digitali e la gestione del cambiamento di unità, tra cui workshop e formazione per garantire l'adozione Monitorare i progressi, i rischi e le prestazioni del progetto e riferire alla gestione senior Collaborare in modo trasversale con operazioni, finanza, IT e altri stakeholder Identificare le opportunità per l'automazione, la digitalizzazione e il miglioramento continuo Il tuo corso di laurea in economia aziendale, ingegneria, o un campo relativo (Master's is a plus) Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione del progetto con attenzione al miglioramento del processo Minimo 3 anni di esperienza come continuo miglioramento responsabile Proven track record nel fornire complesse iniziative di ottimizzazione dei processi Lean Six Sigma (Green\/Black Belt) certificazione Forte analitica e problem-solving competenze con una mentalità orientata ai dati Ottima comunicazione e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti interfunzionali e internazionali Capacità di adattarsi in un ambiente aziendale veloce e in evoluzione inglese è obbligatorio, Tedesco
descriptions.en: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a dynamic and experienced Project Manager Process Improvement to drive strategic optimization initiatives across business units. In this role, you will enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and strengthen overall operational performance through structured process improvements and digital transformation. How you'll make an impact Lead end-to-end process improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma, and A3 methodologies Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success metrics with stakeholders Analyse current processes to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities Develop and implement scalable process solutions leveraging best practices and digital tools and drive change management, including workshops and trainings to ensure adoption Lead CI method trainings (e.g. A3 problem solving) Monitor project progress, risks, and performance, and report to senior management Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, finance, IT, and other stakeholders Identify opportunities for automation, digitalization, and continuous improvement Your background Bachelor's degree in business administration, Engineering, or a related field (Master's is a plus) Minimum 5 years of experience in project management with focus on process improvement Minimum 3 year of experience as continues improvement responsible Proven track record in delivering complex process optimization initiatives Lean Six Sigma (Green\/Black Belt) certification Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Experience working in cross-functional and international environments Ability to adapt in a fast-paced and evolving business environment English is mandatory, German beneficial More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
descriptions.de: Hitachi Energy sucht nach einer dynamischen und erfahrenen Prozessverbesserung für Projektmanager, um strategische Optimierungsinitiativen in allen Geschäftsbereichen voranzutreiben. In dieser Funktion verbessern Sie die Effizienz, senken Kosten und stärken die Gesamtleistung durch strukturierte Prozessverbesserungen und digitale Transformation. Führen Sie End-to-End-Prozessverbesserungsprojekte mit Lean-, Six-Sigma- und A3-Methoden Definieren Sie Projektumfang, Ziele, Ergebnisse und Erfolgsmetriken mit Stakeholdern Analysieren Sie aktuelle Prozesse, um Ineffizienzen und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren Entwicklung und Implementierung skalierbarer Prozesslösungen unter Nutzung von Best Practices und digitalen Tools und Förderung des Change Managements, einschließlich Workshops und Schulungen zur Gewährleistung der Einführung Lead CI-Methodentrainings (z. B. A3-Problemlösung) Überwachen Sie den Projektfortschritt, die Risiken und die Leistung und berichten Sie der Geschäftsleitung Collaborate cross-funktionally mit Operations, Finanzen, IT und anderen Stakeholdern Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten für Automatisierung, Digitalisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor-Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich (Master ist ein Plus) Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement mit Fokus auf Prozessverbesserung Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung als kontinuierliche Verbesserung Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung komplexer Prozessoptimierungsinitiativen Lean Six Sigma (Green\ / Black Belt) Zertifizierung Starke analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit einer datengesteuerten Denkweise Exzellente Kommunikations- und Stakeholdermanagementfähigkeiten Erfahrung in funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Umgebungen Die Fähigkeit, sich in einem schnelllebigen und sich entwickelnden Geschäftsumfeld anzupassen Englisch ist obligatorisch, Deutsch vorteilhaft Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptions.fr: L'occasion Hitachi Energy est à la recherche d'un gestionnaire de projet dynamique et expérimenté Amélioration des processus pour conduire des initiatives d'optimisation stratégique à travers les unités opérationnelles. Dans ce rôle, vous améliorerez l'efficacité, réduireez les coûts et renforcerez la performance opérationnelle globale grâce à des améliorations structurées des processus et à la transformation numérique. Comment vous ferez un impact Diriger les projets d'amélioration des processus de bout en bout en utilisant les méthodologies Lean, Six Sigma et A3 Définir la portée du projet, les objectifs, les produits livrables et les indicateurs de succès avec les intervenants Analyser les processus actuels pour cerner les inefficacités et les possibilités d'amélioration Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des solutions de processus évolutives en tirant parti des pratiques exemplaires et des outils numériques et en favorisant la gestion du changement, y compris des ateliers et des formations pour assurer l'adoption. Surveiller l'avancement du projet, les risques et le rendement, et faire rapport à la haute direction Collaborer de façon interfonctionnelle avec les opérations, les finances, les TI et d'autres intervenants Identifier les possibilités d'automatisation, de numérisation et d'amélioration continue Vos antécédents Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe (Maîtrise est un plus) Minimum 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de projet avec l'accent sur l'amélioration des processus Minimum 3 ans d'expérience comme continue l'amélioration responsable Expérience éprouvée dans la prestation d'initiatives complexes d'optimisation des processus Certification Lean Six Sigma (Green\/Black Belt) Fortes compétences en analyse et résolution de problèmes avec un état d'esprit axé sur les données Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des intervenants Expérience de travail dans des environnements interfonctionnels et internationaux Capacité d'adaptation dans un environnement d'affaires en évolution rapide L'anglais est obligatoire, l'allemand bénéfique Plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Factory Continuous Improvement Specialist for the Business Unit Transformers to join our team driving operational excellence and Lean transformation in Satigny. In this role, you will support the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives at the factory level by facilitating projects, Kaizen events, and capability-building activities that deliver measurable impact. You will have the opportunity to strengthen your expertise in Lean methodologies and coach employees while shaping a culture of continuous improvement. This role offers a strong foundation for your career growth and allows you to make a meaningful contribution to building a more sustainable future. How you will make an impact Lead and execute factory continuous improvement projects and Kaizen events that deliver measurable impact Apply Lean methodologies to identify opportunities and implement solutions that enhance efficiency and quality Ensure compliance with governance standards by supporting audits, maturity assessments, and corrective actions Integrate the Voice of the Customer into improvement initiatives and support structured problem-solving to meet expectations Collect and analyze performance data to track KPIs and prepare dashboards that provide clear visibility of progress Train and coach employees on Lean methods and structured problem-solving to build capability across the factory Calculate and report savings and benefits from improvement projects and Kaizen events to ensure transparency and alignment with targets Provide guidance and support to factory teams to ensure consistent application of continuous improvement practices and strengthen operational performance Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, or related field Minimum 2–4 years of experience in Continuous Improvement, Lean, or Operational Excellence roles, preferably in a manufacturing environment Proficiency in Lean and Six Sigma tools (Green Belt certification) Strong facilitation and problem-solving skills to lead Kaizen events and improvement initiatives Analytical skills for data collection, KPI tracking, and ROI reporting Effective communication and coaching skills to engage factory teams and promote CI practices Fluency in French and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize both your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop and grow

descriptions.it: Join our  Product Evaluation and Qualification  team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg! As R&D SiC Test Engineer you will ensure to deliver faultless, robust semiconductor chips and power modules through a qualification process.   Our products are delivered to a wide range of customers worldwide for different industrial applications as well as renewable energy, traction, and eMobility.   To strengthen our testing activities, we are looking for a  highly motivated R&D SiC Validation Engineer . While we are ideally seeking a senior-level professional, we also welcome applications from junior candidates who demonstrate strong potential and a willingness to grow into the role.   How you'll make an impact   Contribute to development projects related to next generation SiC semiconductor chips and power modules Collaborate closely with R&D design, process, and product engineering teams to evaluate the performance of new platforms Lead, execute, and monitor various electrical tests to ensure product quality, leveraging your knowledge of electrical components and test systems Analyse test result data and provide technical recommendations Communicate key findings clearly to project stakeholders through reports and presentations Drive continuous improvement in testing laboratory activities to enhance customer satisfaction Ensure compliance with safety rules, environmental protection, and maintain cleanliness and order in the test laboratories   Your background   Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with a strong focus on SiC-based semiconductor devices or power electronics Proven experience in power electronics, the semiconductor industry, and SiC testing. Familiarity with modern software tools and platforms, preferably including Python, LabVIEW, CAD software, and statistical data analysis tools Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present results clearly Fluency in English; German is a plus   More About Us   We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefit programs to support your financial, physical, and mental well-being, as well as your personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us – in work and out. Benefits: Generous retirement savings options to help you plan for your future Subsidized gym memberships to support your health and wellness Enjoy discounts on a variety of products and services, including electronics, groceries, and travel   If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply!

Familiarity with modern software tools and platforms, preferably including Python, LabVIEW, CAD software, and statistical data analysis tools Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present results clearly Fluency in English; German is a plus   More About Us   We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefit programs to support your financial, physical, and mental well-being, as well as your personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us – in work and out. Benefits: Generous retirement savings options to help you plan for your future Subsidized gym memberships to support your health and wellness Enjoy discounts on a variety of products and services, including electronics, groceries, and travel   If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply!

descriptions.it: The opportunity   At our Competence Center “Power Converter Solutions”, we are at the forefront of developing, manufacturing, installing, and commissioning high-power electronic converters for applications such as STATCOM, rail power supply systems, and grid interconnections. Our solutions play a key role in enabling the integration of renewable energy into modern power grids while improving overall system efficiency. To strengthen our Control Engineering team, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on Project Control Engineer with a strong interest in power electronics and control systems. If you are a fast learner with a structured and proactive mindset, and you enjoy combining engineering work with real-world applications — this is your opportunity.   How you'll make an impact Plan and execute control engineering aspects of projects, including hardware and software concepts, specifications, and documentation Coordinate technical interfaces between customers, sub-suppliers, and internal teams Define and evaluate hardware interfaces, including electrical components and design reviews Develop and implement control software, including testing on real-time simulation platforms Perform commissioning, testing, and customer training on-site Provide technical support during project execution and after delivery Support the sales team in the preparation of technical concepts and tender documentation Collaborate closely with control, system, and mechanical engineering teams as well as project management   Your background   Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor's or Master's, from a university or university of applied sciences) Hands-on experience with MATLAB \/ Simulink is essential Strong knowledge of process control and software design (e.g. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI) Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) is a plus Initial experience in testing, commissioning, or applied engineering is an advantage Willingness to travel globally for commissioning assignments (approx. 20% of working time) Fluency in English and German   More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.   Additionally, you can expect: Work on cutting-edge technologies in Power Electronics Hands-on experience in international projects and real-world applications A combination of simulation, engineering, and on-site project work Opportunity to grow into a technical expert within a rapidly developing business Collaboration within a highly skilled, international engineering team
