descriptions.de: Die Chance In dieser herausfordernden Rolle entwerfen Sie die Netzwerk- und Sicherheitsarchitektur für Kommunikationsnetze, die in Energieversorgern, Windparks und anderen kritischen Infrastrukturen verwendet werden, basierend auf modernen Technologiestandards. Wie Sie etwas bewirken Sie entwickeln Systeme, die den Sicherheitsstandards wie IEC 62443 und NERC-CIP entsprechen Sie implementieren geplante Cybersicherheitsmaßnahmen auf Geräten und Anwendungen Sie unterstützen die Vertriebsorganisation während der Ausschreibungsphase und in Kundengesprächen Mit Ihrer technischen Expertise unterstützen Sie den Projektmanager und stimmen sich sowohl mit Kunden als auch mit internen Stakeholdern ab Sie erstellen Verfahren und Betriebshandbücher, die auf die Kundenanforderungen zugeschnitten sind Sie führen Risikobewertungen im Rahmen der Projektdurchführung in Übereinstimmung mit IEC 62443 durch, um Cybersicherheitsrisiken in industriellen Automatisierungssystemen zu identifizieren und zu bewerten und sicherzustellen, dass geeignete Sicherheitsmaßnahmen implementiert werden. Sie haben einen Abschluss in Energietechnik, Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnologie oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung, zusammen mit Erfahrung in Kommunikationsnetzen und Systemarchitekturen in Industrie- oder Infrastrukturumgebungen Sie beherrschen Cybersicherheitstechnologien, LAN / WAN-Netzwerke, Peripheriegeräte und Betriebssysteme wie MS Windows (Server, AD) und Linux Sie zeigen starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten Ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich Sie sind motiviert, beim Aufbau eines neuen Geschäftsbereichs zu helfen und den Übergang zu einem cybersicheren Arbeitsansatz aktiv zu unterstützen, indem Sie Ingenieure bei der Einführung von Best Practices für Cybersicherheit unterstützen Mehr über uns Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. Unsere Vorteile sind so konzipiert, dass sie für jeden Einzelnen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – und so Engagement, Leistung und Wachstum fördern. Durch die Priorisierung des Wohlbefindens schaffen wir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem persönlicher und organisatorischer Erfolg zusammenwachsen.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Dans ce rôle difficile, vous concevrez l'architecture de réseau et de sécurité des réseaux de communication utilisés dans les services publics, les parcs éoliens et d'autres infrastructures essentielles, en fonction des normes technologiques modernes. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Vous développerez des systèmes conformes aux normes de sécurité telles que IEC 62443 et NERC-CIP Vous mettrez en œuvre les mesures de cybersécurité prévues sur les appareils et les applications Vous accompagnerez l'organisation commerciale pendant la phase d'appel d'offres et lors des discussions avec les clients Avec votre expertise technique, vous assisterez le gestionnaire de projet et vous coordonnerez avec les clients et les intervenants internes. Vous préparerez des procédures et des manuels opérationnels adaptés aux besoins des clients Vous effectuerez des évaluations des risques dans le cadre de l'exécution du projet, conformément à la norme CEI 62443, afin d'identifier et d'évaluer les risques de cybersécurité au sein des systèmes d'automatisation industrielle et de s'assurer que des mesures de sécurité appropriées sont mises en œuvre. Vous avez un diplôme en génie de l'énergie, en génie électrique, en technologie de l'information ou une expérience professionnelle équivalente, ainsi qu'une expérience dans les réseaux de communication et les architectures de systèmes dans les environnements industriels ou d'infrastructure Vous êtes compétent dans les technologies de cybersécurité, les réseaux LAN\/WAN, les périphériques et les systèmes d'exploitation, y compris MS Windows (Serveur, AD) et Linux Vous démontrez de solides compétences en communication, esprit d'équipe, et la capacité de travailler de manière indépendante. Vous êtes motivé à aider à construire un nouveau secteur d'activité et à soutenir activement la transition vers une approche de travail cybersécurité, aidant les ingénieurs à adopter les meilleures pratiques de cybersécurité Plus sur nous Nous croyons que le grand travail prospère dans un environnement où les gens se sentent véritablement soutenus et équitablement récompensés. Nos avantages sont conçus pour créer une valeur réelle pour chaque individu – alimenter l'engagement, la performance et la croissance. En priorisant le bien-être, nous construisons un milieu de travail où la réussite personnelle et organisationnelle se développe ensemble.

descriptions.it: In questo ruolo, siete una parte centrale della nostra logistica interna e assicurate un flusso di materiale liscio all'interno dell'azienda. Lavori con moderni sistemi logistici, gestisci i movimenti delle merci nel SAP EWM e assicurati che la produzione e le interfacce interne siano fornite in modo ottimale in ogni momento. Con il vostro modo di lavorare attento e affidabile, contribuite in modo significativo all'efficienza, alla sicurezza e all'ordine dell'intero locale aziendale. Puoi farlo. • Prenotazione di beni in entrata e in entrata nel sistema SAP EWM • Etichettatura, etichettatura e nidificazione delle merci su unità di movimentazione • Stoccaggio e delocalizzazione di merci tramite dispositivi mobili • Disposizione e distribuzione del materiale di produzione nell'azienda • Fornitura delle linee di produzione con piccoli contenitori chimici e fornitura • Gestione degli elementi di riciclaggio, rifiuti e logistica (per esempio trough, presse, pallet) • Attuazione del trasporto interno nel rispetto delle norme di sicurezza e di gestione • Raccogliere materiali di produzione per vari impianti e garantire ordine e pulizia Lo porti con te. • Formazione completa come formazione logistica o comparabile, ideale con esperienza professionale • Buona conoscenza di SAP EWM e gestione sicura delle applicazioni PC (Windows, Outlook) • ID carrello elevatore ed esperienza nella gestione dei carrelli elevatori • Buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e scrittura così come le competenze di base inglese • Metodo di lavoro indipendente, affidabile e attento • Hitachi Energy è un leader globale nell'energia e nell'elettrificazione e forma attivamente il futuro dell'energia. Nella nostra posizione, ci si può aspettare un ambiente di lavoro moderno, sicuro e orientato al team con interessanti opportunità di sviluppo.
descriptions.en: In this role, you are a central part of our internal logistics and ensure a smooth material flow within the company. You work with modern logistics systems, manage goods movements in the SAP EWM and ensure that production and internal interfaces are optimally supplied at all times. With your careful and reliable way of working, you contribute significantly to the efficiency, safety and orderliness of the entire company premises. You can do that. • Booking of incoming goods and inbounds in the SAP EWM system • Labelling, labelling and nesting of goods on handling units • Storage and relocation of goods by mobile devices • Provision and distribution of production material within the holding • Supplying the production lines with small chemical containers and ensuring supply • Management of recycling, waste and logistics elements (e.g. troughs, presses, pallets) • Implementation of internal transport in compliance with safety and handling regulations • Picking of production materials for various plants and ensuring order and cleanliness You bring that with you • Completed training as a logistician or comparable training, ideally with professional experience • Good knowledge of SAP EWM and secure handling of PC applications (Windows, Outlook) • Forklift ID and experience in handling forklifts • Good knowledge of German in word and writing as well as basic English skills • Independent, reliable and careful working method • Hitachi Energy is a global leader in energy and electrification and actively shapes the energy future. At our location, you can expect a modern, secure and team-oriented working environment with attractive development opportunities.
descriptions.de: Über die Position In dieser Rolle bist du ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer internen Logistik und stellst einen reibungslosen Materialfluss innerhalb des Unternehmens sicher. Du arbeitest mit modernen Logistiksystemen, bewirtschaftest Warenbewegungen im SAP EWM und sorgst dafür, dass Produktion und interne Schnittstellen jederzeit optimal versorgt sind. Mit deiner sorgfältigen und zuverlässigen Arbeitsweise trägst du wesentlich zur Effizienz, Sicherheit und Ordnung auf dem gesamten Betriebsgelände bei. Das kannst du bewirken • Buchung von Wareneingängen und Inbounds im SAP EWM System • Beschriften, Labeln und Verschachteln von Waren auf Handling Units • Einlagerung und Umlagerung von Waren mittels mobiler Geräte • Bereitstellung und Distribution von Produktionsmaterial innerhalb des Betriebs • Versorgung der Produktionslinien mit Chemie-Kleingebinden sowie Sicherstellung des Nachschubs • Bewirtschaftung von Recycling-, Abfall- und Logistikelementen (z. B. Mulden, Pressen, Paletten) • Durchführung interner Transporte unter Einhaltung der Sicherheits- und Handlingsvorschriften • Kommissionierung von Produktionsmaterial für verschiedene Werke sowie Sicherstellung von Ordnung und Sauberkeit Das bringst du mit • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Logistiker\/in oder vergleichbare Ausbildung, idealerweise mit Berufserfahrung • Gute Kenntnisse in SAP EWM sowie sicherer Umgang mit PC-Anwendungen (Windows, Outlook) • Staplerausweis und Erfahrung im Umgang mit Flurförderfahrzeugen • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie grundlegende Englischkenntnisse • Selbstständige, zuverlässige und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise • Hohes Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Energie und Elektrifizierung und gestaltet die Energiezukunft aktiv mit. An unserem Standort erwartet dich ein modernes, sicheres und teamorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld mit attraktiven Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
descriptions.fr: Dans ce rôle, vous êtes un élément central de notre logistique interne et assurer un flux de matériaux en douceur au sein de l'entreprise. Vous travaillez avec des systèmes logistiques modernes, vous gérez les mouvements de marchandises dans le SAP EWM et vous assurez que la production et les interfaces internes sont fournies de manière optimale en tout temps. Grâce à votre façon de travailler soignée et fiable, vous contribuez de manière significative à l'efficacité, à la sécurité et à l'ordre de tous les locaux de l'entreprise. Tu peux le faire. • Réservation de biens entrants et entrants dans le système SAP EWM • Étiquetage, étiquetage et nidification des marchandises sur les unités de manutention • Stockage et relocalisation des biens par des appareils mobiles • Fourniture et distribution de matériel de production dans l'exploitation • Fourniture de petits conteneurs chimiques aux lignes de production et fourniture • Gestion du recyclage, des déchets et des éléments logistiques (par ex. auges, presses, palettes) • Mise en œuvre du transport intérieur conformément aux règles de sécurité et de manutention • Cueillette de matériaux de production pour différentes plantes et assurer l'ordre et la propreté Apporte ça avec toi. • Formation complète en logistique ou formation comparable, idéalement avec expérience professionnelle • Bonne connaissance de SAP EWM et gestion sécurisée des applications PC (Windows, Outlook) • ID chariot élévateur et expérience dans la manipulation des chariots élévateurs • Bonne connaissance de l'allemand dans la parole et l'écriture ainsi que des compétences de base en anglais • Méthode de travail indépendante, fiable et prudente • Hitachi Energy est un leader mondial de l'énergie et de l'électrification et façonne activement l'avenir énergétique. À notre emplacement, vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement de travail moderne, sécurisé et axé sur l'équipe avec des possibilités de développement attrayantes.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Sosterrai il nostro dipartimento di finanza di fabbrica, acquisendo esperienza pratica nella contabilità, nella gestione dei documenti e nella comunicazione. Come farete un impatto Lavorare all'interno del reparto Finanza, sotto la supervisione del Controllore di fabbrica o membro del dipartimento di finanza, effettuerete vari compiti e progetti Fornire valore alla nostra Finanza, Controllo Operazioni e sostenere la consegna della nostra Direzione di finanza e strategia aziendale Acquisire una comprensione di ciò che ci vuole per operare in un'organizzazione di finanza all'interno di un Global business Partecipare a attività di formazione e sviluppo per migliorare le competenze tecniche Capire i processi di feedback giornalieri e obiettivi Il tuo background Bachelor, o un master in business, o in finanza, o un'altra disciplina relativa (studies da completare prima dell'inizio del programma) Proficiente in inglese scritto e parlato, lingue aggiuntive sono considerate come un vantaggio Buona conoscenza di MS Office e software di contabilità di base Confortevole comunicare in italiano e inglese (scritto e parlato) Cerchiamo di lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale e collaborativo Più su di noi Siamo un'azienda tecnologica con una forte attenzione all'innovazione, al miglioramento continuo e alla produzione sostenibile. • Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicata, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro.
descriptions.en: The opportunity You will support our Factory Finance department, gaining hands-on experience in accounting, document management, and communication. How you'll make an impact Working within the Finance department, under the supervision of the Factory Controller or member of the Finance department, you will carry out various tasks and projects Delivering value to our Finance, Operations Control and supporting the delivery of our Finance Direction and Business strategy Gain an understanding of what it takes to operate in a Finance organization within a Global business Participate in training and development activities to improve technical skills Understand each department's daily processes and goals Completing all assigned tasks and assisting with day-to-day operations Develop your strengths with the help of regular feedback and clearly established performance objectives Your background Bachelor's, or a master's degree in business, or in finance, or another related discipline (studies to be completed before the start of the program) Proficient in written and spoken English, additional languages are considered as an advantage Good knowledge of MS Office and basic accounting software Comfortable communicating in Italian and English (written and spoken) Detail-oriented, organized, and proactive in daily tasks Enjoy working in a multicultural and collaborative environment More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. • We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
descriptions.de: Die Chance Sie unterstützen unsere Factory Finance-Abteilung und sammeln praktische Erfahrung in Buchhaltung, Dokumentenmanagement und Kommunikation. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Arbeiten in der Finanzabteilung, unter der Aufsicht des Factory Controllers oder Mitglied der Finanzabteilung, werden Sie verschiedene Aufgaben und Projekte ausführen Wert für unsere Finanzen, Betriebskontrolle und Unterstützung der Bereitstellung unserer Finanzdirektion und Geschäftsstrategie Gewinnen Sie ein Verständnis dafür, was es braucht, um in einer Finanzorganisation innerhalb eines globalen Unternehmens zu arbeiten Nehmen Sie an Schulungs- und Entwicklungsaktivitäten teil, um technische Fähigkeiten zu verbessern Verstehen Sie die täglichen Prozesse und Ziele jeder Abteilung Abschluss aller zugewiesenen Aufgaben und Unterstützung bei der täglichen Arbeit Entwickeln Sie Ihre Stärken mit Hilfe von regelmäßigem Feedback und klar festgelegten Leistungszielen Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Wirtschaft oder Finanzen oder einer anderen verwandten Disziplin (Studien müssen vor Beginn des Programms abgeschlossen werden) Kenntnisse in schriftlichem und gesprochenem Englisch, zusätzliche Sprachen werden als Vorteil angesehen Gute Kenntnisse von MS Office und grundlegende Buchhaltungssoftware Komfortable Kommunikation in Italienisch und Englisch (schriftlich und gesprochen) Detailorientiert, organisiert und proaktiv in täglichen Aufgaben Genießen Sie die Arbeit in einem multikulturellen und kollaborativen Umfeld Mehr über uns Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung. • Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Mentorenschaft und ein unterstützendes, integratives Umfeld, in dem Sie persönlich und beruflich wachsen können - und ermöglichen Ihnen, zu gedeihen und gleichzeitig Leben und Arbeit in Einklang zu bringen.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Vous soutiendrez notre département des finances d'usine, en acquérant une expérience pratique en comptabilité, gestion de documents et communication. descriptions.it: The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy Research, we are shaping the energy systems of tomorrow. As the power grid evolves into a complex, digital “system of systems” integrating renewable energy, power electronics, and distributed assets, ensuring long-term reliability and availability becomes a central challenge. We are looking for a Scientist in Reliability Modelling to drive innovation in system-level reliability modelling and lifecycle optimization of power grid components and system, large-scale power grid infrastructures, including emerging application in challenging environments to help development of sustainable energy sources and their integration to the power grid of the future. How you'll make an impact   System-Level Reliability Modelling Innovation:  Drive the translation of innovative ideas advanced methodologies for reliability, availability, maintainability, and safety (RAMS) modelling integrating single-asset physical knowledge into modelling to represent interdependencies, redundancy, and system-of-systems behavior Data-driven and Physics based Decision Support:  Contribute to methodologies such as Reliability-Centered Maintenance and reliability twin concepts for decision-making under uncertainty with far reaching impact on GW level power systems over decades of operation Scientific Leadership  Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities, technologies and products suppliers Scientific Communication & Innovation:  Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports    Your background    PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Reliability Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field Systems thinker capable of bridging component-level physics and system-level performance. Strong expertise in system-level reliability modelling (RAMS, RBD, FTA, Monte Carlo, stochastic modelling) Experience with complex engineering systems (energy, aerospace, automotive, or similar high-reliability domains). Including knowledge of maintenance strategies and lifecycle optimization for repairable systems Familiarity with power grid technologies (HVDC, substations, converters) is an advantage but not strictly required Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us   At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every individual. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Join us in shaping a more sustainable and reliable energy future.

descriptions.it: The opportunity     Join our R&D team within High Voltage Products in Zurich-Oerlikon and contribute to the development of high-voltage circuit breakers that support reliable power transmission worldwide.   In this role, you will   be responsible for   testing and   validating   high-voltage equipment throughout the product development cycle. You will work closely with R&D engineers, technical experts, laboratory teams, and external testing partners.   We welcome both experienced professionals and early-career engineers who are eager to learn. Success in this role requires curiosity, resilience,   strong communication   skills, and a proactive mindset.   You will receive support from experienced colleagues while building technical   expertise   in a specialized and highly valued engineering field.     How   you'll   make an impact     Plan and execute high-voltage and high-power test campaigns Define test programs based on project and certification requirements Coordinate testing activities with laboratories and project stakeholders Lead and support testing activities together with laboratory experts Analyze   test results and prepare technical reports Investigate technical issues and contribute to effective solutions Improve testing methods, processes, and knowledge sharing activities Support global R&D projects for high-voltage switching technologies   Your background     Bachelor's or   Master's degree in Electrical Engineering   or   a related   field Experience in testing, R&D, laboratory environments, or power systems engineering Knowledge of electrical power systems and testing principles Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills Proactive mindset with willingness to learn and collaborate Fluent English and basic German skills (or willingness to learn) Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time   More about us   This role offers a unique opportunity to develop   expertise   in high-voltage testing and switching technologies while working in an international environment with experienced technical experts.   Career development opportunities include growth towards Senior Test Engineer, Technical Expert, Project Management, or People Management paths.   Our flexible working practices help you   optimize   personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: Die Möglichkeit Als Field Service Engineer bei HITACHI ENERGY LTD bist du für die Installation, Wartung und Reparatur unserer Produkte und Systeme direkt beim Kunden in der Schweiz verantwortlich. Du stellst die optimale Leistung und Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen sicher und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Installationen, Inbetriebnahmen, Wartungen und Reparaturen an HITACHI ENERGY Produkten und Systemen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hochspannung, Energieübertragung und -verteilung. Fehleranalyse und -behebung an komplexen elektrotechnischen Anlagen und Systemen. Erstellung von Serviceberichten und Dokumentationen nach jedem Einsatz. Beratung der Kunden bezüglich technischer Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten. Schulung von Kundenpersonal im Umgang mit den Anlagen. Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsstandards. Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeiten innerhalb der Schweiz und gelegentlich ins Ausland. Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst (Pikett) ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten. Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Aktualisierung des Fachwissens über neue Produkte und Technologien. Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z.B. Elektriker\/in, Elektroniker\/in, Automatiker\/in) oder Studium (z.B. Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik). Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Service oder Wartung von elektrischen Anlagen, idealerweise in der Energiebranche. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hochspannungstechnik, Schaltanlagen und Steuerungssystemen sind von Vorteil. Sicherer Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten. Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Schweizerdeutsch von Vorteil), sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und analytisches Denkvermögen. Hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Kundenorientierung. Gültiger Führerausweis Kategorie B. Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Reisetätigkeit. Mehr über uns Wir bieten spannende und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dich erwarten interessante und vielseitige Tätigkeiten und Projekte, einschließlich Offshore‑Einsätzen, ein eingespieltes und dynamisches Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von einem attraktiven Leistungspaket mit festen Reise‑ und Verpflegungspauschalen sowie einem Mitspracherecht bei der Wahl der Unterkunft.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Corporate Real Estate Portfolio Analyst to support the effective management of our global real estate portfolio. This role combines data management, lease management, reporting, and cross-functional coordination to ensure that portfolio decisions are supported by accurate information and meaningful insights. The ideal candidate brings experience in corporate real estate, real estate data management, lease management, Excel-based analysis, collaboration tools such as Teams and SharePoint, and the preparation of high-quality presentations for business stakeholders. How you'll make an impact Manage and continuously improve portfolio data in Archibus, including property, lease, strategic planning, and sustainability-related information Develop strong expertise in Archibus functionalities and promote their effective use across the team. Deliver Archibus training and provide support to internal users Work closely with internal stakeholders to collect, validate, and consolidate portfolio data in a timely and reliable manner Oversee our external vendor responsible for lease administration and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of lease data Identify and improve processes related to data collection, validation, lease abstraction, and lease management to enhance efficiency and control. Raise purchase orders and verify invoices Prepare presentation materials, analysis, reports, and charts using multiple data sources and tools Translate complex real estate data into clear insights that support portfolio decisions and management reporting Organize and maintain Teams and SharePoint sites and support the development of the division's intranet presence Contribute to the smooth and efficient operation of the Global Portfolio Management division through administrative support activities Your background Proven experience in real estate data management, analysis, and reporting. Experience in lease management. Experience in corporate real estate within a corporate global real estate function. Ability to interpret lease terms, understand portfolio structures and real estate data. Hands-on experience with a real estate data management platform. Excellent proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and SharePoint. Knowledge of SAP REFX is an asset. Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Highly organized, rigorous, detail-oriented, and able to work with accuracy in a fast-evolving environment. Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and work effectively across different topics. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate successfully in a global team environment. More about us Hitachi Energy Real Estate provides strategic leadership for global real estate activities, acting as a business partner to improve performance through effective solutions. The Global Portfolio Management division shapes strategy, mitigates risks, and uses data-driven insights to enhance portfolio performance. It also supports real estate sustainability topics in collaboration with Business Units and Hitachi Energy Sustainability teams. The minimum salary for this position in the location (Italy) specified: Starting from: 44,800 € gross annual salary  Applicable CBA: Metalmeccanico The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures. This role is open in France, Germany, Switzerland, Italy and Spain If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage. Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes: Competitive salary and incentives Well-being and care  Paid and unpaid leave Flexible work options  Benefits that support your financial security You will receiv

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join our global marketing and communications team and help shape how content is managed and shared across the organization. In this role, you will support content coordination activities, maintain digital assets, and contribute to performance tracking and reporting. Success comes from a proactive mindset, strong attention to detail, and a passion for organization and communication. You will gain hands-on experience in content management within a global energy technology environment while developing valuable project management, analytical, and stakeholder collaboration skills. This is an excellent opportunity to learn, grow, and make a visible impact within an international team. How you'll make an impact Support the management and organization of content asset files Maintain SharePoint repositories and ensure compliance with naming conventions Support the tracking and reporting of content performance metrics Your background Excellent project management and analytics skills Written and verbal communication skills in English Strong attention to detail Basic understanding of content marketing files Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment Proactive, eager to learn, and demonstrate a strong work ethic More about us This part-time internship offers valuable practical experience in content management, digital collaboration tools, and marketing operations within a global organization. You will work alongside experienced professionals, take ownership of meaningful tasks, and develop skills that support future career growth in marketing and communications. We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptions.it: L'opportunità di Hitachi Energy Research, stiamo plasmando i sistemi energetici di domani. Poiché la rete elettrica si evolve in un complesso e digitale “sistema di sistemi” che integra energia rinnovabile, elettronica di potenza e risorse distribuite, garantendo affidabilità e disponibilità a lungo termine diventa una sfida centrale. Siamo alla ricerca di uno scienziato in Reliability Modelling per guidare l'innovazione nella modellazione dell'affidabilità a livello di sistema e l'ottimizzazione del ciclo di vita dei componenti e del sistema della rete elettrica, le infrastrutture della rete elettrica su larga scala, inclusa l'applicazione emergente in ambienti difficili per aiutare lo sviluppo di fonti energetiche sostenibili e la loro integrazione alla rete elettrica del futuro. Come farete un impatto Modello di Affidabilità System-Level Innovazione: Guidare la traduzione di idee innovative metodologie avanzate di collaborazione per l'affidabilità, la disponibilità, la manutenbilità e la sicurezza (RAMS) modellando l'integrazione di conoscenze fisiche single-asset nella modellazione per rappresentare interdipendenze, ridondanza e comportamento di sistema-di-sistemi Data-driven e Fisica basato Supporto di decisione: Contribuire a metodologie come Reliability-Centered Manutenzione e concetti gemelli di affidabilità per il processo decisionale in incertezza globale Costruire relazioni all'interno dell'azienda e condividere attivamente le vostre conoscenze e competenze. Interagisci con partner esterni locali e globali, tra cui università, tecnologie e fornitori di prodotti Comunicazione scientifica e innovazione: Dissemina i tuoi risultati in pubblicazioni scientifiche, applicazioni di brevetti e relazioni tecniche Il tuo dottorato di ricerca in Ingegneria Elettrica, Sistemi di Potere, Ingegneria di Affidabilità, Matematica Applicata, Fisica, o relativo campo Pensatore di sistemi in grado di corroborare fisica a livello di componenti e prestazioni a livello di sistema. Forte competenza nella modellazione dell'affidabilità a livello di sistema (RAMS, RBD, FTA, Monte Carlo, modellazione stocastica) Esperienza con complessi sistemi di ingegneria (energia, aerospaziale, automotive, o simili domini ad alta affidabilità). Inclusa la conoscenza delle strategie di manutenzione e l'ottimizzazione del ciclo di vita per sistemi riparabili La familiarità con le tecnologie della rete elettrica (HVDC, sottostazioni, convertitori) è un vantaggio ma non strettamente necessario Proven track record nelle migliori conferenze scientifiche e pubblicazioni di riviste Le eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese, l'atteggiamento del giocatore di squadra, l'iniziativa e la creatività Più su di noi A Hitachi Energy, crediamo nella potenza della diversità e nel potenziale di ogni individuo. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo dove tutti possano prosperare. Unisciti a noi nella definizione di un futuro energetico più sostenibile e affidabile.
descriptions.en: The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we are shaping the energy systems of tomorrow. As the power grid evolves into a complex, digital “system of systems” integrating renewable energy, power electronics, and distributed assets, ensuring long-term reliability and availability becomes a central challenge. We are looking for a Scientist in Reliability Modelling to drive innovation in system-level reliability modelling and lifecycle optimization of power grid components and system, large-scale power grid infrastructures, including emerging application in challenging environments to help development of sustainable energy sources and their integration to the power grid of the future. How you'll make an impact System-Level Reliability Modelling Innovation: Drive the translation of innovative ideas advanced methodologies for reliability, availability, maintainability, and safety (RAMS) modelling integrating single-asset physical knowledge into modelling to represent interdependencies, redundancy, and system-of-systems behavior Data-driven and Physics based Decision Support: Contribute to methodologies such as Reliability-Centered Maintenance and reliability twin concepts for decision-making under uncertainty with far reaching impact on GW level power systems over decades of operation Scientific Leadership Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities, technologies and products suppliers Scientific Communication & Innovation: Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Reliability Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field Systems thinker capable of bridging component-level physics and system-level performance. Strong expertise in system-level reliability modelling (RAMS, RBD, FTA, Monte Carlo, stochastic modelling) Experience with complex engineering systems (energy, aerospace, automotive, or similar high-reliability domains). Including knowledge of maintenance strategies and lifecycle optimization for repairable systems Familiarity with power grid technologies (HVDC, substations, converters) is an advantage but not strictly required Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every individual. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Join us in shaping a more sustainable and reliable energy future.
descriptions.de: Die Chance Bei Hitachi Energy Research gestalten wir die Energiesysteme von morgen. Da sich das Stromnetz zu einem komplexen, digitalen System von Systemen entwickelt, das erneuerbare Energien, Leistungselektronik und verteilte Anlagen integriert, wird die Gewährleistung der langfristigen Zuverlässigkeit und Verfügbarkeit zu einer zentralen Herausforderung. Wir suchen einen Wissenschaftler für Zuverlässigkeitsmodellierung, um Innovationen in der Zuverlässigkeitsmodellierung auf Systemebene und der Lebenszyklusoptimierung von Stromnetzkomponenten und -systemen sowie großen Stromnetzinfrastrukturen voranzutreiben, einschließlich neuer Anwendungen in herausfordernden Umgebungen, um die Entwicklung nachhaltiger Energiequellen und ihre Integration in das Stromnetz der Zukunft zu unterstützen. Wie Sie die Innovation der Zuverlässigkeitsmodellierung auf Systemebene beeinflussen: Förderung der Übersetzung innovativer Ideen fortschrittliche Methoden für Zuverlässigkeit, Verfügbarkeit, Wartbarkeit und Sicherheit (RAMS) Modellierung Integration von Single-Asset-physikalischen Wissen in Modellierung Interdependenzen, Redundanz und System-of-System-Verhalten Datengesteuerte und Physik basierte Entscheidungsunterstützung: Beitrag zu Methoden wie Zuverlässigkeitszentrierte Wartung und Zuverlässigkeit Zwillingskonzepte für die Entscheidungsfindung unter Unsicherheit mit weitreichenden Auswirkungen auf GW-Level-Power-Systeme über Jahrzehnte des Betriebs Wissenschaftliche Führung Zusammenarbeit mit einem globalen und interdisziplinären Team von Forschern und Ingenieuren in Forschung und Geschäftseinheiten, um wirkungsvolle industrielle Herausforderungen zu identifizieren, zu gestalten und zu lösen Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Bauen Sie Beziehungen innerhalb des Unternehmens auf und teilen Sie aktiv Ihr Wissen und Ihre Expertise. Interagieren Sie mit lokalen und globalen externen Partnern, einschließlich Universitäten, Technologie- und Produktlieferanten Wissenschaftliche Kommunikation & Innovation: Verbreiten Sie Ihre Ergebnisse in wissenschaftlichen Publikationen, Patentanmeldungen und technischen Berichten Ihr Hintergrund PhD in Elektrotechnik, Energiesysteme, Zuverlässigkeitstechnik, Angewandte Mathematik, Physik oder verwandten Bereich Systemdenker, der in der Lage ist, die Komponentenebene Physik und Systemebene Leistung zu verbinden. Starke Expertise in der Zuverlässigkeitsmodellierung auf Systemebene (RAMS, RBD, FTA, Monte Carlo, stochastische Modellierung) Erfahrung mit komplexen Engineering-Systemen (Energie, Luft- und Raumfahrt, Automobil oder ähnliche Bereiche mit hoher Zuverlässigkeit). Einschließlich des Wissens über Wartungsstrategien und Lebenszyklusoptimierung für reparierbare Systeme Die Vertrautheit mit Stromnetztechnologien (HGÜ, Umspannwerke, Umrichter) ist ein Vorteil, aber nicht unbedingt erforderlich Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz auf führenden wissenschaftlichen Konferenzen und Zeitschriftenpublikationen Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch, Teamplayer-Haltung, Initiative und Kreativität Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir an die Kraft der Vielfalt und das Potenzial jedes Einzelnen. Wir sind bestrebt, ein integratives Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem jeder gedeihen kann. Gestalten Sie mit uns eine nachhaltigere und zuverlässigere Energiezukunft.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Chez Hitachi Energy Research, nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain. À mesure que le réseau électrique évolue en un système complexe et numérique de systèmes intégrant les énergies renouvelables, l'électronique électrique et les actifs distribués, assurer la fiabilité et la disponibilité à long terme devient un défi central. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un scientifique en modélisation de fiabilité pour stimuler l'innovation dans la modélisation de fiabilité au niveau du système et l'optimisation du cycle de vie des composants et du système du réseau électrique, des infrastructures de réseau électrique à grande échelle, y compris l'application émergente dans des environnements difficiles pour aider le développement de sources d'énergie durables et leur intégration au réseau électrique de l'avenir. Comment vous ferez un impact Système-Niveau Fiabilité Modélisation Innovation: Conduire l'application d'idées innovantes des méthodologies avancées pour la modélisation de la fiabilité, de la disponibilité, de la maintenance et de la sécurité (RAMS) intégrant les connaissances physiques d'un seul actif dans la modélisation afin de représenter les interdépendances, la redondance et le comportement des systèmes.Appui à la décision fondé sur les données et la physique.Contribuer à des méthodologies telles que le maintien de la fiabilité et les concepts jumelés de fiabilité pour la prise de décision dans l'incertitude avec un impact considérable sur les systèmes d'alimentation au niveau GW au cours des décennies d'exploitation. Établir des relations au sein de l'entreprise et partager activement vos connaissances et votre expertise. Together with your team, you will ensure that production runs smoothly and our high standards of safety, quality and efficiency are met at all times. descriptions.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un analitico e dettagliato Corporate Real Estate Portfolio Analyst per supportare l'efficace gestione del nostro portafoglio immobiliare globale. Questo ruolo combina la gestione dei dati, la gestione delle locazioni, il reporting e il coordinamento interfunzionale per garantire che le decisioni del portafoglio siano supportate da informazioni accurate e approfondimenti significativi. Il candidato ideale porta esperienza nel settore immobiliare aziendale, gestione dei dati immobiliari, gestione del contratto di locazione, analisi basata su Excel, strumenti di collaborazione come Teams e SharePoint, e la preparazione di presentazioni di alta qualità per gli stakeholder aziendali. Gestire e migliorare continuamente i dati del portafoglio in Archibus, tra cui proprietà, locazione, pianificazione strategica e informazioni relative alla sostenibilità Sviluppare una forte esperienza nelle funzionalità di Archibus e promuovere il loro uso efficace in tutto il team. Fornire formazione Archibus e fornire supporto agli utenti interni Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni per raccogliere, convalidare e consolidare i dati del portafoglio in modo tempestivo e affidabile Controllare il nostro fornitore esterno responsabile per l'amministrazione del contratto di locazione e garantire l'accuratezza, la completezza e la coerenza dei dati di locazione Identificare e migliorare i processi relativi alla raccolta, convalida, astrazione del contratto di locazione e gestione del contratto per migliorare l'efficienza e il controllo. Promuovere gli ordini di acquisto e verificare le fatture Preparare materiali di presentazione, analisi, report e grafici utilizzando più fonti di dati e strumenti Tradurre dati immobiliari complessi in chiari approfondimenti che supportano le decisioni di portafoglio e la reportistica di gestione Organizzare e mantenere i siti Team e SharePoint e sostenere lo sviluppo della presenza intranet della divisione Contribuisci al funzionamento fluido ed efficiente della divisione Global Portfolio Management attraverso attività di supporto amministrativo Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione dei dati immobiliari, analisi e reporting. Esperienza nella gestione delle locazioni. Esperienza nel settore immobiliare aziendale all'interno di una funzione immobiliare globale aziendale. Capacità di interpretare i termini di locazione, comprendere le strutture di portafoglio e i dati immobiliari. Esperienza pratica con una piattaforma di gestione dei dati immobiliari. Ottima competenza in Excel, Power BI e SharePoint. La conoscenza di SAP REFX è un bene. Forte pensiero analitico, creatività e un approccio proattivo per risolvere i problemi. Altamente organizzato, rigoroso, orientato ai dettagli, e in grado di lavorare con accuratezza in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione. Capacità di gestire più priorità simultaneamente e lavorare efficacemente su diversi argomenti. Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese, con la capacità di collaborare con successo in un ambiente di team globale. Hitachi Energy Real Estate fornisce una leadership strategica per le attività immobiliari globali, fungendo da partner commerciale per migliorare le prestazioni attraverso soluzioni efficaci. La divisione Global Portfolio Management modella la strategia, mitiga i rischi e utilizza informazioni basate sui dati per migliorare le prestazioni del portafoglio. descriptions.en: The opportunity We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Corporate Real Estate Portfolio Analyst to support the effective management of our global real estate portfolio. This role combines data management, lease management, reporting, and cross-functional coordination to ensure that portfolio decisions are supported by accurate information and meaningful insights. The ideal candidate brings experience in corporate real estate, real estate data management, lease management, Excel-based analysis, collaboration tools such as Teams and SharePoint, and the preparation of high-quality presentations for business stakeholders. How you'll make an impact Manage and continuously improve portfolio data in Archibus, including property, lease, strategic planning, and sustainability-related information Develop strong expertise in Archibus functionalities and promote their effective use across the team. Deliver Archibus training and provide support to internal users Work closely with internal stakeholders to collect, validate, and consolidate portfolio data in a timely and reliable manner Oversee our external vendor responsible for lease administration and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of lease data Identify and improve processes related to data collection, validation, lease abstraction, and lease management to enhance efficiency and control. Raise purchase orders and verify invoices Prepare presentation materials, analysis, reports, and charts using multiple data sources and tools Translate complex real estate data into clear insights that support portfolio decisions and management reporting Organize and maintain Teams and SharePoint sites and support the development of the division's intranet presence Contribute to the smooth and efficient operation of the Global Portfolio Management division through administrative support activities Your background Proven experience in real estate data management, analysis, and reporting. Experience in lease management. Experience in corporate real estate within a corporate global real estate function. Ability to interpret lease terms, understand portfolio structures and real estate data. Hands-on experience with a real estate data management platform. Excellent proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and SharePoint. Knowledge of SAP REFX is an asset. Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Highly organized, rigorous, detail-oriented, and able to work with accuracy in a fast-evolving environment. Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and work effectively across different topics. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate successfully in a global team environment. More about us Hitachi Energy Real Estate provides strategic leadership for global real estate activities, acting as a business partner to improve performance through effective solutions. The Global Portfolio Management division shapes strategy, mitigates risks, and uses data-driven insights to enhance portfolio performance. It also supports real estate sustainability topics in collaboration with Business Units and Hitachi Energy Sustainability teams. descriptions.it: L'OPPORTUNITÀ Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è il leader tecnologico nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta tensione. Tutte le rinomate aziende internazionali del settore elettrico, attive nella generazione, trasmissione e distribuzione di energia elettrica, sono tra i nostri clienti. Abbiamo una posizione di vertice nelle aree delle boccole ad alta tensione in tutto il mondo. Entra a far parte del nostro team come Production Controller. In questo ruolo, opererai come Business Partner per la direzione dell'azienda e capo del dipartimento di controllo in fabbrica (Local Product Group), monitorando allo stesso tempo da vicino i principali indicatori finanziari, le tendenze del mercato e le attività dei clienti. Attingendo alle tue capacità analitiche finemente affinate utilizzando SAP S4 HANA, lavorerai a stretto contatto con le varie parti interessate per garantire un processo decisionale efficace per il successo della fabbrica. Come fare un impatto Responsabilità per la chiusura mensile, la rendicontazione, il budget e le previsioni in linea con le linee guida per la rendicontazione di Hitachi Energy; monitoraggio degli scostamenti tra budget e risultati effettivi per supportare le azioni di gestione Supporta la definizione, l'implementazione e il follow-up della pianificazione aziendale in base alle strategie dell'unità aziendale Crea un'analisi approfondita in SAP Hana del profitto lordo (ad esempio: riconoscimento dei ricavi, COGS, mix di prodotti, spese generali di produzione, Capex, assorbimento) Mantieni il modello di costo completo e rivedi i prezzi e la capacità di produzione Supporta la gestione del progetto durante l'esecuzione del progetto e i responsabili delle vendite del
descriptions.en: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is the technology leader in design and manufacture of high voltage transformer bushings. All renowned international companies of the electrical industry, active in power generation, transmission and distribution are among our customers. We have a top position in the high voltage bushing areas worldwide. Join our team as our Production Controller. In this role, you will operate as a Business Partner to the company's management and head of controlling department in the factory (Local Product Group), while at the same time closely monitoring key financial indicators, market trends and customer activities. Drawing on your finely honed analytical abilities using SAP S4 HANA, you will work closely with the various stakeholders to ensure effective decision-making for the success of the factory. How you'll make an impact Responsibility for monthly closing, reporting, budgeting and forecasting in line with Hitachi Energy reporting guidelines; monitoring of variances between budget and actual results to support management actions Support business planning definition, implementation and follow up according to business unit strategies Create deep dive analysis in SAP HANA of Gross Profit (e.g.: revenue recognition, COGS, product mix, production overhead, Capex, absorption) Maintain Full Cost Model and review pricing and capacity for production Support Project Management during project execution and sales managers of the unit during the tender phase; identify and communicate financial risks and opportunities during tenders; participation in risk reviews Monitoring of production KPIs, monthly SG&A cost analysis, Cash Flows & Overdues, OBL, ORs and Revenues follow up Business improvement capabilities and project management can- do attitude Your background Master or bachelor's degree in business administration \/ finance \/ economics (or similar) 5- 10 years of experience and successful track record in a similar role within an international environment Excellent practical knowledge in SAP S\/4 HANA Experience in factory controlling and product business Proactive, hands-on attitude with a strong can do mindset, able to work effectively under pressure and take ownership of responsibilities Very good understanding of balance sheet, income statement and Cash flow Finance and controlling specialist with solid proficiency in MS Office, SAP, Power BI, and ABACUS Analyzer, and a good understanding of IFRS Fluent in English, German would be a strong advantage More about us Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Notre groupe de produits local Isolation & Components est le leader technologique dans la conception et la fabrication de douilles de transformateurs haute tension. Toutes les entreprises internationales de renom de l'industrie électrique, actives dans la production, la transmission et la distribution d'électricité sont parmi nos clients. Nous avons une position supérieure dans les zones de douille haute tension dans le monde entier. Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que contrôleur de production. Dans ce rôle, vous agirez en tant que partenaire d'affaires de la direction de l'entreprise et chef du département de contrôle de l'usine (Groupe de produits locaux), tout en suivant de près les principaux indicateurs financiers, les tendances du marché et les activités des clients. En s'appuyant sur vos capacités d'analyse fine grâce à SAP S4 HANA, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les différents intervenants pour assurer une prise de décision efficace pour le succès de l'usine. Comment vous allez faire un impact Responsabilité de clôture, de rapport, de budgétisation et de prévision mensuelles conformément aux lignes directrices Hitachi Énergie; suivi des écarts entre le budget et les résultats réels pour soutenir les actions de gestion Soutenir la définition, la mise en oeuvre et le suivi de la planification des activités selon les stratégies des unités commerciales Créer une analyse de plongée profonde dans SAP HANA du profit brut (p. ex.: comptabilisation des revenus, COGS, mélange de produits, frais généraux de production, Capex, absorption) Maintenir le modèle de coûts complets et revoir la tarification et la capacité de production Soutenir la gestion des projets pendant l'exécution des projets et les directeurs des ventes de l'unité pendant la phase d'appel d'offres; identifier et communiquer les risques financiers et les possibilités au cours des appels d'offres; participer à l'examen des risques Surveillance des ICR de production, l'analyse mensuelle des coûts des SG&A, les flux de trésorerie et les excédents, les OBL, les OR et les revenus suivre l'évolution des capacités d'amélioration des entreprises et la gestion des projets.

You will support financial steering across the full lifecycle - from planning and forecasting to project execution and performance analysis - while gaining hands-on exposure to operational and project controlling in an international environment. Bei Hitachi Energy verbindest du dein Bachelorstudium mit spannenden Aufgaben im Projekt-Engineering für gasisolierte Schaltanlagen. Du erhältst Einblick in die technische Planung und Umsetzung von realen Kundenprojekten und lernst Schritt für Schritt die technischen, organisatorischen und dokumentationsbezogenen Aufgaben im Engineering kennen. Hinweis: Das Praktikum ist ausschliesslich in Kombination mit einem praxisintegrierten Bachelorstudium an der Fachhochschule Nordwestschweiz FHNW \/ Zürcher Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften ZHAW möglich. Weitere Informationen findest du hier: Link zu FHNW: https:\/\/www.fhnw.ch\/de\/studium\/technik\/pibs Link zu ZHAW: https:\/\/www.zhaw.ch\/de\/engineering\/studium\/bachelorstudium\/praxisintegriertes-bachelorstudium\/ Das kannst du bewirken Unterstützung des Engineering-Teams bei der Abwicklung von Kunden- oder Entwicklungsprojekten für gasisolierte Schaltanlagen Erstellung und Pflege von technischen Dokumenten, Zeichnungen und 3D-Modellen Mitarbeit bei der Ausarbeitung und Umsetzung technischer Lösungen für unsere Kunden Pflege von Dokumenten, Stücklisten und Zeichnungen in Dokumenten-Managementsysteme Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen wie Projektmanagement, Produktion oder Einkauf Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene gymnasiale Matura als Voraussetzung für die Zulassung an der FHNW oder ZHAW Interesse an Elektrotechnik, Energieübertragung und Energieversorgung Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären und internationalen Teams Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office und Interesse an CAD-Tools Offenheit, Teamfähigkeit und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, mindestens Niveau C1 Gute Englischkenntnisse, Niveau B2 oder höher Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen dir, persönliche und berufliche Ziele zu verbinden. Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, in dem du deine Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen kannst – unterstützt durch Mentoring und eine inklusive Kultur. Haben wir dein Interesse Geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung inklusive CV, Motivationsschreiben und Zeugnisse.
descriptions.fr:
Commencez votre carrière avec une entrée pratique dans l'industrie. Chez Hitachi Energy, vous combinez votre diplôme de bachelor avec une expérience passionnante
• Tâches d'ingénierie de projet pour les commutateurs isolés au gaz. Vous aurez un aperçu de la planification technique et de la mise en œuvre de projets clients réels et apprendre étape par étape la technique, l'organisation et la documentation
• Connaître les tâches d'ingénierie. Note: Le stage n'est possible qu'en combinaison avec un baccalauréat intégré à la pratique à l'Université des sciences appliquées Nord-Ouest Suisse FHNW / Zurich Université des sciences appliquées ZHAW. • Nous vous offrons un environnement où vous pouvez développer et développer vos compétences – soutenue par le mentorat et une culture inclusive. On a eu votre intérêt ? Ensuite, nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature, y compris CV, lettres de motivation et témoignages.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Corporate Real Estate Analyst to support the effective management of our global real estate portfolio. This role combines data analyses, lease management, reporting, and cross-functional coordination to ensure that property decisions are supported by accurate information and meaningful insights. The ideal candidate brings experience in corporate real estate, real estate data management, lease management, Excel-based analysis, creating dashboards in Power BI, collaboration tools such as Teams and SharePoint, and the preparation of high-quality presentations for business stakeholders. We offer flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work in a hybrid model, combining remote work with time spent in the office. How you'll make an impact Manage and continuously improve portfolio data in Archibus, including property, lease, strategic planning, and sustainability-related information Develop strong expertise in Archibus functionalities and promote their effective use across the team Deliver Archibus training and provide support to internal users Work closely with internal stakeholders to collect, validate, and consolidate portfolio data in a timely and reliable manner Oversee our external vendor responsible for lease administration and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of lease data Identify and improve processes related to data collection, validation, lease abstraction, and lease management to enhance efficiency and control Raise purchase orders and verify invoices Prepare presentation materials, data analysis, reports, and charts using multiple data sources and tools Translate complex real estate data into clear insights that support portfolio decisions and management reporting Organize and maintain Teams and SharePoint sites and support the development of the division's intranet presence Contribute to the smooth and efficient operation of the Global Portfolio Management division through administrative support activities Your background Proven experience in real estate data management, data analytics, and reporting Experience in lease management Experience in corporate real estate within a corporate global real estate function Ability to interpret lease terms, understand portfolio structures and real estate data Hands-on experience with a real estate data management platform Excellent proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and SharePoint. Knowledge of SAP REFX is an asset Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and a proactive approach to problem-solving Highly organized, rigorous, detail-oriented, and able to work with accuracy in a fast-evolving environment Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and work effectively across different topics Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate successfully in a global team environment More about us Hitachi Energy Real Estate provides strategic leadership for global real estate activities, acting as a business partner to improve performance through effective solutions. The Global Portfolio Management division shapes strategy, mitigates risks, and uses data-driven insights to enhance portfolio performance. It also supports real estate sustainability topics in collaboration with Business Units and Hitachi Energy Sustainability teams. The minimum salary for this position in the location (Italy) specified: Starting from: 44,800 € gross annual salary  Applicable CBA: Metalmeccanico The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures. This role is open in France, Germany, Switzerland, Italy and Spain. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage. Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally inclu

titles.fr: Construction d'armoires de commutation de technicien AVOR 80 - 100% (f/m/d)

descriptions.it: In questo ruolo, sei responsabile della preparazione del lavoro e della pianificazione e del coordinamento della produzione e della consegna dei nostri armadi di controllo locali. Assicurarsi che materiali, risorse e scadenze siano coordinate in modo ottimale e garantiscano un processo regolare dagli ordini in arrivo alla consegna del cliente in tempo reale. Lavorate a stretto contatto con la produzione, la logistica e altre interfacce interne e contribuite attivamente al continuo miglioramento dei nostri processi. Puoi farlo. • Pianificazione, controllo e monitoraggio degli ordini di produzione, nonché garantire la produzione tempestiva e la consegna • Coordinamento della disponibilità dei materiali in stretta collaborazione con l'acquisto, la logistica e la produzione • Creazione e corrispondenza dei piani di produzione e di consegna e monitoraggio dei progressi della produzione • Garantire il rispetto di standard di qualità, specifiche tecniche e scadenze • Creazione e mantenimento della documentazione di produzione, valutazioni e rapporti di stato • Ottimizzazione dei processi e dei flussi di lavoro nella preparazione del lavoro e nell'elaborazione degli ordini • Collaborare con le interfacce interne per garantire un flusso efficiente di materiali e informazioni • Compliance e promozione della sicurezza, della qualità e degli standard ambientali in tutto il settore della responsabilità • Formazione tecnica completa (ad es. come installatore elettrico, tecnico automatico o tecnico meccatronico), integrata idealmente dalla formazione tecnica • Esperienza professionale nella preparazione del lavoro, nella pianificazione della produzione o nell'elaborazione degli ordini, preferibilmente nella costruzione di armadi a commutazione o nell'ingegneria elettrica • Buona conoscenza di SAP o di un sistema ERP comparabile e gestione sicura di MS Office • La comprensione tecnica e la capacità di leggere e interpretare in modo sicuro disegni e documenti tecnici • Strutturato, auto-responsabile e orientato alla soluzione modo di lavorare, nonché forte comunicazione e competenze di squadra • Molto buona conoscenza della lingua tedesca e buona conoscenza dell'inglese in parole e scrittura Più su di noi Hitachi Energy plasma il futuro dell'energia con tecnologie innovative per un approvvigionamento energetico sostenibile e affidabile. Con noi, ci si può aspettare un ambiente di lavoro moderno, emozionanti opportunità di sviluppo e un team dedicato che lavora insieme su soluzioni orientate al futuro.
descriptions.en: In this role, you are responsible for work preparation and planning and coordinating the production and delivery of our local control cabinets. You ensure that materials, resources and deadlines are optimally coordinated and ensure a smooth process from incoming orders to on-time customer delivery. You work closely with production, logistics and other internal interfaces and actively contribute to the continuous improvement of our processes. You can do that. • Planning, controlling and monitoring production orders as well as ensuring timely production and delivery • Coordinating material availability in close cooperation with purchasing, logistics and production • Creating and matching production and delivery plans and monitoring production progress • Ensuring compliance with quality standards, technical specifications and deadlines • Creating and maintaining production documentation, evaluations and status reports • Optimizing processes and workflows in work preparation and order processing • Collaborate with internal interfaces to ensure an efficient flow of materials and information • Compliance and promotion of safety, quality and environmental standards in the entire area of responsibility • Completed technical training (e.g. as an electrical installer, automatic technician or mechatronics technician), ideally supplemented by technical further training • Professional experience in work preparation, production planning or order processing, preferably in switch cabinet construction or electrical engineering • Good knowledge of SAP or a comparable ERP system as well as secure handling of MS Office • Technical understanding and the ability to safely read and interpret technical drawings and documents • Structured, self-responsible and solution-oriented way of working as well as strong communication and team skills • Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English in words and writing More about us Hitachi Energy shapes the energy future with innovative technologies for a sustainable and reliable energy supply. With us, you can expect a modern working environment, exciting development opportunities and a dedicated team working together on future-oriented solutions.
descriptions.de: Über die Position In dieser Rolle bist du verantwortlich für die Arbeitsvorbereitung sowie die Planung und Koordination der Fertigung und Auslieferung unserer lokalen Steuerschränke. Du sorgst dafür, dass Materialien, Ressourcen und Termine optimal aufeinander abgestimmt sind und stellst einen reibungslosen Ablauf vom Auftragseingang bis zur termingerechten Kundenlieferung sicher. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Produktion, Logistik und weiteren internen Schnittstellen zusammen und trägst aktiv zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Prozesse bei. Das kannst du bewirken • Planen, steuern und überwachen der Fertigungsaufträge sowie Sicherstellen einer termingerechten Produktion und Auslieferung • Koordinieren der Materialverfügbarkeit in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf, Logistik und Produktion • Erstellen und Abstimmen von Fertigungs- und Lieferplänen sowie Überwachen des Fertigungsfortschritts • Sicherstellen der Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards, technischen Spezifikationen sowie Terminvorgaben • Erstellen und Pflegen von Fertigungsdokumentationen, Auswertungen und Statusberichten • Optimieren von Prozessen und Arbeitsabläufen in der Arbeitsvorbereitung und Auftragsabwicklung • Zusammenarbeiten mit internen Schnittstellen zur Sicherstellung eines effizienten Material- und Informationsflusses • Einhalten und Fördern von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltstandards im gesamten Verantwortungsbereich Das bringst du mit • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z. B. als Elektroinstallateur\/in, Automatiker\/in oder Mechatroniker\/in), idealerweise ergänzt durch eine technische Weiterbildung • Berufserfahrung in der Arbeitsvorbereitung, Produktionsplanung oder Auftragsabwicklung, vorzugsweise im Schaltschrankbau oder der Elektrotechnik • Gute Kenntnisse in SAP oder einem vergleichbaren ERP-System sowie sicherer Umgang mit MS Office • Technisches Verständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen und Unterlagen sicher zu lesen und zu interpretieren • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy gestaltet die Energiezukunft mit innovativen Technologien für eine nachhaltige und zuverlässige Energieversorgung. Bei uns erwarten dich ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und ein engagiertes Team, das gemeinsam an zukunftsweisenden Lösungen arbeitet.
descriptions.fr: Dans ce rôle, vous êtes responsable de la préparation et de la planification du travail et de la coordination de la production et de la livraison de nos cabinets de contrôle locaux. Vous veillez à ce que les matériaux, les ressources et les délais soient coordonnés de manière optimale et à ce que le processus se déroule en douceur depuis les commandes reçues jusqu'à la livraison à temps. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec la production, la logistique et d'autres interfaces internes et contribuez activement à l'amélioration continue de nos processus. Tu peux le faire. • Planification, contrôle et suivi des commandes de production ainsi que des délais de production et de livraison • Coordination de la disponibilité du matériel en étroite collaboration avec les achats, la logistique et la production • Création et adaptation de plans de production et de livraison et suivi des progrès de la production • Assurer le respect des normes de qualité, des spécifications techniques et des délais • Création et tenue à jour de documents de production, d ' évaluations et de rapports de situation • Optimisation des processus et des flux de travail dans la préparation des travaux et le traitement des commandes • Collaborer avec les interfaces internes pour assurer un flux efficace de matériaux et d'informations • Respect et promotion des normes de sécurité, de qualité et d ' environnement dans l ' ensemble du domaine de responsabilité • Formation technique terminée (par exemple en tant qu'installateur électrique, technicien automatique ou technicien mécatronique), idéalement complétée par une formation complémentaire technique • Expérience professionnelle dans la préparation du travail, la planification de la production ou le traitement des commandes, de préférence dans la construction d'armoires de commutation ou l'ingénierie électrique • Bonne connaissance du SAP ou d'un système ERP comparable ainsi qu'un traitement sécurisé du MS Office • Compréhension technique et capacité de lire et d'interpréter en toute sécurité les dessins et documents techniques • Mode de travail structuré, auto-responsable et axé sur la solution ainsi que des compétences solides en communication et en équipe • Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et bonne connaissance de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture Plus sur nous Hitachi Énergie façonne l'avenir énergétique avec des technologies innovantes pour un approvisionnement énergétique durable et fiable. Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à un environnement de travail moderne, des opportunités de développement passionnantes et une équipe dévouée travaillant ensemble sur des solutions orientées vers l'avenir.

descriptions.it:
L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un analitico e dettagliato Corporate Real Estate Portfolio Analyst per supportare l'efficace gestione del nostro portafoglio immobiliare globale. Questo ruolo combina la gestione dei dati, la gestione delle locazioni, il reporting e il coordinamento interfunzionale per garantire che le decisioni del portafoglio siano supportate da informazioni accurate e approfondimenti significativi. Il candidato ideale porta esperienza nel settore immobiliare aziendale, gestione dei dati immobiliari, gestione del contratto di locazione, analisi basata su Excel, strumenti di collaborazione come Teams e SharePoint, e la preparazione di presentazioni di alta qualità per gli stakeholder aziendali.
• Offriamo soluzioni di lavoro flessibili, compresa la possibilità di lavorare in un modello ibrido, combinando il lavoro remoto con il tempo trascorso in ufficio. Gestire e migliorare continuamente i dati del portafoglio in Archibus, tra cui proprietà, locazione, pianificazione strategica e informazioni relative alla sostenibilità Sviluppare una forte esperienza nelle funzionalità di Archibus e promuovere il loro uso efficace in tutto il team. Fornire formazione Archibus e fornire supporto agli utenti interni Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni per raccogliere, convalidare e consolidare i dati del portafoglio in modo tempestivo e affidabile Controllare il nostro fornitore esterno responsabile per l'amministrazione del contratto di locazione e garantire l'accuratezza, la completezza e la coerenza dei dati di locazione Identificare e migliorare i processi relativi alla raccolta, convalida, astrazione del contratto di locazione e gestione del contratto per migliorare l'efficienza e il controllo. Promuovere gli ordini di acquisto e verificare le fatture Preparare materiali di presentazione, analisi, report e grafici utilizzando più fonti di dati e strumenti Tradurre dati immobiliari complessi in chiari approfondimenti che supportano le decisioni di portafoglio e la reportistica di gestione Organizzare e mantenere i siti Team e SharePoint e sostenere lo sviluppo della presenza intranet della divisione Contribuisci al funzionamento fluido ed efficiente della divisione Global Portfolio Management attraverso attività di supporto amministrativo Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione dei dati immobiliari, analisi e reporting. Esperienza nella gestione delle locazioni. Esperienza nel settore immobiliare aziendale all'interno di una funzione immobiliare globale aziendale. Capacità di interpretare i termini di locazione, comprendere le strutture di portafoglio e i dati immobiliari. Esperienza pratica con una piattaforma di gestione dei dati immobiliari. Ottima competenza in Excel, Power BI e SharePoint. La conoscenza di SAP REFX è un bene. Forte pensiero analitico, creatività e un approccio proattivo per risolvere i problemi. Altamente organizzato, rigoroso, orientato ai dettagli, e in grado di lavorare con accuratezza in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione. Capacità di gestire più priorità simultaneamente e lavorare efficacemente su diversi argomenti. Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese, con la capacità di collaborare con successo in un ambiente di team globale. Hitachi Energy Real Estate fornisce una leadership strategica per le attività immobiliari globali, fungendo da partner commerciale per migliorare le prestazioni attraverso soluzioni efficaci. La divisione Global Portfolio Management modella la strategia, mitiga i rischi e utilizza informazioni basate sui dati per migliorare le prestazioni del portafoglio. Supporta anche temi di sostenibilità immobiliare in collaborazione con le Business Unit e i team Hitachi Energy Sustainability. Lo stipendio minimo per questa posizione nella posizione (Italia) specificata: A partire da: 44.800 € lordo salario annuo Applicabile CBA: Metalmeccanico L'offerta finale si baserà sulla posizione del candidato, le competenze e le qualifiche, l'esperienza, e allineato con strutture di pagamento interne. Questo ruolo è aperto in Francia, Germania, Svizzera, Italia e Spagna.
