descriptions.it: L'opportunità In questo ruolo dinamico, sarete il primo punto di contatto per visitatori, dipendenti e partner esterni, contribuendo a creare un ambiente accogliente e professionale. Si svolgerà un ruolo importante nel sostenere le operazioni quotidiane del sito, mentre si lavora a stretto contatto con il team Facility Management. Le tue forti capacità organizzative, la mentalità focalizzata sul cliente e l'atteggiamento positivo contribuiranno a un'esperienza di lavoro senza soluzione di continuità. Questa posizione offre una vasta gamma di responsabilità, interazione quotidiana con diversi stakeholder, e l'opportunità di sviluppare ulteriormente le tue competenze amministrative e di coordinamento in un ambiente collaborativo. Se ti piace prendere iniziativa, sostenere gli altri, e rappresentare un'organizzazione con professionalità e calore, questo ruolo potrebbe essere il passo successivo perfetto per te. Come farete un impatto Accogliere e sostenere i visitatori, fornendo assistenza professionale e informazioni Gestire i processi di registrazione dei visitatori e di accesso al sito Fornire supporto amministrativo al team Facility Management Gestire e-mail, ordini e relativa documentazione Coordinate riparazioni e liaise con i fornitori di servizi esterni Gestire sale riunioni e sostenere le operazioni di struttura giorno per giorno Organizzare in entrata e in uscita mail, forniture di uffici e servizi di strutture Condurre ispezioni regolari strutture e passeggiate di strutture Il tuo background Apprendistato commerciale completo o qualifica equivalente Forte capacità organizzative con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente Eccellente comunicazione e competenze interpersonali mentalità orientata al servizio con un approccio professionale e accogliente L'atteggiamento positivo, la volontà di imparare, e la capacità di rappresentare l'azienda professionalmente come il primo punto di contatto Proficienza nelle applicazioni di Microsoft Office Molto buone competenze di lingua tedesca e buona inglese I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo, promuovendo impegno, prestazioni e crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, creiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.
descriptions.en: The opportunity In this dynamic role, you will be the first point of contact for visitors, employees, and external partners, helping to create a welcoming and professional environment. You will play an important role in supporting the daily operations of the site while working closely with the Facility Management team. Your strong organizational skills, customer-focused mindset, and positive attitude will contribute to a seamless workplace experience. This position offers a broad range of responsibilities, daily interaction with diverse stakeholders, and the opportunity to further develop your administrative and coordination skills in a collaborative environment. If you enjoy taking initiative, supporting others, and representing an organization with professionalism and warmth, this role could be the perfect next step for you. How you'll make an impact Welcome and support visitors while providing professional assistance and information Manage visitor registration and site access processes Provide administrative support to the Facility Management team Handle emails, orders, and related documentation Coordinate repairs and liaise with external service providers Manage meeting rooms and support day-to-day facility operations Organize incoming and outgoing mail, office supplies, and facility services Conduct regular facility inspections and building walkthroughs Support safety, evacuation, and first aid initiatives Your background Completed commercial apprenticeship or equivalent qualification Strong organizational skills with the ability to work independently Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Service-oriented mindset with a professional and welcoming approach Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to represent the company professionally as the first point of contact Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications Very good German and good English language skills More about us We believe that great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual, fostering engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we create a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.
descriptions.de: Die Chance In dieser dynamischen Rolle sind Sie der erste Ansprechpartner für Besucher, Mitarbeiter und externe Partner und tragen dazu bei, ein einladendes und professionelles Umfeld zu schaffen. Sie werden eine wichtige Rolle bei der Unterstützung des täglichen Betriebs der Website spielen, während Sie eng mit dem Facility Management-Team zusammenarbeiten. Ihre starken organisatorischen Fähigkeiten, Ihre kundenorientierte Denkweise und Ihre positive Einstellung tragen zu einem nahtlosen Arbeitsplatzerlebnis bei. Diese Position bietet eine breite Palette von Verantwortlichkeiten, die tägliche Interaktion mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern und die Möglichkeit, Ihre Verwaltungs- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten in einem kollaborativen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln. Wenn Sie gerne Initiative ergreifen, andere unterstützen und eine Organisation mit Professionalität und Wärme vertreten, könnte diese Rolle der perfekte nächste Schritt für Sie sein. Begrüßen und unterstützen Sie Besucher bei der Bereitstellung von professioneller Unterstützung und Informationen Verwalten Sie Besucherregistrierungs- und Websitezugriffsprozesse Bieten Sie administrative Unterstützung für das Facility Management-Team Bearbeitung von E-Mails, Bestellungen und damit zusammenhängender Dokumentation Koordinieren Sie Reparaturen und die Verbindung mit externen Dienstleistern Verwalten Sie Besprechungsräume und unterstützen Sie den täglichen Betrieb der Einrichtung Organisieren Sie eingehende und ausgehende Post, Bürobedarf und Einrichtungsdienste Führen Sie regelmäßige Anlageninspektionen und Gebäudedurchführungen Unterstützung von Sicherheit, Evakuierung und Erste-Hilfe-Initiativen Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder gleichwertige Qualifikation Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten Exzellente Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten Serviceorientierte Denkweise mit einem professionellen und einladenden Ansatz Positive Einstellung, Lernbereitschaft und Fähigkeit, das Unternehmen professionell als erster Ansprechpartner zu vertreten Proficiency in Microsoft Office-Anwendungen Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Mehr über uns Wir glauben, dass großartige Arbeit in einem Umfeld gedeiht, in dem sich die Menschen wirklich unterstützt und fair belohnt fühlen. Unsere Vorteile sind so konzipiert, dass sie einen echten Wert für jeden Einzelnen schaffen und Engagement, Leistung und Wachstum fördern. Durch die Priorisierung des Wohlbefindens schaffen wir einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem persönlicher und organisatorischer Erfolg zusammenwachsen.

Vous jouerez un rôle important en appuyant les opérations quotidiennes du site tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de gestion des installations. Vos solides compétences organisationnelles, votre état d'esprit axé sur le client et votre attitude positive contribueront à une expérience de travail transparente. Ce poste offre un large éventail de responsabilités, une interaction quotidienne avec divers intervenants et la possibilité de développer davantage vos compétences en administration et en coordination dans un environnement de collaboration. Si vous aimez prendre des initiatives, soutenir les autres et représenter une organisation avec professionnalisme et chaleur, ce rôle pourrait être la prochaine étape parfaite pour vous. Nos avantages sont conçus pour créer une valeur réelle pour chaque individu, favorisant l'engagement, la performance et la croissance. En donnant la priorité au bien-être, nous créons un milieu de travail où la réussite personnelle et organisationnelle se développe ensemble.

descriptions.it:
L'opportunità Stiamo cercando uno stagista di ingegneria motivato e curioso per supportare il nostro team di eccellenza del prodotto nell'area di arresti di sovratensioni, varistors di ossido di metallo (MO) e prodotti di protezione ad alta tensione. Questo stage offre l'opportunità di lavorare sulle sfide ingegneristiche del mondo reale relative a standard internazionali, qualificazione del prodotto, test, simulazioni e documentazione tecnica. A seconda delle priorità aziendali e degli interessi del candidato, il progetto di stage si concentrerà su uno o più argomenti da un portafoglio di attività di sviluppo e di qualificazione in corso. Analizzare e confrontare gli standard internazionali (ad esempio, IEC, IEEE, raccomandazioni CIGRE) e valutare il loro impatto sui requisiti di progettazione e test di prodotto Sostenere i progetti di qualificazione e riqualificazione dei prodotti per gli arresti di sovratensioni e i varistori di ossido di metallo, comprese le simulazioni dei modelli relativi ai laboratori di progettazione ambientale ed elettrico Attualmente iscritta in un programma MSc in Ingegneria Elettrica Esperienza con Python, Matlab e Electromagnetic Transients Program (EMTP) Forte comunicazione e competenze di gestione degli stakeholder Stile di lavoro collaborativo e proattivo Fluent scritto e parlato Inglese Più su di noi Siamo una società basata sulla tecnologia con un forte focus sull'innovazione, il miglioramento continuo e la produzione sostenibile.
• Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicato, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro.
descriptions.en: The opportunity We are looking for a motivated and curious engineering intern to support our Product Excellence team in the area of surge arresters, metal oxide (MO) varistors, and high-voltage protection products. This internship offers the opportunity to work on real-world engineering challenges related to international standards, product qualification, testing, simulations, and technical documentation. Depending on business priorities and the candidate's interests, the internship project will focus on one or more topics from a portfolio of ongoing development and qualification activities. How you'll make an impact Analyzing and comparing international standards (e.g., IEC, IEEE, CIGRE recommendations) and assessing their impact on product design and testing requirements Supporting product qualification and requalification projects for surge arresters and metal oxide varistors, including simulations related to environmental and electrical performance testing Evaluating testing strategies, including the possibility of harmonizing qualification testing across different standards Assisting with laboratory test planning, execution, and analysis Developing engineering calculation tools and templates to support product design and qualification activities Creating and maintaining technical documentation, reports, and engineering guidelines Analyzing test data and preparing technical conclusions and recommendations Investigating emerging industry requirements and proposed standard revisions Collaborating with product management, engineering, testing laboratories, and standards experts Your background Currently enrolled in an MSc program in Electrical Engineering Experience with Python, Matlab, and Electromagnetic Transients Program (EMTP) Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Collaborative and proactive working style Fluent written and spoken English More about us We are a technology‑driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

Die Chance Wir suchen einen motivierten und neugierigen Ingenieurpraktikanten, der unser Product Excellence Team im Bereich Überspannungsableiter, Metalloxidvaristoren (MO) und Hochspannungsschutzprodukte unterstützt. Dieses Praktikum bietet die Möglichkeit, an realen technischen Herausforderungen im Zusammenhang mit internationalen Standards, Produktqualifikation, Tests, Simulationen und technischer Dokumentation zu arbeiten. Abhängig von den Geschäftsprioritäten und den Interessen des Bewerbers konzentriert sich das Praktikumsprojekt auf ein oder mehrere Themen aus einem Portfolio von laufenden Entwicklungs- und Qualifizierungsaktivitäten. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Analyse und Vergleich internationaler Standards (z. B. IEC, IEEE, CIGRE-Empfehlungen) und Bewertung ihrer Auswirkungen auf Produktdesign- und Testanforderungen Unterstützung von Produktqualifikations- und Requalifikationsprojekten für Überspannungsableiter und Metalloxidvaristoren, einschließlich Simulationen im Zusammenhang mit Umwelt- und Elektroleistungstests Bewertung von Teststrategien, einschließlich der Möglichkeit, Qualifizierungstests über verschiedene Standards hinweg zu harmonisieren Unterstützung bei der Planung, Ausführung und Analyse von Labortests Entwicklung von technischen Berechnungstools und Vorlagen zur Unterstützung von Produktdesign- und Qualifizierungsaktivitäten Erstellung und Pflege von technischen Dokumentationen, Berichten und technischen Richtlinien Analyse von Testdaten und Vorbereitung technischer Schlussfolgerungen und Empfehlungen Untersuchung neuer Industrieanforderungen und vorgeschlagene Standardrevisionen Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Engineering, Testlabors und Normungsexperten Ihr Hintergrund Derzeit eingeschrieben in einem MSc-Programm in Elektrotechnik Erfahrung mit Python, Matlab und Electromagnetic Transients Program (EMTP) Starke Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten Kollaborativer und proaktiver Arbeitsstil Fließend geschrieben und gesprochen Englisch Mehr über uns Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung.

L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un stagiaire d'ingénierie motivé et curieux pour soutenir notre équipe d'excellence produit dans le domaine des pare-chocs, des variators d'oxyde de métal (MO) et des produits de protection haute tension. Ce stage offre l'occasion de travailler sur des défis d'ingénierie réels liés aux normes internationales, à la qualification des produits, aux essais, aux simulations et à la documentation technique. Selon les priorités de l'entreprise et les intérêts du candidat, le projet de stage portera sur un ou plusieurs sujets provenant d'un portefeuille d'activités de perfectionnement et de qualification continues. Comment vous ferez un impact Analyser et comparer les normes internationales (p. ex., IEC, IEEE, recommandations du CIGRE) et évaluer leur impact sur la conception et les exigences d'essai des produits Appuyer les projets de qualification et de requalification des produits pour les pare-chocs et les varificateurs d'oxydes métalliques, y compris les simulations liées aux essais de performance environnementale et électrique Évaluer les stratégies d'essai, y compris la possibilité d'harmoniser les essais de qualification entre les différentes normes Aider à la planification, à l'exécution et à l'analyse des essais en laboratoire Élaborer des outils de calcul et des modèles pour appuyer les activités de conception et de qualification des produits Créer et tenir à jour la documentation technique, les rapports et les directives d'ingénierie Analyser les données d'essai et préparer des conclusions et des recommandations techniques Étudier les nouvelles exigences de l'industrie et les révisions standard proposées Collaborer avec la gestion des produits, l'ingénierie, les laboratoires d'essai et les experts en normes Vos antécédents Actuellement inscrit à un programme de maîtrise en génie électrique Expérience avec Python, Matlab et Electromagnétique Transients Program (EMTP) Fortes compétences en communication et gestion des intervenants Style de travail collaboratif et proactif Fluent écrit et parlé anglais Plus sur nous Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie et qui met fortement l'accent sur l'innovation, l'amélioration continue et la fabrication durable.
• Nous offrons des conditions de travail flexibles, un mentorat dédié et un environnement favorable et inclusif où vous pouvez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement – vous autonomisant à prospérer tout en conciliant vie et travail.

descriptions.it:
L'opportunità L'industria energetica si sta trasformando ad un ritmo senza precedenti. Poiché i clienti cercano una maggiore affidabilità, resilienza, efficienza e sostenibilità dalla loro infrastruttura critica, le tecnologie digitali ridefiniscono come viene consegnato il valore del servizio. Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un'eccezionale Soluzioni di Servizi Digitali Globali Conduce a plasmare e accelerare il futuro dei servizi digitali attraverso il nostro Global Service Business. Reporting to the Head of Global Product Group, BU Service, questo ruolo di leadership altamente visibile definirà e guiderà la strategia, lo sviluppo e la commercializzazione di soluzioni digitali innovative che supportano i clienti durante il ciclo di vita dei loro beni. Lavorando attraverso Hitachi Energy e il più ampio Gruppo Hitachi, vi aiuterà a creare e scalare offerte di servizi di nuova generazione alimentate da intelligenza artificiale, IoT, gemelli digitali, robotica e tecnologie immersive. Potrai svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nella trasformazione dei modelli di servizio tradizionali in offerte connesse, predittive e basate sui risultati, aiutando i clienti a migliorare l'affidabilità degli asset, le prestazioni operative e la resilienza aziendale, guidando la crescita sostenibile per il Service Business. Questa opportunità è ideale per un leader globale collaudato che ha scalato con successo le soluzioni digitali e ha portato complesse iniziative di trasformazione in ambienti industriali, energetici, infrastrutturali o tecnologici. I candidati sono accolti su base globale. Il ruolo potrebbe essere basato su più sedi, tuttavia, il modello di lavoro tipico sarà in gran parte basato sull'area temporale europea.

• Sviluppare e gestire un portafoglio di soluzioni digitali scalabili che creano valore del cliente e accelerano la crescita aziendale.
• Guidare la commercializzazione e l'espansione delle offerte di servizi alimentate da AI, incluso il portafoglio HMAX Energy.
• Condurre il passaggio dai modelli di fornitura di servizi reattivi alle soluzioni di servizio predittive, basate sui dati e basate sui risultati.
• Identificare le opportunità di mercato, le esigenze dei clienti e le tendenze tecnologiche emergenti per modellare le future offerte di servizio.
• Stabilire ed eseguire la strategia Service IoT, consentendo ai clienti di sbloccare il valore attraverso attività connesse, analisi e approfondimenti attuabili.

• Laurea o Master in Ingegneria, Tecnologia, Business o una disciplina relativa.
• Ampia esperienza che conduce i programmi di trasformazione digitale su larga scala all'interno di organizzazioni a tema energetico, industriale, infrastrutturale, automazione o tecnologia.

descriptions.en: The Opportunity The energy industry is transforming at an unprecedented pace. As customers seek greater reliability, resilience, efficiency and sustainability from their critical infrastructure, digital technologies are redefining how service value is delivered. Hitachi Energy is seeking an exceptional Global Digital Service Solutions Lead to shape and accelerate the future of digital services across our global Service Business. Reporting to the Head of Global Product Group, BU Service, this highly visible leadership role will define and drive the strategy, development and commercialization of innovative digital solutions that support customers throughout the lifecycle of their assets. Working across Hitachi Energy and the wider Hitachi Group, you will help create and scale next-generation service offerings powered by Artificial Intelligence, IoT, digital twins, robotics and immersive technologies. You will play a pivotal role in transforming traditional service models into connected, predictive and outcome-based offerings, helping customers improve asset reliability, operational performance and business resilience while driving sustainable growth for the Service Business. This opportunity is ideally suited to a proven global leader who has successfully scaled digital solutions and led complex transformation initiatives within industrial, energy, infrastructure or technology-driven environments. Candidates are welcomed on a global basis. The role could be based from multiple locations, however, the typical working pattern will be largely European timezone based. How You'll Make an Impact • Define and execute the global strategy for digital services, connected solutions and advanced technologies across the Service Business. • Develop and manage a portfolio of scalable digital solutions that create customer value and accelerate business growth. • Drive the commercialization and expansion of AI-powered service offerings, including the HMAX Energy portfolio. • Lead the transition from reactive service delivery models to predictive, data-driven and outcome-based service solutions. • Identify market opportunities, customer needs and emerging technology trends to shape future service offerings. • Establish and execute the Service IoT strategy, enabling customers to unlock value through connected assets, analytics and actionable insights. • Develop commercial models, value propositions and go-to-market strategies that support profitable growth and global adoption. • Drive the introduction and scaling of technologies such as robotics, digital twins, advanced analytics and immersive digital experiences. • Collaborate closely with product management, engineering, technology, sales, marketing and service teams to deliver integrated customer solutions. • Foster innovation across the organisation by building strategic partnerships both within Hitachi Energy and across the wider Hitachi Group. • Lead, coach and inspire teams and stakeholders within a complex global matrix environment. • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing strategic decisions and driving transformational change. Your Background • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Technology, Business or a related discipline. • Extensive experience leading large-scale digital transformation programmes within energy, industrial, infrastructure, automation or technology-focused organisations. • Proven track record of developing, commercialising and scaling digital products, platforms or service solutions on a global scale. • Deep expertise in digital services, Industrial IoT, Artificial Intelligence, advanced analytics and connected asset technologies. • Experience working within the energy sector, industrial manufacturing, automation, utilities or asset-intensive industries. • Strong understanding of service business models, field service operations and installed base management. • Demonstrated success i
descriptions.de:
Die Chance Die Energiewirtschaft verändert sich in einem beispiellosen Tempo. Da Kunden eine höhere Zuverlässigkeit, Widerstandsfähigkeit, Effizienz und Nachhaltigkeit ihrer kritischen Infrastruktur anstreben, definieren digitale Technologien den Servicewert neu. Hitachi Energy strebt einen außergewöhnlichen Global Digital Service Solutions Lead an, um die Zukunft digitaler Dienstleistungen in unserem globalen Servicegeschäft zu gestalten und zu beschleunigen. Berichterstattung an den Leiter der globalen Produktgruppe, BU Service, diese hoch sichtbare Führungsrolle wird die Strategie, Entwicklung und Kommerzialisierung innovativer digitaler Lösungen definieren und vorantreiben, die Kunden während des gesamten Lebenszyklus ihrer Vermögenswerte unterstützen. In Zusammenarbeit mit Hitachi Energy und der breiteren Hitachi Group helfen Sie bei der Erstellung und Skalierung von Serviceangeboten der nächsten Generation, die auf künstlicher Intelligenz, IoT, digitalen Zwillingen, Robotik und immersiven Technologien basieren. Sie spielen eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Umwandlung traditioneller Servicemodelle in vernetzte, prädiktive und ergebnisbasierte Angebote, die Kunden dabei unterstützen, die Zuverlässigkeit von Anlagen, die operative Leistung und die Geschäftsresilienz zu verbessern und gleichzeitig nachhaltiges Wachstum für das Servicegeschäft voranzutreiben. Diese Gelegenheit eignet sich ideal für einen ausgewiesenen globalen Marktführer, der digitale Lösungen erfolgreich skaliert und komplexe Transformationsinitiativen in Industrie-, Energie-, Infrastruktur- oder Technologieumgebungen geleitet hat. Die Kandidaten werden weltweit begrüßt. Die Rolle könnte von mehreren Standorten aus erfolgen, das typische Arbeitsmuster wird jedoch weitgehend auf europäischer Zeitzone basieren. • Etablierung und Umsetzung der Service-IoT-Strategie, die es Kunden ermöglicht, Wert durch verbundene Assets, Analysen und umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu erschließen.
• Entwicklung kommerzieller Modelle, Value Propositions und Go-to-Market-Strategien, die profitables Wachstum und globale Akzeptanz unterstützen.
• Die Einführung und Skalierung von Technologien wie Robotik, digitalen Zwillingen, fortschrittlichen Analysen und immersiven digitalen Erlebnissen vorantreiben.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement-, Engineering-, Technologie-, Vertriebs-, Marketing- und Serviceteams, um integrierte Kundenlösungen zu liefern.

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Engineering, Technologie, Business oder einer verwandten Disziplin. Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Leitung groß angelegter digitaler Transformationsprogramme in Energie-, Industrie-, Infrastruktur-, Automatisierungs- oder Technologieunternehmen.
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung, Vermarktung und Skalierung digitaler Produkte, Plattformen oder Servicelösungen auf globaler Ebene.
• Tiefe Expertise in digitalen Services, Industrial IoT, Künstlicher Intelligenz, Advanced Analytics und Connected Asset Technologien.
• Erfahrung in der Energiebranche, der industriellen Fertigung, Automatisierung, Versorgungsunternehmen oder anlagenintensiven Branchen.

L'opportunité L'industrie énergétique se transforme à un rythme sans précédent. Alors que les clients recherchent une plus grande fiabilité, résilience, efficacité et durabilité de leur infrastructure critique, les technologies numériques redéfinissent la manière dont la valeur du service est fournie. Hitachi Energy cherche des solutions de services numériques d'exception Conduisez à façonner et à accélérer l'avenir des services numériques dans notre service mondial. Relevant du Chef du Groupe de Produits Global, BU Service, ce rôle de leader très visible définira et pilotera la stratégie, le développement et la commercialisation de solutions numériques innovantes qui soutiennent les clients tout au long du cycle de vie de leurs actifs. En travaillant à travers Hitachi Energy et le groupe Hitachi, vous aiderez à créer et à mettre à l'échelle des offres de services de nouvelle génération alimentées par l'intelligence artificielle, l'IoT, les jumeaux numériques, la robotique et les technologies immersives. Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la transformation des modèles de services traditionnels en offres connectées, prédictives et basées sur les résultats, aidant les clients à améliorer la fiabilité des actifs, la performance opérationnelle et la résilience des entreprises tout en favorisant une croissance durable pour les entreprises de services. Les candidats sont accueillis au niveau mondial. Le rôle pourrait être basé sur plusieurs emplacements, mais le schéma de travail typique sera largement basé sur le fuseau horaire européen. • Développer et gérer un portefeuille de solutions numériques évolutives qui créent de la valeur pour les clients et accélèrent la croissance des entreprises.
• Conduire la commercialisation et l'expansion des offres de services alimentées par l'IA, y compris le portefeuille HMAX Energy.
• Diriger la transition des modèles de prestation de services réactifs aux solutions de services prédictives, axées sur les données et axées sur les résultats.

• Élaborer des modèles commerciaux, des propositions de valeur et des stratégies d'accès au marché qui favorisent une croissance rentable et une adoption mondiale.
• Favoriser l'introduction et l'extension de technologies telles que la robotique, les jumelles numériques, l'analyse avancée et les expériences numériques immersives.
• Collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de gestion des produits, d'ingénierie, de technologie, de vente, de marketing et de service pour fournir des solutions client intégrées.

• Diriger, entraîner et inspirer les équipes et les parties prenantes dans un environnement matriciel mondial complexe.
• Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des cadres supérieurs, influencer les décisions stratégiques et stimuler le changement transformationnel. Vos antécédents

• Expérience approfondie en matière de programmes de transformation numérique à grande échelle au sein d'organisations axées sur l'énergie, l'industrie, l'infrastructure, l'automatisation ou la technologie.
• Expérience éprouvée du développement, de la commercialisation et de la mise à l'échelle de produits, de plateformes ou de services numériques à l'échelle mondiale.
• Expertise approfondie en services numériques, IoT industriel, Intelligence artificielle, analyse avancée et technologies d'actifs connectés.
• Expérience dans le secteur de l'énergie, la fabrication industrielle, l'automatisation, les services publics ou les industries à forte intensité d'actifs.
• Une bonne compréhension des modèles d'activité des services, des opérations sur le terrain et de la gestion de la base installée.

Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo Executive Assistant che sostiene i leader senior in un ambiente internazionale complesso. Competenze organizzative e di pianificazione eccezionali, con la capacità di gestire più priorità e scadenze in modo efficace. Forte capacità di comunicazione e di gestione degli stakeholder con una mentalità orientata al servizio. descriptions.en: The opportunity Join a collaborative team shaping next-generation SF6-free circuit breakers. You contribute to understanding dielectric performance under real operating conditions. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de production, contribuant à la réalisation des objectifs et à l'amélioration continue des activités. descriptions.it: The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Semiconductors we develop and manufacture quality power semiconductor devices for advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible and secure. Our broad portfolio serves a diverse range of customers operating in several markets like Renewables, Energy Transmission and Distribution, Traction and e-Mobility. Step into a dynamic role where innovation meets precision. As a Metal\/PECVD Process Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of cutting-edge semiconductor manufacturing, driving process optimization, ensuring excellence in production, and shaping the future of wafer fabrication. This is your opportunity to thrive in a collaborative environment and make a tangible impact in the high-tech world. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

How you'll make an impact  Pioneer Process Optimization: Develop and fine-tune processes to boost stability, tool availability, and production efficiency Master Statistical Control: Utilize advanced techniques like statistical analysis and fault detection\/classification to maintain robust process control Troubleshoot with Precision: Act decisively to address out-of-spec lots, release processes, and solve production challenges swiftly Drive Innovation: Lead or support projects aimed at improving fab capacity, enhancing process capability (Cpk\/Ppk), boosting yields, and reducing costs Document and Report Excellence: Coordinate detailed qualification reports and ensure seamless production workflows Champion New Equipment: Spearhead new equipment installation projects, including defining requirements, factory acceptance tests, process qualification, and tool release Ensure Quality Compliance: Maintain and elevate quality standards across all production processes Foster a Safe Environment: Actively contribute to a culture of safety and continuous improvement Your background A Bachelor's Degree in Industrial, Electrical, Mechanical or Chemical Engineering, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in industry or Master's Degree with 3+ years of experience in industry Hands-on experience in PVD metal deposition systems and PECVD dielectric processing for semiconductor wafers fabrication, and related equipment engineering Experience in data analysis and problem-solving tools Proficiency in presenting data and results Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset Fluent in English and German Ability to work in a Clean-Room environment Good command of Microsoft Office applications and data-driven decision-making tools More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

descriptions.it: The opportunity   We are   seeking   a highly motivated Industrial Engineer   in our Production   with   a    high   focus on   Lean Production   and    Process   flow optimiz ation   to   further develop our Generator Circuit-Breaker (GCB) production environment in Zurich. In this role, you will apply industrial engineering principles, automation, and digital manufacturing approaches to improve productivity, safety, quality, cost efficiency, and delivery performance in a high-variety, low-volume, engineering-to-order manufacturing environment.   You will play a key role in analyzing and improving complex GCB assembly, testing, material flow, and workstation concepts, while supporting the continuous development of a lean, digital, and future-ready factory.     How   you'll   make an impact   Analyze current GCB production layouts, assembly workflows, testing processes, material flows, and operational procedures to   identify   improvement potential in efficiency, safety, quality, cost, and lead time, with a strong focus on automation and digitalization opportunities.   Design and implement optimized production processes, workstation concepts, automation solutions,   equipment   utilization   concepts, and improved material flow for GCB assembly and testing.   Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, value stream analysis, layout planning, capacity analysis, and bottleneck assessments to   eliminate   non-value-added activities and increase operational performance.   Develop, standardize, and improve work instructions, standard operating procedures, manufacturing documentation, and digital   shopfloor   processes for GCB assembly, testing, and   logistics   operations.   Evaluate, specify, and implement new manufacturing technologies such as   automated handling systems, smart tools, digital work instructions, MES-related solutions, and data-driven improvement applications.   Support industrialization activities, new product implementation,   series   ramp-ups, CAPEX initiatives, equipment procurement, PFMEA activities, and the introduction of new tools, jigs, fixtures, and testing equipment.   Collaborate closely with production, testing, engineering, industrialization, quality, supply chain, planning, HSE, project management, and product management teams to ensure robust and sustainable process improvements.   Lead and   participate   in continuous improvement initiatives, Lean Manufacturing projects, Kaizen activities, Six Sigma-related improvements, shopfloor optimization, and digital factory initiatives.   Maintain and improve manufacturing master data, production standards, routing information, and KPI-based performance transparency to support efficient planning and execution.   Contribute to the long-term development of the GCB factory by   identifying   future automation potential, improving ergonomics, strengthening safety, and enabling scalable production capabilities.   Your background   Master's degree in Automation Engineering,   Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or   a related   technical field.   P rofessional experience in industrial engineering, production engineering, automation,   industrialization, or manufacturing process improvement is preferred .   Strong understanding of process optimization, Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement methods, Kaizen, Six Sigma, value stream mapping, time studies, and statistical process control.   Experience in complex assembly environments, high-voltage products, electrical equipment manufacturing, engineering-to-order production, or high-variety\/low-volume manufacturing is highly desirable.   Good knowledge of workstation design, layout planning, tooling concepts, ergonomics, equipment specification, manufacturing documentation, and structured problem solving.   Familiarity with SAP, MES, digital work instructions, data analysis tools, or   production   KPI dashboards is an advantage.   Strong

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

descriptions.it:
L'opportunità AI sta cambiando come lavoriamo. La tecnologia da sola non basta. La gente fa la trasformazione reale. Unisciti al nostro programma AI Nexus come studente di tesi del Maestro. AI Nexus guida l'implementazione AI attraverso la nostra organizzazione. La vostra attenzione: adozione dei dipendenti e gestione dei cambiamenti. Si unirà la ricerca accademica con hands-on lavoro di programma. Studierai come i dipendenti adottano strumenti AI in pratica. I tuoi risultati plasmano direttamente la nostra strategia di adozione. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di base AI Nexus. Potrai anche collaborare con il tuo supervisore universitario. Supportiamo la collaborazione accademica e la validazione esterna del nostro approccio. Questo ruolo si adatta a uno studente curioso e focalizzato sulle persone. Si dovrebbe godere sia di ricerca e lavoro di cambiamento pratico. In cambio, si ottiene una vera esperienza di trasformazione in una società globale. Costruirete una rete tra funzioni e regioni. Sono disponibili sistemi di lavoro flessibili e ibridi. Scrivere la tesi del tuo Master sull'adozione dell'IA e la trasformazione organizzativa Design e eseguire sondaggi dei dipendenti, interviste e valutazioni di adozione Analizzare i dati di adozione e identificare le barriere e gli abilitanti Sviluppare misure pratiche di gestione dei cambiamenti e di comunicazione Support rollout attività, formazione e impegno comunitario Tradurre la ricerca accademica in raccomandazioni attuabili Condividi i risultati con la leadership del programma e le parti interessate Il tuo background Studente di Master Iscritto in business, psicologia, risorse umane o un campo relativo Argomento di tesi allineato con l'adozione di AI, la gestione dei cambiamenti o la trasformazione Interessi in AI e il suo impatto sui modi di lavorare Le competenze di base in metodi di ricerca qualitativi e quantitativi Forte capacità di comunicazione; confortevole coinvolgente con i dipendenti a tutti i livelli Fluent in inglese, tedesco è un plus More about us Siamo una società tecnologica-driven con un focus forte sull'innovazione, miglioramento continuo e produzione sostenibile.
• Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicato, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro.
descriptions.en: The opportunity AI is changing how we work. Technology alone is not enough. People make transformation real. Join our AI Nexus program as a Master's thesis student. AI Nexus drives AI deployment across our organization. Your focus: employee adoption and change management. You will combine academic research with hands-on program work. You will study how employees adopt AI tools in practice. Your findings will directly shape our adoption strategy. You will work closely with the AI Nexus core team. You will also collaborate with your university supervisor. We support academic collaboration and value external validation of our approach. This role suits a curious, people-focused student. You should enjoy both research and practical change work. In return, you gain real transformation experience in a global company. You will build a network across functions and regions. Flexible and hybrid working arrangements are available. How you'll make an impact Write your Master's thesis on AI adoption and organizational transformation Design and run employee surveys, interviews, and adoption assessments Analyze adoption data and identify barriers and enablers Develop practical change management and communication measures Support rollout activities, trainings, and community engagement Translate academic research into actionable recommendations Share findings with program leadership and stakeholders Your background Enrolled Master's student in business, psychology, HR, or a related field Thesis topic aligned with AI adoption, change management, or transformation Interest in AI and its impact on ways of working Basic skills in qualitative and quantitative research methods Strong communication skills; comfortable engaging with employees at all levels Fluent in English, German is a plus More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
descriptions.de:
Die Chance AI verändert unsere Arbeitsweise. Technologie allein reicht nicht aus. Menschen machen Transformation real. Nehmen Sie an unserem AI Nexus-Programm als Master-Student teil. AI Nexus unterstützt die KI-Bereitstellung in unserem Unternehmen. Ihr Fokus: Mitarbeiteradoption und Change Management. Sie kombinieren akademische Forschung mit praktischer Programmarbeit. Sie werden untersuchen, wie Mitarbeiter KI-Tools in der Praxis anwenden. Ihre Erkenntnisse werden unsere Adoptionsstrategie direkt prägen. Sie werden eng mit dem Kernteam von AI Nexus zusammenarbeiten. Sie werden auch mit Ihrem Hochschulbetreuer zusammenarbeiten. Wir unterstützen die akademische Zusammenarbeit und schätzen die externe Validierung unseres Ansatzes. Diese Rolle passt zu einem neugierigen, menschenorientierten Schüler. Sie sollten sowohl Forschung als auch praktische Veränderungsarbeit genießen. Im Gegenzug sammeln Sie echte Transformationserfahrung in einem globalen Unternehmen. Sie bauen ein Netzwerk über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg auf. Flexible und hybride Arbeitsvereinbarungen stehen zur Verfügung. descriptions.fr:

descriptions.it: L'opportunità A Hitachi Energy Semiconductors sviluppiamo e produciamo dispositivi semiconduttori di potenza di qualità per promuovere il sistema energetico mondiale per essere più sostenibili, flessibili e sicuri. Il nostro ampio portafoglio serve una vasta gamma di clienti che operano in diversi mercati come Renewables, Energy Transmission e Distribution, Traction ed e-Mobility. Entra in un ruolo dinamico in cui l'innovazione incontra precisione. In qualità di Ingegnere di Processo Metal\/PECVD, sarai all'avanguardia nella produzione di semiconduttori all'avanguardia, nell'ottimizzazione dei processi di guida, nella garanzia dell'eccellenza nella produzione e nella modellazione del futuro della fabbricazione di wafer. Questa è la tua opportunità di prosperare in un ambiente collaborativo e di avere un impatto tangibile nel mondo high-tech. Sviluppo e perfezionamento dei processi di elaborazione dei processi industriali: sviluppo e perfezionamento dei processi per migliorare la stabilità, la disponibilità degli strumenti e l'efficienza produttiva Controllo statistico: utilizzo di tecniche avanzate come l'analisi statistica e il rilevamento dei guasti\/classificazione per mantenere il controllo dei processi robusti Risoluzione dei problemi con la precisione: agire in modo decisivo per affrontare i lotti fuori produzione, processi di rilascio e risolvere rapidamente le sfide di produzione I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per creare valore reale per ogni individuo – il rifornimento di impegno, le prestazioni e la crescita. Con la priorità del benessere, costruiamo un posto di lavoro dove il successo personale e organizzativo crescono insieme.
descriptions.en: The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Semiconductors we develop and manufacture quality power semiconductor devices for advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible and secure. Our broad portfolio serves a diverse range of customers operating in several markets like Renewables, Energy Transmission and Distribution, Traction and e-Mobility. Step into a dynamic role where innovation meets precision. As a Metal\/PECVD Process Engineer, you'll be at the forefront of cutting-edge semiconductor manufacturing, driving process optimization, ensuring excellence in production, and shaping the future of wafer fabrication. This is your opportunity to thrive in a collaborative environment and make a tangible impact in the high-tech world. How you'll make an impact Pioneer Process Optimization: Develop and fine-tune processes to boost stability, tool availability, and production efficiency Master Statistical Control: Utilize advanced techniques like statistical analysis and fault detection\/classification to maintain robust process control Troubleshoot with Precision: Act decisively to address out-of-spec lots, release processes, and solve production challenges swiftly Drive Innovation: Lead or support projects aimed at improving fab capacity, enhancing process capability (Cpk\/Ppk), boosting yields, and reducing costs Document and Report Excellence: Coordinate detailed qualification reports and ensure seamless production workflows Champion New Equipment: Spearhead new equipment installation projects, including defining requirements, factory acceptance tests, process qualification, and tool release Ensure Quality Compliance: Maintain and elevate quality standards across all production processes Foster a Safe Environment: Actively contribute to a culture of safety and continuous improvement Your background A Bachelor's Degree in Industrial, Electrical, Mechanical or Chemical Engineering, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in industry or Master's Degree with 3+ years of experience in industry Hands-on experience in PVD metal deposition systems and PECVD dielectric processing for semiconductor wafers fabrication, and related equipment engineering Experience in data analysis and problem-solving tools Proficiency in presenting data and results Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset Fluent in English and German Ability to work in a Clean-Room environment Good command of Microsoft Office applications and data-driven decision-making tools More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​

descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Chez Hitachi Energy Semiconductors, nous développons et fabriquons des dispositifs semiconducteurs de puissance de qualité pour faire progresser le système énergétique mondial de manière à être plus durable, plus flexible et plus sûr. descriptions.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere industriale altamente motivato nella nostra produzione con un alto focus sulla produzione magra e l'ottimizzazione del flusso di processo per sviluppare ulteriormente il nostro ambiente di produzione Generator Circuit-Breaker (GCB) a Zurigo. In questo ruolo, si applicano principi di ingegneria industriale, l'automazione e metodi di produzione digitale per migliorare la produttività, la sicurezza, la qualità, l'efficienza dei costi e le prestazioni di consegna in un ambiente di produzione ad alta qualità, a basso volume, ingegneria all'ordine. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nell'analisi e nel miglioramento di complessi concetti di assemblaggio, collaudo, flusso materiale e workstation, supportando allo sviluppo continuo di una magra, digitale e futura fabbrica. Analizzare i layout di produzione GCB attuali, i flussi di lavoro di montaggio, i processi di test, i flussi materiali e le procedure operative per identificare il potenziale di miglioramento in efficienza, sicurezza, qualità, costi e tempi di consegna, con un forte focus sulle opportunità di automazione e digitalizzazione. Progettare e implementare processi di produzione ottimizzati, concetti di workstation, soluzioni di automazione, concetti di utilizzo delle attrezzature, e flusso di materiale migliorato per il montaggio e il test GCB. Condurre studi di tempo e di movimento, mappatura dei processi, analisi del flusso di valore, pianificazione del layout, analisi della capacità e valutazioni del collo di bottiglia per eliminare le attività non-valore aggiunto e aumentare le prestazioni operative. Sviluppare, standardizzare e migliorare le istruzioni di lavoro, le procedure operative standard, la documentazione di produzione e i processi digital shopfloor per le operazioni di montaggio, test e logistica GCB. Valutare, specificare e implementare nuove tecnologie di produzione come sistemi di gestione automatizzati, strumenti intelligenti, istruzioni di lavoro digitali, soluzioni correlate a MES e applicazioni di miglioramento basate sui dati. Sostenere le attività di industrializzazione, la nuova implementazione dei prodotti, le rampe di serie, le iniziative CAPEX, l'approvvigionamento di attrezzature, le attività PFMEA, e l'introduzione di nuovi strumenti, giga, apparecchi e attrezzature di prova. Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di produzione, collaudo, ingegneria, industrializzazione, qualità, supply chain, pianificazione, HSE, project management e product management per garantire miglioramenti di processo robusti e sostenibili. Guidare e partecipare a iniziative di miglioramento continuo, progetti Lean Manufacturing, attività Kaizen, miglioramenti correlati a Six Sigma, ottimizzazione del piano di negozio e iniziative di fabbrica digitale. Mantenere e migliorare i dati master di produzione, gli standard di produzione, le informazioni di routing e la trasparenza delle prestazioni basata su KPI per supportare una pianificazione e l'esecuzione efficienti. Contribuisci allo sviluppo a lungo termine dello stabilimento GCB identificando il potenziale di automazione futuro, migliorando l'ergonomia, rafforzando la sicurezza e consentendo capacità di produzione scalabili. La tua laurea magistrale in Ingegneria dell'automazione, Ingegneria industriale, Ingegneria manifatturiera, Ingegneria meccanica, Ingegneria elettrica, o un campo tecnico correlato. P esperienza professionale in ingegneria industriale, ingegneria della produzione, automazione, industrializzazione, o miglioramento del processo di produzione è preferito. Forte comprensione dell'ottimizzazione dei processi, Lean Manufacturing, metodi di miglioramento continuo, Kaizen, Six Sigma, mappatura del flusso di valore, studi di tempo e controllo dei processi statistici. L'esperienza in ambienti di assemblaggio complessi, prodotti ad alta tensione, produzione di apparecchiature elettriche, produzione di ingegneria all'ordine, o produzione ad alta disponibilità\/basso volume è altamente auspicabile. Buona conoscenza della progettazione delle stazioni di lavoro, pianificazione del layout, concetti di utensili, ergonomia, specificazione delle attrezzature, documentazione di produzione e risoluzione dei problemi strutturati. La familiarità con SAP, MES, istruzioni di lavoro digitali, strumenti di analisi dei dati o cruscotti KPI di produzione è un vantaggio. Forte
descriptions.en: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer in our Production with a high focus on Lean Production and Process flow optimiz ation to further develop our Generator Circuit-Breaker (GCB) production environment in Zurich. In this role, you will apply industrial engineering principles, automation, and digital manufacturing approaches to improve productivity, safety, quality, cost efficiency, and delivery performance in a high-variety, low-volume, engineering-to-order manufacturing environment. You will play a key role in analyzing and improving complex GCB assembly, testing, material flow, and workstation concepts, while supporting the continuous development of a lean, digital, and future-ready factory. How you'll make an impact Analyze current GCB production layouts, assembly workflows, testing processes, material flows, and operational procedures to identify improvement potential in efficiency, safety, quality, cost, and lead time, with a strong focus on automation and digitalization opportunities. Design and implement optimized production processes, workstation concepts, automation solutions, equipment utilization concepts, and improved material flow for GCB assembly and testing. Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, value stream analysis, layout planning, capacity analysis, and bottleneck assessments to eliminate non-value-added activities and increase operational performance. Develop, standardize, and improve work instructions, standard operating procedures, manufacturing documentation, and digital shopfloor processes for GCB assembly, testing, and logistics operations. Evaluate, specify, and implement new manufacturing technologies such as automated handling systems, smart tools, digital work instructions, MES-related solutions, and data-driven improvement applications. Support industrialization activities, new product implementation, series ramp-ups, CAPEX initiatives, equipment procurement, PFMEA activities, and the introduction of new tools, jigs, fixtures, and testing equipment. Collaborate closely with production, testing, engineering, industrialization, quality, supply chain, planning, HSE, project management, and product management teams to ensure robust and sustainable process improvements. Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, Lean Manufacturing projects, Kaizen activities, Six Sigma-related improvements, shopfloor optimization, and digital factory initiatives. Maintain and improve manufacturing master data, production standards, routing information, and KPI-based performance transparency to support efficient planning and execution. Contribute to the long-term development of the GCB factory by identifying future automation potential, improving ergonomics, strengthening safety, and enabling scalable production capabilities. Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. P rofessional experience in industrial engineering, production engineering, automation, industrialization, or manufacturing process improvement is preferred . Strong understanding of process optimization, Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement methods, Kaizen, Six Sigma, value stream mapping, time studies, and statistical process control. Experience in complex assembly environments, high-voltage products, electrical equipment manufacturing, engineering-to-order production, or high-variety\/low-volume manufacturing is highly desirable. Good knowledge of workstation design, layout planning, tooling concepts, ergonomics, equipment specification, manufacturing documentation, and structured problem solving. Familiarity with SAP, MES, digital work instructions, data analysis tools, or production KPI dashboards is an advantage. Strong
descriptions.de: Die Chance Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Industrieingenieur in unserer Produktion mit hohem Fokus auf Lean Production und Prozessflussoptimierung, um unsere Generator Circuit-Breaker (GCB) Produktionsumgebung in Zürich weiterzuentwickeln. In dieser Rolle werden Sie Industrial Engineering-Prinzipien, Automatisierung und digitale Fertigungsansätze anwenden, um Produktivität, Sicherheit, Qualität, Kosteneffizienz und Lieferleistung in einer High-Variety, Low-Volume, Engineering-to-Order-Fertigungsumgebung zu verbessern. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Analyse und Verbesserung komplexer GCB-Montage-, Test-, Materialfluss- und Arbeitsplatzkonzepte und unterstützen gleichzeitig die kontinuierliche Entwicklung einer schlanken, digitalen und zukunftsfähigen Fabrik. Analysieren Sie aktuelle GCB-Produktionslayouts, Montage-Workflows, Testprozesse, Materialflüsse und Betriebsverfahren, um Verbesserungspotenziale in Bezug auf Effizienz, Sicherheit, Qualität, Kosten und Durchlaufzeit zu identifizieren, mit einem starken Fokus auf Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungsmöglichkeiten. Konzipieren und implementieren Sie optimierte Produktionsprozesse, Arbeitsplatzkonzepte, Automatisierungslösungen, Geräteauslastungskonzepte und einen verbesserten Materialfluss für die GCB-Montage und -Prüfung. Durchführung von Zeit- und Bewegungsstudien, Prozessabbildung, Wertstromanalyse, Layoutplanung, Kapazitätsanalyse und Engpassbewertungen, um nicht wertschöpfende Aktivitäten zu eliminieren und die Betriebsleistung zu erhöhen. Entwickeln, standardisieren und verbessern Sie Arbeitsanweisungen, Standardbetriebsverfahren, Fertigungsdokumentation und digitale Shopfloor-Prozesse für GCB-Montage-, Test- und Logistikvorgänge. Bewerten, spezifizieren und implementieren Sie neue Fertigungstechnologien wie automatisierte Handhabungssysteme, intelligente Werkzeuge, digitale Arbeitsanweisungen, MES-bezogene Lösungen und datengesteuerte Verbesserungsanwendungen. Unterstützen Sie Industrialisierungsaktivitäten, die Implementierung neuer Produkte, Serien-Ramp-ups, CAPEX-Initiativen, die Beschaffung von Ausrüstung, PFMEA-Aktivitäten und die Einführung neuer Werkzeuge, Vorrichtungen und Prüfgeräte. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktions-, Test-, Engineering-, Industrialisierungs-, Qualitäts-, Lieferketten-, Planungs-, HSE-, Projektmanagement- und Produktmanagementteams, um robuste und nachhaltige Prozessverbesserungen zu gewährleisten. Führen und beteiligen Sie sich an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen, Lean Manufacturing-Projekten, Kaizen-Aktivitäten, Six Sigma-bezogenen Verbesserungen, Shopfloor-Optimierung und digitalen Fabrikinitiativen. Pflegen und verbessern Sie Fertigungsstammdaten, Produktionsstandards, Routinginformationen und KPI-basierte Leistungstransparenz, um eine effiziente Planung und Ausführung zu unterstützen. Tragen Sie zur langfristigen Entwicklung der GCB-Fabrik bei, indem Sie zukünftige Automatisierungspotenziale identifizieren, die Ergonomie verbessern, die Sicherheit erhöhen und skalierbare Produktionskapazitäten ermöglichen. Ihr Hintergrund-Master-Abschluss in Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich. P rofessional Erfahrung in der Industrietechnik, Produktionstechnik, Automatisierung, Industrialisierung oder Herstellungsprozessverbesserung wird bevorzugt. Starkes Verständnis für Prozessoptimierung, Lean Manufacturing, kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmethoden, Kaizen, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping, Zeitstudien und statistische Prozesskontrolle. Erfahrung in komplexen Montageumgebungen, Hochvoltprodukten, Herstellung von Elektrogeräten, Engineering-to-Order-Produktion oder High-Variety / Low-Volume-Fertigung ist sehr wünschenswert. Gute Kenntnisse der Arbeitsplatzgestaltung, Layoutplanung, Werkzeugkonzepte, Ergonomie, Gerätespezifikation, Fertigungsdokumentation und strukturierte Problemlösung. Die Vertrautheit mit SAP, MES, digitalen Arbeitsanweisungen, Datenanalysetools oder Produktions-KPI-Dashboards ist von Vorteil. stark
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Nous recherchons un ingénieur industriel hautement motivé dans notre production avec un accent particulier sur la production de Lean et l'optimisation du flux de process pour développer davantage notre environnement de production de circuits de générateurs (GCB) à Zurich. Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez des principes d'ingénierie industrielle, d'automatisation et de fabrication numérique pour améliorer la productivité, la sécurité, la qualité, le rapport coût-efficacité et les performances de livraison dans un environnement de fabrication à haute variété, à faible volume et à commande. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'analyse et l'amélioration des concepts complexes d'assemblage, de test, de flux de matériaux et de poste de travail, tout en soutenant le développement continu d'une usine maigre, numérique et prête à l'avenir. Comment vous ferez un impact Analysez les mises en page actuelles de production de GCB, les workflows d'assemblage, les processus de test, les flux de matériaux et les procédures opérationnelles afin d'identifier le potentiel d'amélioration de l'efficacité, de la sécurité, de la qualité, des coûts et des délais, en mettant fortement l'accent sur les possibilités d'automatisation et de numérisation. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des processus de production optimisés, des concepts de poste de travail, des solutions d'automatisation, des concepts d'utilisation de l'équipement et un meilleur flux de matériaux pour l'assemblage et les essais GCB. Effectuer des études de temps et de mouvement, la cartographie des processus, l'analyse des flux de valeur, la planification de la disposition, l'analyse des capacités et les évaluations des goulots d'étranglement afin d'éliminer les activités non à valeur ajoutée et d'accroître le rendement opérationnel. Élaborer, normaliser et améliorer les instructions de travail, les procédures d'exploitation normalisées, la documentation de fabrication et les procédés numériques d'atelier pour l'assemblage, les essais et les opérations logistiques du GCB. Évaluer, spécifier et mettre en œuvre de nouvelles technologies de fabrication telles que les systèmes de traitement automatisé, les outils intelligents, les instructions de travail numériques, les solutions liées au MES et les applications d'amélioration axées sur les données. Appuyer les activités d'industrialisation, la mise en oeuvre de nouveaux produits, les up-ups de série, les initiatives CAPEX, l'acquisition d'équipement, les activités PFMEA, et l'introduction de nouveaux outils, de nouveaux gabarits, de nouveaux accessoires et de nouveaux équipements d'essai. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de production, d'essai, d'ingénierie, d'industrialisation, de qualité, de chaîne d'approvisionnement, de planification, de HSE, de gestion de projet et de gestion des produits pour assurer des améliorations robustes et durables des processus. Diriger et participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue, des projets Lean Manufacturing, des activités Kaizen, des améliorations liées à Six Sigma, l'optimisation des ateliers et des initiatives d'usines numériques. Maintenir et améliorer les données maîtresses de fabrication, les normes de production, l'information sur le routage et la transparence des performances fondée sur l'ICP afin de soutenir une planification et une exécution efficaces. Contribuer au développement à long terme de l'usine GCB en identifiant le potentiel d'automatisation futur, en améliorant l'ergonomie, en renforçant la sécurité et en permettant des capacités de production évolutives. Votre formation Maîtrise en ingénierie d'automatisation, génie industriel, génie manufacturier, génie mécanique, génie électrique ou un domaine technique connexe. L'expérience professionnelle en ingénierie industrielle, en ingénierie de production, en automatisation, en industrialisation ou en amélioration des procédés de fabrication est privilégiée. Une bonne compréhension de l'optimisation des processus, Lean Manufacturing, les méthodes d'amélioration continue, Kaizen, Six Sigma, la cartographie des flux de valeur, les études de temps et le contrôle statistique des processus. L'expérience dans les environnements d'assemblage complexes, les produits à haute tension, la fabrication d'équipements électriques, la production d'ingénierie à commande, ou la fabrication à haute variabilité / à faible volume est hautement souhaitable. Bonne connaissance de la conception des postes de travail, de la planification de la mise en page, des concepts d'outillage, de l'ergonomie, de la spécification des équipements, de la documentation de fabrication et de la résolution structurée des problèmes. Familiarisation avec SAP, MES, instructions de travail numériques, outils d'analyse de données ou tableaux de bord KPI de production est un avantage. Fort

descriptions.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

descriptions.it: The opportunity Would you like to gain valuable practical experience in Payroll and Human Resources? In this role, you will support our Payroll team for 12 months with administrative and payroll-related activities while gaining exciting insights into HR processes within a global organization. You will work with sensitive employee data, take ownership of important tasks, and contribute to the accuracy and efficiency of our payroll operations. At the same time, you will further develop your organizational skills and deepen your understanding of payroll and personnel administration. If you enjoy working with numbers, pay close attention to detail, and thrive in a collaborative team environment, we would love to hear from you. How you'll make an impact Process and distribute incoming mail Manage withholding tax invoices through the myHR ticketing system Review withholding tax statements against payroll system reports Prepare and obtain invoice approvals Verify and manage certificates of residence Process non-return days and related records Complete and process disability insurance questionnaires Support the Payroll and HR team with administrative activities Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of employee data Your background Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel Strong numerical and analytical skills with a high level of accuracy Ability to handle confidential employee data responsibly Strong written and verbal communication skills in German Structured, reliable, and self-driven way of working Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
