descriptions.it:
In Hitachi Energy, stiamo guidando un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti. Al fine di rafforzare il nostro business dei servizi in Svizzera, stiamo cercando una personalità esperta e orientata al cliente nella gestione delle vendite di servizi che possa sviluppare ulteriormente il nostro portafoglio di servizi in Svizzera tedesca e francofona e consentire una crescita a lungo termine. In questo ruolo, siete vicini al mercato e ai nostri clienti. Costruirono relazioni di fiducia, comprendono le esigenze dei clienti tecnici e commerciali e sviluppano soluzioni di servizio convincenti insieme a aree specializzate interne. Accompagniamo i nostri clienti in tutto il ciclo di vita dei loro sistemi ad alta tensione e contribuiamo in modo importante ad un alimentatore sicuro, affidabile e sostenibile in Svizzera. È possibile farlo sviluppando e implementando strategie di vendita per il business dei servizi nelle regioni assegnate e contribuire attivamente a raggiungere i nostri obiettivi di crescita e di vendita, identificare e sviluppare nuove opportunità di business per il nostro portafoglio di servizi, tra cui manutenzione, retrofit, consulenza tecnica, soluzioni digitali e altri servizi a valore aggiunto Costruisci relazioni sostenibili con i decisori e le parti interessate rilevanti e posiziona Hitachi Energy come partner affidabile sull'intero ciclo di vita degli impianti Si controlla l'intero processo di vendita – dall'analisi della domanda alla preparazione della quotazione e negoziazione alla conclusione di contratti di successo Lavorano a stretto contatto con esperti tecnici, project management, operazioni e altri team interni per garantire soluzioni orientate al cliente e attuabili Crea offerte e presentazioni convincenti che mostrano chiaramente il valore aggiunto delle nostre soluzioni di servizio e concentrarsi sulla specifica
• Si osservano le tendenze del mercato e della tecnologia, i requisiti del cliente e l'ambiente competitivo e derivano le opportunità di vendita pertinenti da loro. Tu rappresenti il nostro portafoglio di servizi con convinzione e contribuisci a rafforzare ulteriormente la posizione di Hitachi Energy come partner leader nella tecnologia e nei servizi nel mercato svizzero dell’energia Il tuo background Studi completi nell’amministrazione aziendale, nell’ingegneria, nel marketing o in un’area comparabile Diversi anni di esperienza nelle vendite di servizi, idealmente nel settore energetico Forte comprensione delle esigenze del cliente, dei meccanismi di mercato e dei servizi
• Requisiti per un'infrastruttura energetica affidabile Gioia del contatto con il cliente, alto orientamento del servizio, il fascino commerciale e la capacità di infrastruttura energetica tecnica
• I requisiti di traduzione in soluzioni di cliente convincenti Molto buone capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e negoziazione, nonché un atteggiamento professionale verso i clienti e gli stakeholder interni Gestione sicura dei sistemi CRM, preferibilmente Salesforce , SAP così come le applicazioni comuni di Microsoft Office Esperienza nella creazione, nell'analisi e nell'applicazione di modelli full-cost per la valutazione delle offerte di servizio, dei margini e dei principi decisionali commerciali Serviamo i clienti dall'approvvigionamento energetico, io

At Hitachi Energy, we are driving a sustainable energy future for everyone. In order to strengthen our service business in Switzerland, we are looking for an experienced, customer-oriented personality in service sales management who can further develop our service portfolio in German- and French-speaking Switzerland and enable long-term growth. In this role, you are close to the market and to our customers. They build trusting relationships, understand technical and commercial customer needs and develop convincing service solutions together with internal specialist areas. We accompany our customers throughout the entire life cycle of their high-voltage systems and make an important contribution to a secure, reliable and sustainable power supply in Switzerland. You can do this by developing and implementing sales strategies for the service business in the assigned regions and actively contribute to achieving our growth and sales goals, identifying and developing new business opportunities for our service portfolio, including maintenance, retrofit, technical consulting, digital solutions and other value-added services You build sustainable customer relationships with decision makers and relevant stakeholders and position Hitachi Energy as a reliable partner over the entire plant lifecycle You control the entire sales process – from demand analysis to quotation preparation and negotiation to successful conclusion of contracts They work closely with technical experts, project management, operations and other internal teams to ensure customer-oriented and actionable solutions You create convincing offers and presentations that clearly show the added value of our service solutions and focus on the specific
• You observe market and technology trends, customer requirements and the competitive environment and derive relevant sales opportunities from them You provide transparent pipeline control, reliable forecasts and regular reporting on sales activities and target achievement You represent our service portfolio with conviction and contribute to further strengthening Hitachi Energy’s position as a leading technology and service partner in the Swiss energy market Your background Completed studies in business administration, engineering, marketing or a comparable area Several years of experience in service sales, ideally in the energy branch Strong understanding of customer needs, market mechanisms and the
• Requirements for a reliable energy infrastructure Joy of customer contact, high service orientation, commercial flair and the ability to technical energy infrastructure

Chez Hitachi Energy, nous menons un avenir énergétique durable pour tous. Afin de renforcer notre activité de service en Suisse, nous recherchons une personnalité expérimentée et orientée vers le client dans la gestion des ventes de services qui puisse développer davantage notre portefeuille de services en Suisse germanophone et francophone et permettre une croissance à long terme. Dans ce rôle, vous êtes proche du marché et de nos clients. Ils établissent des relations de confiance, comprennent les besoins techniques et commerciaux des clients et développent des solutions de service convaincantes ainsi que des domaines spécialisés internes. Nous accompagnons nos clients tout au long du cycle de vie de leurs systèmes à haute tension et apportons une contribution importante à une alimentation électrique sûre, fiable et durable en Suisse. Vous pouvez le faire en élaborant et en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies de vente pour les entreprises de services dans les régions désignées et contribuer activement à la réalisation de nos objectifs de croissance et de vente, en identifiant et en développant de nouvelles possibilités d'affaires pour notre portefeuille de services, y compris la maintenance, la modernisation, le conseil technique, les solutions numériques et d'autres services à valeur ajoutée Vous construisez des relations client durables avec les décideurs et les parties prenantes concernées et positionnez Hitachi Energy comme un partenaire fiable sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie de l'usine Vous contrôlez l'ensemble du processus de vente – de l'analyse de la demande à la préparation et la négociation des devis à la conclusion réussie des contrats Ils travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des experts techniques, la gestion de projet, les opérations et d'autres équipes internes pour garantir des solutions orientées vers le client et réalisables Vous créez des offres et des présentations convaincantes qui montrent clairement la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions de service et se concentrent sur les

descriptions.it: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. The Global Transfer of Technology Process Professional is responsible for driving the standardization, optimization, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes across HITACHI ENERGY Distribution Transformers global operations. This role involves defining best practices, developing new process technologies, and implementing robust solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and cost-effectiveness. How you'll make an impact: Define, document, and standardize manufacturing processes globally, ensuring consistency and adherence to best practices as well as making sure these are globally transferred to support capacity expansion projects. Lead and support process improvement initiatives, utilizing methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and Industry 4.0 principles to optimize manufacturing operations. Identify opportunities for process automation, digital transformation, and the integration of advanced manufacturing technologies. Collaborate with R&D, engineering, production, quality teams and especially with our Global Platform Leaders to ensure seamless new product introductions and process validations&Develop and deliver training programs to manufacturing personnel on new processes, technologies, and improvement methodologies. Conduct process audits and performance analyses to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement. Benchmark internal and external manufacturing processes to identify industry best practices and innovative solutions. Manage complex process improvement & capacity expansion projects, including scope definition, resource allocation, timeline management, and stakeholder communication. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, regulations, and internal quality management systems&Provide expert technical support and guidance to manufacturing sites worldwide on process-related issues. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external & internal regulations, procedures & guidelines. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or related field). Master's degree preferred. Strong experience in manufacturing engineering, process development, or continuous improvement roles within a global manufacturing environment. Proven track record of successfully leading and implementing significant manufacturing process improvements and transfer of technology projects. Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma methodologies (Green Belt or Black Belt certification highly desirable) & Experience with advanced manufacturing technologies, automation, and digital manufacturing solutions (e.g., MES, SCADA, AI\/ML in manufacturing). Proficiency in process simulation software, CAD\/CAM tools, and statistical analysis software. Excellent project management, analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously and effectively influence stakeholders at all organizational levels. Ability to travel internationally as required (up to 30-50%). Fluency in English is required; proficiency in other languages is a plus. More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical, and mental wellbeing, as well as your professional growth. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a Project Manager to strengthen our Team in our Business Unit Transformers, Ticino. In this role you are leading the execution of medium-size projects mainly related to LV & MV Transformers and Reactors and ensure that all related activities are performed in accordance with Hitachi Energy policy, quality standards, health & safety and environment requirements. Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. Please submit your resume in English. How you'll make an impact Developing project schedules, and determining resource requirements Monitoring and reporting on the status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing Ensuring adherence to internal and external quality standards (e.g., International Standards Organization) Manage After-Sales projects by ensuring the fulfillment of customer needs Identifying\/resolving obstacles to completing project on time and to budget May include work managing multiple, interrelated projects (including business transformation projects) On some projects, the work may include integrating vendor tasks into the project plan and tracking and reviewing vendor deliverables Your background Electrical Engineering or mechanical Engineering Background 2-3 years proven experience in Project Management with focus on Transformers and Reactors Collaboration with diverse number of stakeholders Very good knowledge of English and Italian; any other languages are a plus Strong communicator, self-driven and open-minded Structured and organized person with the ability to work under time pressure Team-player able to build and motivate a project team More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity  We are looking for a motivated engineering intern to join the Bipolar Semiconductor Process Engineering team in Lenzburg. The internship offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of semiconductor manufacturing, quality engineering, and digital transformation.  The primary objective of this assignment is to transform an existing Digital Quality Control (DQC) prototype into a robust production application that can be used daily by operators and engineers on the Bipolar manufacturing line. The solution will become an integral part of the factory's quality management system and support the prevention of defects, process deviations, and customer escapes. The DQC initiative builds on ongoing efforts to digitalize quality checkpoints and process controls within the Bipolar semiconductor fabrication environment.  This is a hands-on assignment with direct exposure to semiconductor manufacturing processes, operator workflows, quality assurance systems, database applications, and continuous improvement activities.  How you'll make an impact  Analyze and enhance the existing Digital Quality Control (DQC) solution to support its transition into daily manufacturing operations  Develop user-friendly software features and workflows that improve quality control, usability, and operational efficiency  Collaborate with operators, engineers, shift leaders, and quality specialists to gather requirements and implement practical solutions  Support the integration of manufacturing process controls and quality checkpoints into digital systems  Analyze process and quality data, identify trends, and contribute to data-driven improvement initiatives  Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations to support operational and quality-related decision making  Participate in testing, validation, deployment, and user training activities to ensure a successful system rollout  Contribute to technical documentation, work instructions, and continuous improvement efforts that enhance long-term system reliability and performance  Your background  Degree, apprenticeship, relevant training, or practical experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field  Experience with software development using Python, C#, JavaScript, or similar programming languages  Familiarity with databases, SQL, and data management concepts.   Understanding of data visualization, reporting tools, and analytical methods  Knowledge of software testing, debugging, and quality assurance practices  Interest in digital manufacturing, Industry 4.0, process automation, and continuous improvement  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on and proactive mindset  Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a manufacturing environment  More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it: The opportunity We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced  Team Lead for GCB tendering team  to join our dynamic team at Hitachi Energy Ltd. In this role, you will lead a group of GCB tendering managers, drive performance, manage daily sales operation and play a key part in achieving ambitious maintenance sales growth. If you are passionate about leadership, strategy, sales tool and process improvement, and building strong client relationships, this is your chance to make an impact. How you'll make an impact Lead, mentor, and coach GCB tendering team members to achieve and exceed team and individual sales targets Conduct one-on-one meetings to provide constructive feedback, identify training needs, and support professional development Recruit, onboard and develop of new team members Elaborate and implement effective sales strategies to increase GCB maintenance market penetration and drive sustainable service order growth Coordination and active pursuits of quotations\/tenders. Ensure professional quotations within the required timeline, provide technical\/commercial clarification, follow negotiations till booking the orders and handover to Order Management team in an efficient way. Ensure consistent development and implementation of sales tools such as Configure Price Quote (CPQ) platform with its process guideline and practices; Continuously improve the sales tools and process with the target of standardization, efficient end-to-end process and improved speed in quotation time in the GCB tendering team. Monitor the GCB maintenance sales pipeline, forecast results, and provide regular performance reports and market intelligence to management Support in developing innovative and customer-oriented GCB maintenance service solutions and proactively drive their market introduction Collaborate with LSU sales team, and internal functions to align sales efforts with company objectives Stay informed about GCB market trends, market conditions, and competitor activities to refine strategies and proactively share information with internal stakeholders. Your background Senior Professional with international business experience and a proven track-record in GCB business 5 years' experience in sales, technical sales or business development Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets. Strong knowledge of sales methodologies, account management, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), and analytics Excellent leadership, cross-cultural communication, and presentation skills Ability to inspire, influence and develop a high-performing team Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving abilities Strong customer focus and result-oriented personality Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite English on negotiation level, other languages (e.g. German) are a plus More about us You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion, and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be' and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all Flexible working, including hybrid\/remote working opportunities A competitive compensation and benefits package

descriptions.it: The opportunity   Join the Product Evaluation & Qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg. You will play a key role in developing, integrating, and commissioning advanced electrical test systems used for the characterization, validation, and qualification of power semiconductor devices and modules. In this role, you will design, integrate, and commission electrical test solutions while collaborating with experts across R&D, laboratories, and external partners. To strengthen our laboratory and test infrastructure capabilities, we are looking for a highly motivated engineer who enjoys combining system thinking with hands-on engineering. This role offers broad exposure to power electronics, laboratory infrastructure, and product qualification activities. You will continuously expand your technical expertise while contributing to innovative technologies for renewable energy, transportation, industrial applications, and HVDC systems. How you'll make an impact   Develop and integrate electrical test systems for power semiconductor characterization and evaluation Lead the design of solutions for high-power testing applications Commission, troubleshoot, and optimize laboratory test equipment Collaborate with R&D teams to support product development and validation Integrate measurement systems, sensors, power supplies, and automation solutions Define system requirements and coordinate activities with external partners Investigate equipment failures and support root cause analysis activities Create technical documentation, specifications, and test procedures Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics or a related field Experience in system engineering, hardware integration, or test engineering Solid understanding of power electronics and electrical measurement systems Hands-on experience with commissioning, troubleshooting, and laboratory equipment Ability to read and understand electrical schematics and technical drawings Strong communication skills and fluency in English More About Us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefit programs to support your financial, physical, and mental well-being, as well as your personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us – in work and out.   Benefits: Generous retirement savings options to help you plan for your future Subsidized gym memberships to support your health and wellness Enjoy discounts on a variety of products and services, including electronics, groceries, and travel If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply!

descriptions.it: The opportunity Join the Product Evaluation & Qualification team at Hitachi Energy Semiconductors in Lenzburg. You will play a key role in developing, integrating, and commissioning advanced electrical test systems used for the characterization, validation, and qualification of power semiconductor devices and modules. In this role, you will design, integrate, and commission electrical test solutions while collaborating with experts across R&D, laboratories, and external partners. To strengthen our laboratory and test infrastructure capabilities, we are looking for a highly motivated engineer who enjoys combining system thinking with hands-on engineering. This role offers broad exposure to power electronics, laboratory infrastructure, and product qualification activities. You will continuously expand your technical expertise while contributing to innovative technologies for renewable energy, transportation, industrial applications, and HVDC systems. How you'll make an impact Develop and integrate electrical test systems for power semiconductor characterization and evaluation Lead the design of solutions for high-power testing applications Commission, troubleshoot, and optimize laboratory test equipment Collaborate with R&D teams to support product development and validation Integrate measurement systems, sensors, power supplies, and automation solutions Define system requirements and coordinate activities with external partners Investigate equipment failures and support root cause analysis activities Create technical documentation, specifications, and test procedures Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics or a related field Experience in system engineering, hardware integration, or test engineering Solid understanding of power electronics and electrical measurement systems Hands-on experience with commissioning, troubleshooting, and laboratory equipment Ability to read and understand electrical schematics and technical drawings Strong communication skills and fluency in English More About Us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefit programs to support your financial, physical, and mental well-being, as well as your personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us – in work and out. Benefits: Generous retirement savings options to help you plan for your future Subsidized gym memberships to support your health and wellness Enjoy discounts on a variety of products and services, including electronics, groceries, and travel If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply!

descriptions.it: The opportunity Lead and manage a team of procurement professionals to ensure efficient and effective operational procurement activities, supporting HITACHI ENERGY business objectives and supply chain optimization. How you'll make an impact Manage and mentor a team of procurement specialists, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment. Oversee the end-to-end operational procurement process, including requisitioning, purchase order creation, expediting, and invoice resolution. Develop and implement procurement strategies to optimize delivery performance for assigned categories. Monitor key procurement metrics, analyze performance data, and identify areas for improvement. Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders (e.g., engineering, manufacturing, logistics, finance, planning ) to understand their needs and ensure timely and effective supply. Ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures. Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the procurement function, leveraging best practices and technology. Resolve complex supplier issues effectively and efficiently. Your background Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in procurement, ideally with 2 years in a leadership or supervisory role. Proven experience in operational procurement within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong understanding of procurement best practices and supplier relationship management. Proficiency in SAP Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Certifications such as CIPS (Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply) or equivalent are a plus. English on negotiation level, German should be B1 More about us You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion, and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be' and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all Flexible working, including hybrid\/remote working opportunities A competitive compensation and benefits package

descriptions.it: inThe opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Training & Development Specialist for the Bushing Factory of our Business Unit Transformers to join our team in Zürich-Altstetten shaping the future of energy through world-class learning and development. In this role you will support the line managers regarding skills management, identify training needs and develop local training plans, support the coordination of onboarding activities for new employees and be the local power user of the company's learning management system. Main focus will be our blue collar population followed by our white collar workers. How you will make an impact Maintain and update local skill sets in line with the given framework Identify training needs and develop local training plans aligned with company guidelines Integrate global and regional training initiatives into local curricula Maintain training records and documentation Conduct specified trainings, evaluate training effectiveness, as well as prepare and support internal trainers in delivering on-the-job training Ensure that training delivery aligns with defined standards Coordinate onboarding for new employees in collaboration with HR and managers Ensure completion of onboarding and required training within defined timelines Act as local power user of the learning management system, assign system access, manage user permissions, maintain training records as well as drive continuous process improvements within your area of responsibility Your background University Degree in HR, Pedagogy, Psychology or Engineering Interest in manufacturing processes in a hands-on factory environment Minimum 2-3 years of experience in training, skills\/competency management or Learning & Development Experience in delivering training or workshops preferably in a manufacturing environment Experienced in working with LMS or skills management systems Well structured, self-driven personality with strong communication skills, who can effectively cooperate with operators, supervisors, managers and cross-functional teams in a manufacturing environment Fluent German and English More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance, creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptions.it:
The opportunity We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Team Lead for GCB tendering team to join our dynamic team at Hitachi Energy Ltd. In this role, you will lead a group of GCB tendering managers, drive performance, manage daily sales operation and play a key part in achieving ambitious maintenance sales growth. If you are passionate about leadership, strategy, sales tool and process improvement, and building strong client relationships, this is your chance to make an impact. How you'll make an impact Lead, mentor, and coach GCB tendering team members to achieve and exceed team and individual sales targets Conduct one-on-one meetings to provide constructive feedback, identify training needs, and support professional development Recruit, onboard and develop of new team members Elaborate and implement effective sales strategies to increase GCB maintenance market penetration and drive sustainable service order growth Coordination and active pursuits of quotations\/tenders. Ensure professional quotations within the required timeline, provide technical\/commercial clarification, follow negotiations till booking the orders and handover to Order Management team in an efficient way. Ensure consistent development and implementation of sales tools such as Configure Price Quote (CPQ) platform with its process guideline and practices; Continuously improve the sales tools and process with the target of standardization, efficient end-to-end process and improved speed in quotation time in the GCB tendering team. Monitor the GCB maintenance sales pipeline, forecast results, and provide regular performance reports and market intelligence to management Support in developing innovative and customer-oriented GCB maintenance service solutions and proactively drive their market introduction Collaborate with LSU sales team, and internal functions to align sales efforts with company objectives Stay informed about GCB market trends, market conditions, and competitor activities to refine strategies and proactively share information with internal stakeholders. Your background Senior Professional with international business experience and a proven track-record in GCB business 5 years' experience in sales, technical sales or business development Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets. Strong knowledge of sales methodologies, account management, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), and analytics Excellent leadership, cross-cultural communication, and presentation skills Ability to inspire, influence and develop a high-performing team Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving abilities Strong customer focus and result-oriented personality Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite English on negotiation level, other languages (e.g. German) are a plus More about us You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities

descriptions.it: L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di un responsabile dell'ingegneria all'interno dell'unità operativa, Substation Automation Systems Europe . In questo ruolo, fornirete le risorse ingegneristiche professionali necessarie per la progettazione, l'ingegneria, il test e la messa in servizio di sistemi consegnati attraverso progetti commerciali sotto la responsabilità dell'Unità Operativa. Potrai guidare l'eccellenza operativa e l'esecuzione attraverso un'efficace gestione dell'ingegneria, promuovendo la collaborazione tra la comunità ingegneristica all'interno dei paesi dell'Unità Operativa per condividere soluzioni, carichi di lavoro di equilibrio e le lezioni di leva imparate. Le responsabilità chiave includono: Alllocation delle risorse ingegneristiche giuste per progettare i team in conformità con i processi S&OP. Stabilire interfacce efficienti tra team di ingegneria e OPC, aumentando l'utilizzo di OPC. Gestione dei rapporti con i clienti rispetto alle esigenze tecniche. In questo ruolo, si segnala al Manager Unità Operativa, Substation Automation Systems Europe . Come farete un impatto guidare i team di ingegneria e possedere la gestione delle prestazioni dei materiali di ingegneria in tutta l'unità operativa in Europa. Servire come proprietario del processo aziendale per i processi di ingegneria e test. Mentore e sviluppo di leader di funzioni ingegneristiche e membri del team, promuovendo una cultura di innovazione, collaborazione e eccellenza. Costruire e mantenere forti relazioni con i clienti chiave, così come gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. Coordinare l'implementazione e l'adesione a processi di ingegneria globale, standard, pratiche, procedure, strumenti e iniziative di digitalizzazione in collaborazione con il Global Product Group e altre unità operative in tutta l'unità aziendale. Definire e condurre l'implementazione di iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso processi e strumenti di ingegneria, allineati con le strategie Business Unit e Global Product Group. Monitorare i KPI e le metriche di performance per garantire l'eccellenza operativa e l'allineamento strategico. Partecipa al processo di budgeting insieme al Responsabile Unità Operativa e al Controller. Assicurarsi che l'area di responsabilità sia strutturata per sostenere il modello aziendale, adeguatamente occupata con risorse qualificate e gestita efficacemente. Guidare, motivare e sviluppare rapporti diretti e indiretti secondo le politiche HR. Controllare le valutazioni delle competenze e garantire che il personale di ingegneria detiene le licenze e le certificazioni appropriate. I valori fondamentali di sicurezza, integrità e qualità del campione Hitachi Energy assumendo la responsabilità delle vostre azioni mentre si occupano dei vostri colleghi e degli affari. La tua laurea di primo livello o master in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria energetica, o un campo correlato. Più di 15 anni di esperienza ingegneristica nel settore energetico, tra cui almeno 5 anni in un ruolo di leadership globale. Leader orientato ai risultati con una forte passione per lo sviluppo, la leadership, l'impegno degli stakeholder e la collaborazione. Un eccellente comunicatore con la capacità di influenzare al di là delle vostre responsabilità organizzative dirette e pensare strategicamente. Esperienza di lavoro all'interno di una multinazionale e di un ambiente di ingegneria globale. Forte conoscenza dei sistemi energetici, delle infrastrutture di rete, delle tecnologie rinnovabili e dei quadri normativi all'interno del business del progetto di utilità e\/o infrastruttura industriale, combinati con una solida comprensione dei principi ingegneristici e con un comprovato record di tracciato di fornitura di progetti di ingegneria complessi in più geografie.
descriptions.en: The Opportunity We are looking for an Engineering Manager within the Operating Unit, Substation Automation Systems Europe . In this role, you will provide the professional engineering resources required for the design, engineering, testing, and commissioning of systems delivered through commercial projects under the responsibility of the Operating Unit. You will drive operational and execution excellence through effective engineering management while fostering collaboration across the engineering community within the Operating Unit's countries to share solutions, balance workloads, and leverage lessons learned. Key responsibilities include: Allocating the right engineering resources to project teams in accordance with S&OP processes. Establishing efficient interfaces between engineering teams and OPCs while increasing OPC utilization. Managing customer relationships with respect to technical requirements. In this role, you will report to the Operating Unit Manager, Substation Automation Systems Europe . How You'll Make an Impact Lead the engineering teams and own the performance management of engineering deliverables across the Operating Unit in Europe. Serve as the Business Process Owner for engineering and testing processes. Mentor and develop engineering function leaders and team members, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, as well as internal and external stakeholders. Coordinate the implementation of and adherence to global engineering processes, standards, practices, procedures, tools, and digitalization initiatives in collaboration with the Global Product Group and other Operating Units across the Business Unit. Define and lead the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives across engineering processes and tools, aligned with Business Unit and Global Product Group strategies. Monitor KPIs and performance metrics to ensure operational excellence and strategic alignment. Participate in the budgeting process together with the Operating Unit Manager and Controller. Ensure that the area of responsibility is structured to support the business model, adequately staffed with skilled resources, and effectively managed. Guide, motivate, and develop direct and indirect reports in accordance with HR policies. Oversee competency assessments and ensure engineering personnel hold the appropriate licenses and certifications. Champion Hitachi Energy's core values of safety, integrity, and quality by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your Background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a related field. More than 15 years of engineering experience in the energy sector, including at least 5 years in a global leadership role. A results-oriented leader with a strong passion for people development, leadership, stakeholder engagement, and collaboration. An excellent communicator with the ability to influence beyond your direct organizational responsibilities and think strategically. Experience working within a multinational corporation and a global engineering environment. Strong knowledge of energy systems, grid infrastructure, renewable technologies, and regulatory frameworks within the utility and\/or industrial infrastructure project business, combined with a solid understanding of engineering principles and a proven track record of delivering complex engineering projects across multiple geographies.
descriptions.de: Die Chance Wir suchen einen Engineering Manager innerhalb der Operating Unit, Substation Automation Systems Europe. In dieser Rolle stellen Sie die professionellen Engineering-Ressourcen bereit, die für das Design, Engineering, Testen und Inbetriebnehmen von Systemen erforderlich sind, die durch kommerzielle Projekte unter der Verantwortung der Operating Unit geliefert werden. Sie werden operative und exekutive Exzellenz durch effektives Engineering-Management fördern und gleichzeitig die Zusammenarbeit in der gesamten Engineering-Community in den Ländern der Operating Unit fördern, um Lösungen auszutauschen, Workloads auszugleichen und die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse zu nutzen. Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören: Zuweisung der richtigen Engineering-Ressourcen an Projektteams gemäß S&OP-Prozessen. Etablierung effizienter Schnittstellen zwischen Engineering-Teams und OPCs bei gleichzeitiger Erhöhung der OPC-Auslastung. Management der Kundenbeziehungen in Bezug auf technische Anforderungen. In dieser Funktion berichten Sie an den Operating Unit Manager, Substation Automation Systems Europe. How You'll Make an Impact Führen Sie die Engineering-Teams und besitzen Sie das Leistungsmanagement von Engineering-Leistungen in der gesamten operativen Einheit in Europa. Dienen Sie als Business Process Owner für Engineering- und Testprozesse. Mentor und entwickeln Engineering Funktion Führungskräfte und Teammitglieder, eine Kultur der Innovation, Zusammenarbeit und Exzellenz zu fördern. Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu wichtigen Kunden sowie zu internen und externen Stakeholdern. Koordinieren Sie die Implementierung und Einhaltung globaler Engineering-Prozesse, Standards, Praktiken, Verfahren, Tools und Digitalisierungsinitiativen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Global Product Group und anderen operativen Einheiten in der gesamten Business Unit. Definieren und leiten Sie die Umsetzung von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen in allen Engineering-Prozessen und -Tools, ausgerichtet auf Business Unit- und Global Product Group-Strategien. Überwachung von KPIs und Leistungskennzahlen, um operative Exzellenz und strategische Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten. Beteiligen Sie sich am Budgetierungsprozess zusammen mit dem Operating Unit Manager und Controller. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Verantwortungsbereich so strukturiert ist, dass er das Geschäftsmodell unterstützt, angemessen mit qualifizierten Ressourcen ausgestattet ist und effektiv verwaltet wird. Führen, motivieren und entwickeln Sie direkte und indirekte Berichte in Übereinstimmung mit HR-Richtlinien. Beaufsichtigen Sie die Kompetenzbewertungen und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Ingenieurpersonal über die entsprechenden Lizenzen und Zertifizierungen verfügt. Champion Hitachi Energys Kernwerte Sicherheit, Integrität und Qualität, indem Sie Verantwortung für Ihr Handeln übernehmen und sich um Ihre Kollegen und das Unternehmen kümmern. Ihr Hintergrund Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich. Mehr als 15 Jahre Ingenieurserfahrung im Energiesektor, davon mindestens 5 Jahre in einer globalen Führungsrolle. Eine ergebnisorientierte Führungskraft mit einer starken Leidenschaft für die Entwicklung von Menschen, Führung, Stakeholder-Engagement und Zusammenarbeit. Ein ausgezeichneter Kommunikator mit der Fähigkeit, über Ihre direkten organisatorischen Verantwortlichkeiten hinaus Einfluss zu nehmen und strategisch zu denken. Erfahrung in einem multinationalen Unternehmen und einer globalen Engineering-Umgebung. Starkes Wissen über Energiesysteme, Netzinfrastruktur, erneuerbare Technologien und regulatorische Rahmenbedingungen innerhalb des Versorgungs- und / oder Industrieinfrastrukturprojektgeschäfts, kombiniert mit einem soliden Verständnis der technischen Prinzipien und einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung komplexer Engineering-Projekte in mehreren Regionen.
descriptions.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un responsable technique au sein de l'unité d'exploitation, Substation Automation Systems Europe . Dans ce rôle, vous fournirez les ressources d'ingénierie professionnelle nécessaires pour la conception, l'ingénierie, les essais et la mise en service de systèmes fournis dans le cadre de projets commerciaux sous la responsabilité de l'unité d'exploitation. Vous favoriserez l'excellence opérationnelle et l'exécution grâce à une gestion de l'ingénierie efficace tout en favorisant la collaboration dans les pays de l'unité opérationnelle afin de partager les solutions, d'équilibrer la charge de travail et de tirer parti des leçons apprises. Les principales responsabilités comprennent : Attribuer les ressources d'ingénierie appropriées aux équipes de projet conformément aux processus S&OP. Établir des interfaces efficaces entre les équipes de génie et les CPVP tout en augmentant l'utilisation du CPVP. Gestion des relations avec les clients en ce qui concerne les exigences techniques. Dans ce rôle, vous ferez rapport au gestionnaire d'unité d'exploitation, Sous-station Automation Systems Europe . Comment vous ferez un impact Dirigez les équipes d'ingénierie et possédez la gestion de la performance des produits d'ingénierie dans l'ensemble de l'unité opérationnelle en Europe. Servir de propriétaire de processus opérationnels pour les processus d'ingénierie et d'essai. Mentor et développer des chefs de fonction en génie et des membres d'équipe, favorisant une culture d'innovation, de collaboration et d'excellence. Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les principaux clients, ainsi qu'avec les intervenants internes et externes. Coordonner la mise en œuvre et le respect des initiatives mondiales d'ingénierie, de normalisation, de pratiques, de procédures, d'outils et de numérisation, en collaboration avec le Groupe mondial des produits et d'autres unités opérationnelles de l'unité opérationnelle. Définir et diriger la mise en œuvre d'initiatives d'amélioration continue à l'échelle des processus et des outils d'ingénierie, conformément aux stratégies de l'unité opérationnelle et du Groupe mondial des produits. Surveiller les ICR et les mesures du rendement pour assurer l'excellence opérationnelle et l'alignement stratégique. Participer au processus de budgétisation en collaboration avec le gestionnaire et contrôleur de l'unité opérationnelle. Veiller à ce que le domaine de responsabilité soit structuré de façon à appuyer le modèle d'entreprise, à ce que le personnel dispose de ressources qualifiées et à ce qu'il soit géré efficacement. Guider, motiver et élaborer des rapports directs et indirects conformément aux politiques des RH. Superviser les évaluations des compétences et s'assurer que le personnel d'ingénierie détient les licences et les certifications appropriées. Les valeurs fondamentales de sécurité, d'intégrité et de qualité du champion Hitachi Energy en prenant la responsabilité de vos actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise. Votre baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique, en génie énergétique ou dans un domaine connexe. Plus de 15 ans d'expérience en ingénierie dans le secteur de l'énergie, y compris au moins 5 ans dans un rôle de leadership mondial. Leader axé sur les résultats, passionné par le développement des personnes, le leadership, l'engagement des intervenants et la collaboration. Un excellent communicateur avec la capacité d'influencer au-delà de vos responsabilités organisationnelles directes et de penser stratégiquement. Expérience de travail au sein d'une société multinationale et d'un environnement d'ingénierie mondial. Forte connaissance des systèmes énergétiques, de l'infrastructure du réseau, des technologies renouvelables et des cadres réglementaires dans le cadre des activités de projets d'infrastructure d'utilité et/ou industrielle, combinée à une solide compréhension des principes d'ingénierie et à une expérience éprouvée de la réalisation de projets d'ingénierie complexes dans plusieurs géographies.
